ch.682dafa0928edd0f3702312f: 怎么样，塔科夫还好混吗？
ch.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: 你是来办事的，还是来喝一杯的？
ch.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: 看看你，一副正事儿样！去吧，忙你的。
ch.68adfa8dc49e78bddcc10e00: 我手下的人会送你出去。
ch.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: 行了，你在这儿待够久了。
ch.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: 我正准备把你赶出去呢。保重！
ch.68adfb1db6badbfc4248b330: 没有折扣，心理准备好点。
ch.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: 你简直像是知道我刚补了货一样！
ch.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: 别指望我白给你好处，新兵。
ch.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: 我今天心情好才让你进来的。说吧，要什么？
ch.68c30cdd9fa982553ae29611: 你是不是把什么东西落这儿了？
ch.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: 怎么样，战士？都搞定了吗？
ch.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: 啊，是你，士兵。任务完成了吧？
ch.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: 真难以相信你这么快就干完了。都完成了？
ch.68c30e976944a14e32ebca58: 你是来汇报进度的？全搞定了？
ch.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: 还以为一阵子见不到你呢。都准备好了?
ch.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: 还没完成。我想问你点事。
ch.68c30f748041cbea83522701: 还没，但我现在就去做完。
ch.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: 哎哟，这就搞砸了，战士。赶紧补救，把活干完！
ch.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: 你知道任务没完成我什么都不会给你……？行吧，你想问啥？
ch.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: 既然你觉得事情重要到能丢下任务……说吧，发生什么了？
ch.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: 行，说吧。但快点！我还有事。
ch.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: 那你还杵在这儿干嘛？去干你的活，大兵！
ch.68c31031513e917215a56638: 最好动作快点，战士！没干完别回来！
ch.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: 是要我夸你才肯动身吗？赶紧去干！
ch.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: 拖延是最蠢的。现在就去做，完事再回来。
ch.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: 放松点，大兵！我看塔科夫已经把你折腾得不轻了。早点习惯吧，这地方只会越来越难。
ch.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: 让我看看有什么活，大兵。
ch.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: 这儿总有活给你的，战士。
ch.68cc2216494fa991d585d6b2: 让我想想有什么给你做。
ch.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: 既然你亲自拖着你那小身板来了，我就给你找点活干。
ch.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: 哟，瞧瞧这是谁啊——“我数不到三”的先生！别摆出那张臭脸了，我什么都知道。来，说说看，这事咱怎么处理？
ch.68fced4b72306ae373c1d8e9: 我就是为了这事儿来的。
ch.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: 什么都还没做完。我是来问你点事的。
ch.6914771dd291a45e529aaff3: 怎么样，塔科夫还好混吗？
ch.69147795130c033656af3031: 我手下的人送你进来的时候没把你折腾得太狠吧？

cz.682dafa0928edd0f3702312f: Tak co, jak se k tobě chová Tarkov?
cz.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: Jsi tu kvůli kšeftům, nebo dáme panáka na kuráž?
cz.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: Tak jo, už ses tu motal dost dlouho.
cz.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: Už jsem tě chtěl vyhodit. Měj se!
cz.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: Skoro jako bys věděl, že mi zrovna dorazila nová várka!
cz.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: Nečekej, že budu dělat laskavosti zadarmo, zelenáči.
cz.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: Pustil jsem tě sem jenom proto, že mám dneska dobrou náladu. Co chceš?
cz.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: Sakra, to bylo rychlý. Všechno připravený?
cz.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: Á, to jsi ty, vojáku. Úkol splněn, předpokládám?
cz.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: Těžko uvěřit, že jsi to dodělal tak rychle. Všechno hotovo?
cz.68c30e976944a14e32ebca58: Jsi tu s novinkama? Všechno splněno?
cz.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Myslel jsem, že tě chvíli neuvidím. Všechno připravený?
cz.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: Ještě není hotovo. Chtěl jsem se tě na něco zeptat.
cz.68c30f748041cbea83522701: Ještě ne, ale jdu to hned dodělat.
cz.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: No-no, to je průser, válečníku. Běž to spravit a dokonči tu práci!
cz.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: Uvědomuješ si, že ode mě nic nedostaneš, dokud nebude úkol splněn…? Dobře, co chceš?
cz.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: No, když už je to tak důležitý, že jsi se rozhodl vykašlat na práci… Co se děje?
cz.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Tak poslouchej, ale rychle! Mám i jiný věci na práci.
cz.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Tak co tu ještě děláš? Mazej si po svejch, vojáku!
cz.68c31031513e917215a56638: Musíš bejt rychlejší, válečníku! Nelez mi na oči, dokud nebude hotovo.
cz.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: Mám tě za to snad chválit? Běž to udělat!
cz.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Odkládat to donekonečna je debilní nápad. Udělej to hned a pak se vrať.
cz.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: Klid, vojáku! Koukám, že tě Tarkov už trochu prohnal. Radši si zvykej, nebude to snadnější.
cz.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: Kouknem se, co tu máme, vojáku.
cz.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: Vždycky se pro tebe něco najde, válečníku.
cz.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Dobře, mrknu se, třeba se něco najde.
cz.68cc2210b82eb7a3bacf2db9: Vždycky se mi hodí pár rukou navíc.
cz.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Když už jsi se dovlekl až sem osobně, něco pro tebe najdu.
cz.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: Hele, kdo se nám to ukázal, pan "neumím napočítat do tří"! Nedělej takový obličeje, já vím o všem. Tak co s tím vším budeme dělat, co?
cz.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: Ještě není hotovo. Hned to půjdu udělat.
cz.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Ještě není nic hotový. Chtěl jsem se tě na něco zeptat.
cz.6914771dd291a45e529aaff3: Tak co, jak se k tobě chová Tarkov?
cz.69147795130c033656af3031: Moji kluci tě cestou sem moc nezřídili, co?

fr.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: Tu es là pour affaires, ou on se prend un verre vite fait ?
fr.68adfa886b35a7e701e3ebe8: Ça marche, je ne te retiens pas.
fr.68adfa8dc49e78bddcc10e00: Mes gars vont t’accompagner vers la sortie.
fr.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: Bon, tu as assez traîné dans le coin.
fr.68adfa9b42e255921f3934d5: Ciao, Buratino ! Repasse quand tu veux.
fr.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: J’étais justement sur le point de te mettre dehors. Prends soin de toi !
fr.68adfae7fed02eca24fd8f78: T’as du liquide sur toi, j’espère ?
fr.68adfaec2e4e6d7320723e14: J’attendais que tu me le demandes !
fr.68adfb2258d658b7520775a0: Tu cherches quelque chose de précis ?
fr.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: Comme si tu savais que je venais juste d’être réapprovisionné !
fr.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: Ne t’attends pas à des faveurs gratuites, bleu.
fr.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: Je t’ai laissé entrer parce que je suis d’humeur généreuse aujourd’hui. Qu’est-ce que tu veux ?
fr.68c30cdd9fa982553ae29611: Tu aurais oublié quelque chose ici ?
fr.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: Alors, guerrier, ça avance ? Tout est fait ?
fr.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: Putain, c’était rapide. Tout est prêt ?
fr.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: Ah, c’est toi, soldat. Mission terminée, je suppose ?
fr.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: Difficile à croire que tu aies fini si vite. Tout est fait ?
fr.68c30e976944a14e32ebca58: Tu viens faire un rapport ? Tout est bouclé ?
fr.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Je pensais ne pas revoir ta tête de sitôt. Tout est prêt ?
fr.68c30ea2e0927f7131c35a7c: Encore toi. Situation de la mission ?
fr.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: Ce n’est pas encore fait. Je voulais vous demander quelque chose.
fr.68c30f748041cbea83522701: Pas encore, mais je vais m’en occuper tout de suite.
fr.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: Eh ben bravo, guerrier. Va réparer ta connerie et termine le boulot !
fr.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: Tu te rends compte que tu n’obtiendras rien tant que la mission n’est pas terminée… Bon, qu’est-ce que tu veux ?
fr.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: Vu l’importance, tu as décidé de lâcher la mission ? Qu’est-ce qui se passe ?
fr.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Très bien, parle. Mais fais vite, j’ai du travail.
fr.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Alors qu’est-ce que tu fais encore là ? Va faire ton boulot, soldat !
fr.68c31031513e917215a56638: Tu dois être plus rapide, guerrier. Ne reviens pas avant d’avoir tout terminé.
fr.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: Je suis censé te féliciter pour ça ? Va t’y remettre.
fr.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Remettre ça à plus tard est une idée stupide. Fais-le maintenant, puis reviens.
fr.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: Repos, soldat ! Je vois que Tarkov t’a déjà un peu amoché. Autant t’y habituer tout de suite, parce que ça ne va certainement pas devenir plus facile.
fr.68cc21f2fe73a59178b9dfdd: Vous avez du boulot pour moi ?
fr.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: Voyons voir ce que j'ai, soldat.
fr.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: Il y a toujours quelque chose pour toi, guerrier.
fr.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Laisse-moi regarder, j'ai peut être quelque chose.
fr.68cc2210b82eb7a3bacf2db9: J'ai toujours besoin d'une paire de bras.
fr.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Puisque tu t’es bougé le cul jusqu’ici en personne, je vais te trouver quelque chose.
fr.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: Oh, regardez-moi ça, monsieur « je ne sais pas compter jusqu’à trois » ! Ne fais pas cette tête, je sais tout. Alors, qu’est-ce qu’on fait de tout ça, hein ?
fr.68fced4b72306ae373c1d8e9: Je suis justement là pour ça.
fr.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: Pas encore fait. Je vais m’en occuper.
fr.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Ce n’est toujours pas fait. Je voulais vous demander quelque chose.
fr.69147795130c033656af3031: Mes gars ne t’ont pas trop amoché en t’amenant ici, au moins ?

hu.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Then what are you still doing here? Go do your job, soldier!

hu.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: Am I supposed to praise you for that? Go do it!
hu.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Putting things off forever is a dumb move. Do it now, then come back.
hu.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: At ease, soldier! I can see Tarkov’s already roughed you up a bit. Better get used to it now, since it’s not gonna get any easier.
hu.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: Let’s see what we’ve got, soldier.
hu.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: There’s always something for you, warrior.
hu.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Alright, lemme check, maybe there is something.
hu.68cc2210b82eb7a3bacf2db9: I’m always in need of spare hands.
hu.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Since you dragged your ass here personally, I’ll find something for you.
hu.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: Oh, look who it is, mister “I can’t count to three”! Don’t pull that face, I know everything. So, what do we do with all this, huh?
hu.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: Not done yet. I'll go do it.
hu.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Nothing's done yet. I wanted to ask you something.

it.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: Sei qui per lavoro o ci prendiamo un drink veloce?
it.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: Ma guardati, tutto lavoro! Dai, muoviti.
it.68adfa886b35a7e701e3ebe8: Va bene, allora, non ti trattengo oltre.
it.68adfa8dc49e78bddcc10e00: I miei ragazzi ti accompagneranno fuori.
it.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: Bene, sei rimasto qui abbastanza a lungo.
it.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: Stavo proprio per cacciarti via. Stammi bene!
it.68adfae7fed02eca24fd8f78: Hai dei contanti con te, spero?
it.68adfaec2e4e6d7320723e14: Aspettavo solo che me lo chiedessi!
it.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: Quasi come se sapessi che ho appena ricevuto un nuovo rifornimento!
it.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: Non aspettarti che ti faccia favori gratis, novellino.
it.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: Ti ho fatto entrare solo perché oggi mi sento generoso. Cosa vuoi?
it.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: Allora, come va, guerriero? Tutto fatto?
it.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: Cavolo, è stato veloce. Tutto pronto?
it.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: Ah, sei tu, soldato. Compito completato, presumo?
it.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: È difficile credere che tu abbia finito così in fretta. Hai fatto tutto?
it.68c30e976944a14e32ebca58: Sei qui con gli aggiornamenti? Tutto completato?
it.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Pensavo che non ti avrei visto per un po'. È tutto pronto?
it.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: Non è ancora finita. Volevo chiederti una cosa.
it.68c30f748041cbea83522701: Non ancora, ma vado a finirlo subito.
it.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: Bene, bene, hai fatto un casino, guerriero. Vai a sistemarlo e porta a termine il lavoro!
it.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: Ti rendi conto che non otterrai nulla da me finché la missione non sarà completata... Va bene, cosa vuoi?
it.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: Beh, visto che è così importante che hai deciso di mollare il lavoro... Che sta succedendo?
it.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Va bene, sentiamo. Ma fai in fretta! Ho delle cose da fare.
it.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Allora cosa ci fai ancora qui? Vai a fare il tuo lavoro, soldato!
it.68c31031513e917215a56638: Devi essere più veloce, guerriero! Non tornare finché non avrai finito tutto.
it.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: Dovrei lodarti per questo? Vai a farlo!
it.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Rimandare le cose all'infinito è una mossa stupida. Fallo ora, poi torna indietro.
it.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: Riposo, soldato! Vedo che Tarkov ti ha già malmenato un po'. Meglio che ti ci abitui subito, perché non diventerà più facile.
it.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: C'è sempre qualcosa per te, guerriero.
it.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Va bene, fammi controllare, forse c'è qualcosa.
it.68cc2210b82eb7a3bacf2db9: Ho sempre bisogno di una mano.
it.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Dato che ti sei trascinato qui di persona, ti troverò qualcosa.
it.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: Oh, guarda chi c'è, il signor "Non so contare fino a tre"! Non fare quella faccia, so tutto. Allora, cosa ne facciamo di tutto questo, eh?
it.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: Non ho ancora finito. Vado a farlo.
it.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Non è ancora finita. Volevo chiederti una cosa.
it.69147795130c033656af3031: I miei ragazzi non ti hanno maltrattato troppo durante il viaggio, vero?

jp.682dafa0928edd0f3702312f: で、タルコフでの暮らしはどうだ？
jp.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: 用か？それとも一杯やるか？
jp.682dafa0928edd0f37023135: 何かジョークでも知ってるのか？
jp.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: 仕事の虫って感じだな。ほら、行った行った。
jp.68adfa886b35a7e701e3ebe8: この辺にしとこう。行って来い。
jp.68adfa8dc49e78bddcc10e00: うちの連中が出口まで案内する。
jp.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: もう十分だろう。そろそろ帰れ。
jp.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: 追い出すところだったよ。気を付けてな！
jp.68adfae130da887a69d1463c: 好きなのを選べ、戦士よ。
jp.68adfae7fed02eca24fd8f78: 金は持ってるんだろうな？
jp.68adfb1db6badbfc4248b330: 値引きはしないぞ、覚悟しろ。
jp.68adfb2258d658b7520775a0: なにか探しているのか？
jp.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: 新しい入荷を嗅ぎつけたみたいだな！
jp.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: ただなんて期待するなよ、ルーキー。
jp.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: 今日は気分がいいから入れてやったんだ。で、何だ？
jp.68c30cdd9fa982553ae29611: なにか忘れ物でもしたか？
jp.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: 調子はどうだ、戦士よ。順調か？
jp.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: 随分早かったな。終わらせたのか？
jp.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: おお、兵士さんじゃないか。任務は終わらせたんだよな？
jp.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: こんなに早く終わらせるとは信じがたいな。
jp.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: しばらく顔を見ないと思ったが、できたのか？
jp.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: まだ終わっていない。聞きたいことがある。
jp.68c30f748041cbea83522701: まだだが、すぐ終わらせる。
jp.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: おいおい、それはいただけないな。さっさと終わらせてこい！
jp.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: 任務が完了するまでは何も貰えないことは理解してるよな…？で、なんの用だ？
jp.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: 重要な任務を放ってまで来るとはな…一体何だ？
jp.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: 分かった、聞いてやろう。だが手短にだ！忙しいんだ。
jp.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: 何してるんだ？さっさと仕事をしてこい！
jp.68c31031513e917215a56638: もっと迅速にこなせ、戦士よ！終わるまで戻ってこなくていい。
jp.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: 褒めてほしいのか？行って終わらせくるんだな！
jp.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: いつまでも後回しにするんじゃねえ。今すぐ片付けて来い。
jp.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: 安心しろ兵士。タルコフで痛い目に遭ったみたいだな。だが、もっとキツくなるから慣れるしかないぞ。
jp.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: 見てみようじゃないか、兵士さんよ。
jp.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: いつでも用はあるぞ、戦士。
jp.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: 確認させてくれ。なにかあったかもしれんな。
jp.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: わざわざ来てもらったんだ、何か探してやるよ。
jp.68de9d2f436e87eb8f4b68b1: 今のところなにもないな。
jp.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: 誰かと思えば、「3までしか数えられない君」じゃないか！そんな顔するな。全部知ってるんだ。で、どうするつもりなんだ？
jp.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: まだ終わってない。今すぐやる。
jp.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: まだ何も終わっていない。少し聞きたい事がある。
jp.6914771dd291a45e529aaff3: で、タルコフでの暮らしはどうだ？
jp.6914779021b6ce8656784fdf: おう、そこにいたか、兵士！
jp.69147795130c033656af3031: うちの連中、来る途中でお前をいじめたりしてないよな？

kr.682dafa0928edd0f3702312f: 그래, 타르코프에서 사는 건 좀 어떻나?
kr.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: 볼일이 있어서 온건가? 아니면 한 잔 하려고 온건가?
kr.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: 완전 일 얘기뿐이구만! 자, 이제 가보게.
kr.68adfa886b35a7e701e3ebe8: 가보게, 더 이상 자넬 붙잡고 있을 생각은 없네.

kr.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: 안 그래도 내보낼 참이였네. 조심히 들어가게!

kr.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: 오늘은 내가 기분이 좋아서 들여보내준 걸세. 뭐 찾는 게 있나?
kr.68c30cdd9fa982553ae29611: 허, 뭐 두고 간 거라도 있나?
kr.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: 그래, 일은 어떻게 되가고 있나? 다 끝났나?
kr.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: 젠장, 엄청 빨리도 끝냈군. 다 준비됐나?
kr.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: 아, 자네군. 내가 준 일은 다 끝냈나?

kr.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: 한동안 못 볼 줄 알았는데. 준비됐나?
kr.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: 아직 안 끝났어. 물어볼 게 있어서 찾아왔어.
kr.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: 그래, 그래, 완전 좆됐구만. 가서 해결하고 나서 돌아오게!
kr.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: 임무를 다 끝내기 전까진 나한테서 아무것도 못 받는다는 건 알고 있겠지…? 그래, 뭔가?
kr.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: 엄청 중요한 거라서 내가 준 일도 내팽겨치고 왔다 이거지… 무슨 일인가?
kr.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: 좋아, 말해보게. 대신 짧게! 나도 할 일이 있네.
kr.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: 그럼 대체 여기서 뭘 하고 있는 건가? 임무를 마치고 나서 찾아오게!
kr.68c31031513e917215a56638: 얼른 서둘러야 할걸세! 내가 준 임무를 마치기 전까진 찾아오지 말게.
kr.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: 그걸로 칭찬이라도 해줄 줄 알았나? 어서 돌아가게!
kr.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: 띨띨이처럼 질질 끌지 말게. 지금 당장 가서 끝내고 나서 돌아오게.
kr.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: 쉬어! 타르코프가 자네를 벌써 좀 갈궈놨군. 익숙해지게. 앞으로 더 편해질 날은 없을 걸세.
kr.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: 기다려 보게, 자네한테 줄 일거리가 좀 있을 걸세.
kr.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: 굳이 여기까지 찾아왔으니, 자네한테 시킬만한 걸 찾아보겠네.
kr.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: 어이쿠, 이게 누구야. “셋도 못 세는 양반” 아니신가! 그런 표정 짓지 말게, 난 다 알고 있으니까. 그래서, 이걸 다 어쩌면 좋겠나?
kr.68fced4b72306ae373c1d8e9: 안 그래도 그 얘기를 하려고 왔어.
kr.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: 아직 안 끝났어. 가서 마무리하고 올게.
kr.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: 아직 다 못 끝냈어. 자네한테 물어볼 게 있어서 왔어.
kr.6914771dd291a45e529aaff3: 그래, 타르코프에서 사는 건 좀 어떻나?
kr.69147795130c033656af3031: 오는 길에 우리 애들이 자네한테 모질게 굴진 않았겠지?

pl.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: You here on business, or are we grabbing a quick drink?
pl.682dafa0928edd0f37023136: Hey there warrior, come on in!
pl.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: Look at you, all business! Go on, get moving.
pl.68adfa886b35a7e701e3ebe8: Alright then, don’t let me keep you.
pl.68adfa8dc49e78bddcc10e00: My guys will see you out.
pl.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: Right, you’ve been hanging around long enough.
pl.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: I was just about to kick you out. Take care!

pl.68adfaec2e4e6d7320723e14: I’ve been waiting for you to ask!
pl.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: Almost like you knew I just got a fresh restock in!
pl.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: Don’t expect me to do favors for free, rookie.
pl.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: I only let you in because I’m feeling generous today. What do you want?

pl.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Thought I wouldn’t see your face for a while. Everything ready?

pl.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: Well, since it's so important you decided to ditch the job… What's happening?
pl.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Alright, let’s hear it. Just make it quick! I’ve got things to do.
pl.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Then what are you still doing here? Go do your job, soldier!
pl.68c31031513e917215a56638: You’ve gotta be faster, warrior! Don’t come back until you’ve got it all done.
pl.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: Am I supposed to praise you for that? Go do it!
pl.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Putting things off forever is a dumb move. Do it now, then come back.

pl.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: Let’s see what we’ve got, soldier.
pl.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: There’s always something for you, warrior.
pl.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Alright, lemme check, maybe there is something.
pl.68cc2210b82eb7a3bacf2db9: I’m always in need of spare hands.
pl.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Since you dragged your ass here personally, I’ll find something for you.
pl.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: Oh, look who it is, mister “I can’t count to three”! Don’t pull that face, I know everything. So, what do we do with all this, huh?

pl.6914779b13871fd854360ac4: Hey there warrior, come on in!

po.682dafa0928edd0f3702312f: Então, como Tarkov têm lhe tratado?
po.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: Você está aqui a negócios, ou vamos tomar um drinque rápido?
po.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: Olhe só para você, apenas negócios! Vai lá, se manda.
po.68adfa886b35a7e701e3ebe8: Sem problemas então, não vou te segurar por mais tempo.
po.68adfa8dc49e78bddcc10e00: Meus rapazes te mostrarão a saída.
po.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: Beleza, você já está aqui por tempo suficiente.
po.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: Eu estava prestes a te chutar daqui. Se cuida!
po.68adfae7fed02eca24fd8f78: Você tem dinheiro com você, eu suponho?
po.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: É quase como se você soubesse que eu acabei de receber um carregamento novo!
po.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: Não espera que eu lhe faça favores de graça, novato.
po.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: Eu só deixei você entrar porque eu estou me sentindo generoso hoje. O que você quer?
po.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: Então, como está, guerreiro? Tudo feito?
po.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: Nossa, isso foi rápido. Tudo pronto?
po.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: Há, é você, soldado. Missão cumprida, eu presumo?
po.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: Difícil de acreditar que você terminou aquilo tão rápido. Tudo pronto?
po.68c30e976944a14e32ebca58: Você aqui com novidades? Tudo completo?
po.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Pensei que não veria seu rosto por um tempo. Tudo pronto?
po.68c30ea2e0927f7131c35a7c: Você de novo. Relatório da missão?
po.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: Não está feito ainda. Eu queria te perguntar uma coisa.
po.68c30f748041cbea83522701: Ainda não, mas eu vou terminar isso agora mesmo.
po.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: Ora, ora, que vacilo, guerreiro. Vai lá arrumar isso e termine o serviço!
po.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: Você sabe que não vai conseguir nada de mim enquanto a tarefa não estiver completa...? Beleza, o que você quer?
po.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: Bom, já que é tão importante que você decidiu abandonar o serviço... O que está acontecendo?
po.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Tudo bem, vamos escutar. Mas seja rápido! Eu tenho coisas para fazer.
po.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Então o que você ainda está fazendo aqui? Vá fazer seu trabalho, soldado!
po.68c31031513e917215a56638: Você precisa ser mais rápido, guerreiro! Não volte enquanto não estiver com tudo feito.
po.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: Você quer um elogio para isso? Vá fazer!
po.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Adiar as coisas para sempre é uma burrice. Faça agora, e depois volte.
po.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: À vontade, soldado! Vejo que já te maltrataram um pouco. É melhor se acostumar agora, pois não vai ficar mais fácil.
po.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: Vamos ver o que temos, soldado.
po.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: Sempre tem alguma coisa para você, guerreiro.
po.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Certo, deixa eu ver, talvez tenha alguma coisa.
po.68cc2210b82eb7a3bacf2db9: Eu tô sempre precisando de mão de obra extra.
po.68cc2216494fa991d585d6b2: Deixa eu pensar em alguma coisa.
po.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Já que você arrastou o seu traseiro até aqui pessoalmente, vou arrumar alguma coisa pra você.
po.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: Ora, olha só quem é, o senhor “não sei contar até três”! Não faz essa cara, eu sei de tudo. Então, o que fazemos com isso tudo, hein?
po.68fced4b72306ae373c1d8e9: Eu vim aqui justamente por causa disso.
po.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: Ainda não fiz. Vou lá cuidar disso.
po.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Não fiz nada ainda. Queria te perguntar uma coisa.
po.6914771dd291a45e529aaff3: E aí, como Tarkov tá te tratando?
po.69147795130c033656af3031: Meus rapazes não te maltrataram muito no caminho até aqui, não é?

sk.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: You here on business, or are we grabbing a quick drink?
sk.682dafa0928edd0f37023136: Hey there warrior, come on in!
sk.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: Look at you, all business! Go on, get moving.
sk.68adfa886b35a7e701e3ebe8: Alright then, don’t let me keep you.
sk.68adfa8dc49e78bddcc10e00: My guys will see you out.
sk.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: Right, you’ve been hanging around long enough.
sk.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: I was just about to kick you out. Take care!
sk.68adfae7fed02eca24fd8f78: You got cash on you, I hope?
sk.68adfaec2e4e6d7320723e14: I’ve been waiting for you to ask!
sk.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: Almost like you knew I just got a fresh restock in!
sk.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: Don’t expect me to do favors for free, rookie.
sk.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: I only let you in because I’m feeling generous today. What do you want?
sk.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: So, how’s it going, warrior? Everything done?
sk.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: Damn, that was quick. Everything ready?
sk.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: Ah, it’s you, soldier. Task done, I presume?
sk.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: Hard to believe you finished that so quickly. Everything done?
sk.68c30e976944a14e32ebca58: You here with updates? Everything completed?
sk.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Thought I wouldn’t see your face for a while. Everything ready?
sk.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: It's not done yet. I wanted to ask you something.
sk.68c30f748041cbea83522701: Not yet, but I'll go finish it right now.
sk.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: Well-well, that’s a fuck-up, warrior. Go fix it and finish the job!
sk.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: You realize you’re not getting anything from me until the task is complete…? Alright, what do you want?
sk.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: Well, since it's so important you decided to ditch the job… What's happening?
sk.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Alright, let’s hear it. Just make it quick! I’ve got things to do.
sk.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Then what are you still doing here? Go do your job, soldier!
sk.68c31031513e917215a56638: You’ve gotta be faster, warrior! Don’t come back until you’ve got it all done.
sk.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: Am I supposed to praise you for that? Go do it!
sk.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Putting things off forever is a dumb move. Do it now, then come back.
sk.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: At ease, soldier! I can see Tarkov’s already roughed you up a bit. Better get used to it now, since it’s not gonna get any easier.
sk.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: Let’s see what we’ve got, soldier.
sk.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: There’s always something for you, warrior.
sk.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Alright, lemme check, maybe there is something.
sk.68cc2210b82eb7a3bacf2db9: I’m always in need of spare hands.
sk.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Since you dragged your ass here personally, I’ll find something for you.
sk.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: Oh, look who it is, mister “I can’t count to three”! Don’t pull that face, I know everything. So, what do we do with all this, huh?
sk.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: Not done yet. I'll go do it.
sk.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Nothing's done yet. I wanted to ask you something.
sk.69147795130c033656af3031: My guys didn’t rough you up too much on the way here, did they?
sk.6914779b13871fd854360ac4: Hey there warrior, come on in!

es.682dafa0928edd0f3702312f: Y bien, ¿qué tal te va en Tarkov?
es.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: ¿Vienes por negocios o te apetece una birra?
es.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: ¡Vaya, todo un hombre de negocios! Anda, anda.
es.68adfa886b35a7e701e3ebe8: Vale, no te quito más tiempo.
es.68adfa8dc49e78bddcc10e00: Mis chicos te mostrarán la salida.
es.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: Bien, ya llevas bastante tiempo aquí.
es.68adfb1db6badbfc4248b330: Ya lo sabes, nada de descuentos.
es.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: ¡Es como si supieras que acabo de recibir nuevos suministros!
es.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: No esperes que te haga favores de gratis, novato.
es.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: Solo te he dejado entrar porque hoy me siento generoso. ¿Qué quieres?
es.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: Joder, eso ha sido rápido. ¿Está todo listo?
es.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: Ah, soldado, eres tú. Supongo que has terminado la misión, ¿cierto?
es.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: Me cuesta creer que hayas terminado tan rápido. ¿Está todo listo?
es.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Pensaba que no te vería por un rato. ¿Está todo listo?
es.68c30ea2e0927f7131c35a7c: Tú otra vez. ¿Informe de la misión?
es.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: Aún no he terminado. Quería preguntarte algo.
es.68c30f748041cbea83522701: Aún no, pero iré a terminarla de inmediato.
es.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: Vaya, vaya, qué cagada, guerrero. ¡Ve a arreglarlo y termina el trabajo!
es.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: Te das cuenta de que no conseguirás nada de mí hasta que hayas terminado la misión… ¿verdad? Vale, entonces, ¿qué quieres?
es.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: Bueno, si es algo tan importante que has optado por dejar el curro de lado... ¿Qué ocurre?
es.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Vale, te escucho. ¡Pero que sea rápido! Tengo cosas que hacer.
es.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Entonces, ¿qué haces aquí parado? ¡Anda, soldado, a trabajar!
es.68c31031513e917215a56638: ¡Debes ser más rápido, guerrero! No regreses hasta que lo hayas terminado todo.
es.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: ¿Y qué, tengo que felicitarte por eso? ¡Ve y hazlo!
es.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Dejarlo todo para más tarde es una tontería. Hazlo de una vez y luego vuelves.
es.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: ¡En descanso, soldado! Veo que Tarkov te ha hecho pasar un mal momento. Será mejor que te acostumbres, porque las cosas no se pondrán más fáciles.
es.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: Veamos qué tenemos por aquí, soldado.
es.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: Siempre hay algo nuevo para ti, guerrero.
es.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Vale, déjame ver, tal vez haya algo.
es.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Ya que te has molestado en traer el culo hasta acá, te buscaré trabajo.
es.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: ¡Oh, mira quién es, el señor "No sé contar hasta tres"! No me vengas con esa cara, no me engañas. Bueno, ¿qué haremos con todo esto?
es.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: Aún no termino. Iré a hacerlo.
es.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Aún no he terminado. Quería preguntarte algo.
es.6914771dd291a45e529aaff3: Y bien, ¿qué tal te va en Tarkov?
es.69147795130c033656af3031: ¿Mis chicos no te machacaron demasiado de camino hasta acá, verdad?

tu.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: İş için mi geldin, yoksa hızlıca bir içki mi içiyoruz?
tu.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: Şuna bak, tamamen iş modundasın! Hadi, devam et.
tu.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: Az kalsın seni kapı dışarı edecektim. Kendine dikkat et!
tu.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: Sanki yeni stoğumu tazelediğimi bilmiş gibi geldin!
tu.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: Seni bugün içeri almam tamamen cömertliğimdendi. Ne istiyorsun?
tu.68c30cdd9fa982553ae29611: Burada bir şey mi unuttun, ha?
tu.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: Nasıl gidiyor savaşçı? Her şey tamam mı?
tu.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: Vay be, hızlıymış. Her şey hazır mı?
tu.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: Ah, sensin asker. Görev tamam, öyle mi?
tu.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: Bu kadar çabuk bitirdiğine inanmak zor. Her şey tamam mı?
tu.68c30e976944a14e32ebca58: Güncelleme için mi geldin? Her şey tamamlandı mı?
tu.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Bir süre görünmezsin sanmıştım. Her şey hazır mı?
tu.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: Henüz bitmedi. Sana bir şey sormak istedim.
tu.68c30f748041cbea83522701: Henüz değil, ama hemen gidip bitireceğim.
tu.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: Vay vay, bu fena bir iş olmuş savaşçı. Git düzelt ve görevi bitir!
tu.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: Görev bitmeden benden hiçbir şey alamayacağını biliyorsun… Peki, söyle bakalım ne istiyorsun?
tu.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: Madem o kadar önemli ki işi yarıda bırakıp geldin… Neler oluyor?
tu.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Peki, söyle bakalım. Ama çabuk ol! Yapacak işlerim var.
tu.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Peki hâlâ ne duruyorsun? Git işini yap asker!
tu.68c31031513e917215a56638: Daha hızlı olmalısın savaşçı! Her şey tamam olmadan geri gelme.
tu.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: Bunun için seni övmemi mi bekliyorsun? Git yap!
tu.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Sürekli ertelemek aptallık. Şimdi yap ve sonra gel.
tu.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: Rahat ol asker! Görüyorum ki Tarkov seni çoktan hırpalamış. Alışsan iyi olur, çünkü daha kolay olmayacak.
tu.68cc21f2fe73a59178b9dfdd: Bende yapacak bir iş var mı?
tu.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: Senin için her zaman bir şeyler vardır, savaşçı.
tu.68cc2210b82eb7a3bacf2db9: Her zaman fazladan ele ihtiyacım oluyor.
tu.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Madem buraya kadar zahmet etmişsin, sana bir görev bulurum.
tu.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: Aaa, kim gelmiş! Bay “Üçe kadar sayamayan”! O yüzünü ekşitme, her şeyi biliyorum. Peki bütün bunlarla ne yapıyoruz, ha?
tu.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Hiçbir şey yapılmadı daha. Sana bir şey sormak istemiştim.
tu.69147795130c033656af3031: Bizimkiler buraya gelirken seni çok hırpalamadı umarım?

ru.682dafa0928edd0f3702312f: Ну что, как дела в Таркове?
ru.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: Ты ко мне по делу или бахнем по маленькой?
ru.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: Я как раз уже думал тебя выгонять. Бывай!
ru.68adfadad61bb983cfa69b9e: Ну, а чего б и нет.
ru.68adfaec2e4e6d7320723e14: Я всё ждал, когда ты предложишь!
ru.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: Как чуешь, что у меня недавно поставка была!
ru.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: Даже не думай, что я тебе просто так помогу, салага.
ru.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: Я тебя сюда пустил только по доброте душевной. Что надо?
ru.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: Ну, как успехи, вояка? Всё сделал?
ru.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: Ого, быстро же ты. Всё готово?
ru.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: А, это ты, солдат. Что там, задача выполнена?
ru.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: Что-то не верится, что ты так быстро всё закончил. Всё сделано?
ru.68c30e976944a14e32ebca58: Ты к нам с новостями? Выполнено всё?
ru.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Я думал, что не скоро увижу твою рожу. Всё в полной готовности?
ru.68c30ea2e0927f7131c35a7c: Опять ты. Что там по задаче?
ru.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: Пока ничего не готово. Я хочу кое-что у тебя спросить.
ru.68c30f748041cbea83522701: Нет, но я прямо сейчас пойду выполнять.
ru.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: Так-так, это уже косяк, вояка. Задавай свои вопросы и вали доделывать.
ru.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: Ты же понимаешь, что ничего не получишь, пока задача не будет выполнена?.. Ладно, чё хочешь-то обсудить?
ru.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: Ну, если это так важно, что ты решил забить на задачу… Что надо?
ru.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Ну давай. Только быстро! Не только у тебя есть дела.
ru.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: И что ты тут забыл тогда? Ноги в руки и вперёд!
ru.68c31031513e917215a56638: Шустрее надо быть, вояка! Не приходи, пока всё не сделаешь.
ru.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: И что мне, похвалить тебя за это надо? Иди делай!
ru.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Бесконечно откладывать дела – тупая идея. Сделай всё сразу, а потом приходи.
ru.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: Здравия желаю, боец! Вижу, что жизнь тарковская тебя уже потаскала, но к этому лучше сразу привыкнуть. Легче не будет.
ru.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: Для тебя всегда что-нибудь найду, вояка.
ru.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Ну, давай гляну, может что найдётся.
ru.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Раз ты припёрся лично, то что-нибудь найду.
ru.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: О, товарищ «я не уложился в три дня» здесь! Не строй такое лицо, я всё знаю. Что с этим всем делать будем, а?
ru.68fced4b72306ae373c1d8e9: Я здесь как раз насчёт этого.
ru.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: Пока не всё готово. Иду работать.
ru.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Пока ничего не готово. Я хочу кое-что у тебя спросить.

ro.682dafa0928edd0f37023130: You here on business, or are we grabbing a quick drink?
ro.682dafa0928edd0f37023136: Hey there warrior, come on in!
ro.68adfa75edb9079421c8bb08: Look at you, all business! Go on, get moving.
ro.68adfa886b35a7e701e3ebe8: Alright then, don’t let me keep you.
ro.68adfa8dc49e78bddcc10e00: My guys will see you out.
ro.68adfa9736e2e0cdd05e6492: Right, you’ve been hanging around long enough.
ro.68adfaa0b4fa25e22fff349a: I was just about to kick you out. Take care!
ro.68adfae7fed02eca24fd8f78: You got cash on you, I hope?
ro.68adfaec2e4e6d7320723e14: I’ve been waiting for you to ask!
ro.68adfb269f90dcb41e0772ce: Almost like you knew I just got a fresh restock in!
ro.68c30ccae724aac419c2108d: Don’t expect me to do favors for free, rookie.
ro.68c30cd3c7e17b68634fed0f: I only let you in because I’m feeling generous today. What do you want?
ro.68c30e4c0e60a5e67b7c62f3: So, how’s it going, warrior? Everything done?
ro.68c30e8cbae9bd3fbd532d9e: Damn, that was quick. Everything ready?
ro.68c30e90f40d0d5f28a47e9a: Ah, it’s you, soldier. Task done, I presume?
ro.68c30e93f20848e1d16ddd02: Hard to believe you finished that so quickly. Everything done?
ro.68c30e976944a14e32ebca58: You here with updates? Everything completed?
ro.68c30e9e231b524294925d95: Thought I wouldn’t see your face for a while. Everything ready?
ro.68c30f44dceb0777fddf5164: It's not done yet. I wanted to ask you something.
ro.68c30f748041cbea83522701: Not yet, but I'll go finish it right now.
ro.68c30fa283d8f323e1a87f3a: Well-well, that’s a fuck-up, warrior. Go fix it and finish the job!
ro.68c30fb6cf7581817d0853a9: You realize you’re not getting anything from me until the task is complete…? Alright, what do you want?
ro.68c30fba1bbca5f8d9c12d20: Well, since it's so important you decided to ditch the job… What's happening?
ro.68c30fbeca0db5b3ce237db0: Alright, let’s hear it. Just make it quick! I’ve got things to do.
ro.68c3102600ef58c1475401df: Then what are you still doing here? Go do your job, soldier!
ro.68c31031513e917215a56638: You’ve gotta be faster, warrior! Don’t come back until you’ve got it all done.
ro.68c3103e8ca2f311a2bd03c4: Am I supposed to praise you for that? Go do it!
ro.68c31044a54e8663a100510f: Putting things off forever is a dumb move. Do it now, then come back.
ro.68c958e263179c310d7d7906: At ease, soldier! I can see Tarkov’s already roughed you up a bit. Better get used to it now, since it’s not gonna get any easier.
ro.68cc22014ab984adc431de33: Let’s see what we’ve got, soldier.
ro.68cc22066830084c87de19ea: There’s always something for you, warrior.
ro.68cc220b79c6b3dd7cd4ecb8: Alright, lemme check, maybe there is something.
ro.68cc2210b82eb7a3bacf2db9: I’m always in need of spare hands.
ro.68cc221a3fe403bfd4a5bfef: Since you dragged your ass here personally, I’ll find something for you.
ro.68e31ddaa1d6b74b10b4452e: Oh, look who it is, mister “I can’t count to three”! Don’t pull that face, I know everything. So, what do we do with all this, huh?
ro.68fcef9327e5e52d46585bb2: Not done yet. I'll go do it.
ro.68fcf048a13a9a1c435b5363: Nothing's done yet. I wanted to ask you something.
ro.69147795130c033656af3031: My guys didn’t rough you up too much on the way here, did they?
ro.6914779b13871fd854360ac4: Hey there warrior, come on in!

ch.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: 那就听好了吧，勇士！我最近刚和手下讲过这个，他们可是乐疯了！你肯定会喜欢的。
ch.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: 那些经典的都在学校里读到过吧？来听听这个！
ch.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: 你认真的吗？我当然会了。听好了，新兵：一个士兵无所事事地就这么站着，少校看到了他，走了过来。
ch.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436:
听听这个：
 - 为什么将军一言不发？
ch.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: 当然可以！我给你讲个好玩的，这可是我今早才听来的：
ch.68f55145ccca592395d84d49: 这是我最近听来的里面最喜欢的一个。
ch.68f551792a235725da0974fd: 正如连长在强行军时候会说的：“怎么？这就倒下了？做个俯卧撑休息一下，继续跑！”
ch.68f55190a7fef5206b0749d0: 营长正在给士兵们训话：
ch.68f551a7fe86376e961af7c7: 军队里的万圣节是怎么回事？就是两年兵假装被第一年的菜鸟给吓到！该死的伊万诺夫，你的智商肯定有他妈的一百六！你真是个他妈的天才！
ch.68f551b2e32910d5e14f6d8b: 士兵无非分成两种类型：要么误打误撞被卷进战斗；要么跌跌撞撞逃出来！
ch.68f551bff76f53ad7ee47c03: 新兵手册第一条：“至少把手榴弹扔出去，好歹能拉人和你一起上路。”
ch.68f551eb3a67ad6de49ce6ca: 一天早上，有个上尉醉醺醺地回到船上。这时候海军上将来视察了：
ch.68f5520e675667a8c2a5ad40: 我最喜欢的一个笑话：特种部队训练的时候，伪装课程要么人人缺席，要么人人满分。
ch.68f5523931d587154cf2dd5a: 三个特种部队的狠哥们被派去和师长执行绝密任务，其中两个是大块头，还有一个小个子……
ch.68f5527c9cd7e2f1669721a6: 一帮军校生被派去厨房帮忙，他们问准尉：
ch.68f552c17b217e671462fc14: 空军一次夜间训练的时候，轰炸机飞行员问指挥官：
ch.68f5532cae5aede5e5b1a2b3: 少尉想考考手下的士兵对上一次课程掌握得怎么样：
ch.68f55347ee0e1dc1feb6110c: – 嘿,老兄,当个召唤师是不是很酷啊？
ch.68f5535a020b02f0ca239d68: 我想到一个：士官对编队命令道：
ch.68f5536ed7d93571752560d3: 炮兵和工兵有什么共同点？他们打电话的时候都特别小心，生怕拨错号码：工兵最怕听到“你弄错地方了”，炮兵最怕“你他妈打错了”，哈哈！
ch.68f5537b0e4d9c570d7ef374: 有个笑话，但我们实在是笑不出来：服役是完全自愿的。你愿意为俄罗斯服役，就来参军。不想当兵？没关系，等到了军队也容不得你想不想了。
ch.68f5538892569b0c0ddbf3cf: 伞兵在训练的时候，能跑多快就跑多快；等上了飞机，能甩多远就被甩多远。
ch.68f553ae87f820bf62c0b5c1: 我最近听到的一个，笑得我连腰都直不起来了：
ch.691c3d4afe3ef46fed76fcb7: 说明他居然在思考！在我们的军队里，要是哪个将军没有在喋喋不休或者高声叫骂，要么是他突然想起来自己还长了个脑子……要么就只是墙上的画像，哈！
ch.691c3e7fa47703ec120100fa: 拉斯科利尼科夫走进了当铺，当铺里的地主婆问道：
ch.691c3e8f4de05c72b28ef368: – 罗季翁，你上这儿来是先砍自己一刀呢，还是我来砍你？
ch.691c3ebb8627c8e7801a9419: - 没有，蜘蛛把他们全吃了。
ch.691c3f011fdf8a2113b0742c: – 没，米哈伊尔·尤里耶维奇·奥列涅夫把老鼠吃干抹净了。
ch.691c3f52e8de7f2f4506b3b4: – 哦，真不好意思，忘了自我介绍了。
ch.691c3f614150a1383fb2c7c2: – 现在趴下，滋滋形爬到路标那里。
ch.691c3f7aac6a2801a31494ce: – 我说滋滋，你就得给我滋滋！
ch.691c3f8aa63b4505142f2e1a: – 列兵库兹金！为什么队列里就你没在跟着拉歌？
ch.691c3fd29a82d29d1d37ba7c: – 要是还没有志愿者自愿去办这件事，就别怪我帮你们“自愿”一下了！
ch.691c3ff33f793ef1211ac99c: – 四面八方都是敌人，前面，后方，侧翼都是……这种情况下怎么办？
ch.691c3ffd24929ac7628d5e66: – 好吧，起码不是敌暗我明，对吧？
ch.691c40229fcfc80e657af4c6: – 他的脑袋就像个树冠一样！
ch.691c40318793819142555336: – 你难道对上级没有半点敬畏之心吗，上尉同志？
ch.691c408f3b5cb308e247eee3: – 伊万诺夫！拳击冠军，全联盟铃壶举重健将！
ch.691c409ef586f118f37f1073: – 彼得罗夫！桑博格斗冠军，全联盟踢拳健将！
ch.691c40ab778df0816ade5788: – 西多罗夫！象棋冠军……管这俩傻瓜健将的健将！
ch.691c4115ee83913a9f93f8a2: – 当然！张开手——看，这不就五个刨子了吗？
ch.691c41961413fa4ce2c3e492: – 你他妈是怎么得出这个数的？！
ch.691c41fc74a22c8fbde8e937: – 我有个好消息和一个坏消息。
ch.691c4203d802565bc202f0e2: 坏消息是，你们必须把这些沙袋给填满。
ch.691c4207de21cba5efb00977: 好消息是：附近的采石场里有的是沙子！条件都这么好了，快点行动！
ch.691c421af0ae00ef85d35465: – 战争时期该怎么破坏铁路，防止被敌人利用？
ch.691c42fabf1df44ef2cb0b64: – 把售票厅给烧了，防止敌人恶意买票坐火车推进……
ch.691c43071a863166e54272ca: – 在征兵官面前你最好规矩点，年轻人！
ch.691c43151e323bfa3949880b: – 在营房里喝伏特加？你把军队当什么了？你家幼儿园？少干些幼稚的事情吧！
ch.691c4342ef7fdd67066e89ce: 他们的伪装实在是太好了，一次演习的时候一头牛差点把士兵给嚼了。
ch.691c90b2cc98ce5ce1c7c7be: 士兵啪的一下立正了，响亮地回话：
ch.691c90bd7e6bbb0f918b17e9: – 执行您的命令，少校同志！
ch.691c90d59ae5756f199fa402: – 所以我没在做任何事情，少校同志！

cz.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: Poslouchej, válečníku! Nedávno jsem to vyprávěl svým chlapům a bavilo je to. Bude se ti to líbit.
cz.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: Četl jsi někdy ve škole klasiku? Podívej se na tohle!
cz.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: Myslíš to vážně? Samozřejmě, že ano. Poslouchej, nováčku. Voják jen stojí a nic nedělá. Major ho uvidí a přistoupí k němu.
cz.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436:
Poslouchej tohle:
- Proč je generál tak ticho?
cz.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: Samozřejmě! tohle je dobrý vtip z dnešního rána:
cz.68f55145ccca592395d84d49: Oblíbený, na který jsem si nedávno vzpomněl.
cz.68f551792a235725da0974fd: Jak řekl velitel roty během nuceného pochodu: "Kdo upadne, udělá klik a běží dál".
cz.68f551a7fe86376e961af7c7: Co je to za Halloween v armádě? Když druháci předstírají, že se bojí prváků.
cz.68f551b2e32910d5e14f6d8b: Vojáci se dělí na dva typy: na ty, kteří se vrhají do boje, a na ty, kteří z něj utíkají jako o život!
cz.68f551bff76f53ad7ee47c03: Z příručky pro nováčky: „Hoď granát tak, aby s tebou zemřel i někdo jiný“.
cz.68f551eb3a67ad6de49ce6ca: Jednoho rána se na loď dostaví opilý poručík. Admirál přichází na inspekci:
cz.68f5520e675667a8c2a5ad40: Jedna z mých oblíbených: při výcviku speciálních jednotek se buď nikdo neukáže na lekci maskování, nebo ji všichni zvládnou na jedničku.
cz.68f5523931d587154cf2dd5a: Tři členové speciálních jednotek jsou vysláni k veliteli divize na přísně tajnou misi. Dva mohutní chlapi a jeden drobný, skromný muž…
cz.68f5527c9cd7e2f1669721a6: Skupina studentů je přidělena na službu v kuchyni. Zeptali se poddůstojníka:
cz.68f552c17b217e671462fc14: Noční výcvik letectva. Letecký důstojník se ptá velitele bombardéru:
cz.68f5532cae5aede5e5b1a2b3: Poručík kontroluje, jak dobře si vojáci zapamatovali poslední lekci:
cz.68f55347ee0e1dc1feb6110c: – Hele, kámo, je fajn být vyvolávačem duchů?
cz.68f5535a020b02f0ca239d68: Tady je jeden… Seržant k jednotce:
cz.68f5536ed7d93571752560d3: Co mají společného dělostřelci a ženisté? Oba vždy vytočí číslo správně: ženista se bojí, že „to vytočil špatně“, dělostřelec se bojí, že „volá na špatné číslo“.
cz.68f5537b0e4d9c570d7ef374: Tady je vtip, ale vlastně to vtip není: Služba v armádě je dobrovolná. Kdo chce, jde. Kdo nechce – vezmou ho tak jako tak.
cz.68f5538892569b0c0ddbf3cf: Výsadkář nejprve běží, jak daleko může, a pak tak daleko, jak je třeba.
cz.68f553ae87f820bf62c0b5c1: Tady je jeden vtip, u kterého se člověk popadá za břicho:
cz.691c3d4afe3ef46fed76fcb7: Přemýšlí. V naší armádě, když je generál zticha, buď přemýšlí… nebo je to jen portrét.
cz.691c3e7fa47703ec120100fa: Raskolnikov vejde do zastavárny a ona se zeptá:
cz.691c3e8f4de05c72b28ef368: – Rodione, přišel jsi se na něco zeptat?
cz.691c3f011fdf8a2113b0742c: – Ne, snědl je Michail Jurjevič Olenjev.
cz.691c3f614150a1383fb2c7c2: – Doplaz se k té značce na jeden zátah.
cz.691c3f6daa5096d9f8c775e7: – Je to klikatá cesta, soudruhu praporčíku.
cz.691c3f7aac6a2801a31494ce: – Řekl jsem „na jeden zátah“, tak „na jeden zátah“ budeš!
cz.691c3f8aa63b4505142f2e1a: – Vojáku Kuzkine! Proč nezpíváte v šiku?
cz.691c3fd29a82d29d1d37ba7c: – Jestli se nenajdou dobrovolníci, budu je muset přihlásit sám.
cz.691c3ff33f793ef1211ac99c: – Nepřítel je za námi, nalevo, napravo i před námi… Co si o tom myslíš?
cz.691c3ffd24929ac7628d5e66: – No, teď už se před námi neschovají!
cz.691c408f3b5cb308e247eee3: – Ivanov! Boxerský šampion, mistr v zvedání kettlebellů!
cz.691c409ef586f118f37f1073: – Petrov! Mistr v Sambu, držitel titulu CMS v kickboxu!
cz.691c40ab778df0816ade5788: – Sidorov! Šachový mistr… Má na starosti tyhle dva idioty!
cz.691c4203d802565bc202f0e2: Nevýhoda: Tyto pytle je třeba naplnit pískem.
cz.691c4207de21cba5efb00977: Skvělé: v nedalekém lomu je spousta písku!
cz.691c421af0ae00ef85d35465: – Co byste udělali v případě války, abyste zabránili tomu, aby se naše železnice dostaly do rukou nepřítele?
cz.691c43071a863166e54272ca: – Dávej si pozor na to, co říkáš, když jsi před náborovým úředníkem, mladíku!
cz.691c43151e323bfa3949880b: – V kasárnách se vodka pít nesmí, tady nejsme ve školce!
cz.691c4342ef7fdd67066e89ce: Maskování bylo během vojenských cvičení tak dokonalé, že kráva omylem sežrala vojáka.

en.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: Listen up then, warrior! I told this one to my guys recently, they were really cracking up. You’ll like it.
en.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: Ever read the classics in school? Check this one out!
en.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: You serious? Of course I do. Listen up, rookie. A soldier stands around, doing nothing. The major sees him and walks over.
en.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436:
Listen to this:
– Why is the general so quiet?
en.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: Of course! He’s a good one from this morning:
en.68f551792a235725da0974fd: As the company commander said on a forced march: “What falls, does a push-up and keeps running”.
en.68f551a7fe86376e961af7c7: What’s Halloween in the army? When the second-years pretend to be scared of the first-years.
en.68f551b2e32910d5e14f6d8b: Soldiers fall into two types: those who run into a fight, and those who run the hell out!
en.68f551bff76f53ad7ee47c03: From the rookie manual: “Throw the grenade so that someone else dies with you”.
en.68f551eb3a67ad6de49ce6ca: One morning, a lieutenant arrives at the ship drunk. The admiral comes with inspection:
en.68f5520e675667a8c2a5ad40: One of my favorites: during spetsnaz drills, either no one shows up for camouflage class, or everyone aces it.
en.68f5523931d587154cf2dd5a: Three spetsnaz guys are sent to the divisional commander for a top-secret mission. Two huge guys and one small modest guy…
en.68f5527c9cd7e2f1669721a6: A bunch of students are sent to kitchen duty. They ask the warrant officer:
en.68f552c17b217e671462fc14: An air force night training. Flight officer asks the bomber commander:
en.68f5532cae5aede5e5b1a2b3: Lieutenant checks how well the soldiers remembered the last lesson:
en.68f55347ee0e1dc1feb6110c: – Hey dude, is it cool being a spirit caller?
en.68f5536ed7d93571752560d3: What do artillerymen and sappers have in common? Both always dial the phone correctly: sapper fears “you got it wrong”, artilleryman fears “wrong number”.
en.68f5537b0e4d9c570d7ef374: Here’s a joke, but not really a joke: Army service is voluntary. You want in, you go. Don’t want in — they’ll take you anyway.
en.68f5538892569b0c0ddbf3cf: A paratrooper first runs as far as he can, then as far as needed.
en.691c3d4afe3ef46fed76fcb7: He’s thinking. In our army, if a general is quiet, he’s either thinking… or a portrait.
en.691c3e7fa47703ec120100fa: Raskolnikov walks into the pawnbroker’s, and she asks:
en.691c3e8f4de05c72b28ef368: – Rodion, are you here to AXE ME A QUESTION?
en.691c3eacdc2f28da65a31fd5: – Are there cockroaches in the house?
en.691c3f011fdf8a2113b0742c: – No, Mikhail Yuryevich Olenyev ate them.
en.691c3f614150a1383fb2c7c2: – Crawl to that mark in a zugzug.
en.691c3f7aac6a2801a31494ce: – I said zugzug, so zugzug you will!
en.691c3f8aa63b4505142f2e1a: – Private Kuzkin! Why aren’t you singing in formation?
en.691c3fd29a82d29d1d37ba7c: – If we don’t get volunteers, I’ll have to volunteer them myself.
en.691c3ff33f793ef1211ac99c: – The enemy is behind us, to the left, right, and ahead… What do you think about that?
en.691c3ffd24929ac7628d5e66: – Well, now they won’t hide from us!
en.691c400ced1da533dd3f6c7c: – This one goes to the border troops.
en.691c40229fcfc80e657af4c6: – His head looks like a tree stump.
en.691c40318793819142555336: – Why aren’t you afraid of me, Lieutenant?
en.691c408f3b5cb308e247eee3: – Ivanov! Boxing champion, CMS in kettlebell lifting!
en.691c409ef586f118f37f1073: – Petrov! Sambo champion, CMS in kickboxing!
en.691c40ab778df0816ade5788: – Sidorov! Chess champion… In charge of these two idiots!
en.691c410999a6a4f44161d4a6: – Do we have a potato peeler?
en.691c4115ee83913a9f93f8a2: – Of course we do! A crew of five…
en.691c41fc74a22c8fbde8e937: – I’ve got good and bad news.
en.691c4203d802565bc202f0e2: Bad: you have to fill these bags with sand.
en.691c4207de21cba5efb00977: Good: there’s plenty of sand in the nearby quarry!
en.691c421af0ae00ef85d35465: – What would you do in wartime to keep our railroads out of enemy hands?
en.691c43071a863166e54272ca: – Watch your language in front of a draft officer, young man!
en.691c43151e323bfa3949880b: – You’re not allowed to drink vodka in the barracks, this isn’t kindergarten!
en.691c4342ef7fdd67066e89ce: The camouflage was so good during army exercises that a cow accidentally ate a soldier.
en.691c90b2cc98ce5ce1c7c7be: The soldier snaps to attention and replies cheerfully:
en.691c90bd7e6bbb0f918b17e9: – Carrying out your order, comrade Major!
en.691c90d59ae5756f199fa402: – That’s why I’m doing nothing, sir!

fr.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: Écoute bien, guerrier ! J’ai raconté celle-là à mes gars récemment, ils étaient morts de rire. Tu vas aimer.
fr.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: T’as déjà lu les classiques à l’école ? Écoute celle-ci !
fr.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: Sérieux ? Bien sûr que oui. Écoute bien, bleu. Un soldat est planté là, sans rien faire. Le major le remarque et s’approche.
fr.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436:
« Écoute ça :
- Pourquoi le général est-il si silencieux ? »
fr.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: Bien sûr ! Une bonne de ce matin :
fr.68f55145ccca592395d84d49: Une de mes préférées, qui m’est revenue récemment.
fr.68f551792a235725da0974fd: Comme disait le commandant de compagnie lors d’une marche forcée : « Ce qui tombe fait des pompes et continue à courir. »
fr.68f55190a7fef5206b0749d0: Le commandant de bataillon fait un briefing aux soldats :
fr.68f551a7fe86376e961af7c7: C’est quoi Halloween à l’armée ? Quand les anciens font semblant d’avoir peur des bleus.
fr.68f551b2e32910d5e14f6d8b: Il y a deux types de soldats : ceux qui courent vers le combat, et ceux qui courent à toute vitesse dans l’autre sens !
fr.68f551bff76f53ad7ee47c03: Extrait du manuel du bleu : « Lance la grenade de façon à ce que quelqu’un d’autre meure avec toi. »
fr.68f551eb3a67ad6de49ce6ca: Un matin, un lieutenant arrive ivre à bord du navire. L’amiral débarque pour une inspection :
fr.68f5520e675667a8c2a5ad40: Une de mes préférées : pendant les exercices des spetsnaz, soit personne ne vient au cours de camouflage, soit tout le monde a la meilleure note.
fr.68f5523931d587154cf2dd5a: Trois spetsnaz sont envoyés chez le commandant divisionnaire pour une mission ultra-secrète. Deux mastodontes et un petit gars discret…
fr.68f5527c9cd7e2f1669721a6: Un groupe d’étudiants est envoyé en corvée de cuisine. Ils demandent à l’adjudant :
fr.68f552c17b217e671462fc14: Exercice de nuit de l’armée de l’air. L’officier de vol demande au commandant du bombardier :
fr.68f55311c06283dd64e5a521: Un sergent s’adresse à ses soldats :
fr.68f5532cae5aede5e5b1a2b3: Un lieutenant vérifie ce que les soldats ont retenu du dernier cours :
fr.68f55347ee0e1dc1feb6110c: - Hé mec, c’est cool d’être invocateur d’esprits ?
fr.68f5535a020b02f0ca239d68: En voilà une… Le sergent à la formation :
fr.68f5536ed7d93571752560d3: Dans l'armée il n'y a que deux tailles de disponibles pour la dotation : trop petit ou trop grand,
fr.68f5537b0e4d9c570d7ef374: En voilà une, mais pas vraiment une blague : le service militaire est volontaire. Tu veux y aller, tu y vas. Tu veux pas, on t’y envoie quand même.
fr.68f5538892569b0c0ddbf3cf: Un parachutiste court d’abord aussi loin qu’il peut, puis aussi loin qu’il faut.
fr.691c3d4afe3ef46fed76fcb7: Il réfléchit. Dans notre armée, quand un général est silencieux, soit il réfléchit… soit c’est un portrait.
fr.691c3e7fa47703ec120100fa: Raskolnikov entre chez la prêteuse sur gages, et elle lui demande :
fr.691c3e8f4de05c72b28ef368: — Rodion, tu es venu me POSER UNE QUESTION ?
fr.691c3eacdc2f28da65a31fd5: — Il y a des cafards dans la maison ?
fr.691c3ebb8627c8e7801a9419: — Non, les araignées les ont mangés.
fr.691c3ed853611236a7a5576e: — Non, les rats les ont mangées.
fr.691c3eeac4df31ed1aff11e6: — Il y a aussi des rats ?!
fr.691c3f011fdf8a2113b0742c: — Non, Mikhaïl Iourievitch Oleniev les a mangés.
fr.691c3f614150a1383fb2c7c2: — Rampe jusqu’à ce repère en zugzug.
fr.691c3f7aac6a2801a31494ce: — J’ai dit zugzug, alors ce sera zugzug !
fr.691c3f8aa63b4505142f2e1a: — Soldat Kouzkine ! Pourquoi tu ne chantes pas en formation ?
fr.691c3fd29a82d29d1d37ba7c: — S’il n’y a pas de volontaires, je les désignerai moi-même.
fr.691c3ff33f793ef1211ac99c: — L’ennemi est derrière nous, à gauche, à droite et devant… Qu’en pensez-vous ?
fr.691c3ffd24929ac7628d5e66: — Parfait, ils ne pourront plus se cacher !
fr.691c40229fcfc80e657af4c6: — Sa tête ressemble à une souche.
fr.691c40318793819142555336: — Pourquoi n’as-tu pas peur de moi, lieutenant ?
fr.691c408f3b5cb308e247eee3: — Ivanov ! Champion de boxe, maître candidat en kettlebell !
fr.691c409ef586f118f37f1073: — Petrov ! Champion de sambo, maître candidat en kickboxing !
fr.691c40ab778df0816ade5788: — Sidorov ! Champion d’échecs… responsable de ces deux abrutis !
fr.691c410999a6a4f44161d4a6: — On a un éplucheur à patates ?
fr.691c4115ee83913a9f93f8a2: — Bien sûr ! Une équipe de cinq…
fr.691c417bb0ed883ba51970ef: — Huit, annonce la visibilité de vol.
fr.691c41fc74a22c8fbde8e937: — J’ai une bonne et une mauvaise nouvelle.
fr.691c4203d802565bc202f0e2: La mauvaise : vous devez remplir ces sacs de sable.
fr.691c4207de21cba5efb00977: La bonne : il y a plein de sable dans la carrière d’à côté !
fr.691c421af0ae00ef85d35465: — Que ferais-tu en temps de guerre pour empêcher l’ennemi d’utiliser nos chemins de fer ?
fr.691c42fabf1df44ef2cb0b64: — Brûler tous les billets de train…
fr.691c43071a863166e54272ca: — Surveille ton langage devant un officier de recrutement, jeune homme !
fr.691c43151e323bfa3949880b: — Interdiction de boire de la vodka dans la caserne, ce n’est pas une maternelle !
fr.691c4342ef7fdd67066e89ce: Le camouflage était si efficace pendant les manœuvres qu’une vache a mangé un soldat par erreur.
fr.691c90b2cc98ce5ce1c7c7be: Le soldat se met au garde-à-vous et répond joyeusement :
fr.691c90d59ae5756f199fa402: — Voilà pourquoi je ne fais rien, monsieur !

it.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: Allora ascolta bene, guerriero! L'ho raccontata ai miei ragazzi di recente e si sono sbellicati dalle risate. Ti piacerà.
it.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: Hai mai letto i classici a scuola? Dai un'occhiata a questo!
it.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: Dici sul serio? Ma certo che sì. Ascolta bene, novellino. Un soldato se ne sta lì impalato senza far nulla. Il maggiore lo vede e gli si avvicina.
it.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436:
Senti un po':
– Perché il generale è così silenzioso?
it.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: Certo! Eccone uno carino di stamattina:
it.68f55145ccca592395d84d49: Un classico che mi è tornato in mente di recente.
it.68f551792a235725da0974fd: Come disse il comandante della compagnia durante una marcia forzata: "Chi cade, fa una flessione e continua a correre".
it.68f55190a7fef5206b0749d0: Il comandante del battaglione sta dando istruzioni ai soldati:
it.68f551a7fe86376e961af7c7: Com'è Halloween nell'esercito? È quando i soldati al secondo anno fingono di avere paura di quelli al primo anno.
it.68f551b2e32910d5e14f6d8b: I soldati si dividono in due categorie: quelli che si gettano nella mischia e quelli che se la danno a gambe!
it.68f551bff76f53ad7ee47c03: Dal manuale del novellino: "Lancia la granata in modo che qualcun altro muoia insieme a te".
it.68f551eb3a67ad6de49ce6ca: Una mattina, un tenente si presenta a bordo ubriaco. L'ammiraglio arriva per l'ispezione:
it.68f5520e675667a8c2a5ad40: Una delle mie preferite: durante le esercitazioni degli spetsnaz, o nessuno si presenta alla lezione di mimetizzazione, oppure tutti la superano a pieni voti.
it.68f5523931d587154cf2dd5a: Tre membri degli Spetsnaz vengono inviati dal comandante di divisione per una missione top secret. Due omaccioni e un ragazzo minuto e modesto…
it.68f5527c9cd7e2f1669721a6: Un gruppo di studenti viene assegnato al turno in cucina. Chiedono al maresciallo:
it.68f552c17b217e671462fc14: Un'esercitazione notturna dell'aeronautica militare. Il sottufficiale di volo chiede al comandante del bombardiere:
it.68f5532cae5aede5e5b1a2b3: Il tenente verifica quanto bene i soldati abbiano assimilato l'ultima lezione:
it.68f55347ee0e1dc1feb6110c: – Ehi, amico, è bello essere un evocatore di spiriti?
it.68f5535a020b02f0ca239d68: Eccone una… Il sergente alla formazione:
it.68f5536ed7d93571752560d3: Cosa hanno in comune gli artiglieri e i genieri? Entrambi compongono sempre il numero di telefono nel modo giusto: il geniere teme che "l'abbia sbagliato", l'artigliere teme che "sia il numero sbagliato".
it.68f5537b0e4d9c570d7ef374: Ecco una battuta, ma non proprio una battuta: il servizio militare è volontario. Se vuoi arruolarti, lo fai. Se non vuoi, ti prendono lo stesso.
it.68f5538892569b0c0ddbf3cf: Un paracadutista corre prima il più lontano possibile, poi quanto basta.
it.68f553ae87f820bf62c0b5c1: Ecco una battuta esilarante di qualche giorno fa:
it.691c3d4afe3ef46fed76fcb7: Sta riflettendo. Nel nostro esercito, se un generale sta in silenzio, o sta riflettendo… oppure è un ritratto.
it.691c3e7fa47703ec120100fa: Raskolnikov entra nell'agenzia di pegni e lei gli chiede:
it.691c3e8f4de05c72b28ef368: – Rodion, sei qui per farmi una domanda?
it.691c3ebb8627c8e7801a9419: – No, i ragni li hanno mangiati.
it.691c3ed853611236a7a5576e: – No, i ratti li hanno mangiati.
it.691c3f011fdf8a2113b0742c: – No, li ha mangiati Mikhail Yuryevich Olenyev.
it.691c3f8aa63b4505142f2e1a: – Soldato Kuzkin! Perché non canti in formazione?
it.691c3fd29a82d29d1d37ba7c: – Se non troviamo volontari, dovrò costringerli io stesso a farlo.
it.691c3ff33f793ef1211ac99c: – Il nemico è alle nostre spalle, a sinistra, a destra e davanti a noi… Che ne pensi?
it.691c3ffd24929ac7628d5e66: – Beh, ora non potranno più nascondersi da noi!
it.691c400ced1da533dd3f6c7c: – Questo è destinato alle truppe di frontiera.
it.691c40229fcfc80e657af4c6: – La sua testa sembra un ceppo d'albero.
it.691c40318793819142555336: – Perché non ha paura di me, tenente?
it.691c408f3b5cb308e247eee3: – Ivanov! Campione di pugilato, CMS nel sollevamento con kettlebell!
it.691c409ef586f118f37f1073: – Petrov! Campione di sambo, CMS nel kickboxing!
it.691c40ab778df0816ade5788: – Sidorov! Campione di scacchi… A capo di questi due idioti!
it.691c4115ee83913a9f93f8a2: – Ma certo che sì! Una squadra di cinque persone…
it.691c417bb0ed883ba51970ef: – Otto, comunica la visibilità in volo.
it.691c41fc74a22c8fbde8e937: - Ho delle buone e cattive notizie.
it.691c4203d802565bc202f0e2: Cattivo: bisogna riempire questi sacchi di sabbia.
it.691c4207de21cba5efb00977: Buono: nella cava vicina c'è sabbia in abbondanza!
it.691c421af0ae00ef85d35465: – Cosa faresti in tempo di guerra per impedire che le nostre ferrovie cadessero nelle mani del nemico?
it.691c42fabf1df44ef2cb0b64: - Brucia tutti i biglietti dei treni…
it.691c43071a863166e54272ca: – Modera il linguaggio davanti a un ufficiale di leva, giovanotto!
it.691c43151e323bfa3949880b: – Non ti è permesso bere vodka nelle caserme, qui non siamo all’asilo!
it.691c4342ef7fdd67066e89ce: Durante le esercitazioni militari, la mimetizzazione era talmente efficace che una mucca ha mangiato per sbaglio un soldato.
it.691c90b2cc98ce5ce1c7c7be: Il soldato si mette sull'attenti e risponde allegramente:
it.691c90bd7e6bbb0f918b17e9: – Eseguo il suo ordine, compagno Maggiore!
it.691c90d59ae5756f199fa402: – Ed è per questo che non sto facendo niente, signore!

kr.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: 잘 듣게나! 이건 내가 얼마 전에 우리 애들한테 해줬던 건데, 다들 웃겨 자빠져 죽었지. 자네도 좋아할 걸세.
kr.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: 학교 다닐 때 고전문학 좀 읽어봤나? 이거 한번 들어보게!
kr.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: 진심인가? 당연히 있지. 잘 듣게나. 어떤 한 병사가 가만히 서가지고 아무것도 안 하고 있었네. 근데 어떤 한 소령이 그 병사를 보더니 그 쪽으로 가는 걸세.
kr.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436:
잘 들어보게.
– 장군님은 왜 그렇게 조용하십니까?
kr.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: 당연하지! 오늘 아침에 들은 건데 이거 꽤 괜찮은 농담이네.
kr.68f55190a7fef5206b0749d0: 대대장이 병사들 앞에서 훈련 상황 전달을 하는 중이었네.
kr.68f551b2e32910d5e14f6d8b: 군대에서 할로윈이 뭔지 아나? 이등병들이 일병 무서운 척하는 날이다.
kr.68f551bff76f53ad7ee47c03: 이건 신병 교육 책자에 있는 내용인데, "수류탄은 다른 놈이랑 함께 폭사할 수 있게 던져라" 라고 한다네.
kr.68f551cc6c07f6a55cd39f3f: 신병 교범에서: “수류탄은 다른 놈이랑 같이 죽을 수 있게 던져라.”
kr.68f551eb3a67ad6de49ce6ca: 어느 날 아침이었네. 한 중위가 술에 잔뜩 취한 채로 승선했다네. 그러더니 함장이 와서 그 중위한테 이렇게 묻더군.
kr.68f5520e675667a8c2a5ad40: 내가 좋아하는 것 중 하나일세. 스페츠나츠 훈련 중 위장 수업에선 아무도 안 나오거나, 전원이 만점이거나 둘 중 하나라네.
kr.68f5523931d587154cf2dd5a: 스페츠나츠 대원 세 명이 지역 사령관한테 극비 임무를 받으러 가는 중이었다네. 덩치 큰 두 놈들하고 과 왜소하고 얌전한 한 놈이었네…
kr.68f5527c9cd7e2f1669721a6: 스페츠나츠 세 명이 사단장에게 극비 임무를 받으러 간다. 덩치 큰 놈 둘과 왜소하고 얌전한 놈 하나…
kr.68f552c17b217e671462fc14: 학생 몇 명이 취사 당번으로 배정된다. 그들이 준위에게 묻는다:
kr.68f55311c06283dd64e5a521: 공군 야간 훈련 중이다. 비행 장교가 폭격기 지휘관에게 묻는다:
kr.68f5532cae5aede5e5b1a2b3: 소대장이 소대원들한테 저번에 있었던 훈련 내용을 제대로 상기하고 있는 지 묻는 시간이었다네.
kr.68f55347ee0e1dc1feb6110c: 중위가 병사들이 지난 교육 내용을 얼마나 기억하는지 점검한다:
kr.68f5535a020b02f0ca239d68: – 야, 너 무당 노릇하는 거 멋지냐?
kr.68f5536ed7d93571752560d3: 포병이랑 공병의 공통점이 뭔지 아나? 둘 다 전화 걸 때 손가락 달달 떨면서 번호 하나하나 절대 안 틀린다는 거네. 공병은 까딱해서 "야, 너 뭐 잘못 건드렸어"라는 소리를 들으면 그 자리에서 산산조각 나고, 포병은 "야, 너 좌표 잘못 불렀어"라는 소리를 들으면 부대 전체가 좆되거든.
kr.68f5537b0e4d9c570d7ef374: 이건 농담같아 보이겠지만 농담은 아닐세. 우리 군대는 모병제이네. 입대하고 싶다면 입대하면 되고, 입대하기 싫다면… 그래도 입대하게 되있다네.
kr.68f5538892569b0c0ddbf3cf: 이건 농담 같지만 농담 아니다: 군 복무는 자원제다. 가고 싶으면 가고, 가기 싫으면… 그래도 간다.
kr.68f553ae87f820bf62c0b5c1: 이게 또 내가 최근에 들은 것 중에 무릎을 칠 정도로 웃긴 걸세.
kr.691c3d4afe3ef46fed76fcb7: 최근에 들은 걸작이네. 우리 군대에서 장군님이 조용하면 생각하는 중이거나… 초상화네.
kr.691c3e7fa47703ec120100fa: 라스콜니코프가 전당포에 들어가자, 거기에 있던 여자가 이렇게 물었네.
kr.691c3e8f4de05c72b28ef368: – 로디온, 뭐 하나 ‘묻어’ 보려고 여기 온 거냐?
kr.691c3f011fdf8a2113b0742c: – 없어, 미하일 유리예비치 올레녜프가 다 먹었어.
kr.691c3f8aa63b4505142f2e1a: – 쿠즈킨 이병! 왜 군가를 안 부르고 있나?
kr.691c3fd29a82d29d1d37ba7c: – 자원자가 안 나오면, 내가 직접 자원시켜주겠다.
kr.691c3ff33f793ef1211ac99c: – 적은 우리 뒤쪽, 왼쪽, 오른쪽, 그리고 앞쪽에 있다… 이 상황에 대해서 어떻게 생각하나?
kr.691c40318793819142555336: – 중위, 자네는 내가 무섭지 않은 건가?
kr.691c40486cd22888ccfa130b: – 그런데 자네는 왜 술을 마시고 있나?
kr.691c408f3b5cb308e247eee3: – 이바노프! 복싱 챔피언, 케틀벨 리프팅 체육대회 준마스터!
kr.691c40ab778df0816ade5788: – 시도로프! 체스 챔피언… 그리고 이 두 병신 담당!
kr.691c410999a6a4f44161d4a6: – 혹시 채칼 남는 게 좀 있습니까?
kr.691c4203d802565bc202f0e2: 나쁜 소식은 이 마대들을 모래로 채워야 한다.
kr.691c4207de21cba5efb00977: 좋은 소식은 요 근처 채석장에 모래가 널려있다는 것이다!
kr.691c421af0ae00ef85d35465: – 전시에 철도가 적에게 노획되는 걸 방지하려면 어떻게 해야 한다고 했었지?
kr.691c43151e323bfa3949880b: – 병영에서 보드카 마시면 안 된다! 여긴 유치원이 아니다!
kr.691c4342ef7fdd67066e89ce: 훈련 중에 어떤 한 병사의 위장술이 너무나도 완벽했는데, 위장이 너무 완벽했던 나머지 소가 그 병사를 먹어버렸다네.
kr.691c90a6874c3bf12e3eb4ae: – 병사! 지금 뭘 하고 있는 건가?!
kr.691c90b2cc98ce5ce1c7c7be: 그러더니 그 병사가 바로 차렷 자세로 씩씩하게 말하더라고.
kr.691c90bd7e6bbb0f918b17e9: – 소령 동지께서 하달하신 임무를 수행하고 있습니다!
kr.691c90d59ae5756f199fa402: – 그래서 아무것도 안 하고 있습니다, 소령 동지!

pl.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: Listen up then, warrior! I told this one to my guys recently, they were really cracking up. You’ll like it.
pl.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: Ever read the classics in school? Check this one out!
pl.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: You serious? Of course I do. Listen up, rookie. A soldier stands around, doing nothing. The major sees him and walks over.
pl.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436:
Listen to this:
– Why is the general so quiet?
pl.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: Of course! He’s a good one from this morning:
pl.68f551792a235725da0974fd: As the company commander said on a forced march: “What falls, does a push-up and keeps running”.
pl.68f551a7fe86376e961af7c7: What’s Halloween in the army? When the second-years pretend to be scared of the first-years.
pl.68f551b2e32910d5e14f6d8b: Soldiers fall into two types: those who run into a fight, and those who run the hell out!
pl.68f551bff76f53ad7ee47c03: From the rookie manual: “Throw the grenade so that someone else dies with you”.
pl.68f551eb3a67ad6de49ce6ca: One morning, a lieutenant arrives at the ship drunk. The admiral comes with inspection:
pl.68f5520e675667a8c2a5ad40: One of my favorites: during spetsnaz drills, either no one shows up for camouflage class, or everyone aces it.
pl.68f5523931d587154cf2dd5a: Three spetsnaz guys are sent to the divisional commander for a top-secret mission. Two huge guys and one small modest guy…
pl.68f5527c9cd7e2f1669721a6: A bunch of students are sent to kitchen duty. They ask the warrant officer:
pl.68f552c17b217e671462fc14: An air force night training. Flight officer asks the bomber commander:
pl.68f5532cae5aede5e5b1a2b3: Lieutenant checks how well the soldiers remembered the last lesson:
pl.68f55347ee0e1dc1feb6110c: – Hey dude, is it cool being a spirit caller?
pl.68f5536ed7d93571752560d3: What do artillerymen and sappers have in common? Both always dial the phone correctly: sapper fears “you got it wrong”, artilleryman fears “wrong number”.
pl.68f5537b0e4d9c570d7ef374: Here’s a joke, but not really a joke: Army service is voluntary. You want in, you go. Don’t want in — they’ll take you anyway.
pl.68f5538892569b0c0ddbf3cf: A paratrooper first runs as far as he can, then as far as needed.
pl.691c3d4afe3ef46fed76fcb7: He’s thinking. In our army, if a general is quiet, he’s either thinking… or a portrait.
pl.691c3e7fa47703ec120100fa: Raskolnikov walks into the pawnbroker’s, and she asks:
pl.691c3e8f4de05c72b28ef368: – Rodion, are you here to AXE ME A QUESTION?
pl.691c3eacdc2f28da65a31fd5: – Are there cockroaches in the house?
pl.691c3f011fdf8a2113b0742c: – No, Mikhail Yuryevich Olenyev ate them.
pl.691c3f614150a1383fb2c7c2: – Crawl to that mark in a zugzug.
pl.691c3f7aac6a2801a31494ce: – I said zugzug, so zugzug you will!
pl.691c3f8aa63b4505142f2e1a: – Private Kuzkin! Why aren’t you singing in formation?
pl.691c3fd29a82d29d1d37ba7c: – If we don’t get volunteers, I’ll have to volunteer them myself.
pl.691c3ff33f793ef1211ac99c: – The enemy is behind us, to the left, right, and ahead… What do you think about that?
pl.691c3ffd24929ac7628d5e66: – Well, now they won’t hide from us!
pl.691c400ced1da533dd3f6c7c: – This one goes to the border troops.
pl.691c40229fcfc80e657af4c6: – His head looks like a tree stump.
pl.691c40318793819142555336: – Why aren’t you afraid of me, Lieutenant?
pl.691c408f3b5cb308e247eee3: – Ivanov! Boxing champion, CMS in kettlebell lifting!
pl.691c409ef586f118f37f1073: – Petrov! Sambo champion, CMS in kickboxing!
pl.691c40ab778df0816ade5788: – Sidorov! Chess champion… In charge of these two idiots!
pl.691c410999a6a4f44161d4a6: – Do we have a potato peeler?
pl.691c4115ee83913a9f93f8a2: – Of course we do! A crew of five…
pl.691c41fc74a22c8fbde8e937: – I’ve got good and bad news.
pl.691c4203d802565bc202f0e2: Bad: you have to fill these bags with sand.
pl.691c4207de21cba5efb00977: Good: there’s plenty of sand in the nearby quarry!
pl.691c421af0ae00ef85d35465: – What would you do in wartime to keep our railroads out of enemy hands?
pl.691c43071a863166e54272ca: – Watch your language in front of a draft officer, young man!
pl.691c43151e323bfa3949880b: – You’re not allowed to drink vodka in the barracks, this isn’t kindergarten!
pl.691c4342ef7fdd67066e89ce: The camouflage was so good during army exercises that a cow accidentally ate a soldier.
pl.691c90b2cc98ce5ce1c7c7be: The soldier snaps to attention and replies cheerfully:
pl.691c90bd7e6bbb0f918b17e9: – Carrying out your order, comrade Major!
pl.691c90d59ae5756f199fa402: – That’s why I’m doing nothing, sir!

po.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: Então presta atenção, guerreiro! Contei essa pros meus caras outro dia, eles riram pra caramba. Você vai gostar.
po.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: Já leu os clássicos na escola? Escuta essa aqui!
po.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: Tá falando sério? Claro que sei. Presta atenção, recruta. Um soldado tá lá parado, sem fazer nada. O major vê e se aproxima.
po.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436: Escuta essa: Porquê o general está tão quieto?
po.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: Claro! Tem uma boa de hoje de manhã:
po.68f55145ccca592395d84d49: Uma das minhas favoritas, que eu lembrei outro dia.
po.68f551792a235725da0974fd: Como dizia o comandante da companhia em marcha forçada: “Quem cair, faz uma flexão e continua correndo”.
po.68f55190a7fef5206b0749d0: O comandante do batalhão tá passando instruções pros soldados:
po.68f551a7fe86376e961af7c7: O que é Halloween no exército? É quando os soldados do segundo ano fingem ter medo dos do primeiro ano.
po.68f551b2e32910d5e14f6d8b: Os soldados se dividem em dois tipos: os que correm pra briga e os que correm pra bem longe dela!
po.68f551bff76f53ad7ee47c03: Do manual do recruta: “Jogue a granada de um jeito que alguém morra junto com você”.
po.68f551eb3a67ad6de49ce6ca: Certa manhã, um tenente chega bêbado ao navio. O almirante aparece para uma inspeção:
po.68f5520e675667a8c2a5ad40: Uma das minhas favoritas: durante o treino da spetsnaz, ou ninguém aparece na aula de camuflagem, ou todo mundo tira nota máxima.
po.68f5523931d587154cf2dd5a: Três caras da Spetsnaz são enviados ao comandante da divisão para uma missão super secreta. Dois grandalhões e um cara pequeno e discreto…
po.68f5527c9cd7e2f1669721a6: Um monte de estudantes é mandado pra ajudar na cozinha. Eles perguntam pro suboficial:
po.68f552c17b217e671462fc14: Treinamento noturno da força aérea. O oficial de voo pergunta ao comandante do bombardeiro:
po.68f5532cae5aede5e5b1a2b3: O tenente verifica o quanto os soldados lembraram da última aula:
po.68f55347ee0e1dc1feb6110c: — E aí, cara, é da hora ser invocador de espíritos?
po.68f5535a020b02f0ca239d68: Lá vai uma… O sargento, pra tropa em formação:
po.68f5536ed7d93571752560d3: O que os artilheiros e os sabotadores têm em comum? Ambos discam o telefone sempre corretamente: Os sabotadores temem "você fez errado", os artilheiros temem "número errado".
po.68f5537b0e4d9c570d7ef374: Aqui uma piada que não é bem uma piada: Serviço militar é voluntário. Se você quer, você entra. Se não quiser, eles te levam do mesmo jeito.
po.68f5538892569b0c0ddbf3cf: Um paraquedista primeiro corre o mais longe que pode, depois tão longe quanto necessário.
po.691c3d4afe3ef46fed76fcb7: Ele está pensando. No nosso exército, se um general está quieto, ele está pensando ou é um retrato.
po.691c3e7fa47703ec120100fa: Raskolnikov entra na casa de penhores, e ela pergunta:
po.691c3e8f4de05c72b28ef368: — Rodion, você está aqui para ME FAZER UMA PERGUNTA?
po.691c3f011fdf8a2113b0742c: — Não, Mikhail Yuryevich Olenyev comeu eles.
po.691c3f614150a1383fb2c7c2: — Se arraste até aquela marca em "zug zug".
po.691c3f7aac6a2801a31494ce: — Eu disse "zug zug", então você vai fazer em "zug zug"!
po.691c3f8aa63b4505142f2e1a: — Soldado Kuzkin! Por que você não está cantando em formação?
po.691c3fd29a82d29d1d37ba7c: — Se não tivermos voluntários, terei que voluntariá-los eu mesmo.
po.691c3ff33f793ef1211ac99c: — O inimigo está atrás de nós, à esquerda, direita e à frente. O que você acha disso?
po.691c3ffd24929ac7628d5e66: — Bem, agora eles não vão se esconder de nós!
po.691c400ced1da533dd3f6c7c: — Este vai para as tropas da fronteira.
po.691c40229fcfc80e657af4c6: — A cabeça dele parece um toco de árvore.
po.691c40318793819142555336: — Por que você não tem medo de mim, Tenente?
po.691c40486cd22888ccfa130b: — Então por que você está bebendo?
po.691c408f3b5cb308e247eee3: — Ivanov! Campeão de boxe, CMS em levantamento de kettlebell!
po.691c409ef586f118f37f1073: — Petrov! Campeão de Sambo, CMS em kickboxing!
po.691c40ab778df0816ade5788: — Sidorov! Campeão de xadrez. Encarregado desses dois idiotas!
po.691c4115ee83913a9f93f8a2: — Claro que sim! Uma equipe de cinco…
po.691c417bb0ed883ba51970ef: — Oito, informe a visibilidade de voo.
po.691c4203d802565bc202f0e2: Ruim: você tem que encher essas sacolas com areia.
po.691c4207de21cba5efb00977: Bom: há bastante areia na pedreira próxima!
po.691c421af0ae00ef85d35465: — O que você faria em tempo de guerra para manter nossas ferrovias fora das mãos inimigas?
po.691c42fabf1df44ef2cb0b64: — Queimaria todos os bilhetes de trem…
po.691c43071a863166e54272ca: — Cuidado com a sua linguagem na frente de um oficial de recrutamento, jovem!
po.691c43151e323bfa3949880b: — Você não tem permissão para beber vodca no quartel, isso não é jardim de infância!
po.691c4342ef7fdd67066e89ce: A camuflagem era tão boa durante os exercícios militares que uma vaca acidentalmente comeu um soldado.
po.691c90a6874c3bf12e3eb4ae: — Soldado! O que você está fazendo?!
po.691c90b2cc98ce5ce1c7c7be: O soldado fica em posição de sentido e responde alegremente:
po.691c90d59ae5756f199fa402: — É por isso que não estou fazendo nada, senhor!

es.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: ¡Pues escucha, guerrero! Se lo conté a mis chicos hace poco y se partieron de risa. Te va a gustar.
es.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: ¿Alguna vez leíste los libros clásicos en el colegio? ¡Escucha este!
es.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: ¿Estás de coña? Claro que sí. Escucha bien, novato. Un soldado está parado sin hacer nada. Un mayor le ve y se acerca.
es.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436:
Escucha este:
—¿Por qué los generales son tan callados?
es.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: ¡Claro! Este es uno bueno de esta mañana:
es.68f55145ccca592395d84d49: Este es uno de mis favoritos que he recordado hace poco.
es.68f551792a235725da0974fd: Como dijo el comandante de la compañía durante una marcha forzada: "El que se caiga, que haga una flexión y siga corriendo".
es.68f55190a7fef5206b0749d0: El comandante del batallón informa a los soldados:
es.68f551a7fe86376e961af7c7: ¿Cómo es Halloween en el ejército? Es el único día en que los veteranos le tienen miedo a los "espíritus"… o sea, a los reclutas.

es.68f5520e675667a8c2a5ad40: Uno de mis favoritos: Ocurrió algo en el examen de camuflaje de las Spetsnaz: o nadie se presentó, o todos lo aprobaron con honores.
es.68f5523931d587154cf2dd5a: Tres tipos del Spetsnaz son enviados al comandante de división para una misión ultrasecreta. Dos grandullones y un tío bajito…
es.68f5527c9cd7e2f1669721a6: Un grupo de estudiantes es enviado a labores en la cocina. Y le preguntan al suboficial:
es.68f552c17b217e671462fc14: Durante un entrenamiento nocturno de la Fuerza Aérea, el oficial de vuelo le pregunta al comandante del bombardero:
es.68f5532cae5aede5e5b1a2b3: Un teniente comprueba si los soldados recuerdan bien la última lección:
es.68f55347ee0e1dc1feb6110c: —Eh, tío, ¿mola eso de ser un invocador de espíritus?
es.68f5535a020b02f0ca239d68: Aquí va uno… Un sargento se dirige a la tropa:
es.68f5536ed7d93571752560d3: ¿Qué tienen en común los artilleros y los zapadores? En que siempre marcan bien el número de teléfono: el zapador le teme al "número equivocado" y el artillero a "no acertar".
es.68f5537b0e4d9c570d7ef374: Aquí va un chiste, aunque no es exactamente un chiste: El servicio militar es voluntario. Si quieres hacerlo, lo haces. Y si no quieres, lo haces de todos modos.
es.68f5538892569b0c0ddbf3cf: Un paracaidista corre primero hasta donde puede… y luego, hasta donde debe.
es.68f553ae87f820bf62c0b5c1: Aquí va uno reciente, está para partirse:
es.691c3d4afe3ef46fed76fcb7: En nuestro ejército es simple: si el general está callado, es porque o está pensando… o es un retrato en la pared.
es.691c3e7fa47703ec120100fa: Raskólnikov entra a la casa de empeños y la mujer le pregunta:
es.691c3e8f4de05c72b28ef368: —Rodión, ¿has venido a preguntarme algo… o a hacer leña?
es.691c3f011fdf8a2113b0742c: —No, se las comió Mijaíl Yúryevich Olényev.
es.691c3f7aac6a2801a31494ce: —¡He dicho en zugzug, y lo harás en zugzug!
es.691c3f8aa63b4505142f2e1a: —¡Soldado Kuzkin! ¿Por qué no está cantando en la formación?
es.691c3fd29a82d29d1d37ba7c: —Si nadie se ofrece voluntario, yo seleccionaré a los voluntarios.
es.691c3ff33f793ef1211ac99c: —El enemigo está detrás de nosotros, a la izquierda, a la derecha y adelante… ¿Qué les parece?
es.691c3ffd24929ac7628d5e66: —¡Bueno, al menos no tienen dónde esconderse de nosotros!
es.691c40229fcfc80e657af4c6: —Su cabeza parece un tocón de árbol.
es.691c40318793819142555336: —¿Qué ocurre, teniente? ¿Acaso no me tiene miedo?
es.691c408f3b5cb308e247eee3: —¡Ivanov! ¡Campeón de boxeo y campeón de levantamiento de pesas rusas!
es.691c409ef586f118f37f1073: —¡Petrov! ¡Campeón de sambo y campeón de kickboxing!
es.691c40ab778df0816ade5788: —¡Sidorov! Campeón de ajedrez… ¡Al mando de estos dos idiotas!
es.691c4115ee83913a9f93f8a2: —¡Claro que sí! Un equipo de cinco tíos…
es.691c41fc74a22c8fbde8e937: —Tengo dos noticias: una mala y una buena.
es.691c4203d802565bc202f0e2: —La mala: Debéis llenar estos sacos con arena.
es.691c4207de21cba5efb00977: —La buena: ¡Hay un cojón de arena en la cantera de al lado!
es.691c421af0ae00ef85d35465: —¿Qué haréis para que el enemigo no tome nuestros trenes durante la guerra?
es.691c43071a863166e54272ca: —¡Joven, esa no es forma de dirigirse a un oficial de reclutamiento!
es.691c43151e323bfa3949880b: —No se permite beber vodka en el cuartel, ¡esto no es una guardería!
es.691c4342ef7fdd67066e89ce: El camuflaje era tan bueno durante los ejercicios militares que una vaca pasó y se comió a un soldado por accidente.
es.691c90b2cc98ce5ce1c7c7be: El soldado inmediatamente se pone firme y responde sonriendo:

es-mx.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4433: ¡Escucha este, guerrero! Se lo conté a mis muchachos hace poco y se murieron de la risa. Te va a gustar.
es-mx.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4434: ¿Alguna vez te tocó leer los libros clásicos en la escuela? ¡Escucha este!
es-mx.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4435: ¿Preguntas en serio? Claro que sí. Escucha este, novato. Un soldado está parado sin hacer nada. Un mayor lo ve y se le acerca.
es-mx.682f02ee15b1af55cd0b4436:
Escucha este:
—¿Por qué los generales son tan callados?
es-mx.68f5506ff7d2b67f54b6cc1c: ¡Por supuesto! Aquí te va uno muy bueno que me contaron en la mañana:
es-mx.68f55145ccca592395d84d49: Uno de mis favoritos que recordé hace poco.
