— Trouve le miroir.
Il est clair que la sorcière n’a pas fait ça par gentillesse : elle veut que vous remplissiez sa demande rapidement.
fr.6899d110c07ccf9225c2ca7c:
Vous fermez les yeux. Peut-être qu’ils n’ont pas tué la sorcière, mais ils ont brûlé un village entier ! Peut-être que c’est mieux ainsi.
Vous gardez les yeux clos jusqu’à ce que le dernier cri et le dernier râle d’agonie s’éteignent. Quand tout est terminé, la sorcière se tient à vos côtés.
— Apporte-moi le miroir !
fr.689c6d794fe50ff9942b2d21: Essayer de gagner leur confiance. Avec de la saucisse.
fr.689c6dcf48c70c8d466a2fe3:
Vous devez parler à ces hommes pour trouver l’artefact pour la sorcière.
Et quoi de mieux que de la nourriture pour rapprocher les gens ?
Vous sortez de votre sac un morceau de saucisse acheté au village et vous vous approchez des hommes.
fr.689c6ddbd2b0b1ead301aaac: J’ai de la nourriture. Je te la donne si tu me dis quelque chose.
fr.689c6de37a72829bdcefc20c: Hé ! Tu veux manger ? Réponds d’abord à mes questions !
fr.689c6e1303ba5b6f39a5b3d5:
Les hommes se figent de surprise et vous fixent, les yeux écarquillés. Leur regard descend vers la saucisse dans votre main. La faim s’allume aussitôt dans leurs yeux.

— C’est qui, bordel, celui-là ? Et pourquoi il est si culotté ? — crache celui à la voix aiguë en tirant son épée.
fr.689c6e958bcad34c0010e733: Ne fais pas l’idiot, j’ai tout entendu. Tu ne trouveras plus de provisions ici.
fr.689c6ed4279990335031bc08:
Vous décidez de mettre la pression aux bandits, mais vous sous-estimez leur désespoir.

— Va frimer ailleurs, — le grinçant s’avance vers vous. Le second, avec un accent, ricane et ajoute :

— De l’autre côté.

Tous deux se jettent sur vous, épées dégainées.
fr.689c6edd7fef3c34d45c32be:
Vous décidez de mettre la pression aux bandits, mais vous sous-estimez leur désespoir.

— Va frimer ailleurs, — le grinçant s’avance vers vous. Le second, avec un accent, ricane et ajoute :

— De l’autre côté.

Tous deux se jettent sur vous, épées dégainées.
fr.689c6f3b0e489eaadc7c3a9c:
Vous tentez désespérément de vous enfuir. Au diable le village brûlé, la sorcière et sa requête ! Vous voulez juste vivre.

Mais c’est inutile. Les hommes, malgré la faim, sont clairement mieux entraînés que vous. L’un d’eux vous rattrape.
fr.689c6f4a563d4717728d273e:
Vous savez que c’est fini. Vous ne pouvez pas semer ces bandits : affamés ou non, ils sont plus rapides et mieux entraînés.

Vous ne ressentez même pas la douleur lorsque la lame de l’homme à la voix aiguë vous tranche la tête d’un seul coup. Votre corps s’effondre, les doigts crispés sur la saucisse dans un spasme de mort. Les bandits l’arrachent de votre main, mais vous n’en avez plus conscience.

Vous êtes mort.
fr.689c6f7602d41260df62a293:
Une douleur fulgurante. Vos jambes se dérobent : votre colonne vertébrale sectionnée par une épée. Vous étouffez de terreur en baissant les yeux et en voyant la pointe de la lame ressortir près de votre plexus solaire.

Vous tombez à genoux, puis face contre terre. La saucisse glisse de vos mains. Un bandit s’approche et la ramasse. L’autre se dispute avec lui, mais vous ne distinguez plus les mots. Votre conscience s’éteint.

Vous mourez.

ge.68776e51a583a513398d76fe:
— My murderers must face punishment. But first, you must return what they stole from me.
You don’t know how to respond. It’s like everything’s already been decided for you. But maybe you should try something...
ge.68776eed138a88d7d40310fc: Where do I find your murderers?
ge.68776f130a3d5213d0b5b8aa:
The ghost leans forward, stopping mere inches from your face. Her voice turns into an eerie, otherworldly hiss.
— I don’t care. You’re here, so you’ll manage, — she says, pulling back with a careless shrug. — You don’t need to be a warrior. Being a thief will do.
ge.68776f27279785c6efb5aa5f:
— They came from the village by the road. Their home is there, and so is my stolen mirror. Bring it back to me.
You nod resignedly. The ghost glides beside you, placing her hand on your cheek. Or she would have, if she were alive. Instead, you feel an unbearable cold. Your cheek goes numb, but you stand still, unmoving. The witch pulls away and gestures toward the sword protruding from her body.
— Take this sword. You might need it. Now go, and don’t fail me.
ge.68776f9e898fc18e5b451dc3:
You step out of the hut and exhale shakily. A gentle breeze warms your chilled body. Rubbing your cheeks with your hands, you shrug off the lingering cold and adjust the bag on your shoulder. Now, a sword rests inside it.
You still haven’t fully processed what happened. Did you ever think you’d meet a ghost? Or help one?
But you have no choice. The witch’s magic won’t let you leave the swamps. You must do as she asked.
ge.68776fb1e03472f2f9d57bd9:
You head toward the village. This time, you don’t wander and walk straight to it.
At first, you don’t realize what’s wrong, but then the sparse swamp trees part, revealing the full scene.
The village is burned and pillaged. You freeze in place.
ge.68776fc7ac55d85e4e94c8a2: The wind carries the suffocating stench of smoke and burned flesh. You see corpses, such devastation... You want to flee, but your task holds you here. You must reach Targrad, no matter the cost. Perhaps the witch’s murderers are already dead... If so, bringing her the artifact might be enough. You hope it will satisfy her.
ge.68776fcafea5ef3f947f96d0:
The witch said her murderers were holed up in this village. But what do you do if they’re all dead now? Will the ghost listen to you? Or will she think you’re trying to deceive her?  
You realize you’re in deep trouble. But maybe you can at least find the artifact?
ge.68776fe61d62f818144929b3:
You approach the edge of the ruined village, crouching and moving cautiously. Whoever destroyed this place couldn’t have gotten far. The witch’s curse wouldn’t allow it.
Suddenly, you hear voices. They’re not begging for help or mourning the dead; they’re discussing mundane things. You realize these are the ones who attacked the village.
ge.687770119a6b54bdde1a5e09: Well, you’ve got nothing to lose. If they’re trapped here like you, maybe they won’t attack right away. If they do, death might spare you from carrying out the witch’s errand.
ge.6877701680ac1c8fc0a67cf8:
You decide to stay hidden for now. Who knows what these men, capable of destroying an entire village, might do to you? Luckily, none of them notice you.
You press yourself against the corner of a burned-out house and listen.
One man has a deep voice with a slight, unfamiliar accent. The other speaks without an accent, his voice higher and almost shrill.
— How can a village like this have so few supplies? I’m starving, and there’s nothing, — grumbles the one with the accent.
— We’re gonna die here! These swamps are cursed, and we’ve got no idea how to break the spell, — the shrill one replies hysterically. You realize they’re trapped here by the curse too. And they’re hungry.
ge.687770255d653efcf402554c:
You step forward, raising your hands to show you come in peace. Several tired-looking men stand before you. They grip their weapons tighter, eyeing you with wary fear as you emerge from behind the half-burned house.
— A live one, — says one of the men, slightly relaxing his shoulders. — Who are you?
You hear a faint accent in his voice, but you can’t place it. Not that it matters right now.
ge.68777038f3c351577685307e:
— I swear, chief knows something. Like, why we’re stuck here, — the shrill one lowers his voice, forcing you to lean forward to hear.
— Cut it out. How would he know? — The one with the accent seems less suspicious. — Don’t badmouth our leader!
— Alright, alright, it's just a theory!
You hear their footsteps fade as the men walk away.
ge.68777068417fdab26ffb8723:
You think the men might reveal more useful information. You follow them as quietly as possible, straining to listen, but you get too caught up and step on a dry, heat-cracked branch. It snaps loudly, and the men hear it.
— Who’s there? Come out now!
ge.687770798620a3432a97173b: Step out from your hiding spot.
ge.68777097aef5de13e6265bc8:
You can’t think of anything better than to bolt. You dart around the corner. The house you were hiding behind is missing a wall, so the men spot you.
— Stop, you little rat! — the shrill one yells. You notice him giving chase. The other man, for some reason, is nowhere in sight.
ge.687770ab8a0d6fb48d25b5cb: But not for long. He suddenly appears in front of you, stepping out from around a corner. You veer to the side, but there’s a pile of half-burned logs blocking your path. Behind you, the shrill one is closing in. You’re trapped.
ge.687770b814300497ca1dc887: I’m stuck here just like you!
ge.687770bdc888ca05f005a144: I’m a messenger of the Order of Navigators!
ge.687770c4d13a96e750824979:
— Then why were you eavesdropping? — the one with the accent asks, still skeptical, though he lowers his sword.
— Yeah, and why’d you run? — the shrill one chimes in.
ge.687770c82e35b771f834f773: — We’ve never heard of that, — the accented one says, drawing his sword again and eyeing you suspiciously. You’ve got one last card to play.
ge.687770ea7116dd4e4ccab803: I’m stuck here just like you!
ge.6877710b743696531c94767d:
The men exchange glances and burst into synchronized laughter.
— What’s so funny? — a new voice booms, low and harsh. Both men snap to attention. You turn around.
From behind the ruins of another burned house, several more figures emerge. They’re clearly from the same band: exhausted, angry, and deeply terrified beneath it all.
— Who’s this now? — a tall man in leather armor stares at you. His mustache is sharply twisted, and his gaze drips with disdain and distrust.
Well, it seems this is the leader. You’re already exhausted from dealing with bandits today!
ge.6877713d71fb89187f2c6ae8: I’m stuck here just like you.
ge.68777142b10562bdb441afbc: I’m just a messenger of the Order of Navigators.
ge.687771498198fb94b7c7f178:
The men exchange glances at your words.
— Never heard of it. Where’d you come from? All the locals are long dead.
They tense up again and start closing in on you.
ge.6877714dcd7817d80cab402c:
Now the men look at you differently.
— We’ve been trying to get out of here for who knows how long! — says one who’d been silent until now. The other elbows him in the side.
— Just spill everything already!
— What’s it matter? Maybe he’s been sent to sort this mess and get us out!
ge.68777164c6503bbfbef44368: I know something... Maybe I can help.
ge.68777169d27ffb1fd3b7fe3c: I think we should team up.
ge.68777172ecaff18af8343399:
You realize this is your chance, there won’t be another. The men stare at you, as if weighing your words. Something you said clearly struck a chord.
Suddenly, there’s a noise nearby. From behind the ruins of another burned house, several more figures emerge. They’re clearly part of the same band: exhausted, angry, and deeply terrified beneath it all.
— Who’s this now? — a tall man in leather armor stares at you. His mustache is sharply twisted, and his gaze drips with disdain and distrust. Your new acquaintances both snap to attention.
Well, it seems this is the leader. You’re already exhausted from dealing with bandits today!
ge.6877717c1c47f3efb21336d5:
— He says he’s trapped here like us. Says he might help, — one of them introduces you. The leader squints and sneers.
— And how’s this runt supposed to help us? Can you even hold a sword?
ge.687771b646f9b37bd9a181fb: I know what will get us all out of here.
ge.687771bd405ba3f4e15b922c:
The bandit leader raises an eyebrow, then laughs with a cruel, mocking sound. His lackeys join in, their laughter hollow.
— In what, then? Writing? We don’t need scribes. Words? Those are useless too.
ge.687771c1612fd19c7a89c97d: I know what will get us all out of here.
ge.687771cda360c1de351bf14a:
You see the entire group staring at you, hope flickering in their eyes. The leader, though, isn’t convinced.
— Why should we trust you? Tell us what you know first, then we’ll decide if you’re worth believing.
ge.687771f65c6bc4cd5a76e726:
You decide there’s no point in hiding anything. These bandits want to escape the cursed swamps just as badly as you do. Right now, you’re allies, and many of them likely understand that.
— It’s all because of the locals. They killed the swamp witch and stole a valuable artifact. She wants it back. And, of course, she wants revenge.
A few bandits glance around nervously, as if looking for those responsible for the witch’s death. But alas, they’re the ones who killed them.
ge.687771fb4af817d6da36adb1:
These are the bandits who wiped out an entire village. Trusting them completely would be foolish. What if they kill you as soon as they hear the truth? You decide to play it safe.
— t’s because of the witch. She was killed and robbed by the people of this village. She sent me to find what was stolen. If anything happens to me, she’ll destroy everyone in the area.
Of course, the witch never said you were particularly important, but the bandits don’t need to know that.
You see in their eyes that they believe you. Now they look at you with more respect than before. Some even step back slightly, as if afraid.
ge.68777209d2f6c5d9902e84b5: — So, what do you suggest we do? — the leader asks, frowning and staring at you expectantly.
ge.6877724575c61507df6aa339: We need to find the stolen mirror.
ge.68777248a82ae5340e85a3b4: We need to figure out how to trick the witch.
ge.6877725b6e4d07907a24ec43:
Why come up with something new when the witch already gave you a clear path? Sure, you can’t punish the guilty, but maybe that’s for the best?
The bandit leader frowns discontentedly. Something shifts in his movements, but you can’t quite place what. You’re distracted by the high-pitched voice of a young man standing just behind him.  
— We did see a strange mirror that doesn’t burn! A round one.
The leader spins toward the young man and practically growls:
— That’s definitely. Not. It!
You freeze, as does the young man. That kind of reaction can only mean one thing.
ge.6877725ec0232b786f36d303:
You realize the witch probably won’t be satisfied with just the artifact. And that’s not even considering how you’ll get it in the first place. You start to think, but the same young man who mentioned the mirror suddenly speaks up again.
— What if we just banish the witch? — everyone turns to look at him, and he shrugs, — I would’ve tried earlier, but we didn’t know about the witch!
ge.68777ebcddf7bdc1b5294ff3: You have the mirror, don't you?
ge.68777ec7e80e2cdbbbf16d59: Do you know how to do that?
ge.68777ecb09285caee7e293ed: Is there anyone here who knows how to do that?
ge.68777eea8cf0f973aecd50a8:
— Well, yeah, I know how, — the young man says, puffing out his chest with a boastful grin. — I was a priest with Turva’s band. I’ve done crazier things than this!
It’s a reasonable idea. But can you really trust your life to some young kid?
ge.68777eed0334393e733d8657:
— Yeah, I do, — the young man says, spreading his arms, — I was a priest with Turva’s band. I’ve done crazier things than this.
It’s a solid idea. But can you really trust your life to some kid?
ge.68777f1371ec3fda827cd7a4: You shake your head. Maybe the kid really is a priest, but taking such a risk... You want to escape these swamps, not get stuck here forever because of an angry witch’s whim.
ge.68777f1a90768808625407d6:
Here goes nothing! You agree to the young man’s plan. The leader rubs his chin thoughtfully, then shrugs:
— Might as well try. We’ve got nothing to lose.
He turns his gaze to you.
— Alright, lead the way to where this witch of yours is hiding.
ge.68777f632cb5f630737f0645: We need to find the stolen mirror.
ge.68777fdde9dbf46430a8b89a:
You lead the group through the swamps, heading straight for the hut. The journey seems to take longer than it should, but you brush off the strangeness.
You stop right in front of the hut. The young man who claims to be a priest tugs at your sleeve to get your attention.
— By the way, I’m Mstislav. Call me Slavka, — he says with a grin, nodding toward the hut. — Just thought you should know the name of the guy who’s gonna banish that witch, right?
He laughs, as if he’s not scared at all.
ge.68777ff59f3cf8c68c46e6a3:
The leader turns to you, glaring with disdain.
— And if I’ve got the mirror, so what? You gonna take it from me? Think you're up for it?
ge.68778003999b2330c41b3ccb:
Your body aches from what happened just hours ago. You draw your sword, but your movements are clumsy. The bandit leader smirks, watching your struggle with the weapon.
— You’ve never held anything heavier than a quill, you little punk!
He deftly draws his own sword and advances, winding up for a strike. You realize the force of his blow will be too much for you to block.
ge.6877800552157c87b8a740c7:
You surprisingly draw your sword with ease. Traces of the witch’s blood still stain the blade, but you pay it no mind. You have a goal, and nothing stands in your way. You grip the hilt tightly and lock eyes with the leader.
— Look at this serious guy! — they mock, but you don’t take the bait.
The leader draws his weapon and comes at you, winding up for a strike.
ge.6877809c1f2529646b28b4de:
You slide to the side, dodging the path of the strike. The sword whistles past your ear but doesn’t touch you. The leader spins with the momentum, trying to hit you again. You leap back.
The other bandits haven’t joined the fight yet. You see confusion on their faces. It’s dawning on them that their leader is willing to sacrifice both his life and theirs for greed.
You realize you could call out to them. But doing so might distract you, leaving you open to the leader’s next strike.
ge.6877809f9322bd17f049d9e6: ...But what does it matter? The fury of battle engulfs you, its fire burning hot. You meet the leader’s strike with your blade... or try to, as the force of his blow obliterates your barely prepared defense. You’re knocked to the side, tripping over a charred piece of wood and falling. You don’t scream, no, just curse and struggle to get up.
ge.687780e458982e675f3b55ec:
The leader steps closer and spits near you. For a moment, you freeze, looking up at him.
— Too much pride, you little punk, — he sneers, raising his sword above you, — Send my regards to that witch of yours.
He swings down. The blade cuts through your unarmored body like butter, slicing your heart.
You die before you can take your final breath.
ge.687780f9863b6ec75207f1a5: Don’t you see he’s ready to risk your lives for his own gain?!
ge.68778108bc8407c6acdf1e18:
You notice a few bandits flinch, exchanging glances. You know standing up alone against someone stronger is always terrifying, but there are so many of them! You hope for their common sense.  
And you’re not wrong.
The young man who mentioned the mirror is the first to raise his hand.
— He’s really ready to cling to that mirror until he dies!
Another man nods, grabbing his battle axe.
— Yeah, until we all die here like dogs! How many days have we been slogging through these swamps?! My junk’s already crawling with leeches!
One by one, they start grumbling angrily. You’d love to listen, but the leader clearly plans to deal with you first before sorting out the others.
ge.6877810c4dcbc02930d301bc:
There’s no time to get distracted. Dying a martyr to some pathetic deserter bandit’s blade isn’t the fate you dreamed of.
You miss the chance to gain allies but don’t miss the leader’s strike. Dodging just in time, you swing back, but he deftly parries and nicks you with his sword. The blade tears through your clothes and slices your side. You scream in pain.
— Not so brave now, huh? — the leader taunts, stepping closer. His eyes gleam with bloodlust.
Suddenly, you feel a presence, something intangible to ordinary senses. The air grows colder, and you shiver. Something is trying to merge with you. You hear a faint whisper: "Let me in".
ge.68778175a6d0eaf0f969dd89:
You’ve felt this cold before, back in the swamp hut. The witch has come to your aid, and who are you to refuse her?
You let her in, gasping from the icy chill. It feels like being plunged into a frozen lake in winter.
From that moment, you’re a passenger in your own body: your arms and legs move on their own, your tongue speaks words in an unfamiliar language. A bell seems to toll in your head. You see everything in flashes.
The leader freezes mid-sentence in a ridiculous pose. His eyes, wide with primal terror, flash before you. His head, severed from his body, rolls across the ground.
ge.6877817a7062e46f9300666d: No, your body will never be defiled by vile magic, no spirits will touch you. You resist with every ounce of strength left. The witch’s voice whispers in your ear that you’re a fool, then fades. Right as the leader’s blade severs your head.
ge.687781bd55214a43034cb837: You smile and introduce yourself in return. The guy seems decent. Maybe later you can guide him toward the true path, to join your Order of Navigators. But that’s for later. Right now, the more pressing question is whether Mstislav can handle the witch.
ge.687781c4b618a1b138c6f8ca: You couldn’t care less about his name. What matters far more is whether he can deal with the witch. You hope he can, as does likely every living soul trapped in these swamps.
ge.687781e523ad21a5fbf4be50:
Only you and Mstislav dare to enter the hut. The corpse still lies on the floor. You shiver, though the biting cold that comes with the ghost’s presence isn’t here now.
Mstislav takes a deep breath, exhales loudly, closes his eyes, and begins reciting a prayer.
You feel a strange tremor and step back, as if making way for the words, almost a song. The candle flames in the hut flicker out, plunging everything into darkness. You hadn’t even noticed they’d been burning this whole time!
ge.687781ee3098c5ff6a93592a:
Now it’s getting cold. You hug your shoulders, shifting from foot to foot, waiting for the witch to appear, but she doesn’t. Slavka finishes the prayer, swaying slightly with his eyes closed, then sighs. The cold vanishes as abruptly as it came.
You both stand silently, listening. The hut seems to grow brighter, despite the extinguished candles.
— Well, looks like that’s it, — Mstislav says with a smile, scratching the back of his head. — No more evil here. I think we can leave now.
ge.687781f81ccbcc5602cb5443:
You step out of the hut like victors. The bandits look at you with hope. Even the leader allows himself to ask:
— That’s it? We’re free?
ge.6877820fa57acb6be31ff898: Cheers erupt. The bandits slap you and Slavka on the shoulders. The ordeal is finally over. They can finally leave.
ge.6877821dd501bb8f2de08652:
You walk away. And keep walking. And walking. It feels normal at first: maybe the distances here are just vast without magic?
But then...
ge.6877823dfdc066fea438e04d:
...you arrive back at the same hut.
It seems there’s no escape from this place.
ge.68778244871265ea10dcb70c: There’s still a chance to do things right and return the mirror to the witch!
ge.6877824f42aef7da99a5352a:
But as soon as you mention it, the leader snorts derisively.
— Hell no, I’m not giving up a damn thing.
ge.687782cdad7684ddfb627cfd: Finally, it’s over. You no longer feel the witch’s ghostly presence. You collapse to your knees, catching your breath, then quickly check your side. Nothing, just torn clothes. It seems the witch healed your wound. You whisper a silent gratitude.
ge.687782d81a97f0f7fda3ba5e:
The bandits stare at you, unsure whether to fear or praise you.
— Well, looks like the mirror’s yours now, — the young man says, snapping out of it first. You nod and try to stand.
ge.687782f2810ddd6883ad65ec:
He makes a subtle movement, and you barely dodge in time. His blade grazes your arm, cutting nearly to the bone, but better that than your heart. You can hardly hold your sword, but it’s no longer necessary.
The rebelling bandits surround their leader. You see them arguing, but only until the young man sneaks up behind him and drives a dagger under his ribs.
The leader wheezes and collapses. In a futile attempt to stay upright, he clutches at the air. No one moves to help him.
When he finally breathes his last, the young man rummages through his jacket and pulls out the mirror.
— Alright, we’ll patch you up and take the mirror to the witch! — he says with a smile.
ge.687787ad21b770c98efdbce5:
Suddenly, everyone flinches back. Some cross themselves, others curse. You jerk your head up and see the witch standing between you and the bandits.
— Vengeance, I need vengeance, — she almost growls. Her hair is disheveled, writhing like snakes. Even you feel uneasy. — They’re mine.
— But we didn’t do anything! We didn’t kill you! — someone shouts from the crowd. Everyone nods, as if that could convince a bloodthirsty otherworldly being. Is it even worth getting involved?
ge.687787f2cec442460aea3c69: This is no longer your business.
ge.6882b31e44acfd5dd15e7b11:
As soon as you speak, an icy band clamps around your throat. You clutch your neck, gasping for air.
— They killed those who killed me. They took their sins upon themselves, — the witch says without turning to you. You realize the undead have their own logic, beyond the grasp of the living. But you’re not ready to accept it! You leap to your feet and charge at the ghost, as if you could actually do something. And you believe you can, until the witch extends her hand and passes it straight through your chest.
ge.6882b3292499b80cee57f584:
At first, you feel nothing. Then your heart seems to forget how to beat. You clutch your chest and collapse.
You die to the screams and death rattles of the bandits being torn apart by the witch.
ge.6882b33e86d1a7850df26159:
You close your eyes. Maybe they didn’t kill the witch, but they burned an entire village! Perhaps this is for the best.
You keep your eyes shut until the last scream and dying gasp fade. When it’s over, the witch is beside you.
— Bring me the mirror!
ge.688b66caafc1aba624722439:
The leader turns to you, glaring with contempt.
— And if have it, so what? You gonna take it from me? Think you're up for it?
ge.688b67ad75e02713bc02e77e:
Suddenly, everyone flinches back. Some cross themselves, others curse. You jerk your head up and see the witch standing between you and the bandits.
— Vengeance, I need vengeance, — she almost growls. Her hair is disheveled, writhing like snakes. Even you feel uneasy. — They’re mine.
— But we didn’t do anything! We didn’t kill you! — someone shouts from the crowd. Everyone nods, as if that could convince a bloodthirsty otherworldly being. Is it even worth getting involved?
ge.6899c0f38dd72da50ae7242d:
She touches you, and a chill spreads from the contact through your body. Your wounds close, breathing becomes easier, and the pain fades.
— Find the mirror.
It’s clear the witch didn’t do this out of kindness, she wants you to fulfill her demand quickly.
ge.6899c1e5ddb734a7304022f5:
You close your eyes. Maybe they didn’t kill the witch, but they burned an entire village! Perhaps this is for the best.
You keep your eyes shut until the last scream and dying gasp fade. When it’s over, the witch is beside you.
— Bring me the mirror!
ge.6899c25833f86014545ae014:
You close your eyes. Maybe they didn’t kill the witch, but they burned an entire village! Perhaps this is for the best.
You keep your eyes shut until the last scream and dying gasp fade. When it’s over, the witch is beside you.
— Bring me the mirror!
ge.6899cbaf967b650ad527c24c:
She touches you, and a chill spreads from the contact through your body. Your wounds close, breathing becomes easier, and the pain fades.
— Find the mirror.
It’s clear the witch didn’t do this out of kindness, she wants you to fulfill her demand quickly.
ge.6899d110c07ccf9225c2ca7c:
You close your eyes. Maybe they didn’t kill the witch, but they burned an entire village! Perhaps this is for the best.
You keep your eyes shut until the last scream and dying gasp fade. When it’s over, the witch is beside you.
— Bring me the mirror!
ge.689c6d794fe50ff9942b2d21: Try to gain their trust. With sausage.
ge.689c6dcf48c70c8d466a2fe3:
You need to talk to these people to find the artifact for the witch.
And what brings people closer than food?
You pull a piece of sausage bought in the village from your pack and approach the men.
ge.689c6ddbd2b0b1ead301aaac: I’ve got food. I’ll give it to you if you tell me something.
ge.689c6de37a72829bdcefc20c: Hey! Want to eat? Answer my questions first!
ge.689c6e1303ba5b6f39a5b3d5:
The men freeze in surprise, staring at you wide-eyed. Their gazes drop to the sausage in your hands. Hunger flares in their eyes instantly.

— Who the hell are you? And why so bold? — the shrill-voiced one sneers, drawing his sword.
ge.689c6e958bcad34c0010e733: Don’t play dumb, I heard everything. You won’t find any more supplies here.
ge.689c6ed4279990335031bc08:
You decide to press the bandits, but you misjudge how desperate they are.

— You can show off somewhere else, — the shrill one advances on you. The second, with an accent, snorts and adds:

— On the other side.

Both lunge at you, swords bared.
ge.689c6edd7fef3c34d45c32be:
— Hold it right there, — the accented one also draws his sword. You step back, not taking your eyes off them. They’re fixated on the sausage in your hands.

It happens too fast, you don’t even have time to draw the sword the witch gave you. Both men charge like starving dogs, teeth bared, movements jerky. They know exactly what they’re doing.
ge.689c6f3b0e489eaadc7c3a9c:
You make a desperate attempt to flee. To hell with the burned village, the witch, and her request! You just want to live.

But it’s no use. The men, though hungry, are clearly better trained than you. One catches up.
ge.689c6f4a563d4717728d273e:
You know it’s the end. You can’t outrun these bandits: hungry or not, they’re faster, better trained.

You don’t even feel the pain as the shrill one’s blade severs your head in one swing. Your body collapses, fingers clutching the sausage in a death spasm. The bandits pry it from your grip, but you no longer care.

You’re dead.
ge.689c6f7602d41260df62a293:
A sharp pain. Your legs give out: your spine severed by a sword. You choke on terror, glancing down to see the blade’s tip protruding near your solar plexus.

You fall to your knees, then face-first. The sausage slips from your hands. One bandit steps closer and takes it. The other argues with him, but you can’t make out the words. Consciousness fades.

You die.

hu.68776e51a583a513398d76fe:
— My murderers must face punishment. But first, you must return what they stole from me.
You don’t know how to respond. It’s like everything’s already been decided for you. But maybe you should try something...
hu.68776eed138a88d7d40310fc: Where do I find your murderers?
hu.68776f130a3d5213d0b5b8aa:
The ghost leans forward, stopping mere inches from your face. Her voice turns into an eerie, otherworldly hiss.
— I don’t care. You’re here, so you’ll manage, — she says, pulling back with a careless shrug. — You don’t need to be a warrior. Being a thief will do.
hu.68776f27279785c6efb5aa5f:
— They came from the village by the road. Their home is there, and so is my stolen mirror. Bring it back to me.
You nod resignedly. The ghost glides beside you, placing her hand on your cheek. Or she would have, if she were alive. Instead, you feel an unbearable cold. Your cheek goes numb, but you stand still, unmoving. The witch pulls away and gestures toward the sword protruding from her body.
— Take this sword. You might need it. Now go, and don’t fail me.
hu.68776f9e898fc18e5b451dc3:
You step out of the hut and exhale shakily. A gentle breeze warms your chilled body. Rubbing your cheeks with your hands, you shrug off the lingering cold and adjust the bag on your shoulder. Now, a sword rests inside it.
You still haven’t fully processed what happened. Did you ever think you’d meet a ghost? Or help one?
But you have no choice. The witch’s magic won’t let you leave the swamps. You must do as she asked.
hu.68776fb1e03472f2f9d57bd9:
You head toward the village. This time, you don’t wander and walk straight to it.
At first, you don’t realize what’s wrong, but then the sparse swamp trees part, revealing the full scene.
The village is burned and pillaged. You freeze in place.
hu.68776fc7ac55d85e4e94c8a2: The wind carries the suffocating stench of smoke and burned flesh. You see corpses, such devastation... You want to flee, but your task holds you here. hu.68776fcafea5ef3f947f96d0:

You realize you’re in deep trouble. But maybe you can at least find the artifact?
hu.68776fe61d62f818144929b3:
You approach the edge of the ruined village, crouching and moving cautiously. Whoever destroyed this place couldn’t have gotten far. The witch’s curse wouldn’t allow it.
Suddenly, you hear voices. They’re not begging for help or mourning the dead; they’re discussing mundane things. You realize these are the ones who attacked the village.
hu.687770119a6b54bdde1a5e09: Well, you’ve got nothing to lose. If they’re trapped here like you, maybe they won’t attack right away. If they do, death might spare you from carrying out the witch’s errand.
hu.6877701680ac1c8fc0a67cf8:
You decide to stay hidden for now. Who knows what these men, capable of destroying an entire village, might do to you? Luckily, none of them notice you.
You press yourself against the corner of a burned-out house and listen.
One man has a deep voice with a slight, unfamiliar accent. The other speaks without an accent, his voice higher and almost shrill.
— How can a village like this have so few supplies? I’m starving, and there’s nothing, — grumbles the one with the accent.
— We’re gonna die here! These swamps are cursed, and we’ve got no idea how to break the spell, — the shrill one replies hysterically. You realize they’re trapped here by the curse too. And they’re hungry.
hu.687770255d653efcf402554c:
You step forward, raising your hands to show you come in peace. Several tired-looking men stand before you. They grip their weapons tighter, eyeing you with wary fear as you emerge from behind the half-burned house.
— A live one, — says one of the men, slightly relaxing his shoulders. — Who are you?
You hear a faint accent in his voice, but you can’t place it. Not that it matters right now.
hu.68777038f3c351577685307e:
— I swear, chief knows something. Like, why we’re stuck here, — the shrill one lowers his voice, forcing you to lean forward to hear.
— Cut it out. How would he know? — The one with the accent seems less suspicious. — Don’t badmouth our leader!
— Alright, alright, it's just a theory!
You hear their footsteps fade as the men walk away.
hu.68777068417fdab26ffb8723:
You think the men might reveal more useful information. You follow them as quietly as possible, straining to listen, but you get too caught up and step on a dry, heat-cracked branch. It snaps loudly, and the men hear it.
— Who’s there? Come out now!
hu.687770798620a3432a97173b: Step out from your hiding spot.
hu.68777097aef5de13e6265bc8:
You can’t think of anything better than to bolt. You dart around the corner. The house you were hiding behind is missing a wall, so the men spot you.
— Stop, you little rat! — the shrill one yells. You notice him giving chase. The other man, for some reason, is nowhere in sight.
hu.687770ab8a0d6fb48d25b5cb: But not for long. He suddenly appears in front of you, stepping out from around a corner. You veer to the side, but there’s a pile of half-burned logs blocking your path. Behind you, the shrill one is closing in. You’re trapped.
hu.687770b814300497ca1dc887: I’m stuck here just like you!

hu.687770c4d13a96e750824979:

hu.687770c82e35b771f834f773: — We’ve never heard of that, — the accented one says, drawing his sword again and eyeing you suspiciously. You’ve got one last card to play.
hu.687770ea7116dd4e4ccab803: I’m stuck here just like you!

— Who’s this now? — a tall man in leather armor stares at you. His mustache is sharply twisted, and his gaze drips with disdain and distrust.
Well, it seems this is the leader. You’re already exhausted from dealing with bandits today!
hu.6877713d71fb89187f2c6ae8: I’m stuck here just like you.
hu.68777142b10562bdb441afbc: I’m just a messenger of the Order of Navigators.
hu.687771498198fb94b7c7f178:

hu.6877714dcd7817d80cab402c:

hu.68777164c6503bbfbef44368: I know something... Maybe I can help.
hu.68777169d27ffb1fd3b7fe3c: I think we should team up.

Suddenly, there’s a noise nearby. From behind the ruins of another burned house, several more figures emerge. They’re clearly part of the same band: exhausted, angry, and deeply terrified beneath it all.
— Who’s this now? — a tall man in leather armor stares at you. His mustache is sharply twisted, and his gaze drips with disdain and distrust. Your new acquaintances both snap to attention.

hu.6877717c1c47f3efb21336d5:

hu.687771b646f9b37bd9a181fb: I know what will get us all out of here.

hu.687771c1612fd19c7a89c97d: I know what will get us all out of here.

hu.687771fb4af817d6da36adb1:

hu.68777209d2f6c5d9902e84b5: — So, what do you suggest we do? — the leader asks, frowning and staring at you expectantly.

hu.68777248a82ae5340e85a3b4: We need to figure out how to trick the witch.

hu.68777ebcddf7bdc1b5294ff3: You have the mirror, don't you?
hu.68777ec7e80e2cdbbbf16d59: Do you know how to do that?
hu.68777ecb09285caee7e293ed: Is there anyone here who knows how to do that?
hu.68777eea8cf0f973aecd50a8:

hu.68777eed0334393e733d8657:

hu.68777f1371ec3fda827cd7a4: You shake your head. Maybe the kid really is a priest, but taking such a risk... You want to escape these swamps, not get stuck here forever because of an angry witch’s whim.
hu.68777f1a90768808625407d6:
Here goes nothing! You agree to the young man’s plan. The leader rubs his chin thoughtfully, then shrugs:
— Might as well try. We’ve got nothing to lose.
He turns his gaze to you.
— Alright, lead the way to where this witch of yours is hiding.
hu.68777f632cb5f630737f0645: We need to find the stolen mirror.
hu.68777fdde9dbf46430a8b89a:
You lead the group through the swamps, heading straight for the hut. The journey seems to take longer than it should, but you brush off the strangeness.
You stop right in front of the hut. The young man who claims to be a priest tugs at your sleeve to get your attention.
— By the way, I’m Mstislav. Call me Slavka, — he says with a grin, nodding toward the hut. — Just thought you should know the name of the guy who’s gonna banish that witch, right?

hu.68777ff59f3cf8c68c46e6a3:
The leader turns to you, glaring with disdain.
— And if I’ve got the mirror, so what? You gonna take it from me? Think you're up for it?
hu.68778003999b2330c41b3ccb:
Your body aches from what happened just hours ago. You draw your sword, but your movements are clumsy. The bandit leader smirks, watching your struggle with the weapon.
— You’ve never held anything heavier than a quill, you little punk!
He deftly draws his own sword and advances, winding up for a strike. You realize the force of his blow will be too much for you to block.
hu.6877800552157c87b8a740c7:
You surprisingly draw your sword with ease. Traces of the witch’s blood still stain the blade, but you pay it no mind. You have a goal, and nothing stands in your way. You grip the hilt tightly and lock eyes with the leader.
— Look at this serious guy! — they mock, but you don’t take the bait.
The leader draws his weapon and comes at you, winding up for a strike.
hu.6877809c1f2529646b28b4de:
You slide to the side, dodging the path of the strike. The sword whistles past your ear but doesn’t touch you. The leader spins with the momentum, trying to hit you again. You leap back.
The other bandits haven’t joined the fight yet. You see confusion on their faces. It’s dawning on them that their leader is willing to sacrifice both his life and theirs for greed.
You realize you could call out to them. But doing so might distract you, leaving you open to the leader’s next strike.
hu.6877809f9322bd17f049d9e6: ...But what does it matter? The fury of battle engulfs you, its fire burning hot. You meet the leader’s strike with your blade... or try to, as the force of his blow obliterates your barely prepared defense. You’re knocked to the side, tripping over a charred piece of wood and falling. You don’t scream, no, just curse and struggle to get up.
hu.687780e458982e675f3b55ec:
The leader steps closer and spits near you. For a moment, you freeze, looking up at him.
— Too much pride, you little punk, — he sneers, raising his sword above you, — Send my regards to that witch of yours.
He swings down. The blade cuts through your unarmored body like butter, slicing your heart.
You die before you can take your final breath.
hu.687780f9863b6ec75207f1a5: Don’t you see he’s ready to risk your lives for his own gain?!
hu.68778108bc8407c6acdf1e18:
You notice a few bandits flinch, exchanging glances. You know standing up alone against someone stronger is always terrifying, but there are so many of them! You hope for their common sense.  
And you’re not wrong.
The young man who mentioned the mirror is the first to raise his hand.
— He’s really ready to cling to that mirror until he dies!
Another man nods, grabbing his battle axe.
— Yeah, until we all die here like dogs! How many days have we been slogging through these swamps?! My junk’s already crawling with leeches!
One by one, they start grumbling angrily. You’d love to listen, but the leader clearly plans to deal with you first before sorting out the others.
hu.6877810c4dcbc02930d301bc:
There’s no time to get distracted. Dying a martyr to some pathetic deserter bandit’s blade isn’t the fate you dreamed of.

— Not so brave now, huh? — the leader taunts, stepping closer. His eyes gleam with bloodlust.
Suddenly, you feel a presence, something intangible to ordinary senses. The air grows colder, and you shiver. Something is trying to merge with you. You hear a faint whisper: "Let me in".
hu.68778175a6d0eaf0f969dd89:
You’ve felt this cold before, back in the swamp hut. The witch has come to your aid, and who are you to refuse her?
You let her in, gasping from the icy chill. It feels like being plunged into a frozen lake in winter.
From that moment, you’re a passenger in your own body: your arms and legs move on their own, your tongue speaks words in an unfamiliar language. A bell seems to toll in your head. You see everything in flashes.
The leader freezes mid-sentence in a ridiculous pose. His eyes, wide with primal terror, flash before you. His head, severed from his body, rolls across the ground.
hu.6877817a7062e46f9300666d: No, your body will never be defiled by vile magic, no spirits will touch you. You resist with every ounce of strength left. The witch’s voice whispers in your ear that you’re a fool, then fades. Right as the leader’s blade severs your head.
hu.687781bd55214a43034cb837: You smile and introduce yourself in return. The guy seems decent. Maybe later you can guide him toward the true path, to join your Order of Navigators. But that’s for later. Right now, the more pressing question is whether Mstislav can handle the witch.
hu.687781c4b618a1b138c6f8ca: You couldn’t care less about his name. What matters far more is whether he can deal with the witch. You hope he can, as does likely every living soul trapped in these swamps.

hu.687781f81ccbcc5602cb5443:

— Sono venuti dal villaggio lungo la strada. La loro casa è lì, e così anche il mio specchio rubato. Riportamelo.
Annuisci rassegnato. Il fantasma ti sfiora, posandoti una mano sulla guancia. O almeno lo farebbe, se fosse viva. Invece, senti un freddo insopportabile. La guancia ti si intorpidisce, ma rimani immobile, senza muoverti. La strega si allontana e indica la spada che sporge dal suo corpo.
            — Prendi questa spada. Potrebbe servirti. Ora vai e non deludermi.
it.68776f9e898fc18e5b451dc3:
Esci dalla capanna ed espiri tremando. Una leggera brezza riscalda il tuo corpo infreddolito. Ti strofini le guance con le mani, scrolli di dosso il freddo persistente e aggiusti la borsa sulla spalla. Ora al suo interno c'è una spada.
Non hai ancora elaborato completamente ciò che è successo. Avresti mai pensato di incontrare un fantasma? O di aiutarlo? Ma non hai scelta. La magia della strega non ti permetterà di lasciare le paludi. Devi fare come ti ha chiesto.
it.68776fb1e03472f2f9d57bd9:
Ti dirigi verso il villaggio. Questa volta non vaghi, ma cammini dritto verso di esso.
            All'inizio non capisci cosa c'è che non va, ma poi gli alberi sparsi della palude si aprono, rivelando l'intera scena.
            Il villaggio è bruciato e saccheggiato. Ti blocchi sul posto.
it.68776fc7ac55d85e4e94c8a2: Il vento trasporta il fetore soffocante del fumo e della carne bruciata. Vedi cadaveri, tanta devastazione... Vorresti fuggire, ma il tuo compito ti trattiene qui. Devi raggiungere Targrad, a qualsiasi costo. Forse gli assassini della strega sono già morti... Se così fosse, portarle il manufatto potrebbe essere sufficiente. Speri che questo la soddisfi.
it.68776fcafea5ef3f947f96d0:
La strega ha detto che i suoi assassini si erano rifugiati in questo villaggio. Ma cosa fare se ora sono tutti morti? Il fantasma ti ascolterà? O penserà che stai cercando di ingannarla?
            Ti rendi conto di essere in guai seri. Ma forse potresti almeno trovare il manufatto?
it.68776fe61d62f818144929b3:
Ti avvicini al limite del villaggio in rovina, accovacciandoti e muovendoti con cautela. Chiunque abbia distrutto questo posto non può essere andato lontano. La maledizione della strega non lo permetterebbe.
            All'improvviso, senti delle voci. Non stanno implorando aiuto né piangendo i morti; stanno discutendo di cose banali. Ti rendi conto che sono quelli che hanno attaccato il villaggio.
it.687770119a6b54bdde1a5e09: Beh, non hai nulla da perdere. Se sono intrappolati qui come te, forse non ti attaccheranno subito. Se lo facessero, la morte potrebbe risparmiarti dal portare a termine il compito assegnato dalla strega.
it.6877701680ac1c8fc0a67cf8:
Decidi di rimanere nascosto per ora. Chissà cosa potrebbero farti questi uomini, capaci di distruggere un intero villaggio? Fortunatamente, nessuno di loro ti nota.
            Ti appiattisci contro l'angolo di una casa bruciata e ascolti.
            Uno degli uomini ha una voce profonda con un leggero accento sconosciuto. L'altro parla senza accento, con una voce più acuta e quasi stridula.
— Come può un villaggio come questo avere così poche provviste? Sto morendo di fame e non c'è niente, — brontola quello con l'accento.
            — Moriremo qui! Queste paludi sono maledette e non abbiamo idea di come spezzare l'incantesimo, — risponde istericamente quello con la voce stridula. Ti rendi conto che anche loro sono intrappolati qui dalla maledizione. E hanno fame.
it.687770255d653efcf402554c:
Ti fai avanti, alzando le mani per mostrare che vieni in pace. Diversi uomini dall'aria stanca ti stanno davanti. Stringono più forte le loro armi, guardandoti con diffidente paura mentre emergi da dietro la casa semidistrutta.
            — Uno vivo, — dice uno degli uomini, rilassando leggermente le spalle. — Chi sei?
            Senti un leggero accento nella sua voce, ma non riesci a riconoscerlo. Non che abbia importanza in questo momento.
it.68777038f3c351577685307e:
— Giuro, il capo sa qualcosa. Ad esempio, perché siamo bloccati qui — quello dalla voce acuta abbassa il tono, costringendoti a sporgerti in avanti per sentire.
            — Smettila. Come potrebbe saperlo? — Quello con l'accento sembra meno sospettoso. — Non parlare male del nostro capo!
            — Va bene, va bene, è solo una teoria!
            Senti i loro passi allontanarsi mentre gli uomini si allontanano.
it.68777068417fdab26ffb8723:
Pensi che gli uomini potrebbero rivelare informazioni più utili. Li segui il più silenziosamente possibile, sforzandoti di ascoltare, ma ti distrai e calpesti un ramo secco e spezzato dal calore. Si rompe rumorosamente e gli uomini lo sentono.
            — Chi c'è? Vieni fuori subito!
it.68777097aef5de13e6265bc8:
Non riesci a pensare a niente di meglio che scappare. Ti precipiti dietro l'angolo. La casa dietro cui ti nascondevi ha un muro mancante, quindi gli uomini ti individuano.
            — Fermati, piccolo ratto! — urla quello dalla voce stridula. Noti che ti sta inseguendo. L'altro uomo, per qualche motivo, non si vede da nessuna parte.
it.687770ab8a0d6fb48d25b5cb: Ma non per molto. All'improvviso appare davanti a te, sbucando da dietro un angolo. Ti sposti di lato, ma c'è una pila di tronchi semicombusti che ti blocca il passaggio. Dietro di te, quello stridulo si sta avvicinando. Sei in trappola.
it.687770b814300497ca1dc887: Sono bloccato qui proprio come te!
it.687770bdc888ca05f005a144: Sono un messaggero dell'Ordine dei Navigatori!
it.687770c4d13a96e750824979:
— Allora perché stavi origliando? — chiede quello con l'accento, ancora scettico, anche se abbassa la spada.
            — Già, e perché sei scappato? — interviene quello dalla voce stridula.
it.687770c82e35b771f834f773: — Non ne abbiamo mai sentito parlare — dice quello con l'accento, estraendo di nuovo la spada e guardandoti con sospetto. Hai un'ultima carta da giocare.
it.687770ea7116dd4e4ccab803: Sono bloccato qui proprio come te!
it.6877710b743696531c94767d:
Gli uomini si scambiano uno sguardo e scoppiano in una risata sincronizzata.
            — Cosa c'è di così divertente? — tuona una nuova voce, bassa e aspra. Entrambi gli uomini si mettono sull'attenti. Ti volti.
Da dietro le rovine di un'altra casa bruciata emergono diverse altre figure. Sono chiaramente dello stesso gruppo: esausti, arrabbiati e profondamente terrorizzati sotto sotto.
            — Chi è questo adesso? — Un uomo alto con un'armatura di cuoio ti fissa. I suoi baffi sono fortemente arricciati e il suo sguardo trasuda disprezzo e sfiducia.
            Beh, sembra che questo sia il capo. Sei già esausto per aver avuto a che fare con i banditi oggi!
it.6877713d71fb89187f2c6ae8: Sono bloccato qui proprio come te.
it.68777142b10562bdb441afbc: Sono solo un messaggero dell'Ordine dei Navigatori.
it.687771498198fb94b7c7f178:
Gli uomini si scambiano uno sguardo alle tue parole.
            — Mai sentito nominare. Da dove vieni? Tutti gli abitanti del posto sono morti da tempo.
            Si irrigidiscono di nuovo e iniziano ad avvicinarsi a te.
it.6877714dcd7817d80cab402c:
Ora gli uomini ti guardano in modo diverso.
            — È da chissà quanto tempo che cerchiamo di uscire da qui! — dice uno che fino a quel momento era rimasto in silenzio. L'altro gli dà una gomitata nel fianco.
            — Sputa il rospo!
            — Che importanza ha? Forse è stato mandato per sistemare questo casino e tirarci fuori!
it.68777172ecaff18af8343399:
Ti rendi conto che questa è la tua occasione, non ce ne sarà un'altra. Gli uomini ti fissano, come se valutassero le tue parole. Qualcosa che hai detto ha chiaramente colpito nel segno.
            All'improvviso, si sente un rumore nelle vicinanze. Da dietro le rovine di un'altra casa bruciata emergono diverse altre figure. Fanno chiaramente parte della stessa banda: esausti, arrabbiati e profondamente terrorizzati sotto sotto.
— Chi è questo adesso? — Un uomo alto con un'armatura di cuoio ti fissa. I suoi baffi sono fortemente arricciati e il suo sguardo trasuda disprezzo e sfiducia. I tuoi nuovi conoscenti scattano sull'attenti.
            Beh, sembra che questo sia il capo. Sei già esausto per aver avuto a che fare con i banditi oggi!
it.6877717c1c47f3efb21336d5:
— Dice che è intrappolato qui come noi. Dice che potrebbe aiutarci, — ti presenta uno di loro. Il capo strizza gli occhi e sogghigna.
            — E come potrebbe aiutarci questo nanerottolo? Sai almeno impugnare una spada?
it.687771b294f231bd8ff6e515: La mia forza non sta nel combattimento.
it.687771b646f9b37bd9a181fb: So cosa ci permetterà di uscire tutti da qui.
it.687771bd405ba3f4e15b922c:
Il capo dei banditi alza un sopracciglio, poi ride con un suono crudele e beffardo. I suoi tirapiedi si uniscono a lui, con una risata vuota.
            — In cosa, allora? Nella scrittura? Non abbiamo bisogno di scribi. Nelle parole? Anche quelle sono inutili.
it.687771c1612fd19c7a89c97d: So cosa ci permetterà di uscire tutti da qui.
it.687771cda360c1de351bf14a:
Vedi l'intero gruppo che ti fissa, con uno scintillio di speranza negli occhi. Il capo, però, non è convinto.
            — Perché dovremmo fidarci di te? Dicci prima quello che sai, poi decideremo se vale la pena crederti.
it.687771f65c6bc4cd5a76e726:
Decidi che non ha senso nascondere nulla. Questi banditi vogliono fuggire dalle paludi maledette proprio come te. In questo momento siete alleati e molti di loro probabilmente lo capiscono.
            — È tutta colpa della gente del posto. Hanno ucciso la strega della palude e rubato un prezioso manufatto. Lei lo rivuole indietro. E, ovviamente, vuole vendicarsi.
Alcuni banditi si guardano intorno nervosamente, come se cercassero i responsabili della morte della strega. Ma purtroppo sono stati loro ad ucciderla.
it.687771fb4af817d6da36adb1:
Questi sono i banditi che hanno sterminato un intero villaggio. Fidarsi completamente di loro sarebbe da sciocchi. E se ti uccidessero non appena scoprissero la verità? Decidi di andare sul sicuro.
            — È a causa della strega. È stata uccisa e derubata dagli abitanti di questo villaggio. Mi ha mandato a cercare ciò che è stato rubato. Se mi succede qualcosa, distruggerà tutti nella zona.
Ovviamente, la strega non ha mai detto che sei particolarmente importante, ma i banditi non hanno bisogno di saperlo.
            Dai loro sguardi capisci che ti credono. Ora ti guardano con più rispetto di prima. Alcuni fanno persino un piccolo passo indietro, come se avessero paura.
it.68777209d2f6c5d9902e84b5: — Allora, cosa suggerisci di fare? — chiede il capo, aggrottando la fronte e fissandoti con aria interrogativa.
it.68777248a82ae5340e85a3b4: Dobbiamo capire come ingannare la strega.
it.6877725b6e4d07907a24ec43: Perché inventarsi qualcosa di nuovo quando la strega ti ha già indicato chiaramente la strada? Certo, non puoi punire il colpevole, ma forse è meglio così? Il capo dei banditi aggrotta le sopracciglia scontento. C'è qualcosa di diverso nei suoi movimenti, ma non riesci a capire cosa. Sei distratto dalla voce acuta di un giovane che sta proprio dietro di lui. — Abbiamo visto uno strano specchio che non brucia! Uno rotondo. Il capo si gira verso il giovane e praticamente ringhia: — Non è sicuramente quello! Ti blocchi, così come il giovane. Quel tipo di reazione può significare solo una cosa.
it.6877725ec0232b786f36d303:
Ti rendi conto che probabilmente la strega non si accontenterà solo del manufatto. E questo senza nemmeno considerare come riuscirai a procurartelo. Cominci a riflettere, ma lo stesso giovane che ha menzionato lo specchio improvvisamente interviene di nuovo.
            — E se semplicemente bandissimo la strega? — Tutti si voltano a guardarlo, e lui alza le spalle. — Ci avrei provato prima, ma non sapevamo della strega!
it.68777ecb09285caee7e293ed: C'è qualcuno qui che sa come farlo?
it.68777eea8cf0f973aecd50a8:
— Beh, sì, so come fare — dice il giovane, gonfiando il petto con un sorriso compiaciuto. — Ero un sacerdote nella banda di Turva. Ho fatto cose più folli di questa!
            È un'idea ragionevole. Ma puoi davvero affidare la tua vita a un ragazzino?
it.68777eed0334393e733d8657:
— Sì, lo faccio, — dice il giovane, allargando le braccia, — ero un prete nella banda di Turva. Ho fatto cose più folli di questa.
            È un'idea valida. Ma puoi davvero affidare la tua vita a un ragazzino?
it.68777f1371ec3fda827cd7a4: Scuoti la testa. Forse il ragazzo è davvero un prete, ma correre un rischio del genere... Vuoi fuggire da queste paludi, non rimanere bloccato qui per sempre a causa del capriccio di una strega arrabbiata.
it.68777f1a90768808625407d6:
Ci proviamo! Accetti il piano del giovane. Il capo si strofina il mento pensieroso, poi alza le spalle:
            — Potremmo anche provarci. Non abbiamo nulla da perdere.
            Ti guarda.
            — Va bene, conducici dove si nasconde questa tua strega.
it.68777fdde9dbf46430a8b89a:
Guidi il gruppo attraverso le paludi, dirigendoti direttamente verso la capanna. Il viaggio sembra durare più del previsto, ma non dai peso a questa stranezza.
Ti fermi proprio davanti alla capanna. Il giovane che sostiene di essere un prete ti tira la manica per attirare la tua attenzione.
            — A proposito, mi chiamo Mstislav. Chiamami Slavka — dice con un sorriso, indicando la capanna con un cenno del capo. — Ho pensato che dovessi sapere il nome del ragazzo che bandirà quella strega, no?
            Ride, come se non avesse affatto paura.
it.68777ff59f3cf8c68c46e6a3:
Il capo si gira verso di te, guardandoti con disprezzo.
            — E se ho lo specchio, che importa? Me lo vuoi prendere? Pensi di potercela fare?
it.68778003999b2330c41b3ccb:
Il tuo corpo è dolorante per quello che è successo poche ore fa. Estrai la spada, ma i tuoi movimenti sono goffi. Il capo dei banditi sorride beffardo, osservando la tua difficoltà con l'arma.
            — Non hai mai impugnato niente di più pesante di una penna d'oca, piccolo teppista!
            Estrae abilmente la sua spada e avanza, preparandosi a colpire. Ti rendi conto che la forza del suo colpo sarà troppo forte per poterla parare.
it.6877800552157c87b8a740c7:
Sorprendentemente, estrai la spada con facilità. Tracce del sangue della strega macchiano ancora la lama, ma non ci fai caso. Hai un obiettivo e nulla ti ostacolerà. Impugni saldamente l'elsa e incroci lo sguardo del capo.
            — Guarda che tipo serio! — ti prendono in giro, ma tu non abbocchi.
            Il capo estrae la sua arma e ti attacca, preparandosi a colpire.
it.6877809c1f2529646b28b4de:
Ti sposti di lato, schivando il colpo. La spada ti sfreccia accanto all'orecchio senza toccarti. Il capo ruota su se stesso, cercando di colpirti di nuovo. Tu fai un balzo all'indietro.
Gli altri banditi non si sono ancora uniti alla lotta. Vedi la confusione sui loro volti. Stanno capendo che il loro capo è disposto a sacrificare sia la sua vita che la loro per avidità.
            Ti rendi conto che potresti chiamarli. Ma farlo potrebbe distrarti, lasciandoti esposto al prossimo colpo del capo.
it.6877809f9322bd17f049d9e6: ...Ma che importanza ha? La furia della battaglia ti travolge, il suo fuoco brucia ardente. Rispondi all'attacco del capo con la tua lama... o almeno ci provi, poiché la forza del suo colpo annienta la tua difesa mal preparata. Vieni scaraventato di lato, inciampi su un pezzo di legno carbonizzato e cadi. Non urli, no, imprecando e lottando per rialzarti.
it.687780e458982e675f3b55ec:
Il capo si avvicina e sputa vicino a te. Per un attimo rimani immobile, guardandolo.
            — Troppo orgoglio, piccolo teppista, — dice con tono beffardo, sollevando la spada sopra di te. — Porta i miei saluti alla tua strega.
            Colpisce con la spada. La lama taglia il tuo corpo non protetto come se fosse burro, recidendoti il cuore.
            Muori prima di poter esalare l'ultimo respiro.
it.687780f9863b6ec75207f1a5: Non vedi che è pronto a rischiare le vostre vite per il proprio tornaconto?!
it.68778108bc8407c6acdf1e18:
Noti che alcuni banditi sussultano, scambiandosi sguardi. Sai che affrontare da solo qualcuno più forte di te è sempre terrificante, ma loro sono così tanti! Speri che abbiano buon senso.
            E non ti sbagli.
            Il giovane che ha menzionato lo specchio è il primo ad alzare la mano.
            — È davvero pronto ad aggrapparsi a quello specchio fino alla morte!
Un altro uomo annuisce, afferrando la sua ascia da battaglia.
            — Sì, finché non moriremo tutti qui come cani! Da quanti giorni stiamo arrancando in queste paludi?! Ho già le sanguisughe che mi strisciano addosso!
            Uno dopo l'altro, iniziano a brontolare con rabbia. Ti piacerebbe ascoltarli, ma il capo ha chiaramente intenzione di occuparsi prima di te prima di sistemare gli altri.
it.6877810c4dcbc02930d301bc:
Non c'è tempo per distrarsi. Morire martire per mano di un patetico bandito disertore non è il destino che sognavi.
            Perdi l'occasione di guadagnarti degli alleati, ma non quella di colpire il capo. Schivando appena in tempo, rispondi al colpo, ma lui lo para abilmente e ti ferisce con la sua spada. La lama ti lacera i vestiti e ti taglia il fianco. Urli di dolore.
— Non sei più così coraggioso, eh? — ti schernisce il capo, avvicinandosi. I suoi occhi brillano di sete di sangue.
            All'improvviso, senti una presenza, qualcosa di intangibile ai sensi ordinari. L'aria si fa più fredda e tu rabbrividisci. Qualcosa sta cercando di fondersi con te. Senti un flebile sussurro: "Lasciami entrare".
it.68778175a6d0eaf0f969dd89:
Hai già provato questo freddo, nella capanna nella palude. La strega è venuta in tuo aiuto e chi sei tu per rifiutarla?
La lasci entrare, ansimando per il freddo gelido. È come essere immersi in un lago ghiacciato in inverno.
Da quel momento, sei un passeggero nel tuo stesso corpo: le tue braccia e le tue gambe si muovono da sole, la tua lingua pronuncia parole in una lingua sconosciuta. Una campana sembra suonare nella tua testa. Vedi tutto in modo frammentario.
Il capo si blocca a metà frase in una posa ridicola. I suoi occhi, spalancati dal terrore primordiale, lampeggiano davanti a te. La sua testa, separata dal corpo, rotola sul terreno.
it.6877817a7062e46f9300666d: No, il tuo corpo non sarà mai contaminato dalla magia malvagia, nessuno spirito ti toccherà. Resisti con ogni grammo di forza che ti è rimasto. La voce della strega ti sussurra all'orecchio che sei uno sciocco, poi svanisce. Proprio mentre la lama del capo ti recide la testa.
it.687781bd55214a43034cb837: Tu sorridi e ti presenti a tua volta. Il ragazzo sembra a posto. Magari più tardi potrai guidarlo verso la vera via, affinché si unisca al tuo Ordine dei Navigatori. Ma questo è per dopo. In questo momento, la questione più urgente è se Mstislav sarà in grado di gestire la strega.
it.687781c4b618a1b138c6f8ca: Non ti interessa affatto il suo nome. Ciò che conta molto di più è se è in grado di affrontare la strega. Speri che ci riesca, come probabilmente sperano tutte le anime intrappolate in queste paludi.
it.687781e523ad21a5fbf4be50:
Solo tu e Mstislav avete il coraggio di entrare nella capanna. Il cadavere giace ancora sul pavimento. Rabbrividisci, anche se il freddo pungente che accompagna la presenza del fantasma ora non c'è più.
            Mstislav fa un respiro profondo, espira rumorosamente, chiude gli occhi e inizia a recitare una preghiera.
Senti uno strano tremore e fai un passo indietro, come per lasciare spazio alle parole, quasi una canzone. Le fiamme delle candele nella capanna si spengono, immergendo tutto nell'oscurità. Non ti eri nemmeno accorto che fossero rimaste accese per tutto questo tempo!
it.687781ee3098c5ff6a93592a:
Ora sta diventando freddo. Ti stringi le spalle, spostando il peso da un piede all'altro, aspettando che la strega appaia, ma lei non lo fa. Slavka finisce la preghiera, ondeggiando leggermente con gli occhi chiusi, poi sospira. Il freddo svanisce improvvisamente come era arrivato.
Rimanete entrambi in silenzio, ascoltando. La capanna sembra diventare più luminosa, nonostante le candele spente.
            — Beh, sembra che sia tutto, — dice Mstislav con un sorriso, grattandosi la nuca. — Non c'è più nulla di male qui. Penso che ora possiamo andare.
it.687781f81ccbcc5602cb5443:
Esci dalla capanna come un vincitore. I banditi ti guardano con speranza. Anche il capo si permette di chiedere:
            — Tutto qui? Siamo liberi?
it.6877820fa57acb6be31ff898: Scoppiano applausi. I banditi danno una pacca sulle spalle a te e a Slavka. La prova è finalmente finita. Possono finalmente andarsene.
it.6877821dd501bb8f2de08652:
Ti allontani. E continui a camminare. E camminare. All'inizio sembra normale: forse qui le distanze sono semplicemente enormi senza magia?
            Ma poi...
it.6877823dfdc066fea438e04d:
...torni alla stessa capanna.
            Sembra che non ci sia via di fuga da questo posto.
it.68778244871265ea10dcb70c: C'è ancora una possibilità di fare la cosa giusta e restituire lo specchio alla strega!
it.6877824f42aef7da99a5352a:
Ma non appena lo dici, il capo sbuffa con disprezzo.
            — Col cavolo, non rinuncio a niente.
it.687782cdad7684ddfb627cfd: Finalmente è finita. Non senti più la presenza spettrale della strega. Crolli in ginocchio, riprendendo fiato, poi controlli rapidamente il fianco. Niente, solo vestiti strappati. Sembra che la strega abbia guarito la tua ferita. Sussurri un silenzioso ringraziamento.
it.687782d81a97f0f7fda3ba5e:
I banditi ti fissano, incerti se temerti o lodarti.
            — Beh, sembra che lo specchio sia tuo adesso — dice il giovane, riprendendosi per primo. Tu annuisci e cerchi di alzarti.
it.687782f2810ddd6883ad65ec:
Lui fa un movimento impercettibile e tu riesci a schivarlo appena in tempo. La sua lama ti sfiora il braccio, tagliandoti quasi fino all'osso, ma meglio così che al cuore. Riesci a malapena a tenere la spada, ma non è più necessario.
            I banditi ribelli circondano il loro capo. Li vedi litigare, ma solo fino a quando il giovane si avvicina di soppiatto alle sue spalle e gli conficca un pugnale sotto le costole.
Il capo ansima e crolla a terra. Nel futile tentativo di rimanere in piedi, afferra l'aria. Nessuno si muove per aiutarlo.
            Quando finalmente esala l'ultimo respiro, il giovane fruga nella sua giacca e tira fuori lo specchio.
            — Va bene, ti mediceremo e porteremo lo specchio alla strega! — dice con un sorriso.
it.687787ad21b770c98efdbce5:
All'improvviso, tutti indietreggiano. Alcuni si fanno il segno della croce, altri imprecano. Alzi di scatto la testa e vedi la strega in piedi tra te e i banditi.
— Vendetta, ho bisogno di vendetta — ringhia quasi. I suoi capelli sono arruffati e si contorcono come serpenti. Anche tu ti senti a disagio. — Sono miei.
            — Ma noi non abbiamo fatto niente! Non ti abbiamo uccisa! — grida qualcuno dalla folla. Tutti annuiscono, come se questo potesse convincere un essere ultraterreno assetato di sangue. Vale davvero la pena immischiarsi?
it.6882b31e44acfd5dd15e7b11:
Non appena parli, una fascia gelida ti stringe la gola. Ti stringi il collo, ansimando in cerca d'aria.
— Hanno ucciso quelli che mi hanno ucciso. Si sono presi la responsabilità dei loro peccati, — dice la strega senza voltarsi verso di te. Ti rendi conto che i non morti hanno una loro logica, al di là della comprensione dei vivi. Ma non sei pronto ad accettarlo! Ti alzi di scatto e ti lanci contro il fantasma, come se potessi davvero fare qualcosa. E credi di poterlo fare, finché la strega non allunga la mano e te la passa attraverso il petto.
it.6882b3292499b80cee57f584:
All'inizio non senti nulla. Poi il tuo cuore sembra dimenticare come battere. Ti stringi il petto e crolli a terra.
            Muori tra le urla e gli ultimi rantoli dei banditi che vengono fatti a pezzi dalla strega.
it.6882b33e86d1a7850df26159:
Chiudi gli occhi. Forse non hanno ucciso la strega, ma hanno bruciato un intero villaggio! Forse è meglio così.
            Tieni gli occhi chiusi fino a quando l'ultimo urlo e l'ultimo respiro morente non svaniscono. Quando tutto è finito, la strega è accanto a te.
            — Portami lo specchio!
it.6882b368dcaa3ce8f1d9d450: È necessaria la versione completa del gioco.
it.688b66caafc1aba624722439:
Il capo si gira verso di te, guardandoti con disprezzo.
            — E se ce l'ho, che importa? Me lo vuoi togliere? Pensi di potercela fare?

it.6899c0f38dd72da50ae7242d:
Lei ti tocca e un brivido si diffonde nel tuo corpo dal punto di contatto. Le tue ferite si chiudono, respirare diventa più facile e il dolore svanisce.
            — Trova lo specchio.
            È chiaro che la strega non l'ha fatto per gentilezza, vuole che tu soddisfi rapidamente la sua richiesta.
