tu.688cdcf0a2b55c50cdc5c008: — Evet, geldik. Lordlar seni bekliyor, — daha önce seninle konuşan muhafızlardan biri, tutuşunu gevşetip büyük kapıları işaret ediyor.
tu.688cdcfa2e2dae6bd4636ed5: Lordlar mı? Birden fazla mı var?
tu.688cdd07085555ce8608795e:
— Aynen öyle, altı kişiler. Bu kadar, başka soru yok. Zorla içeri sürüklememizi istemiyorsan yürü.
Sırtına hafifçe bir dürtü geliyor.
tu.688cdd0bf4ac4129d31d580b: Şimdilik ağzını kapalı tutmanın en iyisi olduğuna karar veriyorsun. Böyle daha güvenli.
tu.688cdd25652c3fa4d4fb080f:
Sarayın içine götürülüyorsun. Hava baskılayıcı. Hizmetkâr sayısı az ve neredeyse parmak uçlarında yürüyorlar.
Boyunun üç katı yüksekliğinde büyük ahşap kapıların önünde durduruluyorsun. Muhafızlar kollarını açmanı ve üzerini aramalarına izin vermeni emrediyor.
tu.688cdd73472b87376082a6a0:
Kenarlarını, kollarını ve bacaklarını yokluyorlar, seyahat çantanı karıştırıyorlar.
— Burada ne bulduk bakalım? — diyor muhafızlardan biri, harabelerden aldığın kitabı bulunca.
tu.688cdd852105a4e56f02fca2: Kenarlarını, kollarını ve bacaklarını yokluyorlar, çantanı karıştırıyorlar ama ilginç hiçbir şey bulamıyorlar. Somurtarak çantanı geri veriyorlar, yaşananla ilgili tek kelime etmiyorlar.
tu.688cdda671d261ee2411751f: Kitapların ne zamandır yasak olduğu da ne demek?
tu.688cde2f53f1254827452e54:
Kitaba neden bu kadar önem verdiklerini anlayamıyorsun. Garip bir yanı yok ki. Ya da... var mı?..
— Her şeyi kontrol etmek zorundayız, — diyor muhafızlardan biri, kitabın kayışlarını çözüp kapağını açarken. Ortamda kısa bir sessizlik oluşuyor. Gözlerinin hızla sayfalar arasında gezindiğini, ifadesinin değiştiğini görüyorsun. Birkaç sayfa çeviriyor, dişlerinin arasından bir küfür mırıldanıyor ve kitabı sertçe kapatıyor.
— Ne sapkınlık! Tam bir saçmalık. Birinin bunu yazmış olması bile...
Kitabı seyahat çantana geri sıkıştırıyor.
— Siz okumuş takımının, böyle saçmalıklar uydurmaktan başka işi yok zaten.
tu.688cde3b7bf30bfbc3c38351: Tepki vermemeye karar veriyorsun, ama zihnin kıpır kıpır. Muhafız o kitapta ne okudu? Aldığından beri açmamıştın bile.
tu.688cde74b5b02b7417ae3693:
Metne gösterilen tepki seni rahatsız ediyor. Belki de kitabı hiç almamalıydın? Muhtemelen öyle. O kitap o bodruma nasıl girdi ve senden önce neden kimse sahiplenmedi? Her bir soru içini daha da huzursuz ediyor. Bu kitaptan kurtulmak en iyisi—ama ancak buradaki işin bittikten sonra.
Daha fazla bir şey söylemeden, muhafızların seni ileriye götürmesine izin veriyorsun.
tu.688cde778b516abff90c1b00: Kitabı dönüş yolunda okursun. Şimdilik, tek yapman gereken görevi tamamlamak. Kitaba bir an önce ulaşmak istiyorsun ama sessiz kalıp muhafızların seni ileriye götürmesine izin veriyorsun.
tu.688cdebf434a46cf61995b9c: Taht salonuna getiriliyorsun. Etrafa hayranlıkla bakmamaya çalışıyorsun ama zor. Salon gösterişli ama bakımsız. Köşelerde örümcek ağları, zeminde ise şarap mı yoksa kan mı belli olmayan ve tamamen temizlenmemiş bir leke var. Uzakta altı sandalye duruyor, yalnızca üçü dolu. Sandalyeler yakın zamanda yerleştirilmiş gibi duruyor.
tu.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
Muhafızlar seni biraz daha yaklaştırıyor, sonra duruyor. Eğilip kenara çekiliyorlar. Seni tutan yok, ama en ufak bir yanlış harekette anında doğranacağını biliyorsun.
Karşındaki üç kişiyi inceliyorsun. Ortada oturan, kırk yaşlarında, iri yapılı bir adam; bacaklarını genişçe açmış. Sağında, dudaklarını öyle sıkmış ki çenesi titreyen solgun bir kadın. Solundaysa sıkılmış görünen genç bir adam, başını eline yaslamış. Hiçbiri bu işle uğraşmaktan memnun görünmüyor. Diğer üç lord ya gelmemiş ya da gelmeye tenezzül etmemiş.
tu.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:
Ortadaki adam seni dikkatle süzüyor.
— Ee, bizim şehrimizde ne işin varmış senin?
"Bizim." Hafifçe gülümsüyorsun. Sen kralın şehrine geldin, onlarınkine değil. İşlerin ne kadar çabuk değiştiğine bak! Ama önemi yok. Bir amacın var ve ona sadık kalman gerekiyor.
tu.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:
Ortadaki adam konuşan ilk kişi oluyor.
— Demek, halkın kafasını fikirlerle doldurmaya çalışan buymuş?
Sesindeki küçümseme seni diken diken ediyor. Biliyorsun ki biraz daha zamanın olsaydı, meydandaki insanlar seni dinlerdi. Ama seni zorla alıp buraya getirdiler.
— Ne küstahlık, — diyor kadın gülümseyerek, ama gözleri buz gibi.
— Targrad’da böyle birine ihtiyacımız yok. Ben olsam boğazını keserdim, buraya kadar sürüklemezdim, — diye homurdanıyor genç adam; tırnaklarıyla o kadar meşgul ki sana bile bakmıyor.
tu.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:
— O zaman bir yasa çıkarırız! — diyor genç adam, sana alaycı ve meydan okuyan bir bakışla. Ortadaki adam elini kaldırıyor.
— Yeter! Artık önemi yok. Küçük çocuklar gibi çekişmeyi kesin.
tu.688ce0cbe03f37a53d2fd2d2:
Ortadaki adam seni dikkatle süzüyor.
— Ee, bizim şehrimizde ne işin varmış senin?
“Bizim.” Hafifçe gülümsüyorsun. Sen kralın şehrine geldin, onlarınkine değil. İşlerin ne kadar çabuk değiştiğine bak! Ama bu önemli değil. Bir amacın var ve ona sadık kalmalısın.
tu.688ce0fef027489c75abab7d: Navigatörler Düzeni’nden size bir kehanet iletmem gerekiyor.
tu.688ce10116403e2bd3b1d6fd: Yalnızca yerel hükümdarla paylaşabileceğim bir şeyim var.
tu.688ce118237836458f9bd9e3:
Sandalyelerde oturan üç kişi birbirine bakışır. Kaşları çatılır, küçümseyici bakışlar atarlar. Her birinin tek başına hükmetmekten memnun olacağını fark edersin.
Ama bu, şimdilik imkânsız.
Ortadaki adam konuşur:
— Neymiş bu konu? Burada hepimiz eşitiz, açıkça konuşabilirsin.
tu.688ce11f41c2999201789185: Navigatörler Düzeni’nden gelen bir kehanet hakkında.
tu.688ce129380a933a8b7a4090:
— Kehanet mi? Ne saçmalık! — diye homurdanarak güler kadın, elini ağzına kapatarak. Sen yerinden kıpırdamadan beklersin. İstediği kadar gülsünler, Navigatörler Düzeni liderinin her kehaneti bugüne dek gerçekleşti. Targrad bunu kabullenmek zorunda kalacak.
— Targrad, böyle batıl inançlara göre hareket edecek bir yer değil, — diye ekler genç adam alaycı bir ifadeyle, — burada bilime inanırız biz.
tu.688ce14ae766281384b6f59c: Anlamıyorsunuz! Her bir kehanet bugüne kadar gerçekleşti!
tu.688ce14ea87e870d685133ba: İnanmak zorunda değilsiniz. Sadece dinleyin yeter.
tu.688ce15c6bbcad99f9904c4d: Duygularına engel olamazsın. Navigatörler Düzeni liderinin iradesini nasıl sorgularlar?! Önceki hükümdar kehanetleri ciddiye alırdı. Ama bunlar... hiçbir şey anlamıyorlar. Görevin onları doğru yola sevk etmek.
tu.688ce160b2181bac5a8abd2e: Sakin ve temkinli kalmaya çalışırsın. Belki kehanetlere inanmıyorlar, ama duymaları gerek. Bu senin görevin. Bunu yapmadan Düzen’e dönmenin bir anlamı olmaz.
tu.688ce1897eab5de901684c48:
— Evet, evet, hiçbir şey anlamıyoruz, — tahttaki genç gözlerini devirdi ve nöbetçilere doğru işaret etti. — Şunu buradan çıkarın. Kehanetlerini gidip meyhanedeki sarhoşlara okusun.
Nöbetçilerin yaklaştığını duyuyorsun. Buraya gelme amacını gerçekleştirmek için yalnızca birkaç saniyen var.
tu.688ce193a5412dcc5972634e:
Genç bir şey söylemek istiyor ama ortadaki sandalyede oturan adam elini kaldırarak onu durduruyor.
— Tek ihtiyacın bu mu? Emrinizdeki o tarikatın kehanetini okumamız mı gerekiyor? Neydi onların adı… Seyyahlar mıydı?
Başını sallıyorsun. Adam seni yanına çağırıyor. Gözlerinde hafif bir merak parıltısı beliriyor. Görünüşe göre ilgisini çekmeyi başardın.
— Parşömeni ver bana. Okuyacağım.
tu.688ce1c84054e6f943d7a0cd:
Parşömeni keskin bir hareketle çekip çıkarıyorsun. Tahtlardaki figürler irkiliyor. Genç olan bile doğrulup öne doğru eğiliyor, yüzü öfkeyle buruşmuş. Görünüşe göre uzun zamandır kimse ona karşı gelmemiş. Arkandaki nöbetçilerin adımları hızlanıyor.
Parşömenin mührünü kırıyorsun ve...
tu.688ce1e259b11920c275fde1:
Parşömeni çantandan sakince çıkarıyorsun. Bir anlığına parlıyor gibi oluyor ama gözlerini kırpınca görüntü kayboluyor. Garip… Belki de sadece bu kadar yorgunsundur?
— Hadi ama, oyalanma, — kadın senin tereddüdünü fark edip dudaklarını rahatsız olmuş bir ifadeyle bükerek söylüyor. — Kehanetin dışında ilgilenmemiz gereken başka işlerimiz de var.
Son kelimeyi söylerkenki tonu, onun da buna inanmadığını açıkça gösteriyor. Eh, bu onların sorunu. Ve bu şehrin.
Öne doğru bir adım atıyor ve parşömeni ortadaki adama uzatıyorsun.
tu.688ce1f5690bf3ab4e774eba:

ru.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:

ru.688ce118237836458f9bd9e3:

Пока что.

Ты ломаешь печать на свитке и...

— Ну же, не тяните, — женщина, видя твоё замешательство, недовольно кривит губы, — у нас есть и другие дела, помимо вашего пророчества.
По тому, как она буквально выплёвывает последнее слово ты понимаешь, что она тоже в него не верит. Что ж, это уже их проблемы. И этого города.

ru.688ce1f5690bf3ab4e774eba:

ru.688ce202b284883465e196c2:
Ты смотришь, как мужчина разламывает печать твоего ордена, как подцепляет край свитка пальцами. На секунду тебе снова мерещатся синие искры, ты хмуришься и трясёшь головой. Кажется, тебе очень нужно поспать.
Искр становится больше, ты моргаешь и...

ro.688cdcf0a2b55c50cdc5c008: — Well, we’re here. The lords are already waiting for you, — one of the guards, the same one who spoke to you earlier, lets go of you and waves toward the tall doors.
ro.688cdd07085555ce8608795e:
— Yup, six of them. That’s it, no more questions. Go on before we drag you in by force.
You’re nudged in the back.
ro.688cdd0bf4ac4129d31d580b: You decide it’s better to keep your mouth shut for now. Safer that way.
ro.688cdd25652c3fa4d4fb080f:
You’re led inside the palace. The atmosphere is oppressive. There are few servants, and they move almost on tiptoes.
You’re stopped before grand wooden doors three times your height. The guards order you to spread your arms and let them search you.
ro.688cdd73472b87376082a6a0:
They pat down your sides, arms, and thighs, rummaging through your travel bag.
— What’s this we’ve got here? — one of the guards finds the book you took from the ruins.
ro.688cdd852105a4e56f02fca2: They pat down your sides, arms, and thighs, rummaging through your travel bag but find nothing of interest. With sour expressions, they return your bag without commenting on what just happened.
ro.688cde2f53f1254827452e54:
You don’t understand why they care about the book. There’s nothing strange about it. Or is there?..  
— We’re required to check everything, — one of the guards says, unbuckling the straps on the book and opening it. A pause hangs in the air. You see his eyes darting, his expression shifting. He flips through a few pages, mutters a curse under his breath, and slams the book shut.
— What heresy! Utter nonsense. To think someone came up with this...
He stuffs the book back into your travel bag.  
— You learned folk have nothing better to do than conjure up such gibberish.
ro.688cde3b7bf30bfbc3c38351: You decide not to react, though your mind races. What did the guard read in there? You haven’t opened the book since you took it.
ro.688cde5f16c9774461027a6c: Read it when you get the chance.
ro.688cde74b5b02b7417ae3693:
The guard’s reaction to the text unsettles you. Maybe you shouldn’t have taken it? Probably not. How did the book end up in that basement, and why hadn’t anyone claimed it before you? Each question makes you more uneasy. It’s best to get rid of the book—but only after you’ve finished your business here.
You say nothing more, letting the guards lead you onward.
ro.688cde778b516abff90c1b00: You’ll read the book on your way back. For now, you just need to complete your task. Eager to get to the book, you stay silent, letting the guards lead you further.
ro.688cdebf434a46cf61995b9c: You’re brought into the throne room. You try not to gawk at your surroundings, but it’s hard. The hall is lavish, yet neglected. Cobwebs cling to corners, and a stain on the floor, wine or blood, hasn’t been fully scrubbed out. At the far end, six chairs stand, only three occupied. They look recently placed.
ro.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
The guards bring you closer, then stop. They bow and step aside. No one’s holding you, but you know one wrong move will get you cut down without hesitation.
You study the three before you. A burly man, about forty, sits in the center, legs spread wide. To his right, a gaunt woman, her lips pursed so tightly her chin trembles. To his left, a young man, bored, propping his head on his hand. None of them seem pleased to be bothered. The other three lords are either absent or couldn’t be bothered to show.
ro.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:
The man in the center eyes you closely.
— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?
"Our". You smirk. You came to the king’s city, not theirs. How quickly things change! But it doesn’t matter. You have a goal, and you need to stick to it.
ro.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:
The man in the center speaks first.
— So, this is the one trying to fill the rabble’s heads with ideas?
The disdain in his voice makes you bristle. You know, given more time, the people in the square would’ve listened. But you were seized and dragged here.
— Such arrogance, — the woman says with a smile, her eyes ice-cold.
— We don’t need that in Targrad. I’d have slit his throat rather than drag him here, — the young man mutters, too engrossed in his nails to even glance at you.
ro.688ce08f2082437172194a4c: There’s no law against speaking to the people.
ro.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:
— So we’ll make one! — the youth looks at you with mockery and defiance. The man in the middle raises his hand.
— Enough! It doesn’t matter now. Stop bickering like little children.
ro.688ce0cbe03f37a53d2fd2d2:
The man in the center eyes you closely.
— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?
"Our". You smirk. You came to the king’s city, not theirs. How quickly things change! But it doesn’t matter. You have a goal, and you need to stick to it.
ro.688ce0fef027489c75abab7d: I must deliver a prophecy to you from the Order of Navigators.
ro.688ce10116403e2bd3b1d6fd: I have something I can only share with the local ruler.
ro.688ce118237836458f9bd9e3:
All three seated in the chairs exchange glances. You see them frown, casting contemptuous looks at one another. You realize each would relish ruling alone. But that’s impossible.
For now.
The man in the middle speaks up.
— So, what’s this about? We’re all equals here, so you can speak freely.
ro.688ce11f41c2999201789185: It’s about a prophecy from the Order of Navigators.
ro.688ce129380a933a8b7a4090:
— A prophecy? What nonsense! — the woman laughs hoarsely, covering her mouth with her hand. You stand still, waiting it out. They can laugh all they want, but every prophecy of the Order of Navigators’ leader has always come true. Targrad will have to accept it.
— Targrad is no place for such superstitious nonsense, — the young man chimes in, looking at you with mockery, — we deal in science here.
ro.688ce14ae766281384b6f59c: You don't understand! Every prophecy has always come true!
ro.688ce14ea87e870d685133ba: You can simply hear the prophecy without believing it.
ro.688ce15c6bbcad99f9904c4d: You let your emotions surge. How dare they question the will of the Order’s leader?! The previous ruler took prophecies seriously. But these... they understand nothing. Your task is to set them on the true path.
ro.688ce160b2181bac5a8abd2e: You strive to stay calm and composed. They may not believe in prophecies, but they must hear it. It's your duty. Without this, you might as well not return to the Order.
ro.688ce1897eab5de901684c48:
— Yeah, yeah, we don’t understand a thing, — the youth on the throne rolls his eyes and gestures to the guards. — Take him out of here. Let him read his prophecies to the drunks in the tavern.
You hear the guards approaching. You have mere moments to do what you came for.
ro.688ce193a5412dcc5972634e:
The youth wants to say something, but the man in the central chair raises his hand, stopping him.
— Is that all you need? For us to read the prophecy from your order? What are they called again... The Navigators?
You nod. The man beckons you closer. A faint glimmer of interest flickers in his eyes. Well, looks like you've managed to pique his curiosity.
— Hand me the scroll. I’ll read it.
ro.688ce1c84054e6f943d7a0cd:
You yank the scroll out with a sharp motion. The figures on the thrones flinch. Even the youth sits up straight, leaning forward with a face twisted in anger. It seems no one has defied him in a long time. The guards’ footsteps behind you quicken.
You break the seal on the scroll and...
ro.688ce1e259b11920c275fde1:
You calmly pull the scroll from your bag. For a moment, it seems to glow, but you blink, and the effect vanishes. Strange, perhaps you're just that exhausted?
— Come on, don't dawdle, — the woman says, her lips curling in annoyance as she notices your hesitation. — We have other matters to attend to besides your prophecy.
The way she spits out the last word makes it clear she doesn’t believe in it either. Well, that’s their problem. And this city’s.
You step closer and hand the scroll to the man in the center.
ro.688ce1f5690bf3ab4e774eba:
...everything is flooded with blue light. You feel the magic emanating from the scroll with your entire being. It seeps into you, pierces through you, destroys you. But you feel no pain. You cease to exist, detachedly thinking:
"Looks like I've become death itself, indeed."
ro.688ce202b284883465e196c2:
You watch as the man breaks the seal of your order, prying open the edge of the scroll with his fingers. For a moment, you see blue sparks again, you frown and shake your head. It seems you desperately need some sleep.
The sparks grow brighter, you blink, and...
ro.689f6b7ef5087b91c8cb7657: You’ve gotten right up to the heart of it. The secrets will be revealed a little later. Be patient for now and come back again.

— We’re required to check everything, — one of the guards says, unbuckling the straps on the book and opening it. A pause hangs in the air. You see his eyes darting, his expression shifting. He flips through a few pages, mutters a curse under his breath, and slams the book shut.
— What heresy! Utter nonsense. To think someone came up with this...
He stuffs the book back into your travel bag.  
— You learned folk have nothing better to do than conjure up such gibberish.
vi.688cde3b7bf30bfbc3c38351: You decide not to react, though your mind races. What did the guard read in there? You haven’t opened the book since you took it.
vi.688cde5f16c9774461027a6c: Read it when you get the chance.
vi.688cde74b5b02b7417ae3693:
The guard’s reaction to the text unsettles you. Maybe you shouldn’t have taken it? Probably not. How did the book end up in that basement, and why hadn’t anyone claimed it before you? Each question makes you more uneasy. It’s best to get rid of the book—but only after you’ve finished your business here.
You say nothing more, letting the guards lead you onward.
vi.688cde778b516abff90c1b00: You’ll read the book on your way back. For now, you just need to complete your task. Eager to get to the book, you stay silent, letting the guards lead you further.
vi.688cdebf434a46cf61995b9c: You’re brought into the throne room. You try not to gawk at your surroundings, but it’s hard. The hall is lavish, yet neglected. Cobwebs cling to corners, and a stain on the floor, wine or blood, hasn’t been fully scrubbed out. At the far end, six chairs stand, only three occupied. They look recently placed.
vi.688cdece68c27e4bef0fb6d3:
The guards bring you closer, then stop. They bow and step aside. No one’s holding you, but you know one wrong move will get you cut down without hesitation.
You study the three before you. A burly man, about forty, sits in the center, legs spread wide. To his right, a gaunt woman, her lips pursed so tightly her chin trembles. To his left, a young man, bored, propping his head on his hand. None of them seem pleased to be bothered. The other three lords are either absent or couldn’t be bothered to show.
vi.688ce076988fd48c7449aa00:
The man in the center eyes you closely.
— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?
"Our". You smirk. You came to the king’s city, not theirs. How quickly things change! But it doesn’t matter. You have a goal, and you need to stick to it.
vi.688ce07d327e0e71519277aa:
The man in the center speaks first.
— So, this is the one trying to fill the rabble’s heads with ideas?
The disdain in his voice makes you bristle. You know, given more time, the people in the square would’ve listened. But you were seized and dragged here.
— Such arrogance, — the woman says with a smile, her eyes ice-cold.
— We don’t need that in Targrad. I’d have slit his throat rather than drag him here, — the young man mutters, too engrossed in his nails to even glance at you.
vi.688ce08f2082437172194a4c: There’s no law against speaking to the people.
vi.688ce096089ee7897a2fc361:
— So we’ll make one! — the youth looks at you with mockery and defiance. The man in the middle raises his hand.
— Enough! It doesn’t matter now. Stop bickering like little children.
vi.688ce0cbe03f37a53d2fd2d2:

— So, what are you supposed to do in our city?

vi.688ce10116403e2bd3b1d6fd: I have something I can only share with the local ruler.
vi.688ce118237836458f9bd9e3:
All three seated in the chairs exchange glances. You see them frown, casting contemptuous looks at one another. You realize each would relish ruling alone. But that’s impossible.
For now.
The man in the middle speaks up.
— So, what’s this about? We’re all equals here, so you can speak freely.
vi.688ce11f41c2999201789185: It’s about a prophecy from the Order of Navigators.
vi.688ce129380a933a8b7a4090:
— A prophecy? What nonsense! — the woman laughs hoarsely, covering her mouth with her hand. You stand still, waiting it out. They can laugh all they want, but every prophecy of the Order of Navigators’ leader has always come true. Targrad will have to accept it.
— Targrad is no place for such superstitious nonsense, — the young man chimes in, looking at you with mockery, — we deal in science here.
vi.688ce14ae766281384b6f59c: You don't understand! Every prophecy has always come true!
vi.688ce14ea87e870d685133ba: You can simply hear the prophecy without believing it.
vi.688ce15c6bbcad99f9904c4d: You let your emotions surge. How dare they question the will of the Order’s leader?! The previous ruler took prophecies seriously. But these... they understand nothing. Your task is to set them on the true path.
vi.688ce160b2181bac5a8abd2e: You strive to stay calm and composed. They may not believe in prophecies, but they must hear it. It's your duty. Without this, you might as well not return to the Order.
vi.688ce1897eab5de901684c48:
— Yeah, yeah, we don’t understand a thing, — the youth on the throne rolls his eyes and gestures to the guards. — Take him out of here. Let him read his prophecies to the drunks in the tavern.
You hear the guards approaching. You have mere moments to do what you came for.
vi.688ce193a5412dcc5972634e:
The youth wants to say something, but the man in the central chair raises his hand, stopping him.
— Is that all you need? For us to read the prophecy from your order? What are they called again... The Navigators?
You nod. The man beckons you closer. A faint glimmer of interest flickers in his eyes. Well, looks like you've managed to pique his curiosity.
— Hand me the scroll. I’ll read it.
vi.688ce1c84054e6f943d7a0cd:
You yank the scroll out with a sharp motion. The figures on the thrones flinch. Even the youth sits up straight, leaning forward with a face twisted in anger. It seems no one has defied him in a long time. The guards’ footsteps behind you quicken.
You break the seal on the scroll and...
vi.688ce1e259b11920c275fde1:
You calmly pull the scroll from your bag. For a moment, it seems to glow, but you blink, and the effect vanishes. Strange, perhaps you're just that exhausted?
— Come on, don't dawdle, — the woman says, her lips curling in annoyance as she notices your hesitation. — We have other matters to attend to besides your prophecy.
The way she spits out the last word makes it clear she doesn’t believe in it either. Well, that’s their problem. And this city’s.
You step closer and hand the scroll to the man in the center.
vi.688ce1f5690bf3ab4e774eba:
...everything is flooded with blue light. You feel the magic emanating from the scroll with your entire being. It seeps into you, pierces through you, destroys you. But you feel no pain. You cease to exist, detachedly thinking:
"Looks like I've become death itself, indeed."
vi.688ce202b284883465e196c2:
You watch as the man breaks the seal of your order, prying open the edge of the scroll with his fingers. For a moment, you see blue sparks again, you frown and shake your head. It seems you desperately need some sleep.
The sparks grow brighter, you blink, and...
vi.689f6b7ef5087b91c8cb7657: You’ve gotten right up to the heart of it. The secrets will be revealed a little later. Be patient for now and come back again.

fr.690e0703bdf07a46a6d7e801: C’est pour éviter qu’un soldat sous stress ne passe accidentellement en automatique et ne vide tout son chargeur en tir de panique.

po.690e063a7cdc8bbbb278da51: Na verdade, ele criou sua arma pensando que acabaria com as guerras.
po.690e06408ff405e68b0a6c29: Fico me perguntando se ele percebeu o quanto estava errado.
po.690e068ca5b896e61fc26b76: Ele achava que as pessoas finalmente reconsiderariam se matar após verem algo verdadeiramente destrutivo.
po.690e0703bdf07a46a6d7e801: É para que um soldado sob estresse não mude acidentalmente para tiro contínuo e desperdice o carregador todo em pânico.

sk.68c960fa07ce60f864e6fe0b: Sure. Good luck out there, mercenary.
sk.68c960fa2bd2ee5232030c86: You remember where the exit is, I won’t be walking you out.
sk.68c960fa52645077874b2f62: Of course. Choose carefully, a lot of this stuff is scarce now.
sk.68c960fa59b1c99946b3f744: Hello. Good to see you alive.
sk.68c960fa9eea2dcd4c672595: Just had a restock not long ago.
sk.68c960faa39fc1fcfa0d22a5: Yeah, but make it quick. I’ve got other things to do.
sk.68c960fac98915395c7f53c9: Don’t forget to shut the door behind you.
sk.68c960faf649f89e144c9356: Haven’t seen you in a while.
sk.68ca016f1d61788df0be768e: So you’re a top-notch gunsmith. Got anything interesting to share about guns?
sk.68ca019ce834daac527b76f8: In the AK one hundred family you’ve got the 101, 102, 103, 104, 105… then it jumps straight to 107.
sk.68ca01a575c7c424c91235e9: Curiously, the KS-23 carbine is considered light artillery in Russia because of its 23mm caliber.
sk.68ca01ab80e31a5bc132cee0: This one’s not exactly about guns…
sk.68ca01b24420abaaf020cec8: You know why on AK rifles the semi-auto fire is always at the lowest position on the selector?
sk.68d029accee57fbcd52ba00a: I’ll never turn down some assistance.
sk.68d029e27213047a1868047a: Let’s see where you can be useful.
sk.68d029e64f21c4916aca24fa: There’s always something, don’t worry about that.
sk.68d029eb5d9cc42af8603a75: Ah, looking to make some money? That’s a good goal.
sk.68d029efe76b2ccfea544734: Let me think of something to keep you busy.
sk.68d029f4463e9dd36b2603c9: Actually, I was just looking for someone to handle a couple tasks.
sk.68d02a5bcc75117dec81545f: Any success with that job we agreed on?
sk.68d02a5fcfd700ff1f92c21e: Ah, it’s you, mercenary. Here to report your progress?
sk.68d02a635c79330dc827a500: You finish everything we talked about yet?
sk.68d02ade0c76a0338706e159: Not yet, but I wanted to talk to you.
sk.68d02b9d11f703a9751ad59a: How are you going to complete my tasks if you’re always here… Okay, what do you need?
sk.68d02ba1d06062c592ef8087: Suggest you don’t waste my time then. What do you want?
sk.68d02ba9a1d6c600213aa23c: I thought the task was urgent enough, but it looks like you’re managing just fine. What did you want to discuss?
sk.68d02bb89f3399c29c061097: You don’t need to report that to me.
sk.68d02bbb4af6c574bfa46b61: Remember, this is you who needs this. It’s in your best interest to finish it.
sk.68d02bbfab59bc88dad2234a: I’ll wait for you to complete the task then.
sk.68d02bc3c5709502d1e23d00: You won’t have enough time if you keep coming here all the time.
sk.68de9f90baf172b3d2e456ef: No, I don’t need anything right now.
sk.68dfe78ac0a3ae6cb2a6a728: Hey. Hope you came here for business.
sk.68dfe78ceaeb47a3d628969f: Mercenary. Here on business, or just wandering in?
sk.68dffe20f5f735371e06a170: What exactly are you looking for?
sk.690272cae5f76949404e5e7f: Haven’t seen you in a while.
sk.690273f04b7b3ddc6eafcb08: Actually, I haven't finished it yet… Give me a bit more time, I'll finish it.
sk.690274c9702fb3d68d3149b0: Job's not done yet, but I wanted to talk to you.
sk.690e05c7a9f0ca60302891d4: Nobody’s ever seen an AK-106, but there are rumors it was supposed to be chambered in 9x39.
sk.690e0615b07a615fc4f721ce: By GOST standards, anything over 20mm is classed as artillery.
sk.690e0635204ea74a48d4e59f: Did you know Richard Gatling, the inventor of the Gatling gun, was a doctor by training?
sk.690e063a7cdc8bbbb278da51: He actually made his weapon thinking it would end wars.
sk.690e06408ff405e68b0a6c29: Wonder if he ever realized just how wrong he was.
sk.690e068ca5b896e61fc26b76: He figured people would finally reconsider killing each other after seeing something truly destructive.
sk.690e0703bdf07a46a6d7e801: That’s so a soldier under stress doesn’t accidentally switch to full auto and waste the whole mag in panic fire.

es.68c960fa07ce60f864e6fe0b: Claro. Buena suerte ahí afuera, mercenario.
es.68c960fa2bd2ee5232030c86: Ya sabes dónde está la salida, no te voy a acompañar.
es.68c960fa52645077874b2f62: Claro. Elige con cuidado; muchas de estas cosas son difíciles de encontrar.
es.68c960fa59b1c99946b3f744: Hola. Me alegro de verte con vida.
es.68c960fa9eea2dcd4c672595: Acaban de reabastecer mis suministros hace poco.
es.68c960faa39fc1fcfa0d22a5: Sí, pero que sea rápido. Tengo otras cosas que hacer.
es.68c960fac98915395c7f53c9: No te olvides de cerrar la puerta al salir.
es.68c960faf649f89e144c9356: Hacía tiempo que no te veía.
es.68ca016f1d61788df0be768e: Eres uno de los mejores armeros. ¿Tienes algún dato interesante que quieras compartir sobre las armas?
es.68ca019ce834daac527b76f8: En los fusiles AK de la Centésima Serie están el 101, 102, 103, 104, 105… y luego salta al 107.
es.68ca01a575c7c424c91235e9: Curiosamente, la carabina KS-23 es considerada como artillería ligera en Rusia debido a que tiene un calibre de 23 mm.
es.68ca01ab80e31a5bc132cee0: Esto no es exactamente sobre armas…
es.68ca01b24420abaaf020cec8: ¿Sabes por qué los fusiles AK tienen el modo semiautomático siempre en la posición más baja del selector?
es.68d029accee57fbcd52ba00a: Nunca rechazo un poco de ayuda.
es.68d029e27213047a1868047a: Veamos en qué puedes ser útil.
es.68d029e64f21c4916aca24fa: Siempre hay algo, no te preocupes por eso.
es.68d029eb5d9cc42af8603a75: Ah, ¿quieres ganar dinero? Ese es un buen objetivo.
es.68d029efe76b2ccfea544734: Déjame pensar en algo para mantenerte ocupado.
es.68d029f4463e9dd36b2603c9: De hecho, justo buscaba a alguien que se encargara de un par de tareas.
es.68d02a5bcc75117dec81545f: ¿Hay algún avance sobre el trabajo que acordamos?
es.68d02a5fcfd700ff1f92c21e: Ah, mercenario, eres tú. ¿Has venido a informar sobre tus progresos?
es.68d02a635c79330dc827a500: ¿Ya has terminado con todo eso de lo que hablamos?
es.68d02ade0c76a0338706e159: Aún no, pero quería hablar contigo.
es.68d02b9d11f703a9751ad59a: ¿Cómo vas a completar mis encargos si siempre estás aquí…? En fin, ¿qué necesitas?
es.68d02ba1d06062c592ef8087: Pues te sugiero que no me hagas perder el tiempo. ¿Qué quieres?
es.68d02ba9a1d6c600213aa23c: Pensaba que el encargo era bastante urgente, pero parece que te las estás arreglando muy bien. ¿De qué querías discutir?
es.68d02bb89f3399c29c061097: No es necesario que me informes de eso.
es.68d02bbb4af6c574bfa46b61: Recuerda, tú eres el que necesita esto. Te conviene mucho terminarlo.
es.68d02bbfab59bc88dad2234a: Entonces esperaré a que termines el encargo.
es.68d02bc3c5709502d1e23d00: No tendrás tiempo si sigues viniendo aquí todo el tiempo.
es.68de9f90baf172b3d2e456ef: No, no necesito nada ahora mismo.
es.68dfe78ac0a3ae6cb2a6a728: Hola. Espero que hayas venido para hacer negocios.
es.68dfe78ceaeb47a3d628969f: Mercenario. ¿Has venido por negocios o solo estás de paso?
es.690272cae5f76949404e5e7f: Hacía tiempo que no te veía.
es.690273f04b7b3ddc6eafcb08: La verdad es que aún no lo he terminado… Dame un poco más de tiempo y lo terminaré.
es.690274c9702fb3d68d3149b0: Aún no he terminado el trabajo, pero quería hablar contigo.
es.690e05c7a9f0ca60302891d4: Nadie ha visto nunca un AK-106, pero hay rumores de que iba a ser de calibre 9x39 mm.
es.690e0615b07a615fc4f721ce: Según el estándar GOST, cualquier arma con un calibre superior a 20 mm debe clasificarse como artillería.
es.690e0635204ea74a48d4e59f: ¿Sabías que Richard Gatling, el inventor de la ametralladora Gatling, tenía formación como médico?
es.690e063a7cdc8bbbb278da51: De hecho, creó su arma pensando que con ella acabaría con las guerras.
es.690e06408ff405e68b0a6c29: Me pregunto si alguna vez se dio cuenta de lo equivocado que estaba.
es.690e068ca5b896e61fc26b76: Pensó que la gente finalmente recapacitaría sobre matarse los unos a los otros después de ver algo verdaderamente destructivo.
es.690e0703bdf07a46a6d7e801: Para que un soldado bajo el estrés del combate no cambie accidentalmente al modo automático y desperdicie todo el cargador disparando en pánico.

tu.68c960fa2bd2ee5232030c86: Çıkışın nerede olduğunu hatırlıyorsun, seni elinden tutup çıkarmayacağım.
tu.68c960fa52645077874b2f62: Elbette. Dikkatli seç, bu malların çoğu artık çok kıt.
tu.68c960fa9eea2dcd4c672595: Kısa süre önce taze stok aldım.
tu.68c960faa39fc1fcfa0d22a5: Evet, ama çabuk ol. Başka işlerim var.
tu.68ca016f1d61788df0be768e: Demek birinci sınıf bir silah ustasısın. Silahlarla ilgili ilginç bir şey var mı anlatacağın?
tu.68ca019ce834daac527b76f8: AK yüz serisinde 101, 102, 103, 104, 105 var… sonra direkt 107’ye atlıyor. AK-106’yı kimse görmedi, ama 9x39’la çalışacak bir model olduğu söylentisi var.
tu.68ca01a575c7c424c91235e9: İlginçtir, KS-23 karabina Rusya’da 23 mm çapı yüzünden hafif topçu olarak geçer. GOST standartlarına göre 20 mm üzeri her şey topçu sınıfıdır.
tu.68ca01ab80e31a5bc132cee0: Bu silahla tam ilgili değil ama… Gatling silahının mucidi Richard Gatling aslında eğitimli bir doktordu. Silahını, savaşların biteceğini düşünerek geliştirmişti. İnsanlar gerçekten yıkıcı bir şey görünce birbirini öldürmeyi yeniden düşünür sanmıştı. Yanıldığını hiç fark etti mi acaba?
tu.68ca01b24420abaaf020cec8: AK tüfeklerde tek atış modunun seçici üzerindeki en alt konumda olmasının nedeni ne biliyor musun? Asker stres altındayken yanlışlıkla tam otomatiğe getirip tüm şarjörü panik ateşinde boşaltmasın diye.
tu.68d029e64f21c4916aca24fa: Her zaman bir şeyler vardır, merak etme.
tu.68d029eb5d9cc42af8603a75: Ah, biraz para kazanmak mı istiyorsun? Güzel hedef.
tu.68d029efe76b2ccfea544734: Seni meşgul edecek bir şey düşüneyim.
tu.68d029f4463e9dd36b2603c9: Aslında birkaç işi halledecek birini arıyordum.
tu.68d02a564403c389b62e0a99: Görevle ilgili bir gelişme var mı?
tu.68d02a5bcc75117dec81545f: Anlaştığımız işte bir başarı var mı?
tu.68d02a5fcfd700ff1f92c21e: Ah, sen misin paralı asker. İlerlemeni raporlamaya mı geldin?
tu.68d02ade0c76a0338706e159: Henüz değil ama seninle konuşmak istedim.
tu.68d02b9d11f703a9751ad59a: Görevlerimi nasıl tamamlayacaksın sürekli buradaysan… Peki, ne istiyorsun?
tu.68d02ba9a1d6c600213aa23c: Görevin yeterince acil olduğunu sanıyordum ama gayet idare ediyorsun gibi. Ne konuşmak istedin?
tu.68d02bb89f3399c29c061097: Bunu bana rapor etmene gerek yok.
tu.68d02bbb4af6c574bfa46b61: Unutma, buna ihtiyacı olan sensin. Bitirmen senin yararına.
tu.68d02bc3c5709502d1e23d00: Buraya böyle gelmeye devam edersen yeterince vaktin olmayacak.
tu.68de9f90baf172b3d2e456ef: Hayır, şu an bir şeye ihtiyacım yok.
tu.68dfe78ceaeb47a3d628969f: Paralı asker. İş için mi geldin, yoksa öylesine mi dolanıyorsun?
tu.68dffde4a5d8f5f24eb613a0: Ah, demek sensin. Önemli bir şey mi var?
tu.690273f04b7b3ddc6eafcb08: Aslında hâlâ bitirmedim… Bana biraz daha zaman ver, bitireceğim.
tu.690274c9702fb3d68d3149b0: Görev bitmedi ama seninle konuşmak istedim.

tu.690e0635204ea74a48d4e59f: Gatling silahının mucidi Richard Gatling’in aslında eğitimli bir doktor olduğunu biliyor muydun?
tu.690e06408ff405e68b0a6c29: Ne kadar yanıldığını hiç fark etti mi acaba.
tu.690e068ca5b896e61fc26b76: İnsanlar gerçekten yıkıcı bir şey görünce birbirini öldürmeyi yeniden düşünür sanmıştı.

ru.68c960fa2bd2ee5232030c86: Ты помнишь, где выход, провожать не буду.
ru.68c960fa52645077874b2f62: Конечно. Выбирай внимательно, многие вещи в дефиците сейчас.
ru.68c960fa9eea2dcd4c672595: У меня как раз недавно была новая поставка.
ru.68c960faa39fc1fcfa0d22a5: Ага, только выбирай побыстрее, у меня ещё есть дела.
ru.68c960fac98915395c7f53c9: Не забудь дверь за собой закрыть.
ru.68ca016f1d61788df0be768e: Значит, ты первоклассный оружейник. Можешь рассказать что-нибудь интересное про пушки?
ru.68ca019ce834daac527b76f8: В линейке автоматов АК есть модели 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, а потом сразу 107.
ru.68ca01a575c7c424c91235e9: Карабин КС-23 считается в России легкой артиллерией за счет калибра 23мм.
ru.68ca01ab80e31a5bc132cee0: Это не совсем про пушки, но…
ru.68ca01b24420abaaf020cec8: Ты знаешь, почему на автоматах на базе АК одиночный огонь – это всегда крайнее нижнее положение переводчика огня?
ru.68d029e27213047a1868047a: Давай посмотрим, где ты можешь помочь.
ru.68d029eb5d9cc42af8603a75: А, решил денег заработать? Похвальное стремление.
ru.68d029f4463e9dd36b2603c9: Я как раз искал исполнителя на пару заданий.
ru.68d02a5bcc75117dec81545f: Есть успехи по заданию, которое мы оговаривали?
ru.68d02a5fcfd700ff1f92c21e: А, это ты, наёмник. Пришёл рассказать о своих успехах?
ru.68d02a635c79330dc827a500: Ты уже выполнил всё, о чём мы говорили?
ru.68d02ade0c76a0338706e159: Пока нет, но мне надо с тобой поговорить.
ru.68d02b9d11f703a9751ad59a: И как ты собираешься выполнять задачи, если постоянно ко мне ходишь… Ладно, что тебе нужно?
ru.68d02ba1d06062c592ef8087: Не стоит тратить так много времени на разговоры. Что тебе требуется?
ru.68d02ba9a1d6c600213aa23c: Я думал, что задача у тебя горит, но, оказывается, не так уж всё и срочно. Ладно, что надо обсудить?
ru.68d02bb89f3399c29c061097: Не обязательно сообщать мне об этом.
ru.68d02bbb4af6c574bfa46b61: Напоминаю, что это нужно тебе. В твоих интересах всё выполнить. Не нужно уведомлять меня о каждом шаге.
ru.68d02bc3c5709502d1e23d00: Времени точно не будет хватать, если постоянно сюда ходить.
ru.68dfe78ceaeb47a3d628969f: Наёмник. Ты ко мне по делу или просто так?
ru.6902724adc5cf9a4c5b27c58: Как раз пришел на счет этого.
ru.690273f04b7b3ddc6eafcb08: На самом деле я ещё не закончил... Дай ещё немного времени, я всё сделаю.
ru.690274c9702fb3d68d3149b0: Пока дело не сделано, но мне надо с тобой поговорить.
ru.690e05c7a9f0ca60302891d4: АК106 никто не видел, но ходят слухи, что должен был быть под патрон 9х39.
ru.690e0615b07a615fc4f721ce: По ГОСТу все оружие, имеющее калибр больше 20, причисляется к артиллерии.
ru.690e0635204ea74a48d4e59f: Знаешь, что Джордан Гатлинг, изобретатель пулемёта Гатлинга, был врачом по образованию?
ru.690e063a7cdc8bbbb278da51: А создавал он своё оружие, думая, что это поможет положить конец конфликтам.
ru.690e06408ff405e68b0a6c29: Интересно, понял ли он в итоге, насколько сильно ошибался?
ru.690e068ca5b896e61fc26b76: Он считал, что люди наконец-то передумают убивать друг друга, увидев по-настоящему разрушительную войну.
ru.690e0703bdf07a46a6d7e801: Это нужно, чтобы боец в стрессовой ситуации не перевёл случайно на очередь и не отстрелял впустую весь магазин.

ch.68ca99a820cee3b235970d2d: 全塔科夫都找不到比我这儿更好的货！
ch.68ca99a8230a7d407974df70: 你知道吗？就算是塔科夫现在这个情况，还有一堆收藏家呢！
ch.68ca99a855bf79bdd336ae63: 当然啦。我刚补过一批货。
ch.68ca99a85c9e91798319df18: 你一直在做买卖对吧？别人下过最奇怪的订单是什么？
ch.68ca99a85e9b3fa7abdfacf0: 好吧，兄弟，随便挑你想要的。
ch.68ca99a88153b61477286ccb: 你是有什么预测的能力吗？每次来得都这么准？我这刚到一批新货。
ch.68ca99a8c070d64acebcfbca: 印着塔科夫某位政客头像的 T 恤。名字想不起来了，那个光头……
ch.68ca99a8d740a46478e26f3b: 你绝对想象不到我的渠道每天要经手多少东西！
ch.68ca99a8d87f37c05199d7d1: 当然！但记住——我这不打折。
ch.68ca99a8dd66a45284e49b2f: 要说以前的事，我还曾卖过一批假的路易伪登包包。没人看出来它们是假的！
ch.68d08bef150c490f936fec45: 把这里当自己家就好，千万别拘束。
ch.68d08c8cbba41fefa7943140: 随便挑！我卖的几乎所有东西都有质量保证。
ch.68d08e49fa65e10a41677f0b: 哟哟，看看是谁来了！我让你办的事你办了吗？
ch.68d08e500e5e0e85a9996de5: 哦，你这么快就来了？都做完了？
ch.68d08e558f33487394a5f778: 动作挺快啊！一切都准备好了？
ch.68d08e609c2225eb5a868f1b: 你已经做完了还是怎么？
ch.68d08eb992b9a2932b9d8120: 还没有。我现在正要出去。
ch.68d08edefc1094cee828ff80: 一点也不意外。那么你想聊什么？
ch.68d08f0d8545cffe35dfa770: 兄弟，你这让我有点失望啊。好吧，说吧，你需要什么？
ch.68d08f136a311eecda64a840: 最好去干活，而不是在这儿跟我闲聊。
ch.68d08f1de71bd2732a43bb67: 谁会这样磨蹭？算了……你想说啥？
ch.68d08f421811e0d1805450f9: 我一般挺欣赏你做事快的，兄弟！但这次你掉链子了。
ch.68d08f538e382e50f199a79b: 那就去做。不然我得找别人来干这活了。
ch.68d08f585ad8308e31e65f2e: 去吧干活。活儿不会等人。
ch.68d09a478962eb3fc959a339: 我现在就给你找个合适的活儿。
ch.68d09a51ba39ddd7356c7dab: 兄弟，你这话伤我自尊了！当然有。
ch.68d09a5c782c0ed4a0b25a9d: 我记得有点小活儿……我现在看看。
ch.69027e8ddc3a20d8838b4187: 突然想起来我还有东西没做完。我得走了。
ch.69027ef5343f9036cdc1f2f4: 活儿还没做完。得跟你聊点事。
ch.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: 但别告诉别人啊，兄弟。我可不想名声受影响。
ch.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: 好笑的是，我把那些货运到了封锁区外面。
ch.690e09aa3a53de8ec8a67e7f: 他们拿去干嘛我不知道，但付了我不少钱。

fr.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: Mais n’en parle à personne, frère. Je ne voudrais pas que ma réputation en prenne un coup.
fr.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: Le plus drôle, c’est que je les ai expédiés en dehors du cordon.

it.68ca99a855bf79bdd336ae63: Assolutamente. Ho appena fatto un piccolo rifornimento.
it.68ca99a85c9e91798319df18: Hai sempre lavorato nel commercio, giusto? Qual è la cosa più strana che ti hanno ordinato?
it.68ca99a85e9b3fa7abdfacf0: Beh, scegli quello che vuoi, fratello.
it.68ca99a87562d71981e2d95b: Sì, sì, restiamo in contatto allora.
it.68ca99a88153b61477286ccb: Hai capito quando passare o cosa? Ho appena ricevuto una nuova spedizione.
it.68ca99a8c070d64acebcfbca: Magliette con uno dei politici di Tarkov. Non ricordo il suo nome, il tizio calvo...
it.68ca99a8d740a46478e26f3b: Non crederesti mai alla quantità di roba che passa attraverso la mia rete!
it.68ca99a8dd66a45284e49b2f: Se parliamo di cose passate, una volta ho venduto un lotto di borse Loui Peeton contraffatte. Nessuno si è accorto che erano false!
it.68d08c8cbba41fefa7943140: Scegli pure! Quasi tutti i prodotti che vendo hanno una garanzia di qualità.
it.68d08e49fa65e10a41677f0b: Bene bene, guarda chi c'è! Hai fatto quello che ti ho chiesto?
it.68d08e500e5e0e85a9996de5: Oh, sei già qui? Hai già fatto tutto?
it.68d08e5a9bdb093ba9d68082: Questa sì che è velocità! Hai finito tutto?
it.68d08e81c36d2e5ee936a9a3: No. Devo discutere di una cosa con te.
it.68d08edefc1094cee828ff80: E perché non sono sorpreso. Allora, di cosa vuoi discutere?
it.68d08f0d8545cffe35dfa770: Fratello, mi stai davvero deludendo. Va bene, di cosa hai bisogno?
it.68d08f136a311eecda64a840: Faresti meglio a fare il tuo lavoro invece di chiacchierare con me.
it.68d08f1de71bd2732a43bb67: Chi fa cose del genere? Comunque... Che succede?
it.68d08f421811e0d1805450f9: Di solito ti apprezzo per la tua rapidità nel portare a termine le cose, fratello! Ma questa volta hai sbagliato.
it.68d08f538e382e50f199a79b: Allora fallo. Altrimenti dovrò trovare qualcun altro per questo lavoro.
it.68d08f585ad8308e31e65f2e: Avanti, allora. Il lavoro non aspetta.
it.68d09a478962eb3fc959a339: Ti troverò subito qualcosa di adatto.
it.68d09a51ba39ddd7356c7dab: Mi offendi, fratello! Certo che sì.
it.68d09a5c782c0ed4a0b25a9d: Credo ci fosse un piccolo lavoro... Adesso vado a dare un'occhiata.
it.68dfb14e805b89b256c648f0: Mi dispiace fratello, al momento non c'è niente.
it.69027de046e2966b95cf00e9: Stavo proprio pensando a te, fratello!
it.69027e8ddc3a20d8838b4187: Mi sono appena ricordato che devo ancora finirlo. Devo andare.
it.69027ef5343f9036cdc1f2f4: Non ho ancora finito il lavoro. Ho qualcosa da discutere.
it.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: Ma non dirlo a nessuno, fratello. Non vorrei che la mia reputazione ne risentisse.
it.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: La cosa divertente è che li ho spediti fuori dal cordone.
it.690e09aa3a53de8ec8a67e7f: Non so cosa ne abbiano fatto, ma mi hanno pagato piuttosto bene.
it.690e09e9155f862173330f22: Da stupide magliette a posate di lusso.
it.690e09ed646fb2deb0536cb9: Ogni mese porto libri di barzellette a Tarkov. Credo che tu abbia capito a chi sono destinati.
it.690e0a4835c7dcdd7f3fcb6e: A volte ricevo ordini per statuine di ragazze anime in mutande.
it.690e0a4dac225492c0e6dd52: E no, non ti dirò chi è.

jp.68ca99a80bf27c829f7a3517: やあやあ、誰が来たかと思ったぞ！
jp.68ca99a81ebb5b8a47edf6da: ちょうどお前のことを考えてたんだ、兄弟！
jp.68ca99a820cee3b235970d2d: タルコフでこれ以上の品は見つけらんないぞ！
jp.68ca99a8230a7d407974df70: タルコフにはまだまだコレクターがたくさんいるって知っているだろう？
jp.68ca99a83468834a17406c0d: その質問を待ってたんだ！
jp.68ca99a83ff2ed3a3f810ba2: 何か新しいものを探してるのか？
jp.68ca99a8519bd491982196dd: 金を忘れずに持って来ているよな？
jp.68ca99a85247ac6df979a49c: 買ったものは忘れるなよ！
jp.68ca99a855bf79bdd336ae63: もちろんだ。少しだけだが補充したぞ。
jp.68ca99a85c9e91798319df18: あんたは昔から取引しているんだろう？今までの注文の中で一番変なのは何だった？
jp.68ca99a85e9b3fa7abdfacf0: まあ、好きなものを選びな、兄弟。
jp.68ca99a87562d71981e2d95b: そうだなそうだな、連絡を取り合おう。
jp.68ca99a876bdb305b3dc767c: じゃあまた待ってるぜ。
jp.68ca99a88153b61477286ccb: いつ立ち寄るといいか分かるのか？ちょうど新しい物が届いたところだ。
jp.68ca99a8c070d64acebcfbca: タルコフの政治家の一人がプリントされた Tシャツだな。名前は思い出せないんだが、あのハゲの男だ...面白いことにな、これを封鎖線の外に送ったんだ。どうなったのかは知らないけど、かなりの額をもらえたよ。
jp.68ca99a8d740a46478e26f3b: 俺の流通網を通る品の量は信じらんないだろ！くだらねえ Tシャツから、洒落たフォークまである。それに一番変わってるのは...毎月タルコフにジョーク本を届けてもらってる。誰に向けたものかは分かるだろ？
jp.68ca99a8d87f37c05199d7d1: もちろんだ！だが、割引はしないぞ。
jp.68ca99a8dd66a45284e49b2f: 昔の話なんだが、Loui Peeton の偽バッグを大量に売ったことがあるんだよ。誰も偽物だと気づきやしなかったな！だが誰にも言わないでくれよ、評判に傷をつけたくないしな。
jp.68d08bef150c490f936fec45: くつろげよ、遠慮するな。
jp.68d08c8cbba41fefa7943140: 選んでくれ！俺が売ってるもののほとんどに品質保証がついてるぞ。
jp.68d08e49fa65e10a41677f0b: ようよう、誰なのかとな！頼んだことは終わったか？
jp.68d08e500e5e0e85a9996de5: おお、もう来たのか？すべて終わったか？
jp.68d08e558f33487394a5f778: 仕事が早いな！すべて準備できたのか？
jp.68d08e5a9bdb093ba9d68082: これこそスピードという奴だな！すべて終えたのか？
jp.68d08e81c36d2e5ee936a9a3: いや、ちょっと話があるんだ。
jp.68d08edefc1094cee828ff80: まあ驚きはしないさ。それで、どうしたんだ？
jp.68d08f0d8545cffe35dfa770: 兄弟、本当にがっかりだぞ。それで何が要るんだ？
jp.68d08f136a311eecda64a840: 俺としゃべってるのならちゃんと仕事してくれ。
jp.68d08f1de71bd2732a43bb67: 誰がこんなことするんだ？まあいいか...どうした？
jp.68d08f421811e0d1805450f9: 普段は早くこなしてくれてるが、今回は手を抜いたな。
jp.68d08f538e382e50f199a79b: じゃあやってくれ。でないと、この仕事をほかの奴に頼まないといけなくなる。
jp.68d08f585ad8308e31e65f2e: なら行ってこい。仕事は待ってくれないぞ。
jp.68d08f5dc7f5a492c41f8906: 結果に期待するぞ、兄弟。
jp.68d09a02ffe4bb9316ba9946: 何か俺にできる仕事はないか？
jp.68d09a478962eb3fc959a339: 今何かお前に合うものを探してやろう。
jp.68d09a57f2d3f53060cc77aa: 確認しないとな、何かあったはずだ...
jp.68d09a5c782c0ed4a0b25a9d: ちょっとした仕事があったような...今確認する。
jp.68dfb14e805b89b256c648f0: 悪いな兄弟、今は何もないな。
jp.69027de046e2966b95cf00e9: ちょうどお前のことを考えてたんだ、兄弟！
jp.69027e8ddc3a20d8838b4187: まだ終わらせないといけねえことを思い出したよ、行かないと。
jp.69027ef5343f9036cdc1f2f4: まだ仕事が終わってないんだ。話したいことがある。
jp.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: だが誰にも言わないでくれよ、評判に傷をつけたくないしな。
jp.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: 面白いことにな、これを封鎖線の外に送ったんだ。
jp.690e09aa3a53de8ec8a67e7f: どうなったのかは知らないけど、かなりの額をもらえたよ。
jp.690e09e9155f862173330f22: くだらねえ Tシャツから、洒落たフォークまである。
jp.690e09ed646fb2deb0536cb9: 毎月タルコフにジョーク本を届けてもらってる。誰に向けたものかは分かるだろ？
jp.690e0a0251a4e6834a425b58: それに一番変わってるのは...
jp.690e0a4835c7dcdd7f3fcb6e: 時々、やばい下着姿のアニメの女のフィギュアのオーダーが入るんだぜ。
jp.690e0a4dac225492c0e6dd52: いや、誰の注文なのかは言わないよ。

kr.68ca99a81ebb5b8a47edf6da: I was just thinking about you, bro!
kr.68ca99a820cee3b235970d2d: You won’t find better goods in Tarkov!
kr.68ca99a8230a7d407974df70: You know Tarkov’s still got plenty of collectors, right?
kr.68ca99a83468834a17406c0d: I was waiting for you to ask that!
kr.68ca99a8519bd491982196dd: You didn’t forget to bring cash, did you?
kr.68ca99a855bf79bdd336ae63: Absolutely. I just had a small restock.
kr.68ca99a85c9e91798319df18: You’ve always been in trade, right? What’s the strangest thing people ordered?
kr.68ca99a85e9b3fa7abdfacf0: Well, pick whatever you want, brother.
kr.68ca99a876bdb305b3dc767c: I’ll be waiting another time then.
kr.68ca99a88153b61477286ccb: You got a feel for when to drop by or what? I just got a new shipment.
kr.68ca99a8c070d64acebcfbca: T-shirts with one of Tarkov’s politicians. Can’t recall his name, the bald guy…
kr.68ca99a8d740a46478e26f3b: You wouldn’t believe the volume of stuff that passes through my network!
kr.68ca99a8d87f37c05199d7d1: Of course! But remember – no discounts.
kr.68ca99a8dd66a45284e49b2f: If we’re talking past stuff, I once sold a batch of knockoff Loui Peeton bags. Nobody realized they were fake!
kr.68d08bef150c490f936fec45: Make yourself at home, don’t be shy.
kr.68d08c8cbba41fefa7943140: Pick away! Almost everything I sell has a quality guarantee.
kr.68d08e49fa65e10a41677f0b: Well well, look who it is! You did what I asked?
kr.68d08e500e5e0e85a9996de5: Oh, you’re here already? Done everything?
kr.68d08e5a9bdb093ba9d68082: Now that’s speed! Finished with everything?
kr.68d08e81c36d2e5ee936a9a3: No. I need to discuss something with you.
kr.68d08eb992b9a2932b9d8120: Not yet. I’m heading out now.
kr.68d08edefc1094cee828ff80: And why am I not surprised. So what do you want to discuss?
kr.68d08f0d8545cffe35dfa770: Brother, you’re really letting me down. Alright, what do you need?
kr.68d08f136a311eecda64a840: Better be doing the job instead of jawing with me.
kr.68d08f1de71bd2732a43bb67: Who does stuff like this? Whatever… What's up?
kr.68d08f421811e0d1805450f9: I usually appreciate you for getting things done quick, bro! But this time you slipped.
kr.68d08f538e382e50f199a79b: Go do it then. Otherwise I’ll have to find somebody else for this job.
kr.68d08f585ad8308e31e65f2e: Go on then. Work won’t wait.
kr.68d09a478962eb3fc959a339: I’ll find you something suitable right now.
kr.68d09a4d07ca1bea5a88f7b8: I think so. Let me check.
kr.68d09a51ba39ddd7356c7dab: You offend me, bro! Of course.
kr.68d09a57f2d3f53060cc77aa: Need to check, there was definitely something…
kr.68d09a5c782c0ed4a0b25a9d: I think there was a little job… I’ll take a look now.
kr.69027de046e2966b95cf00e9: I was just thinking about you, bro!
kr.69027e8ddc3a20d8838b4187: Just remembered I still have to finish it up. I gotta go.
kr.69027ef5343f9036cdc1f2f4: Haven't finished the job yet. Got something to discuss.
kr.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: But don’t tell anyone, brother. Wouldn’t want my rep to take a hit.
kr.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: The funny thing is, I shipped them outside the cordon.
kr.690e09aa3a53de8ec8a67e7f: Don’t know what they did with them, but they paid me pretty well.
kr.690e09e9155f862173330f22: From dumb T-shirts to fancy cutlery.
kr.690e09ed646fb2deb0536cb9: Every month I haul in joke books to Tarkov. I think you get who they’re for.
kr.690e0a4835c7dcdd7f3fcb6e: Sometimes I get orders for figurines of anime girls in fucking underwear.
kr.690e0a4dac225492c0e6dd52: And no, I won’t tell you who.

po.68ca99a820cee3b235970d2d: Não vai encontrar mercadoria melhor em Tarkov!
po.68ca99a8230a7d407974df70: Você sabe que Tarkov ainda tem muitos colecionadores, né?
po.68ca99a8519bd491982196dd: Você não esqueceu de trazer dinheiro, né?
po.68ca99a855bf79bdd336ae63: Com certeza. Acabei de receber uma reposição.
po.68ca99a85c9e91798319df18: Você sempre esteve no comércio, né? Qual é a coisa mais estranha que as pessoas pediram?
po.68ca99a85e9b3fa7abdfacf0: Bom, escolhe o que quiser, irmão.
po.68ca99a87562d71981e2d95b: Sim, sim, fica em contato então.
po.68ca99a88153b61477286ccb: Você tem um faro para quando aparecer aqui, hein? Acabei de receber uma remessa nova.
po.68ca99a8c070d64acebcfbca: Camisetas com um dos políticos de Tarkov. Não lembro o nome, o careca…
po.68ca99a8d740a46478e26f3b: Você não acreditaria no volume de coisas que passam pela minha rede!
po.68ca99a8dd66a45284e49b2f: Se estamos falando de coisas do passado, uma vez vendi um lote de bolsas falsas da Loui Peeton. Ninguém percebeu que eram falsas!
po.68d08bef150c490f936fec45: Fique à vontade, não seja tímido.
po.68d08c8cbba41fefa7943140: Pode escolher! Quase tudo que vendo tem garantia de qualidade.
po.68d08e49fa65e10a41677f0b: Opa, olha quem é! Você fez o que pedi?
po.68d08e5a9bdb093ba9d68082: Isso é que é velocidade! Terminou tudo?
po.68d08e81c36d2e5ee936a9a3: Não. Preciso discutir algo com você.
po.68d08edefc1094cee828ff80: E por quê eu não estou surpreso. Então o que você quer discutir?
po.68d08f0d8545cffe35dfa770: Irmão, você tá me decepcionando mesmo. Certo, o que você precisa?
po.68d08f136a311eecda64a840: Melhor ir fazer o serviço do que ficar papo furado comigo.
po.68d08f1de71bd2732a43bb67: Quem faz uma coisa dessas? Tanto faz… O que foi?
po.68d08f421811e0d1805450f9: Geralmente te valorizo por fazer as coisas rápido, mano! Mas dessa vez você escorregou.
po.68d08f538e382e50f199a79b: Vai lá fazer então. Senão vou ter que achar outra pessoa pra esse serviço.
po.68d08f585ad8308e31e65f2e: Vai então. O trabalho não espera.
po.68d09a414378941e4ccd5752: A gente acha alguma coisa agora.
po.68d09a478962eb3fc959a339: Já te acho algo adequado agora.
po.68d09a4d07ca1bea5a88f7b8: Acho que sim. Deixa eu verificar.
po.68d09a51ba39ddd7356c7dab: Você me ofende, mano! Claro que sim.
po.68d09a57f2d3f53060cc77aa: Precisa verificar, com certeza tinha alguma coisa…
po.68d09a5c782c0ed4a0b25a9d: Acho que tinha um servicinho… Vou dar uma olhada agora.
po.69027de046e2966b95cf00e9: Eu estava pensando em você agora, mano!
po.69027e8ddc3a20d8838b4187: Acabei de lembrar que ainda tenho que terminar isso. Preciso ir.
po.69027ef5343f9036cdc1f2f4: Ainda não terminei o serviço. Tenho algo pra discutir.
po.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: Mas não conta pra ninguém, irmão. Não quero que minha reputação saia arranhada.
po.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: O engraçado é que eu mandei eles pra fora do cordão.
po.690e09aa3a53de8ec8a67e7f: Não sei o que fizeram com eles, mas me pagaram muito bem.
po.690e09e9155f862173330f22: De camisetas idiotas a talheres finos.
po.690e09ed646fb2deb0536cb9: Todo mês eu trago livros de piadas pra Tarkov. Acho que você sabe pra quem são.
po.690e0a4835c7dcdd7f3fcb6e: Às vezes recebo pedidos de figurinhas de garotas de anime só de calcinha, porra.
po.690e0a4dac225492c0e6dd52: E não, não vou te dizer quem.

sk.68ca99a8519bd491982196dd: You didn’t forget to bring cash, did you?
sk.68ca99a855bf79bdd336ae63: Absolutely. I just had a small restock.
sk.68ca99a85c9e91798319df18: You’ve always been in trade, right? What’s the strangest thing people ordered?
sk.68ca99a85e9b3fa7abdfacf0: Well, pick whatever you want, brother.
sk.68ca99a876bdb305b3dc767c: I’ll be waiting another time then.
sk.68ca99a88153b61477286ccb: You got a feel for when to drop by or what? I just got a new shipment.
sk.68ca99a8c070d64acebcfbca: T-shirts with one of Tarkov’s politicians. Can’t recall his name, the bald guy…
sk.68ca99a8d740a46478e26f3b: You wouldn’t believe the volume of stuff that passes through my network!
sk.68ca99a8d87f37c05199d7d1: Of course! But remember – no discounts.
sk.68ca99a8dd66a45284e49b2f: If we’re talking past stuff, I once sold a batch of knockoff Loui Peeton bags. Nobody realized they were fake!
sk.68d08bef150c490f936fec45: Make yourself at home, don’t be shy.
sk.68d08c8cbba41fefa7943140: Pick away! Almost everything I sell has a quality guarantee.
sk.68d08e49fa65e10a41677f0b: Well well, look who it is! You did what I asked?
sk.68d08e500e5e0e85a9996de5: Oh, you’re here already? Done everything?
sk.68d08e5a9bdb093ba9d68082: Now that’s speed! Finished with everything?
sk.68d08e81c36d2e5ee936a9a3: No. I need to discuss something with you.
sk.68d08eb992b9a2932b9d8120: Not yet. I’m heading out now.
sk.68d08edefc1094cee828ff80: And why am I not surprised. So what do you want to discuss?
sk.68d08f0d8545cffe35dfa770: Brother, you’re really letting me down. Alright, what do you need?
sk.68d08f136a311eecda64a840: Better be doing the job instead of jawing with me.
sk.68d08f1de71bd2732a43bb67: Who does stuff like this? Whatever… What's up?
sk.68d08f421811e0d1805450f9: I usually appreciate you for getting things done quick, bro! But this time you slipped.
sk.68d08f538e382e50f199a79b: Go do it then. Otherwise I’ll have to find somebody else for this job.
sk.68d08f585ad8308e31e65f2e: Go on then. Work won’t wait.
sk.68d09a478962eb3fc959a339: I’ll find you something suitable right now.
sk.68d09a4d07ca1bea5a88f7b8: I think so. Let me check.
sk.68d09a51ba39ddd7356c7dab: You offend me, bro! Of course.
sk.68d09a57f2d3f53060cc77aa: Need to check, there was definitely something…
sk.68d09a5c782c0ed4a0b25a9d: I think there was a little job… I’ll take a look now.
sk.69027de046e2966b95cf00e9: I was just thinking about you, bro!
sk.69027e8ddc3a20d8838b4187: Just remembered I still have to finish it up. I gotta go.
sk.69027ef5343f9036cdc1f2f4: Haven't finished the job yet. Got something to discuss.
sk.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: But don’t tell anyone, brother. Wouldn’t want my rep to take a hit.
sk.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: The funny thing is, I shipped them outside the cordon.
sk.690e09aa3a53de8ec8a67e7f: Don’t know what they did with them, but they paid me pretty well.
sk.690e09e9155f862173330f22: From dumb T-shirts to fancy cutlery.
sk.690e09ed646fb2deb0536cb9: Every month I haul in joke books to Tarkov. I think you get who they’re for.
sk.690e0a4835c7dcdd7f3fcb6e: Sometimes I get orders for figurines of anime girls in fucking underwear.
sk.690e0a4dac225492c0e6dd52: And no, I won’t tell you who.

es.68ca99a80bf27c829f7a3517: ¡Vaya, vaya, mira quién anda por aquí!

es.68ca99a8230a7d407974df70: ¿Sabías que Tarkov sigue teniendo un gran número de coleccionistas?
es.68ca99a83468834a17406c0d: ¡Estaba esperando a que me preguntaras eso!
es.68ca99a8519bd491982196dd: No te habrás olvidado de traer dinero, ¿verdad?
es.68ca99a855bf79bdd336ae63: Claro que sí. Acaban de reabastecerme.
es.68ca99a85c9e91798319df18: Siempre te has dedicado al comercio, ¿verdad? ¿Qué es lo más raro que te han pedido?
es.68ca99a85e9b3fa7abdfacf0: Bueno, hermano, elige lo que quieras.
es.68ca99a88153b61477286ccb: ¿Siempre tienes un presentimiento de cuándo debes venir? Justo acabo de recibir un nuevo cargamento.

es.68ca99a8d740a46478e26f3b: ¡No te imaginas la cantidad de cosas que pasan por mi red de suministros!
es.68ca99a8d87f37c05199d7d1: ¡Por supuesto! Pero recuerda: nada de descuentos.
es.68ca99a8dd66a45284e49b2f: Si hablamos de cosas del pasado, una vez vendí un lote de bolsos Loui Peeton de imitación. ¡Nadie se enteró de que eran falsos!
es.68d08bef150c490f936fec45: Siéntete como en casa, no seas tímido.
es.68d08c8cbba41fefa7943140: ¡Elige lo que quieras! Casi todo lo que vendo tiene garantía de calidad.
es.68d08e49fa65e10a41677f0b: ¡Vaya, vaya, mira quién está aquí! ¿Has hecho lo que te pedí?
es.68d08e500e5e0e85a9996de5: Oh, ¿ya estás de regreso? ¿Has terminado todo?
es.68d08e81c36d2e5ee936a9a3: No. Tengo que hablar contigo sobre algo.
es.68d08eb992b9a2932b9d8120: Aún no. Justo voy a ello.
es.68d08edefc1094cee828ff80: Y por qué eso no me sorprende. Bueno, ¿de qué quieres hablar?
es.68d08f0d8545cffe35dfa770: Macho, en verdad me estás decepcionando. Pero está bien, ¿qué necesitas?
es.68d08f136a311eecda64a840: Más vale que te pongas manos a la obra en lugar de perder el tiempo conmigo.
es.68d08f1de71bd2732a43bb67: ¿Quién hace las cosas así? En fin… ¿Qué pasa?
es.68d08f421811e0d1805450f9: ¡Hermano, normalmente aprecio que hagas las cosas rápido! Pero esta vez la has fastidiado.
es.68d08f538e382e50f199a79b: Pues hazlo. Si no, tendré que buscar a otra persona que haga el trabajo.
es.68d08f585ad8308e31e65f2e: Venga, pues. El trabajo no puede esperar.
es.68d09a478962eb3fc959a339: Te buscaré algo adecuado en este instante.
es.68d09a57f2d3f53060cc77aa: Tengo que revisar, definitivamente había algo…
es.68d09a5c782c0ed4a0b25a9d: Creo que había un pequeño trabajo… Déjame echar un vistazo de una vez.
es.68dfb14e805b89b256c648f0: Lo siento, hermano, no hay nada ahora mismo.
es.69027e6eee66140a66844f2e: Estoy aquí para hablar de eso.
es.69027e8ddc3a20d8838b4187: Acabo de recordar que aún debo terminarlo. Me tengo que ir.
es.69027ef5343f9036cdc1f2f4: Aún no he terminado el trabajo. Tengo un asunto que comentarte.
es.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: Pero no se lo digas a nadie, hermano. No quiero que resulte dañada mi reputación.
es.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: Y la gracia es que los envié fuera del bloqueo.
es.690e09aa3a53de8ec8a67e7f: No sé qué hicieron con ellos, pero me pagaron bastante bien.
es.690e09e9155f862173330f22: Desde camisetas sin gracia hasta vajillas de lujo.
es.690e09ed646fb2deb0536cb9: Cada mes traigo libros de chistes a Tarkov. Supongo que te haces una idea de para quién son.
es.690e0a0251a4e6834a425b58: Y lo más extraño de todo…
es.690e0a4835c7dcdd7f3fcb6e: A veces me llegan pedidos de figuras de chicas anime vestidas en ropa interior, joder.
es.690e0a4dac225492c0e6dd52: Y no, no te diré quién es.

tu.68ca99a820cee3b235970d2d: Tarkov’da bundan daha iyi mal bulamazsın!
tu.68ca99a8230a7d407974df70: Biliyorsun, Tarkov’da hâlâ bir sürü koleksiyoncu var, değil mi?
tu.68ca99a8519bd491982196dd: Yanında nakit getirmeyi unutmadın değil mi?
tu.68ca99a855bf79bdd336ae63: Kesinlikle. Az önce ufak bir stok yeniledim.
tu.68ca99a85c9e91798319df18: Hep ticaretin içindeydin, değil mi? İnsanların sipariş ettiği en garip şey neydi?
tu.68ca99a87562d71981e2d95b: Evet evet, iletişimde kal o zaman.
tu.68ca99a88153b61477286ccb: Zamanı mı kolluyorsun nedir? Yeni bir sevkiyat aldım.
tu.68ca99a8c070d64acebcfbca: Tarkov’un politikacılarından birinin bulunduğu tişörtler. Adını hatırlamıyorum, kel olan…
tu.68ca99a8d740a46478e26f3b: Ağımın içinden geçen malın miktarına inanamazsın!
tu.68ca99a8dd66a45284e49b2f: Geçmişten bahsediyorsak, bir keresinde sahte Loui Peeton çantaları sattım. Kimse sahte olduklarını anlamadı!
tu.68d08c8cbba41fefa7943140: Seç beğen al! Sattığım neredeyse her şeyin kalite garantisi vardır.
tu.68d08e49fa65e10a41677f0b: Ohoo kim gelmiş! İstediğim şeyi yaptın mı?
tu.68d08e500e5e0e85a9996de5: Aaa, çoktan buradasın? Her şey tamam mı?
tu.68d08e558f33487394a5f778: Hızlı iş ha! Her şey hazır mı?
tu.68d08e5a9bdb093ba9d68082: Vay be, işte hız! Her şeyi bitirdin mi?
tu.68d08e81c36d2e5ee936a9a3: Hayır. Seninle bir şey konuşmam lazım.
tu.68d08f0d8545cffe35dfa770: Kardeşim, beni hayal kırıklığına uğratıyorsun. Neyse, ne istiyorsun?
tu.68d08f136a311eecda64a840: Benimle laklak edeceğine git işi yap.
tu.68d08f1de71bd2732a43bb67: Böyle iş mi olur? Neyse… ne var?
tu.68d08f421811e0d1805450f9: Genelde işleri hızlı hallettiğin için seni severim bro! Ama bu sefer tökezledin.
tu.68d08f538e382e50f199a79b: Git yap o zaman. Yoksa bu iş için başkasını bulmak zorunda kalacağım.
tu.68d09a478962eb3fc959a339: Hemen sana uygun bir şey bulurum.
tu.68d09a57f2d3f53060cc77aa: Kontrol etmem lazım, kesin bir şey vardı…
tu.68d09a5c782c0ed4a0b25a9d: Sanırım ufak bir iş vardı… Şimdi bakıyorum.
tu.68dfb14e805b89b256c648f0: Üzgünüm kardeşim, şu an hiçbir şey yok.
tu.69027e8ddc3a20d8838b4187: Az önce bitirmem gerektiğini hatırladım. Gitmem gerek.
tu.69027ef5343f9036cdc1f2f4: Görevi bitirmedim daha. Konuşmam gereken bir şey var.
tu.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: Ama kimseye söyleme kardeşim. İtibarım zedelenmesin.
tu.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: Komik olan şu ki, onları hattın dışına gönderdim.
tu.690e09aa3a53de8ec8a67e7f: Ne yaptılar bilmiyorum ama bayağı iyi para ödediler.
tu.690e09e9155f862173330f22: Aptal tişörtlerden lüks çatal biçaklara kadar.
tu.690e09ed646fb2deb0536cb9: Her ay Tarkov’a fıkra kitapları taşıyorum. Kimler için olduğunu anlamışsındır.

ru.68ca99a81ebb5b8a47edf6da: Только недавно о тебе вспоминал, брат!
ru.68ca99a820cee3b235970d2d: Лучше моего товара ты в Таркове не найдёшь!
ru.68ca99a8230a7d407974df70: Ты знал, что у нас в Таркове осталось полно коллекционеров?
ru.68ca99a83468834a17406c0d: А я всё ждал, когда ты это спросишь!
ru.68ca99a8519bd491982196dd: Баксы-то с собой взять не забыл?
ru.68ca99a855bf79bdd336ae63: Конечно. У меня как раз обновление небольшое было.
ru.68ca99a85c9e91798319df18: Ты ж всегда торговал, да? Что самое интересное заказывали?
ru.68ca99a88153b61477286ccb: Чувствуешь, что ли, когда надо приходить? У меня как раз новая поставка была.
ru.68ca99a8c070d64acebcfbca: Футболки с одним из политиканов Таркова. Не помню его имя, лысый такой…
ru.68ca99a8d740a46478e26f3b: Ты бы знал, какие объёмы всего проходят через мою сеть!
ru.68ca99a8dd66a45284e49b2f: Если не говорить о нынешнем времени, то мне однажды удалось сбыть партию палёных сумок Луи Питон. Никто так и не понял, что они были ненастоящие!
ru.68d08c8cbba41fefa7943140: Выбирай! Почти на все мои товары распространяется гарантия качества.
ru.68d08e49fa65e10a41677f0b: Так-так, смотрите, кто здесь! Сделал всё, что я просил?
ru.68d08e5a9bdb093ba9d68082: Вот это скорость! Со всем уже закончил?
ru.68d08e81c36d2e5ee936a9a3: Нет. Мне надо кое-что с тобой обсудить.
ru.68d08edefc1094cee828ff80: И почему я вообще не удивлён? Так что обсудить хочешь?
ru.68d08f0d8545cffe35dfa770: Эх, братан, подводишь сильно. Ладно, что нужно-то?
ru.68d08f136a311eecda64a840: Лучше бы работу делал, а не трепался со мной.
ru.68d08f1de71bd2732a43bb67: Ну кто ж так делает-то? Эх, ладно… Что надо обсудить?
ru.68d08f421811e0d1805450f9: Я ж тебя ценю за то, что ты всё быстро делаешь! А тут что-то сплоховал.
ru.68d08f538e382e50f199a79b: Так иди и делай. А то мне придется искать кого-нибудь ещё на эту работу.
ru.68d09a5c782c0ed4a0b25a9d: Вроде было какое-то дельце… Сейчас гляну.
ru.69027de046e2966b95cf00e9: Только недавно о тебе вспоминал, брат!
ru.69027e8ddc3a20d8838b4187: Я только вспомнил, надо ещё кое-что закончить по твоему делу. Мне нужно идти.
ru.69027ef5343f9036cdc1f2f4: Я ещё не закончил твою работу. Нужно обсудить кое-что.
ru.690e09711aaa3b7f88b53640: Только, брат, никому об этом. А то моя репутация пострадает.
ru.690e09a3726103ff7cc2df5f: Самое интересное, что отправлял я их за оцепление.
ru.690e09aa3a53de8ec8a67e7f: Не знаю уж что с ними там сделали, но заплатили мне неплохие такие бабки.
ru.690e09e9155f862173330f22: От идиотских футболок до вилок всяких дорогих.
ru.690e09ed646fb2deb0536cb9: Ну, я каждый месяц притаскиваю в Тарков сборники анекдотов. Думаю, ты понимаешь, для кого это.
ru.690e0a4835c7dcdd7f3fcb6e: Иногда мне заказывают фигурки с анимешными девочками в трусах.
ru.690e0a4dac225492c0e6dd52: И нет, я не скажу, кто.
