ch.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: 在野外很简单：别溜号，不然你自己就会变成猎物。
ch.68cc09140b3d0f4bfb671f7b: 路上怎么样？坐下，我来听你说。
ch.68cc091425a6703969fd5924: 来吧，说说是什么把你带到这儿的。
ch.68cc09144a357115bfa25a01: 你以为这些所谓的“文明”改变了世界？其实没有。
ch.68cc09144c0c5d02af05b80c: 塔科夫需要救赎。掠夺的、抢劫的太多了，这城市都看不出来原本的样子了。
ch.68cc09145d9ae83e0d3ea0ae: 你以前只是个普通的林务员，对吧？可现在你给的训练甚至按塔科夫的标准都算残酷的。为什么？你到底在为什么做准备？
ch.68cc091466fc02cfc82a6db5: 好，我得检查一下库存，给我一分钟。
ch.68cc0914706419e2bd209509: 让我到后面看看，给我一分钟
ch.68cc09147b142b3f584d891d: 路上遇见 Partisan 了吗？来，坐下吧。
ch.68cc0914883517847c314180: 是的，我这有几把不错的霰弹枪。
ch.68cc09148fd85f61e5a4b6fe: 我给你留了几样东西，来看看吧。
ch.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: 只有你心中的信念能让你立于不败之地。
ch.68d0351f139325ec2b88f028: 是什么风把你给吹来了？坐下，说说吧。
ch.68d03805b6a7a6612a133616: 我还有点东西。来，我带你看看。
ch.68d0382ecfa44b6563573785: 现在事情很多。让我翻翻我的笔记。
ch.68d03833250e508185aa0f8b: 有了你帮忙应该会方便很多。
ch.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: 塔科夫需要像你这样的人。让我看一下记录。
ch.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: 想清理塔科夫的罪恶腐朽吗？你来对地方了。
ch.68d03844444871c42a664992: 想做好事？我这有几把好猎枪。
ch.68d0384b78cbb0f7c3249ba3: 想帮帮这座城市？这是个高尚的目标。
ch.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Voevoda 在我们一起狩猎时教过我这些。
ch.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: 这些试炼，不只是为了技术。
ch.68dfb6ce1abfab3ece3385b4: 现在一切都很安静。趁还有时间最好先休息一下。
ch.68dfb71d1e9809509c1daa7e: 我一直在等你。我交代的事情你都办完了吗？
ch.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: 说曹操曹操到。我刚还在想你什么时候能把活儿做完。
ch.68dfb73bdf3335ca5159558e: 你来了。说明活儿做完了？
ch.68dfb7400b08c75b1a2a1be2: 说点能让我开心的事？我让你做的事，你完成了吗？
ch.68dfb7456e523de03f4c850f: 既然你来了，交给你的活儿最好是做完了。
ch.68dfb7cdb391dcd880361245: 我还没做完。我是来问你点事。
ch.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: 你应该专心干活。现在问你要问的，但之后赶紧去做。
ch.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: 可惜。不过既然你都来了，那说吧。
ch.68dfb8376ef2530241e814da: 事情不是这么做的。你可以提要求，但工作还是得先完成。
ch.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: 没做完就不该来。但你既然来了，说你需要什么。
ch.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: 我记得你那项任务，但我还没做完。等我搞定了我会回来。
ch.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: 那你为什么要穿过整片森林就为了说这个？现在的年轻人啊……
ch.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: 这么重要的事就不该托付给你的。打起精神来！
ch.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: 你大老远赶来就为了说这个？快回去干活。
ch.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: 最好别让我生气。活儿做完再来见我。
ch.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: 我一直在等你。你在“迷宫”里找到那些 BEAR 了吗？
ch.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: 你还活着！谢天谢地你没有被那个“迷宫”吞噬。你发现了什么？
ch.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: 我朋友最近来过，他问起他那支 BEAR 小队。你找到什么了吗？
ch.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: 你既然来了，那肯定带来了“迷宫”的消息。你了解到了什么？
ch.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: 我朋友问起了你。你找到那支失踪的 BEAR 小队了吗？
ch.68ffed574db649574545c762: 现在没时间。我之后再做。
ch.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: 哼！我们说好了的，那些钥匙可不是白给你的。
ch.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: 你要让我们等多久？事情很简单，去把活儿做完。
ch.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: 那你来干什么？任务很重要，别再拖了。
ch.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: 没什么好说的。你最好赶紧去干。
ch.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: 为什么来来回回？先把任务做完，我们再一起喝茶。
ch.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: 你不会想无视我们的约定吧？这事不能拖，你明白吗？
ch.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: 那你什么时候有时间？你觉得那些钥匙是白给的吗？
ch.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: 要是我知道会这样，我就派别人了。更可靠的人。
ch.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: 敢违背交易？那我们没什么可谈的了。
ch.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: 不行。把活儿做完，再回来。
ch.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: 我还在做你交代的事，但还没完成。我现在得走了。
ch.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: 我还在做你的活儿。但我这次来，是为了别的事。
ch.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: 我们的城市也是一样。谁不明白这个道理——塔科夫就会直接吞了他。
ch.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: 很多人说我的试炼太严苛，甚至毫无意义。但塔科夫不会理会他们的抱怨，迟早会把他们生吞活剥。这些懒惰的人消失在塔科夫无非是时间问题。
ch.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: 只有最顶尖的掠食者才能在弱肉强食的规则下存活。这就是我要教给你的东西。
ch.6909f162bab9101e55668094: 那些连我的试炼都撑不过的家伙只会变成猎物。
ch.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: 你不会真以为我们在人数上占优势吧？
ch.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: 像你这样的士兵，一个要打十个。
ch.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: 所以我对你要求更多，你的试炼也更艰难。
ch.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: 当然，并不是所有人都能通过我的测试。
ch.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: 但我也不是对所有人都照单全收的。唯有双手稳如磐石、头脑清明如水的战士才能应对这样的污泥。
ch.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: 那你就该明白，恶棍永远比强者多。
ch.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: 所以像你这样的战士很重要。你们每一个都必须硬得足以在任何情况下压倒敌人。
ch.6909f30672df36c6d81680c6: 这样我们才能把罪恶的腐朽从这座城市里剔除干净。
ch.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: 现在很清楚了，Voevoda——他的队员都叫他 Batya，把他当成自己的父亲一样。他的小队只为真相而战，而软弱者早就投靠那些逐利的帮派去了。
ch.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: 试炼会揭示每个人的本性，也会告诉你谁值得信任。
ch.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: 压力之下，每个人都会露出真面目。强者更强，弱者崩溃。
ch.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: 要清理这座满是劫掠者的城市，我需要可靠的战士。
ch.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: 是什么风把你吹来了？坐吧，我们谈谈。

cz.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: V divočině je to jednoduchý: nepolevuj, jinak se staneš kořistí.
cz.68cc09140b3d0f4bfb671f7b: Jaká byla cesta? Posaď se, poslech si tě.
cz.68cc09141d56c027704afb1b: Pojď sem, čaj se zrovna uvařil.
cz.68cc091425a6703969fd5924: Pojď dál, řekni mi, co tě sem přivádí.
cz.68cc09143d243c8c5693ae4d: Posaď se, řekni mi, co se děje.
cz.68cc09144a357115bfa25a01: Myslíš si, že tahle "civilizace" změnila svět, ale nezměnila.
cz.68cc09144c0c5d02af05b80c: Tarkov potřebuje zachránit. Moc zlodějů a plenitelů, město je k nepoznání.
cz.68cc09145d9ae83e0d3ea0ae: Bejval jsi obyčejnej lesník, ne? Ale teď dáváš zkoušky, který se zdají brutální i na tarkovský poměry. Proč? Na co se připravuješ?
cz.68cc091466fc02cfc82a6db5: No, budu se muset podívat do skrýše.
cz.68cc0914706419e2bd209509: Nech mě se podívat dozadu, dej mi minutku.
cz.68cc09147b142b3f584d891d: Potkal jsi cestou Partizána? Dobře, posaď se.
cz.68cc091489f17763a0bdac7e: Chystáš se na lov? S tím ti můžu pomoct.
cz.68cc09148fd85f61e5a4b6fe: Něco jsem ti schoval, mrkni na to.
cz.68cc0914bc8ebf176efb5023: Jsem si jistej, že se zase potkáme.
cz.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: To, co ti zabrání selhat, je tvůj charakter.
cz.68cc0914cf0afbb423033fa2: Posaď se, řekni mi, co se děje.
cz.68d0351f139325ec2b88f028: Co tě sem přivádí? Posaď se, pokecáme.
cz.68d03805b6a7a6612a133616: Něco mi zbylo. Pojď, ukážu ti to.
cz.68d0382ecfa44b6563573785: Práce je teď spousta. Nech mě se podívat do poznámek.
cz.68d03833250e508185aa0f8b: Možná se tvoje pomoc bude hodit na něco.
cz.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: Tarkov potřebuje lidi jako jsi ty. Nech mě mrknout do zápisníku.
cz.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: Chceš vyčistit tarkovskej hnus? Jsi na správným místě.
cz.68d03844444871c42a664992: Chceš udělat něco dobrýho? Mám pár tipů.
cz.68d0384b78cbb0f7c3249ba3: Chceš pomoct městu? To je chvályhodný.
cz.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Tohle mě naučil Voevoda, když jsme spolu lovili.
cz.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: Tyhle zkoušky, ty nejsou jenom o dovednostech.
cz.68dfb6ce1abfab3ece3385b4: Zatím je klid. Odpočiň si, dokud můžeš.
cz.68dfb71d1e9809509c1daa7e: Čekal jsem na tebe. Udělal jsi, o co jsem tě žádal?
cz.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: Zrovna jsem tě vzpomínal. Říkal jsem si, kdy dokončíš tu práci.
cz.68dfb73bdf3335ca5159558e: Jsi tady. Takže je ta práce hotová?
cz.68dfb7400b08c75b1a2a1be2: Přišel jsi mi udělat radost? Udělal jsi, o co jsem tě žádal?
cz.68dfb7456e523de03f4c850f: Jsi tady, takže ta práce musí bejt hotová.
cz.68dfb7cdb391dcd880361245: Ještě jsem to nedokončil. Přišel jsem se tě na něco zeptat.
cz.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: Měl by ses soustředit na tu práci. Zeptej se, co potřebuješ teď, ale pak se dej do práce.
cz.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: Škoda. Ale když už jsi tady, tak pokračuj.
cz.68dfb8376ef2530241e814da: Takhle se to nedělá. Zeptej se, co chceš, ale tu práci dodělej potom.
cz.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: Neměl jsi chodit, dokud jsi to nedodělal. Ale když už jsi tady, řekni mi, co potřebuješ.
cz.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: Pamatuju si na tvůj úkol, ale ještě jsem ho nedokončil. Vrátím se, až to bude hotový.
cz.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: Tak proč jsi se sem táhnul přes celej les jenom kvůli tomuhle? Ta dnešní mládež...
cz.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: Neměl jsem ti svěřovat něco tak důležitýho. Vzpamatuj se!
cz.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: A ty jsi šel celou cestu jenom proto, abys mi to řekl? Běž to udělat.
cz.68dfb89b434db812207b6d65: Pospěš si. Nevracej se, dokud to nebude hotový.
cz.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: Radši mě nenasírej. Vrať se, až bude ta práce hotová.
cz.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: Čekal jsem na tebe. Našel jsi ty BEARy v Labyrintu?
cz.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: Ty žiješ! Takže tě Labyrint nechal odejít. Co jsi zjistil?
cz.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: Nedávno mě navštívil kamarád, ptal se na jeho BEAR jednotku. Našel jsi něco?
cz.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: Když už jsi tady, tak budou nějaký zprávy z Labyrintu. Co jsi se dozvěděl?
cz.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: Můj kamarád se na tebe ptal. Našel jsi tu ztracenou BEAR jednotku?
cz.68ffed574db649574545c762: Teď na to nemám čas. Udělám to později.
cz.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: Hele! Udělali jsme dohodu, ty klíče jsi nedostal zadarmo.
cz.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: Jak dlouho nás ještě budeš nechávat čekat? Ta dohoda byla jednoduchá, běž a dodělej tu práci.
cz.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: Proč jsi tady teda? Ten úkol je důležitej, neotálej dál.
cz.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Takže už nic víc neřekneš? Radši se do toho dej.
cz.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: Proč se takhle courat sem a tam? Nejdřív dodělej ten úkol a pak si dáme čaj.
cz.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: Nemyslel jsem si, že budeš ignorovat naši dohodu. Nemůžeš to takhle protahovat, chápeš?
cz.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: Kdy na to budeš mít teda čas? Myslíš si, že jsme ti dali ty klíče zadarmo?
cz.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: Kdybych to věděl, poslal bych jinýho bojovníka. Někoho spolehlivýho.
cz.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: Znevažuješ tu dohodu? Takže nemáme o čem mluvit.
cz.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: To nejde. Dodělej tu práci a pak se vrať.
cz.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: Pořád pracuju na tvojí misi, ale ještě není hotová. Radši už půjdu.
cz.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Pořád pracuju na tvý práci. Jsem tady kvůli jiný věci.
cz.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: Naše město se stalo pořád stejný. Každýho, kdo to nechápe, si Tarkov vezme.
cz.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Mnozí říkali, že moje zkoušky jsou moc drsný, dokonce i zbytečný. Tarkov je stejně spolknul. Některý dřív, některý později.
cz.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Přežije jenom ten predátor, kterej zůstane napřed. To je to, co učím.
cz.6909f162bab9101e55668094: Ti, co nezvládnou moje zkoušky? Stanou se kořistí.
cz.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: Ty si nemyslíš, že jsme ve většině, že ne?
cz.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: Na každýho vojáka jako jsi ty, připadá tucet banditů.
cz.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: Proto od tebe vyžaduju víc a ty zkoušky pro tebe jsou těžší.
cz.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: Jasně, ne každej projde mýma testama.
cz.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: Ale já nepotřebuju každýho. Jenom válečníci s pevnou rukou a jasnou myslí se dokážou vypořádat s touhle špínou.
cz.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: Takže musíš vědět, že vždycky bude víc padouchů než silných jedinců.
cz.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: Proto se počítá každej bojovník jako jsi ty. Každej z vás musí bejt zatvrzelej, aby překonal nepřátele v jakýkoliv situaci.
cz.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Teď už je to jasný – Batya a jeho chlapi bojovali jenom za pravdu a slaboši šli do gangů honících se za ziskem.
cz.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: Ty zkoušky ukážou, kde je čí místo a komu můžeš věřit.
cz.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: Pod tlakem každej ukáže, kdo je. Silný zesílí, slabý se zlomí.
cz.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: Abych vyčistil město od plenitelů, potřebuju spolehlivý bojovníky.
cz.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: Co tě sem přivádí? Posaď se, pokecáme.

en.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: Out in the wild, it’s simple: don’t relax, or you’ll end up prey.
en.68cc09140b3d0f4bfb671f7b: How was the trip? Sit down, I’ll listen.
en.68cc09141d56c027704afb1b: Come here, the tea’s just boiled.
en.68cc091425a6703969fd5924: Come on in, tell me what brought you here.
en.68cc09143d243c8c5693ae4d: Sit down, tell me what’s going on.
en.68cc09144a357115bfa25a01: You think all this “civilization” changed the world, but it hasn’t.
en.68cc09144c0c5d02af05b80c: Tarkov needs saving. Too many looters and pillagers, the city’s unrecognizable.
en.68cc09145d9ae83e0d3ea0ae: You used to be a simple forester, right? But now you give trials that seem brutal even by Tarkov standards. Why? What are you preparing for?
en.68cc091465afb6f909efc9a5: Looking to buy something? Sure thing.
en.68cc091466fc02cfc82a6db5: Well, I’ll need to check the stash.
en.68cc0914706419e2bd209509: Let me look in the back, give me a minute.
en.68cc09147b142b3f584d891d: Seen Partisan on your way here? Alright, sit down.
en.68cc0914883517847c314180: Yeah, I’ve got a couple of solid shotguns.
en.68cc091489f17763a0bdac7e: Getting ready for a hunt? I can help with that.
en.68cc09148fd85f61e5a4b6fe: I saved a few things for you, take a look.
en.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: What will keep you from failing is your character.
en.68cc0914cf0afbb423033fa2: Sit down, tell me what’s going on.
en.68d0351f139325ec2b88f028: What brings you here? Take a seat, let’s chat.
en.68d037fd805b238d3e938a47: Need to gear up? Let's see.
en.68d03805b6a7a6612a133616: Got something left. Come, I’ll show you.
en.68d0382ecfa44b6563573785: Plenty of work right now. Let me check my notes.
en.68d03833250e508185aa0f8b: Maybe your help will come in handy for something.
en.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: Tarkov needs people like you. Let me glance at my notebook.
en.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: Want to clean out Tarkov’s rot? You came to the right place.
en.68d03844444871c42a664992: Looking to do some good? I’ve got a couple of leads.
en.68d0384b78cbb0f7c3249ba3: Want to help the city? That’s a noble cause.
en.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Voevoda taught me this when we hunted together.
en.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: These trials, they aren’t just for skill.
en.68dfb6ce1abfab3ece3385b4: All quiet for now. Rest up while you can.
en.68dfb71d1e9809509c1daa7e: I’ve been waiting for you. Did you do what I asked?
en.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: Speak of the devil. I was just thinking when you’d finish the job.
en.68dfb73bdf3335ca5159558e: You’re here. So, the work’s done?
en.68dfb7400b08c75b1a2a1be2: Here to make me happy? Did you do what I asked?
en.68dfb7456e523de03f4c850f: You’re here, so the work must be done.
en.68dfb7cdb391dcd880361245: Haven’t finished it yet. I came to ask you something.
en.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: You should focus on the job. Ask what you need now, but get to work after.
en.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: Shame. But since you’re already here, go ahead.
en.68dfb8376ef2530241e814da: Not how things are done. Ask what you want, but do the job after.
en.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: Shouldn’t have come before finishing. But since you’re here, tell me what you need.
en.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: I remember about your task, but I haven’t finished it yet. I’ll come back after it’s done.
en.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: So why did you trek all this way through the forest just for this? The youth these days…
en.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: Shouldn’t have trusted you with something this important. Pull yourself together!
en.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: And you came all this way just to say that? Go do it.
en.68dfb89b434db812207b6d65: Hurry. Don’t come back until it’s done.
en.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: Better not make me angry. Come back when the job’s finished.
en.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: I've been waiting for you. Have you found the BEARs in the Labyrinth?
en.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: You’re alive! So the Labyrinth let you leave. What did you find out?
en.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: My friend visited me recently, he’s asked me about his BEAR squad. Did you find anything?
en.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: If you’re here, there’s bound to be some news from the Labyrinth. What did you learn?
en.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: My friend asked about you. Did you find the lost BEAR squad?
en.68ffed574db649574545c762: No time for it now. I’ll do it later.
en.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: Huh! We made a deal, those keys weren’t given to you for free.
en.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: How long are you going to keep us waiting? The deal was simple, go finish the job.
en.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: Why are you here then? The task is important, don’t delay further.
en.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Nothing more to say, then. You better get to it.
en.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: Why go back and forth then? Finish the task first, then we’ll drink tea.
en.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: Didn’t think you’d ignore our deal like that. You can’t drag this out, you understand?
en.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: When will you have time then? You think we gave you the keys for free?
en.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: If only I knew, I’d send some other fighter. Someone reliable.
en.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: Disrespecting the deal? We have nothing to talk about then.
en.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: That won’t do. Finish the work, then come back.
en.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: I'm still working on your mission, but I'm not done yet. I better go now.
en.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Still working on your job. I'm here about another thing.
en.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: Our city’s become the same. Anyone who doesn’t get that – Tarkov takes them.
en.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Many said my trials are too harsh, pointless even. Tarkov swallowed them anyway. Some sooner, some later.
en.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Only the predator that stays ahead survives. That’s what I’m teaching.
en.6909f162bab9101e55668094: Those who can’t handle my trials? They become prey.
en.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: You don’t think we’re in the majority, do you?
en.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: For every soldier like you, there’s a dozen bandits.
en.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: That’s why I demand more from you, and the trials for you are tougher.
en.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: Sure, not everyone passes my tests.
en.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: But I don’t need everyone. Only warriors with a steady hand and clear mind can handle this filth.
en.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: Then you must know that there are always more scoundrels than strong-willed.
en.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: That’s why every fighter like you counts. Each of you must be hardened to overcome enemies in any situation.
en.6909f30672df36c6d81680c6: That’s how we’ll clean the city of rot.
en.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Now it’s clear – Batya and his guys fought for truth alone, and weaklings went to gangs chasing profit.
en.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: The trials show everyone’s place, and who you can trust.
en.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: Under pressure, everyone shows who they are. The strong get stronger, the weak break.
en.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: To clear the city of pillagers, I need reliable fighters.
en.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: What brings you here? Take a seat, let’s chat.

fr.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: En pleine nature, c’est simple : ne te relâche pas, ou tu finiras en proie.
fr.68cc09140b3d0f4bfb671f7b: Comment s’est passé le trajet ? Assieds-toi, je t’écoute.
fr.68cc09141d56c027704afb1b: Viens par ici, le thé vient de bouillir.
fr.68cc09143d243c8c5693ae4d: Assieds-toi, dis-moi ce qui se passe.
fr.68cc09144a231b6a677a0e90: Tu as quelque chose à vendre ?
fr.68cc09144a357115bfa25a01: Tu crois que toute cette « civilisation » a changé le monde, mais ce n’est pas le cas.
fr.68cc09144c0c5d02af05b80c: Tarkov a besoin d’être sauvée. Trop de pilleurs et de pillards, la ville est méconnaissable.
fr.68cc09145d9ae83e0d3ea0ae: Vous étiez simple forestier avant, n’est-ce pas ? Et maintenant, vous proposez des épreuves qui semblent brutales, même selon les standards de Tarkov. Pourquoi ? Que préparez-vous ?
fr.68cc091465afb6f909efc9a5: Tu cherches à acheter quelque chose ? Bien sûr.
fr.68cc091466fc02cfc82a6db5: Bon, je dois vérifier la réserve.
fr.68cc0914706419e2bd209509: Laisse-moi regarder à l’arrière, donne-moi une minute.
fr.68cc09147b142b3f584d891d: Tu as vu Partisan en venant ? Bien. Assieds-toi.
fr.68cc0914883517847c314180: Ouais, j’ai quelques bons fusils à pompe.
fr.68cc091489f17763a0bdac7e: Tu te prépares pour une chasse ? Je peux t’aider.
fr.68cc09148fd85f61e5a4b6fe: Je t’ai mis quelques trucs de côté, regarde.
fr.68cc0914bc8ebf176efb5023: Je suis sûr qu’on se reverra.
fr.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: Ce qui t’empêchera d’échouer, c’est ton caractère.
fr.68cc0914cf0afbb423033fa2: Assieds-toi, dis-moi ce qui se passe.
fr.68d0351f139325ec2b88f028: Qu’est-ce qui t’amène ? Assieds-toi, on discute.
fr.68d03805b6a7a6612a133616: Il me reste quelque chose. Viens, je te montre.
fr.68d0382ecfa44b6563573785: Il y a pas mal de boulot en ce moment. Laisse-moi consulter mes notes.
fr.68d03833250e508185aa0f8b: Peut-être que ton aide sera utile pour quelque chose.
fr.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: Tarkov a besoin de gens comme toi. Laisse-moi jeter un œil à mon carnet.
fr.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: Tu veux nettoyer la pourriture de Tarkov ? Tu es au bon endroit.
fr.68d03844444871c42a664992: Tu veux faire le bien ? J’ai quelques pistes.
fr.68d0384b78cbb0f7c3249ba3: Tu veux aider la ville ? C’est une noble cause.
fr.68d038c11cd1a2ae7fc5ba4b: Tu as déjà lu des livres, non ?
fr.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Voevoda m’a appris ça quand on chassait ensemble.
fr.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: Ces épreuves, ce n’est pas qu’une question de compétence.
fr.68dfb6ce1abfab3ece3385b4: Pour l’instant, tout est calme. Repose-toi tant que tu le peux.
fr.68dfb71d1e9809509c1daa7e: Je t’attendais. Tu as fait ce que je t’ai demandé ?
fr.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: En parlant du loup. Je me demandais justement quand tu finirais le boulot.
fr.68dfb73bdf3335ca5159558e: Te voilà. Alors, le travail est fait ?
fr.68dfb7400b08c75b1a2a1be2: Tu es venu pour me faire plaisir ? Tu as fait ce que je t’ai demandé ?
fr.68dfb7456e523de03f4c850f: Si tu es là, c’est que le travail est terminé.
fr.68dfb7cdb391dcd880361245: Je n’ai pas encore fini. Je suis venu vous demander quelque chose.
fr.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: Tu devrais te concentrer sur le travail. Demande ce que tu veux maintenant, mais mets-toi au boulot après.
fr.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: Dommage. Mais puisque tu es déjà là, vas-y.
fr.68dfb8376ef2530241e814da: Ce n’est pas comme ça que ça se passe. Demande ce que tu veux, mais fais le boulot après.
fr.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: Tu n’aurais pas dû venir avant d’avoir terminé. Mais puisque tu es là, dis-moi ce qu’il te faut.
fr.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: Je me souviens de ma tâche, mais je ne l’ai pas encore terminée. Je reviendrai quand ce sera fait.
fr.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: Alors pourquoi tu as traversé toute la forêt juste pour ça ? Les jeunes d’aujourd’hui…
fr.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: Je n’aurais pas dû te confier quelque chose d’aussi important. Ressaisis-toi !
fr.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: Et tu es venu jusqu’ici juste pour dire ça ? Va t’en occuper.
fr.68dfb89b434db812207b6d65: Dépêche-toi. Ne reviens pas avant que ce soit terminé.
fr.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: Ne me mets pas en colère. Reviens quand le boulot sera fini.
fr.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: Je t’attendais. As-tu trouvé les BEAR dans le Labyrinthe ?
fr.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: Tu es en vie ! Alors le Labyrinthe t’a laissé sortir. Qu’as-tu découvert ?
fr.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: Un ami est venu me voir récemment, il m’a demandé des nouvelles de son escouade BEAR. As-tu trouvé quelque chose ?
fr.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: Si tu es là, c’est qu’il y a des nouvelles du Labyrinthe. Qu’as-tu appris ?
fr.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: Mon ami a demandé après toi. As-tu retrouvé l’escouade BEAR disparue ?
fr.68ffed574db649574545c762: Je n’ai pas le temps pour ça maintenant. Je le ferai plus tard.
fr.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: Quoi ? On avait un accord, ces clés ne t’ont pas été données gratuitement.
fr.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: Combien de temps comptes-tu nous faire attendre ? L’accord était simple, va terminer le travail.
fr.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: Alors pourquoi es-tu là ? La tâche est importante, ne tarde pas davantage.
fr.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Rien de plus à dire, alors. Tu ferais mieux de t’y mettre.
fr.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: Pourquoi faire des allers-retours ? Termine d’abord la tâche, ensuite on boira le thé.
fr.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: Je ne pensais pas que tu ignorerais notre accord comme ça. Tu ne peux pas faire traîner, tu comprends ?
fr.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: Et quand trouveras-tu le temps alors ? Tu crois qu’on t’a donné les clés gratuitement ?
fr.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: Si j’avais su, j’aurais envoyé un autre combattant. Quelqu’un de fiable.
fr.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: Tu manques de respect à l’accord ? Dans ce cas, on n’a plus rien à se dire.
fr.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: Ça ne va pas. Termine le travail, puis reviens.
fr.68fff166bfd1afe7af3258b2: Je suis là uniquement pour ça.
fr.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: Je travaille encore sur votre mission, mais ce n’est pas terminé. Je ferais mieux d’y aller maintenant.
fr.690276876eee315590313824: Je suis là uniquement pour ça.
fr.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Je travaille encore sur votre tâche. Je suis venu pour autre chose.
fr.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: Notre ville est devenue la même. Ceux qui ne le comprennent pas, Tarkov les avale.
fr.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Beaucoup ont dit que mes épreuves étaient trop dures, inutiles même. Tarkov les a avalés quand même. Certains plus tôt, d’autres plus tard.
fr.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Seul le prédateur qui garde une longueur d’avance survit. C’est ce que j’enseigne.
fr.6909f162bab9101e55668094: Ceux qui ne supportent pas mes épreuves deviennent des proies.
fr.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: Tu ne penses quand même pas que nous soyons majoritaires ?
fr.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: Pour chaque soldat comme toi, il y a une douzaine de bandits.
fr.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: C’est pour ça que j’exige plus de toi, et que les épreuves sont plus dures pour toi.
fr.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: Certes, tout le monde ne réussit pas mes épreuves.
fr.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: Mais je n’ai pas besoin de tout le monde. Seuls les guerriers à la main sûre et à l’esprit clair peuvent gérer cette merde.
fr.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: Tu dois donc savoir qu’il y a toujours plus de canailles que de gens à la volonté forte.
fr.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: C’est pourquoi chaque combattant comme toi compte. Chacun doit être endurci pour vaincre ses ennemis en toute situation.
fr.6909f30672df36c6d81680c6: C’est ainsi que nous débarrasserons la ville de sa pourriture.
fr.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Maintenant c’est clair : Batya et ses hommes se battaient seuls pour la vérité, et les faibles ont rejoint des gangs en quête de profit.
fr.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: Les épreuves montrent la place de chacun et en qui tu peux avoir confiance.
fr.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: Sous la pression, chacun révèle sa vraie nature. Les forts deviennent plus forts, les faibles se brisent.
fr.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: Pour nettoyer la ville des pillards, j’ai besoin de combattants fiables.
fr.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: Qu’est-ce qui t’amène ? Assieds-toi, on discute.

ge.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: Out in the wild, it’s simple: don’t relax, or you’ll end up prey.
ge.68cc09140b3d0f4bfb671f7b: How was the trip? Sit down, I’ll listen.
ge.68cc09141d56c027704afb1b: Come here, the tea’s just boiled.
ge.68cc091425a6703969fd5924: Come on in, tell me what brought you here.
ge.68cc09143d243c8c5693ae4d: Sit down, tell me what’s going on.
ge.68cc09144a357115bfa25a01: You think all this “civilization” changed the world, but it hasn’t.
ge.68cc09144c0c5d02af05b80c: Tarkov needs saving. Too many looters and pillagers, the city’s unrecognizable.
ge.68cc09145d9ae83e0d3ea0ae: You used to be a simple forester, right? But now you give trials that seem brutal even by Tarkov standards. Why? What are you preparing for?
ge.68cc091465afb6f909efc9a5: Looking to buy something? Sure thing.
ge.68cc091466fc02cfc82a6db5: Well, I’ll need to check the stash.
ge.68cc0914706419e2bd209509: Let me look in the back, give me a minute.
ge.68cc09147b142b3f584d891d: Seen Partisan on your way here? Alright, sit down.
ge.68cc0914883517847c314180: Yeah, I’ve got a couple of solid shotguns.
ge.68cc091489f17763a0bdac7e: Getting ready for a hunt? I can help with that.
ge.68cc09148fd85f61e5a4b6fe: I saved a few things for you, take a look.
ge.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: What will keep you from failing is your character.
ge.68cc0914cf0afbb423033fa2: Sit down, tell me what’s going on.
ge.68d0351f139325ec2b88f028: What brings you here? Take a seat, let’s chat.
ge.68d037fd805b238d3e938a47: Need to gear up? Let's see.
ge.68d03805b6a7a6612a133616: Got something left. Come, I’ll show you.
ge.68d0382ecfa44b6563573785: Plenty of work right now. Let me check my notes.
ge.68d03833250e508185aa0f8b: Maybe your help will come in handy for something.
ge.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: Tarkov needs people like you. Let me glance at my notebook.
ge.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: Want to clean out Tarkov’s rot? You came to the right place.
ge.68d03844444871c42a664992: Looking to do some good? I’ve got a couple of leads.
ge.68d0384b78cbb0f7c3249ba3: Want to help the city? That’s a noble cause.
ge.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Voevoda taught me this when we hunted together.
ge.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: These trials, they aren’t just for skill.
ge.68dfb6ce1abfab3ece3385b4: All quiet for now. Rest up while you can.
ge.68dfb71d1e9809509c1daa7e: I’ve been waiting for you. Did you do what I asked?
ge.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: Speak of the devil. I was just thinking when you’d finish the job.
ge.68dfb73bdf3335ca5159558e: You’re here. So, the work’s done?
ge.68dfb7400b08c75b1a2a1be2: Here to make me happy? Did you do what I asked?
ge.68dfb7456e523de03f4c850f: You’re here, so the work must be done.
ge.68dfb7cdb391dcd880361245: Haven’t finished it yet. I came to ask you something.
ge.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: You should focus on the job. Ask what you need now, but get to work after.
ge.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: Shame. But since you’re already here, go ahead.
ge.68dfb8376ef2530241e814da: Not how things are done. Ask what you want, but do the job after.
ge.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: Shouldn’t have come before finishing. But since you’re here, tell me what you need.
ge.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: I remember about your task, but I haven’t finished it yet. I’ll come back after it’s done.
ge.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: So why did you trek all this way through the forest just for this? The youth these days…
ge.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: Shouldn’t have trusted you with something this important. Pull yourself together!
ge.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: And you came all this way just to say that? Go do it.
ge.68dfb89b434db812207b6d65: Hurry. Don’t come back until it’s done.
ge.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: Better not make me angry. Come back when the job’s finished.
ge.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: I've been waiting for you. Have you found the BEARs in the Labyrinth?
ge.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: You’re alive! So the Labyrinth let you leave. What did you find out?
ge.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: My friend visited me recently, he’s asked me about his BEAR squad. Did you find anything?
ge.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: If you’re here, there’s bound to be some news from the Labyrinth. What did you learn?
ge.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: My friend asked about you. Did you find the lost BEAR squad?
ge.68ffed574db649574545c762: No time for it now. I’ll do it later.
ge.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: Huh! We made a deal, those keys weren’t given to you for free.
ge.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: How long are you going to keep us waiting? The deal was simple, go finish the job.
ge.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: Why are you here then? The task is important, don’t delay further.
ge.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Nothing more to say, then. You better get to it.
ge.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: Why go back and forth then? Finish the task first, then we’ll drink tea.
ge.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: Didn’t think you’d ignore our deal like that. You can’t drag this out, you understand?
ge.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: When will you have time then? You think we gave you the keys for free?
ge.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: If only I knew, I’d send some other fighter. Someone reliable.
ge.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: Disrespecting the deal? We have nothing to talk about then.
ge.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: That won’t do. Finish the work, then come back.
ge.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: I'm still working on your mission, but I'm not done yet. I better go now.
ge.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Still working on your job. I'm here about another thing.
ge.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: Our city’s become the same. Anyone who doesn’t get that – Tarkov takes them.
ge.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Many said my trials are too harsh, pointless even. Tarkov swallowed them anyway. Some sooner, some later.
ge.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Only the predator that stays ahead survives. That’s what I’m teaching.
ge.6909f162bab9101e55668094: Those who can’t handle my trials? They become prey.
ge.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: You don’t think we’re in the majority, do you?
ge.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: For every soldier like you, there’s a dozen bandits.
ge.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: That’s why I demand more from you, and the trials for you are tougher.
ge.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: Sure, not everyone passes my tests.
ge.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: But I don’t need everyone. Only warriors with a steady hand and clear mind can handle this filth.
ge.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: Then you must know that there are always more scoundrels than strong-willed.
ge.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: That’s why every fighter like you counts. Each of you must be hardened to overcome enemies in any situation.
ge.6909f30672df36c6d81680c6: That’s how we’ll clean the city of rot.
ge.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Now it’s clear – Batya and his guys fought for truth alone, and weaklings went to gangs chasing profit.
ge.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: The trials show everyone’s place, and who you can trust.
ge.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: Under pressure, everyone shows who they are. The strong get stronger, the weak break.
ge.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: To clear the city of pillagers, I need reliable fighters.
ge.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: What brings you here? Take a seat, let’s chat.

po.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Agora está claro — Batya e seus homens lutaram pela verdade, e os fracos foram para as gangues atrás de lucro.
po.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: As provações mostram o lugar de cada um, e em quem você pode confiar.
po.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: Sob pressão, todo mundo mostra quem é. Os fortes ficam mais fortes, os fracos quebram.
po.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: Para limpar a cidade de pilhadores, preciso de combatentes confiáveis.
po.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: O que te traz aqui? Senta, vamos conversar.

sk.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: Out in the wild, it’s simple: don’t relax, or you’ll end up prey.
sk.68cc09140b3d0f4bfb671f7b: How was the trip? Sit down, I’ll listen.
sk.68cc09141d56c027704afb1b: Come here, the tea’s just boiled.
sk.68cc091425a6703969fd5924: Come on in, tell me what brought you here.
sk.68cc09143d243c8c5693ae4d: Sit down, tell me what’s going on.
sk.68cc09144a357115bfa25a01: You think all this “civilization” changed the world, but it hasn’t.
sk.68cc09144c0c5d02af05b80c: Tarkov needs saving. Too many looters and pillagers, the city’s unrecognizable.
sk.68cc09145d9ae83e0d3ea0ae: You used to be a simple forester, right? But now you give trials that seem brutal even by Tarkov standards. Why? What are you preparing for?
sk.68cc091465afb6f909efc9a5: Looking to buy something? Sure thing.
sk.68cc091466fc02cfc82a6db5: Well, I’ll need to check the stash.
sk.68cc0914706419e2bd209509: Let me look in the back, give me a minute.
sk.68cc09147b142b3f584d891d: Seen Partisan on your way here? Alright, sit down.
sk.68cc0914883517847c314180: Yeah, I’ve got a couple of solid shotguns.
sk.68cc091489f17763a0bdac7e: Getting ready for a hunt? I can help with that.
sk.68cc09148fd85f61e5a4b6fe: I saved a few things for you, take a look.
sk.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: What will keep you from failing is your character.
sk.68cc0914cf0afbb423033fa2: Sit down, tell me what’s going on.
sk.68d0351f139325ec2b88f028: What brings you here? Take a seat, let’s chat.
sk.68d037fd805b238d3e938a47: Need to gear up? Let's see.
sk.68d03805b6a7a6612a133616: Got something left. Come, I’ll show you.
sk.68d0382ecfa44b6563573785: Plenty of work right now. Let me check my notes.
sk.68d03833250e508185aa0f8b: Maybe your help will come in handy for something.
sk.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: Tarkov needs people like you. Let me glance at my notebook.
sk.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: Want to clean out Tarkov’s rot? You came to the right place.
sk.68d03844444871c42a664992: Looking to do some good? I’ve got a couple of leads.
sk.68d0384b78cbb0f7c3249ba3: Want to help the city? That’s a noble cause.
sk.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Voevoda taught me this when we hunted together.
sk.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: These trials, they aren’t just for skill.
sk.68dfb6ce1abfab3ece3385b4: All quiet for now. Rest up while you can.
sk.68dfb71d1e9809509c1daa7e: I’ve been waiting for you. Did you do what I asked?
sk.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: Speak of the devil. I was just thinking when you’d finish the job.
sk.68dfb73bdf3335ca5159558e: You’re here. So, the work’s done?
sk.68dfb7400b08c75b1a2a1be2: Here to make me happy? Did you do what I asked?
sk.68dfb7456e523de03f4c850f: You’re here, so the work must be done.
sk.68dfb7cdb391dcd880361245: Haven’t finished it yet. I came to ask you something.
sk.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: You should focus on the job. Ask what you need now, but get to work after.
sk.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: Shame. But since you’re already here, go ahead.
sk.68dfb8376ef2530241e814da: Not how things are done. Ask what you want, but do the job after.
sk.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: Shouldn’t have come before finishing. But since you’re here, tell me what you need.
sk.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: I remember about your task, but I haven’t finished it yet. I’ll come back after it’s done.
sk.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: So why did you trek all this way through the forest just for this? The youth these days…
sk.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: Shouldn’t have trusted you with something this important. Pull yourself together!
sk.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: And you came all this way just to say that? Go do it.
sk.68dfb89b434db812207b6d65: Hurry. Don’t come back until it’s done.
sk.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: Better not make me angry. Come back when the job’s finished.
sk.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: I've been waiting for you. Have you found the BEARs in the Labyrinth?
sk.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: You’re alive! So the Labyrinth let you leave. What did you find out?
sk.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: My friend visited me recently, he’s asked me about his BEAR squad. Did you find anything?
sk.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: If you’re here, there’s bound to be some news from the Labyrinth. What did you learn?
sk.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: My friend asked about you. Did you find the lost BEAR squad?
sk.68ffed574db649574545c762: No time for it now. I’ll do it later.
sk.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: Huh! We made a deal, those keys weren’t given to you for free.
sk.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: How long are you going to keep us waiting? The deal was simple, go finish the job.
sk.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: Why are you here then? The task is important, don’t delay further.
sk.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Nothing more to say, then. You better get to it.
sk.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: Why go back and forth then? Finish the task first, then we’ll drink tea.
sk.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: Didn’t think you’d ignore our deal like that. You can’t drag this out, you understand?
sk.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: When will you have time then? You think we gave you the keys for free?
sk.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: If only I knew, I’d send some other fighter. Someone reliable.
sk.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: Disrespecting the deal? We have nothing to talk about then.
sk.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: That won’t do. Finish the work, then come back.
sk.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: I'm still working on your mission, but I'm not done yet. I better go now.
sk.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Still working on your job. I'm here about another thing.
sk.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: Our city’s become the same. Anyone who doesn’t get that – Tarkov takes them.
sk.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Many said my trials are too harsh, pointless even. Tarkov swallowed them anyway. Some sooner, some later.
sk.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Only the predator that stays ahead survives. That’s what I’m teaching.
sk.6909f162bab9101e55668094: Those who can’t handle my trials? They become prey.
sk.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: You don’t think we’re in the majority, do you?
sk.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: For every soldier like you, there’s a dozen bandits.
sk.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: That’s why I demand more from you, and the trials for you are tougher.
sk.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: Sure, not everyone passes my tests.
sk.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: But I don’t need everyone. Only warriors with a steady hand and clear mind can handle this filth.
sk.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: Then you must know that there are always more scoundrels than strong-willed.
sk.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: That’s why every fighter like you counts. Each of you must be hardened to overcome enemies in any situation.
sk.6909f30672df36c6d81680c6: That’s how we’ll clean the city of rot.
sk.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Now it’s clear – Batya and his guys fought for truth alone, and weaklings went to gangs chasing profit.
sk.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: The trials show everyone’s place, and who you can trust.
sk.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: Under pressure, everyone shows who they are. The strong get stronger, the weak break.
sk.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: To clear the city of pillagers, I need reliable fighters.
sk.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: What brings you here? Take a seat, let’s chat.

es.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: Cuando estás en territorio salvaje, todo es muy sencillo: no te relajes si no quieres acabar siendo la presa.
es.68cc09140b3d0f4bfb671f7b: ¿Qué tal el viaje? Siéntate, te escucho.
es.68cc09141d56c027704afb1b: Ven aquí, el té acaba de hervir.
es.68cc091425a6703969fd5924: Pasa, dime qué te ha traído por aquí.
es.68cc09144a357115bfa25a01: Tú crees que toda esta "civilización" ha cambiado al mundo, pero no es así.
es.68cc09144c0c5d02af05b80c: Tenemos que salvar a Tarkov. Hay demasiados saqueadores y ladrones; la ciudad es irreconocible.
es.68cc09145d9ae83e0d3ea0ae: Tengo entendido que antes eras un simple guardabosques, ¿verdad? Pero ahora impones pruebas que parecen brutales incluso para los estándares de Tarkov. ¿Por qué? ¿Para qué te estás preparando?
es.68cc091466fc02cfc82a6db5: Bueno, tendré que echar un vistazo a mi alijo.
es.68cc0914706419e2bd209509: Déjame ver qué tengo allá atrás, dame un minuto.
es.68cc09147b142b3f584d891d: ¿Te has encontrado con Partisan de camino acá? Muy bien, siéntate.
es.68cc0914883517847c314180: Sí, tengo un par de escopetas muy buenas.
es.68cc091489f17763a0bdac7e: ¿Preparándote para una cacería? Puedo ayudarle con eso.
es.68cc09148fd85f61e5a4b6fe: Te he guardado algunas cosas, échales un vistazo.
es.68cc0914bc8ebf176efb5023: Estoy seguro de que nos volveremos a ver.
es.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: Si hay algo que puede evitar que caigas, es la fuerza de tu carácter.
es.68d0351f139325ec2b88f028: ¿Qué te trae por aquí? Siéntate, hablemos un poco.
es.68d03805b6a7a6612a133616: Me queda algo. Ven, te mostraré.
es.68d0382ecfa44b6563573785: Ahora hay mucho trabajo. Déjame revisar mis notas.
es.68d03833250e508185aa0f8b: Tal vez puedas ayudarme con algo.
es.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: Tarkov necesita gente como tú. Déjame echar un vistazo a mi libreta.
es.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: ¿Quieres acabar con la podredumbre que hay en Tarkov? Has venido al lugar adecuado.
es.68d03844444871c42a664992: ¿Quieres hacer una buena acción? Tengo un par de ideas.
es.68d0384b78cbb0f7c3249ba3: ¿Quieres ayudar a la ciudad? Esa es una causa noble.
es.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Voevoda me enseñó esto cuando cazábamos juntos.
es.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: Estas pruebas no son solo para evaluar la habilidad.
es.68dfb6ce1abfab3ece3385b4: Por ahora todo está tranquilo. Descansa un poco.
es.68dfb71d1e9809509c1daa7e: Te he estado esperando. ¿Has hecho lo que te pedí?
es.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: Hablando del rey de Roma. Justo estaba pensando cuándo terminarías el trabajo.
es.68dfb73bdf3335ca5159558e: Has llegado. Supongo que has terminado el trabajo, ¿verdad?
es.68dfb7400b08c75b1a2a1be2: ¿Has venido con buenas noticias? ¿Has hecho lo que te pedí?
es.68dfb7456e523de03f4c850f: Ya que estás aquí, supongo que ya has terminado el trabajo.
es.68dfb7cdb391dcd880361245: Aún no lo he terminado. He venido a preguntarte algo.
es.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: Deberías concentrarte en el trabajo. Pregunta lo que necesites por el momento, pero después ponte a ello.
es.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: Qué pena. Pero como ya estás aquí, adelante.
es.68dfb8376ef2530241e814da: Así no es como se hacen las cosas. Pregunta lo que quieras, pero después pon manos a la obra.
es.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: No deberías haber venido aquí sin haber terminado antes. Pero ya que estás aquí, dime qué necesitas.
es.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: Me acuerdo de tu encargo, pero aún no lo he terminado. Volveré cuando esté hecho.
es.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: ¿Y por qué has atravesado el bosque entero? ¿Solo para esto? Ahh, los jóvenes de hoy en día…
es.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: No debí haberte confiado algo tan importante. ¡Concéntrate!
es.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: ¿Y has venido hasta aquí solo para decirme eso? Ve y hazlo.
es.68dfb89b434db812207b6d65: Date prisa. No vuelvas hasta que hayas terminado.
es.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: Será mejor que no me hagas enfadar. Vuelve cuando hayas terminado el trabajo.
es.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: He estado esperándote. ¿Has encontrado a los BEAR en Labyrinth?
es.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: ¡Estás vivo! Así que Labyrinth no puede tragarse a cualquiera. ¿Qué has encontrado?
es.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: Mi amigo me visitó recientemente y me preguntó por su escuadrón BEAR. ¿Has encontrado algo?
es.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: Si estás aquí, de seguro eso significa que hay noticias de Labyrinth. ¿Qué has descubierto?
es.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: Mi amigo ha preguntado por ti. ¿Has encontrado al escuadrón BEAR perdido?
es.68ffed574db649574545c762: Ahora no tengo tiempo. Lo haré más tarde.
es.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: ¡Eh! Teníamos un trato; esas llaves no te las han dado gratis.
es.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: ¿Cuánto tiempo más vas a hacernos esperar? El trato era simple; ahora ve y termina el trabajo.
es.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: ¿Entonces, qué haces aquí? El encargo es muy importante, no lo pospongas más.
es.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Entonces no hay nada más que decir. Será mejor que te pongas a ello.
es.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: ¿Y por qué perder el tiempo entonces? Primero termina el trabajo, luego tomaremos un poco de té.
es.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: No pensaba que ignorarías nuestro trato de esa manera. No puedes prolongar esto, ¿entiendes?
es.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: Y entonces, ¿cuándo tendrás tiempo para hacerlo? ¿Piensas que te hemos dado las llaves a cambio de nada?
es.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: De haberlo sabido, habría enviado a otro combatiente. A alguien de confianza.
es.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: ¿Así que no piensas respetar el trato? Entonces no tenemos nada de qué hablar.
es.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: Eso no está bien. Termina el trabajo y luego vuelve.
es.68fff166bfd1afe7af3258b2: Justamente he venido a hablar de eso.
es.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: Sigo trabajando en tu misión, pero aún no la he terminado. Será mejor que me ponga en marcha.
es.690276876eee315590313824: Justamente he venido a hablar de eso.
es.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Sigo trabajando en tu encargo. He venido por otro asunto.
es.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: Nuestra ciudad se ha vuelto igual. Quien no lo entienda, Tarkov se lo lleva.
es.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Muchos me decían que mis pruebas eran demasiado duras y que no tenían sentido. Pero Tarkov se los ha tragado. A algunos antes, a otros después.
es.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Solo sobrevive el depredador que se mantiene a la vanguardia. Eso es lo que enseño.
es.6909f162bab9101e55668094: ¿Aquellos que no pueden soportar mis pruebas? Se convierten en presas.
es.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: ¿No creerás que somos la mayoría, verdad?
es.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: Por cada soldado como tú, hay una docena de bandidos.
es.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: Es por eso que exijo más de ti, y por lo que tus pruebas son más duras.
es.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: Claro, no todos superan mis pruebas.
es.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: Pero no necesito a todo el mundo. Solo los guerreros con mano firme y mente clara pueden hacerle frente a esta podredumbre.
es.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: Entonces debes saber que siempre hay más sinvergüenzas que personas de carácter firme.
es.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: Es por eso que cada combatiente como tú cuenta. Cada uno de vosotros debe estar preparado para vencer a los enemigos en cualquier situación.
es.6909f30672df36c6d81680c6: Así es como limpiaremos la ciudad de la podredumbre.
es.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Ahora está claro: Batya y sus chicos combatieron únicamente por la verdad, y los débiles se unieron a las pandillas en busca de ganancias.
es.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: Así es. Las pruebas ponen a cada uno en su sitio y muestran en quién se puede confiar.
es.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: Bajo presión, todos muestran quiénes son realmente. Los de espíritu fuerte se vuelven más fuertes, pero los débiles se rompen.
es.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: Para limpiar la ciudad de saqueadores, necesito combatientes de confianza.
es.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: ¿Qué te trae por aquí? Siéntate, hablemos un poco.

es-mx.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: Será mejor que no me hagas enojar. Vuelve cuando hayas terminado el trabajo.
es-mx.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: He estado esperándote. ¿Has encontrado a los BEAR en el Laberinto?
es-mx.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: ¡Estás vivo! Así que el Laberinto no puede tragarse a cualquiera. ¿Qué encontraste?
es-mx.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: Mi amigo me visitó recientemente y me preguntó por su escuadrón BEAR. ¿Encontraste algo?
es-mx.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: Si estás aquí, de seguro eso significa que hay noticias del Laberinto. ¿Qué has descubierto?
es-mx.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: Mi amigo preguntó por ti. ¿Encontraste al escuadrón BEAR perdido?
es-mx.68ffed574db649574545c762: No tengo tiempo ahora. Lo haré más tarde.
es-mx.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: ¡Eh! Un trato es un trato, no te dieron esas llaves gratis.
es-mx.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: ¿Cuánto tiempo nos vas a tener esperando? El trato era simple; ahora ve y termina el trabajo.
es-mx.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: ¿Entonces, por qué estás aquí? El encargo es muy importante, no lo pospongas más.
es-mx.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Entonces no hay nada más que decir. Será mejor que te pongas a hacerlo.
es-mx.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: ¿Y por qué andas dando vueltas? Primero termina el trabajo, luego tomaremos un poco de té.
es-mx.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: No pensé que ignorarías nuestro trato de esa manera. No puedes prolongar esto, ¿lo entiendes?
es-mx.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: Y entonces, ¿cuándo vas a tener tiempo? ¿Crees que te dimos las llaves gratis?
es-mx.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: De haberlo sabido, habría enviado a otro combatiente. A alguien de confianza.
es-mx.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: ¿Así que no piensas respetar el trato? Entonces no tenemos nada de qué hablar.
es-mx.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: Eso no es suficiente. Termina el trabajo y luego regresa.
es-mx.68fff166bfd1afe7af3258b2: Justamente vine a hablar de eso.
es-mx.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: Sigo trabajando en tu misión, pero aún no la he terminado. Será mejor que me vaya.
es-mx.690276876eee315590313824: Justamente vine a hablar de eso.
es-mx.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Sigo trabajando en tu encargo. Vengo por otro asunto.
es-mx.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: Nuestra ciudad se ha vuelto igual. Cualquiera que no se dé cuenta de eso, Tarkov acabará con él en un instante.
es-mx.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Muchos me decían que mis pruebas eran demasiado duras y que no tenían sentido. Pero Tarkov se los tragó. A algunos antes, a otros después.
es-mx.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Solo sobrevive el depredador que se mantiene a la vanguardia. Eso es lo que enseño.
es-mx.6909f162bab9101e55668094: ¿Aquellos que no pueden soportar mis pruebas? Se convierten en presas.
es-mx.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: ¿No crees que somos la mayoría, verdad?
es-mx.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: Por cada soldado como tú, hay una docena de bandidos.
es-mx.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: Es por eso que exijo más de ti, y por lo que tus pruebas son más duras.
es-mx.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: Claro, no todos superan mis pruebas.
es-mx.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: Pero no necesito a todo el mundo. Solo los guerreros con mano firme y mente clara pueden encargarse de esta podredumbre.
es-mx.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: Entonces deberías saber que siempre hay más sinvergüenzas que personas de carácter fuerte.
es-mx.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: Es por eso que cada combatiente como tú cuenta. Cada uno de ustedes debe estar preparado para vencer a los enemigos en cualquier situación.
es-mx.6909f30672df36c6d81680c6: Así es como limpiaremos la ciudad de la podredumbre.
es-mx.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Ahora está claro: Batya y sus muchachos combatieron solo por la verdad, y los débiles se unieron a las pandillas en busca de ganancias.
es-mx.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: Así es. Las pruebas pondrán a cada uno en su lugar y mostrarán en quién se puede confiar.
es-mx.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: Bajo presión, todos muestran quiénes son realmente. Los de espíritu fuerte se vuelven más fuertes, pero los débiles se rompen.
es-mx.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: Para limpiar la ciudad de saqueadores, necesito combatientes de confianza.
es-mx.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: ¿Qué te trae por aquí? Siéntate, vamos a platicar.

tu.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: Doğada işler basittir: Rahatı bırak, av olursun.

tu.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: Başarısız olmanı engelleyecek tek şey karakterindir.
tu.68d0351f139325ec2b88f028: Seni buraya ne getirdi? Geç, otur, sohbet edelim.

tu.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: Tarkov senin gibi insanlara ihtiyaç duyuyor. Defterime bir göz atayım.
tu.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: Tarkov’un çürümüşlüğünü temizlemek mi istiyorsun? Doğru yere geldin.

tu.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Voevoda birlikte avlanırken bana bunu öğretmişti.
tu.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: Bu sınavlar, sadece beceri için değil.
tu.68dfb6ce1abfab3ece3385b4: Şimdilik ortalık sakin. Ne zaman fırsat bulursan dinlen.
tu.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: Lafın üzerine geldin. Tam da işi ne zaman bitireceğini düşünüyordum.

tu.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: İşe odaklanmalısın. Şimdi sor ne soracaksan, sonra işe dön.
tu.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: Yazık. Ama madem geldin, söyle bakalım.

tu.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: Bitirmeden gelmemeliydin. Ama madem geldin, söyle ne lazım.
tu.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: Görevini hatırlıyorum ama daha bitirmedim. Bitirince geri gelirim.
tu.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: Sırf bunun için ormanı aşarak geldin ha? Şimdiki gençler…
tu.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: Bu kadar önemli bir şeyi sana emanet etmemem lazımmış. Kendine gel!
tu.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: Bunca yolu sırf bunu söylemeye mi geldin? Git yap.
tu.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: Seni bekliyordum. Labirent’te BEAR’ları buldun mu?
tu.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: Yaşıyorsun! Demek Labirent seni saldı. Ne öğrendin?

tu.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: Buradaysan, Labirent’ten haber vardır. Ne öğrendin?
tu.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: Arkadaşım senden bahsetti. Kayıp BEAR timini buldun mu?
tu.68ffed574db649574545c762: Şu an zaman yok. Sonra yapacağım.
tu.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: Hah! Anlaşma yaptık, o anahtarları sana bedava vermedik.
tu.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: Daha ne kadar bekleteceksin? Anlaşma basitti, git işi bitir.
tu.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: Peki o zaman niye buradasın? Görev önemli, daha fazla oyalanma.
tu.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Diyecek başka bir şey yok o hâlde. En iyisi gitmeye bak.
tu.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: Niye gidip geliyorsun? Önce görevi bitir, sonra çay içeriz.
tu.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: Anlaşmayı görmezden geleceğini düşünmemiştim. Bu işi uzatamazsın, anladın mı?
tu.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: Ne zaman vaktin olacak peki? O anahtarları sana bedava verdiğimizi mi sandın?
tu.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: Bilecek olsam başka bir dövüşçü gönderirdim. Güvenilir birini.
tu.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: Anlaşmaya saygısızlık ha? O zaman konuşacak bir şeyimiz yok.
tu.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: Böyle olmaz. Önce işi bitir, sonra gel.
tu.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: Görevin üzerinde çalışıyorum ama bitmedi. En iyisi gideyim.
tu.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Hâlâ senin işi yapıyorum. Başka bir şey için geldim.
tu.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: Şehrimiz de aynı hale geldi. Bunu anlamayanı Tarkov yutar.
tu.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Birçoğu sınavlarımın fazla sert, hatta anlamsız olduğunu söyledi. Tarkov onları yine yuttu. Kimi erken, kimi geç.
tu.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Önden giden yırtıcı hayatta kalır. Benim öğrettiğim bu.
tu.6909f162bab9101e55668094: Sınavlarıma dayanamayanlar mı? Av olur giderler.

tu.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: Ama benim herkese ihtiyacım yok. Ancak eli titremeyen, zihni berrak savaşçılar bu pisliği kaldırabilir.
tu.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: O zaman biliyorsundur ki alçaklar her zaman güçlü iradelilerden daha çoktur.
tu.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: Bu yüzden senin gibi her savaşçının değeri var. Her biriniz her durumda düşmanı alt edecek kadar sertleşmelisiniz.
tu.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Artık belli — Batya ve adamları yalnızca hakikat için savaştı, zayıflar ise kâra koşan çetelerin peşine gitti.
tu.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: Sınavlar herkesin yerini gösterir, kime güveneceğini de.

tu.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: Seni buraya ne getirdi? Geç, otur konuşalım.

ru.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: В диких местах всё просто: нельзя расслабляться, если не хочешь стать добычей.
ru.68cc091425a6703969fd5924: Ну заходи, говори с чем пришёл.
ru.68cc09144a231b6a677a0e90: Может, у тебя есть что-то на продажу?
ru.68cc09144a357115bfa25a01: Ты думаешь, что вся эта «цивилизация» что-то изменила в мире, но на самом деле всё осталось прежним.
ru.68cc09144c0c5d02af05b80c: Тарков спасать надо. Слишком много мародёров и насильников, город не узнать.
ru.68cc09145d9ae83e0d3ea0ae: Ты вроде лесником обычным раньше был. Но теперь даёшь испытания, которые кажутся жестокими даже на фоне Таркова. Зачем тебе это? К чему ты готовишься?
ru.68cc091466fc02cfc82a6db5: Ну, это надо в подполе посмореть.
ru.68cc0914706419e2bd209509: Надо посмотреть в загашнике , дай минутку.
ru.68cc0914883517847c314180: Да, у меня есть пара хороших ружей.
ru.68cc091489f17763a0bdac7e: Готовишься к охоте? С этим помогу.
ru.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: Если что-то и поможет тебе не оступиться, так это твой характер.
ru.68d03518890aa4340fb21e19: В ногах правды нет. Садись, всё обсудим.
ru.68d0382ecfa44b6563573785: Работы нынче много. Дай записи посмотрю.
ru.68d03833250e508185aa0f8b: Может, и пригодится твоя помощь кое в чём.
ru.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: Таркову нужны такие, как ты. Дай в блокнот только загляну.
ru.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: Тарков от гнили очистить хочешь? Это ты правильно зашёл.
ru.68d03844444871c42a664992: Пользу принести хочешь? Есть у меня пара наводок.
ru.68d0384b78cbb0f7c3249ba3: Городу помочь хочешь? Это дело благое.
ru.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Воевода научил, когда на охоту вместе ходили.
ru.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: Испытания, они ведь не только тебе навыки дают.
ru.68dfb71d1e9809509c1daa7e: Я ждал тебя. Ты сделал, что я просил?
ru.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: Лёгок на помине. Я как раз думал, когда ты всё сделаешь.
ru.68dfb73bdf3335ca5159558e: Ты здесь. А раз так, то и работу сделал?
ru.68dfb7400b08c75b1a2a1be2: Порадовать меня пришёл? Всё верно сделал, как я просил?
ru.68dfb7456e523de03f4c850f: Ты здесь, значит и работа уже сделана.
ru.68dfb7cdb391dcd880361245: Я ещё не закончил. Зашёл к тебе спросить кое-что.
ru.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: Суетиться тебе меньше надо. Сейчас спрашивай, что хотел, но потом работой займись.
ru.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: Жаль. Но раз уж зашёл, спрашивай.
ru.68dfb8376ef2530241e814da: Это не дело. Спрашивай, что хотел, а потом за работу мою возьмись.
ru.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: Не стоило приходить, пока заказ не выполнил. Но раз ты тут – говори, зачем пришёл.
ru.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: Я помню о деле, но ещё его не закончил. Вернусь, как будет готово.
ru.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: И зачем ты сюда тогда через весь лес добирался? Молодёжь…
ru.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: Не стоило тебе такое важное дело доверять. Соберись!
ru.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: И ты проделал весь путь, чтоб мне об этом сказать? Ступай давай.
ru.68dfb89b434db812207b6d65: Поторопись. И не возвращайся, пока дело не сделаешь.
ru.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: Лучше тебе меня не злить. Возвращайся, когда работу сделаешь.
ru.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: Я ждал тебя. Ты нашёл бирцов в Лабиринте?
ru.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: Живой! Значит, не всякого Лабиринт сожрать может. Что узнал?
ru.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: Ко мне на днях товарищ заходил, про бирцов спрашивал. Ты узнал что-нибудь?
ru.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: Если ты тут, значит есть новости из Лабиринта. Что узнал?
ru.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: Товарищ как раз спрашивал про тебя. Ты нашёл пропавших бирцов?
ru.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: Ишь чё! Договор есть договор, ключи тебе не задаром дали.
ru.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: И долго ты ещё тянуть собираешься? Уговор был простой, дело сделать надо.
ru.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: Зачем тогда вернулся? Дело важное, не откладывай.
ru.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Тогда говорить не о чем. Лучше делом займись.
ru.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: И чего ты мотаешься туда-сюда? Задачу сначала выполни, а чаю потом выпьем.
ru.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: Не думал, что ты можешь наплевать на договор. Тянуть с этим делом нельзя, ты понял?
ru.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: А когда до того будет? Думаешь, тебе ключи за так отдали?
ru.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: Знал бы, другого бойца нашёл. Понадёжнее.
ru.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: Значит, договор не уважаешь? Тогда говорить нам не о чем.
ru.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: Так не пойдёт. Сначала дело сделай, а потом возвращайся.
ru.68fff166bfd1afe7af3258b2: Как раз на счет этого и пришел.
ru.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: Я работаю над твоим делом, но ещё не закончил. Мне нужно идти.
ru.690276876eee315590313824: Как раз на счет этого и пришел.
ru.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Над твоей задачей я ещё работаю. Зашёл по другому делу.
ru.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: И город наш стал таким местом. Кто этого не знает, того враз Тарков заберёт.
ru.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Многие мне говорили, что эти испытания слишком тяжёлые, и смысла в них нет. Вот только сожрал их Тарков. Кого раньше, а кого позже.
ru.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Выживет только тот хищник, который всегда впереди. Этому я и учу.
ru.6909f162bab9101e55668094: А если кто-то не может выдержать мои испытания, то добычей станет. Так-то.
ru.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: Ты ведь не думаешь, что мы в большинстве?
ru.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: На одного такого воина, как ты, найдётся десяток бандитов.
ru.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: Потому и спрос с тебя больше, и испытания строже.
ru.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: Да, не всякий мои испытания пройдёт.
ru.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: Но мне всякие и не нужны. Только воины с твёрдой рукой и ясной головой смогут одолеть эту нечисть.
ru.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: Тогда должен знать, что сволочи разной всегда больше, чем твердых духом.
ru.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: Потому у меня каждый боец вроде тебя на счету. И каждый из вас должен быть закалённым, чтобы в любой ситуации врага одолеть.
ru.6909f30672df36c6d81680c6: Только так город от этой гнили очистим.
ru.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Теперь всё понятно – Батя с пацанами один остался за правду воевать, а слабаки все на банды разбились и наживу ищут.
ru.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: Так-то. Испытания расставят всех на нужные стороны и покажут, на кого положиться можно.
ru.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: В тяготах каждый показывает, кто он есть. Сильного духом мои задания сделают ещё сильнее. А вот слабый сломается.
ru.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: Чтобы город от мародёров очистить, нужны надёжные бойцы.

ro.68cc091409b26effc12e9859: Out in the wild, it’s simple: don’t relax, or you’ll end up prey.
ro.68cc09140b3d0f4bfb671f7b: How was the trip? Sit down, I’ll listen.
ro.68cc09141d56c027704afb1b: Come here, the tea’s just boiled.
ro.68cc091425a6703969fd5924: Come on in, tell me what brought you here.
ro.68cc09143d243c8c5693ae4d: Sit down, tell me what’s going on.
ro.68cc09144a357115bfa25a01: You think all this “civilization” changed the world, but it hasn’t.
ro.68cc09144c0c5d02af05b80c: Tarkov needs saving. Too many looters and pillagers, the city’s unrecognizable.
ro.68cc09145d9ae83e0d3ea0ae: You used to be a simple forester, right? But now you give trials that seem brutal even by Tarkov standards. Why? What are you preparing for?
ro.68cc091465afb6f909efc9a5: Looking to buy something? Sure thing.
ro.68cc091466fc02cfc82a6db5: Well, I’ll need to check the stash.
ro.68cc0914706419e2bd209509: Let me look in the back, give me a minute.
ro.68cc09147b142b3f584d891d: Seen Partisan on your way here? Alright, sit down.
ro.68cc0914883517847c314180: Yeah, I’ve got a couple of solid shotguns.
ro.68cc091489f17763a0bdac7e: Getting ready for a hunt? I can help with that.
ro.68cc09148fd85f61e5a4b6fe: I saved a few things for you, take a look.
ro.68cc0914c4dfb303f73d1b56: What will keep you from failing is your character.
ro.68cc0914cf0afbb423033fa2: Sit down, tell me what’s going on.
ro.68d0351f139325ec2b88f028: What brings you here? Take a seat, let’s chat.
ro.68d037fd805b238d3e938a47: Need to gear up? Let's see.
ro.68d03805b6a7a6612a133616: Got something left. Come, I’ll show you.
ro.68d0382ecfa44b6563573785: Plenty of work right now. Let me check my notes.
ro.68d03833250e508185aa0f8b: Maybe your help will come in handy for something.
ro.68d03839de69ffaa904673cd: Tarkov needs people like you. Let me glance at my notebook.
ro.68d0383ec094d173ab24fa93: Want to clean out Tarkov’s rot? You came to the right place.
ro.68d03844444871c42a664992: Looking to do some good? I’ve got a couple of leads.
ro.68d0384b78cbb0f7c3249ba3: Want to help the city? That’s a noble cause.
ro.68d038c8fd55012b42c54f93: Voevoda taught me this when we hunted together.
ro.68d038cd109aa2251f17a11d: These trials, they aren’t just for skill.
ro.68dfb6ce1abfab3ece3385b4: All quiet for now. Rest up while you can.
ro.68dfb71d1e9809509c1daa7e: I’ve been waiting for you. Did you do what I asked?
ro.68dfb736ea4f986643e47b43: Speak of the devil. I was just thinking when you’d finish the job.
ro.68dfb73bdf3335ca5159558e: You’re here. So, the work’s done?
ro.68dfb7400b08c75b1a2a1be2: Here to make me happy? Did you do what I asked?
ro.68dfb7456e523de03f4c850f: You’re here, so the work must be done.
ro.68dfb7cdb391dcd880361245: Haven’t finished it yet. I came to ask you something.
ro.68dfb82d84604ed9e453e710: You should focus on the job. Ask what you need now, but get to work after.
ro.68dfb83292b2a67da0b31755: Shame. But since you’re already here, go ahead.
ro.68dfb8376ef2530241e814da: Not how things are done. Ask what you want, but do the job after.
ro.68dfb83cb943f4a43a1f9967: Shouldn’t have come before finishing. But since you’re here, tell me what you need.
ro.68dfb87f3d10958027991aea: I remember about your task, but I haven’t finished it yet. I’ll come back after it’s done.
ro.68dfb88a57f2105ce69a5cc0: So why did you trek all this way through the forest just for this? The youth these days…
ro.68dfb890a1ad02a966ba07d5: Shouldn’t have trusted you with something this important. Pull yourself together!
ro.68dfb895e95b4524a6edc7ba: And you came all this way just to say that? Go do it.
ro.68dfb89b434db812207b6d65: Hurry. Don’t come back until it’s done.
ro.68dfb8a1668e43a2e4dc56b1: Better not make me angry. Come back when the job’s finished.
ro.68ffec8027c5cdb449ef163b: I've been waiting for you. Have you found the BEARs in the Labyrinth?
ro.68ffec88d8a19bbb9eccb1f5: You’re alive! So the Labyrinth let you leave. What did you find out?
ro.68ffec892f2e2c7d618140c4: My friend visited me recently, he’s asked me about his BEAR squad. Did you find anything?
ro.68ffec8ef90f9860071e8673: If you’re here, there’s bound to be some news from the Labyrinth. What did you learn?
ro.68ffec901a24a320603553ce: My friend asked about you. Did you find the lost BEAR squad?
ro.68ffed574db649574545c762: No time for it now. I’ll do it later.
ro.68ffeddf2ed5b81dd1502245: Huh! We made a deal, those keys weren’t given to you for free.
ro.68ffededac26e0afd732f25d: How long are you going to keep us waiting? The deal was simple, go finish the job.
ro.68ffedfb75e35429ae0a6c39: Why are you here then? The task is important, don’t delay further.
ro.68ffee084f5778e7dbba9d2b: Nothing more to say, then. You better get to it.
ro.68ffee14114a0a6592be545f: Why go back and forth then? Finish the task first, then we’ll drink tea.
ro.68ffee9f8a40a7cf606f87e4: Didn’t think you’d ignore our deal like that. You can’t drag this out, you understand?
ro.68ffeeac2b229f9c4dacb877: When will you have time then? You think we gave you the keys for free?
ro.68ffeeb8888c11b68b5bc35a: If only I knew, I’d send some other fighter. Someone reliable.
ro.68ffeec4d2231a8a8603b33e: Disrespecting the deal? We have nothing to talk about then.
ro.68ffeed2d2cf411e7f9c5ab6: That won’t do. Finish the work, then come back.
ro.68fff38e7e0bb1fe642eadda: I'm still working on your mission, but I'm not done yet. I better go now.
ro.690277ecba1b610f374bf9c9: Still working on your job. I'm here about another thing.
ro.6909ee7a43823b872f6ae014: Our city’s become the same. Anyone who doesn’t get that – Tarkov takes them.
ro.6909eeac86ed7f2c11b98397: Many said my trials are too harsh, pointless even. Tarkov swallowed them anyway. Some sooner, some later.
ro.6909f14c4f0d4084e575d885: Only the predator that stays ahead survives. That’s what I’m teaching.
ro.6909f162bab9101e55668094: Those who can’t handle my trials? They become prey.
ro.6909f1a50141ea62a47baa1c: You don’t think we’re in the majority, do you?
ro.6909f1c98d353da53a6ea860: For every soldier like you, there’s a dozen bandits.
ro.6909f20251b0cb6a6a1f05a0: That’s why I demand more from you, and the trials for you are tougher.
ro.6909f24e1a9058c545c41688: Sure, not everyone passes my tests.
ro.6909f26710546409ac151ca2: But I don’t need everyone. Only warriors with a steady hand and clear mind can handle this filth.
ro.6909f2ee2ab2f1f41e04c39b: Then you must know that there are always more scoundrels than strong-willed.
ro.6909f2f5f99c84778f81a198: That’s why every fighter like you counts. Each of you must be hardened to overcome enemies in any situation.
ro.6909f30672df36c6d81680c6: That’s how we’ll clean the city of rot.
ro.6909f37cc523d6980cc5a0c2: Now it’s clear – Batya and his guys fought for truth alone, and weaklings went to gangs chasing profit.
ro.6909f381b737a5b621a37d2a: The trials show everyone’s place, and who you can trust.
ro.6909f3d611d3b9c9c1bab932: Under pressure, everyone shows who they are. The strong get stronger, the weak break.
ro.6909f3dacc7be91bb5cb0d7f: To clear the city of pillagers, I need reliable fighters.
ro.6914dd64697dea97a4a60dfb: What brings you here? Take a seat, let’s chat.

ch.68d09cff1350929013a40bb3: 活儿永远干不完，问题是谁来接。
ch.68d09cff1ca60854a790242e: 你不记笔记的吗？要是把任务搞砸了，就别想拿报酬。
ch.68d09cff39de552250106e9a: 现在一堆活儿。看看记录里写了啥。
ch.68d09cff6897985bff4060d2: 听说你现在搞各种灰色生意？那你一开始是干什么的？
ch.68d09cff725b4aa2814a49bc: 好奇心会害死你的，伙计！是啊，我干过这些，那又怎样？
ch.68d09cff859574f3c5f2e2e0: 存了点钱对吧？放轻松，我就是问问。你知道去哪儿找东西。
ch.68d09cff9cc410849e3b1bf6: 那可是好时候啊，真跟你说。货一堆，傻子更多，抢着买……每个人都以为自己要发大财了。可光靠那些玩意儿哪能建起商业帝国呢。我早就知道，真正的生意是在港口。对，就是那儿，真家伙们交易的地方。
ch.68d09cffb03f6e9a472e5daa: 快进来！最近怎么样，伙计？
ch.68d09cffc2d35ad838d2843c: 等等再来吧？到时候我们再聊。
ch.68d09cffcf86abe6ac96c57f: 那时候大家都在外面摆摊……在街市卖破烂，冻得屁股都麻了，手里抱着瓶伏特加看着自己那点破货。
ch.68d09cffd3c4b53aa743d811: 早说嘛！兄弟们会带你看一遍的
ch.68d09cffe4bd8a3801f8e5cd: 我这儿总有点东西。你带钱了吗？
ch.68d09cffea87a02c90df17a0: 我脑子装不下所有活儿。来，看看记录。
ch.68d09cffeea27d9647bf7de0: 啊，有想法！你能赚点钱，我也能看得起你。
ch.68d09df668c8128795a94493: 喂你！杵那儿干嘛？好啦别紧张，我听说过你！你要去港口，对吧？你耍的那点把戏根本算不上计划，不过随你好了。
ch.68d15172c829f7b87367051c: 要挣钱？好，我看看能把你安排到哪儿。
ch.68e009408c42d8ea235832d3: 终于！按我说的方式都做了，对吧？
ch.68e00945790596888eff789e: 我正要叫你呢。活儿做完了吗？
ch.68e0094996ebb5f0df948018: 我希望活儿已经干完了，过来。
ch.68e0096f03400edf1ba741cf: 活儿我还在做，来问点事。
ch.68e0097bb97e1d49ec9d3145: 行，快问完赶紧滚！命令可不等人。
ch.68e0097f00b5ce7e02bd7497: 到底啥问题？想问啥赶紧问，问完去干活。
ch.68e00983d5e90fddf65cad03: 你动作挺慢的啊？行吧，我心情好，快问。
ch.68e00986bc6793b47074af40: 不太合规矩。但如果能快点问完的话，就开口吧。但别拖我给你安排的活儿——否则你会后悔。
ch.68e009afcc00ded7361c6dfb: 那你他妈来干嘛？蠢货！快点把活儿干完！
ch.68e009b36e31d8ecb1fb1863: 那你杵这儿干嘛？活儿做完了再说。
ch.68e009b74bb927beb66b9cf3: 你来这儿干嘛？先把活儿做完再聊。
ch.68f5107579aef5e938abf4ad: 活儿怎么样？门搞定了没有？
ch.68f510830c31424232b031dd: 这么快就回来了啊。门开了没？
ch.68f5108a7cbc5b3c72ccc19d: 你既然来了，那门肯定是开了，对吧？
ch.68f510eb64970d5296719423: 瞧你这样子……门是打开了吧？
ch.68f51466f1158ed8e14e088a: 那你回来干嘛？想要消息？先把那破活儿做完！
ch.68f51499384750b629deb27e: 你在这儿晃悠啥？想耍我是吧？
ch.68f514a06846e22e1e57ab81: 别浪费我时间。先干活，再聊天！
ch.68f514a5552b3c2da6f215b0: 那你找我干嘛？先把门打开，再给消息——咱俩就是这么约的。
ch.68f514a902f8fc72a41a6ca7: 你脑子坏了？规矩写得清清楚楚的。那你来这儿干嘛？
ch.68f51520448448f759954f69: 我找不到你那破钥匙了。能不能不靠它解决？
ch.68f51542eedb0109699c6680: 你搞反了，伙计。我说了，开开之后才有消息，就这么简单。
ch.68f5154de9d60063ac7db783: 别给我掺和乱七八糟的。活儿是你接的，就给我做完。要不就滚，之后别来哭着找活干。
ch.68f5155407381055d1e83da7: 你这小子脸皮挺厚啊。这次我就算了——但现在闭嘴干活。交易就是交易。
ch.68f5155c2017b0b3c8226adb: 你是不是搞糊涂了？我需要你把那扇门打开，你要消息。交易就是交易，毁约的是些该死的老鼠。你不是老鼠，对吧
ch.68f5156567915f0d08d27b6c: 想半路改规矩？你现在闭嘴把事做好还来得及，但这是最后一次——再来这一套我可不惯着。
ch.690288d0cacc9f4c45029bda: 我才发现还没做完。再给我点时间。
ch.6902892069f80486a0a13db9: 活儿我还在做，我来问你点事。
ch.690e01bfdfbe5d65ae0387d2: 所有人都以为自己要发大财。
ch.690e01e627babe3f241e5b8f: 可光靠那些玩意儿哪能建起商业帝国呢。我早就知道真正的玩法是在港口。
ch.690e01f96b928e8b2df1af08: 对……真正的现金都流向了那儿。
ch.690e02632a4c1380b93fa503: 以为卖几袋进口货就算大人物了？
ch.690e0268a1b892e00d10146a: 想都别想，得有脑子、有胆子、还得够硬气才行。
ch.690e02ab018c9bda07c92d7d: 想从泥坑爬出来，你就得先踩点脏水。
ch.690e02b494c2f840de233b79: 走私装备、违禁品、音响这些破玩意儿，统统都有。
ch.690e02bb3c44d3952f99f3da: 这行里你不抢机会，别人就会抢——最后你既没钱，也没人脉。
ch.690e02f0adc0bb056a64ef33: 那时候我还是个小喽啰，但也在搞点小动作。口香糖啊、衣服啊，那都是小打小闹。
ch.690e02f5a5fd9588e0964f54: 真正的大钱，是我在港口认识一个哥们之后才开始滚进来的。那才叫有意思。

cz.68d09cff1350929013a40bb3: Práce je vždycky dost, otázka je, komu ji dát.
cz.68d09cff1ca60854a790242e: Ty si neděláš poznámky? Jestli zkurvíš nějaký rozkaz, tak nečekej odměnu.
cz.68d09cff39de552250106e9a: Teď je hromada práce. Jdeme se podívat do poznámek, co se děje.
cz.68d09cff5781b2c1ea2c41a0: Nestůj tam jak tvrdý Y. Pojď sem.
cz.68d09cff5bbfc28b45db6869: Máš prachy? Tak jo, koukni se.
cz.68d09cff6897985bff4060d2: Slyšel jsem, že seš do různých kriminálních kšeftů. S čím jsi začal?
cz.68d09cff725b4aa2814a49bc: Zvědavost tě zabije, kámo! Jo, stalo se to, no a?
cz.68d09cff859574f3c5f2e2e0: Našetřils nějaký prachy, jo? Klídek, jen se ptám. Víš, kde hledat.
cz.68d09cff9cc410849e3b1bf6: Dobrý časy, to ti povím. Hromada zboží, hromada idiotů, co to kupovali...
cz.68d09cffb8dc190acd7fa408: Možná bych pro tebe něco našel.
cz.68d09cffc2d35ad838d2843c: Zastav se později, jo? Možná si pak popovídáme.
cz.68d09cffcf86abe6ac96c57f: Všichni tam tehdy byli... Prodávali harampádí na tržištích, mrzli jim prdele, hlídali si zásoby s flaškou vodky v ruce.
cz.68d09cffd3c4b53aa743d811: Měl jsi to říct! Kluci ti všechno ukážou.
cz.68d09cffe4bd8a3801f8e5cd: Vždycky něco mám. Máš u sebe prachy?
cz.68d09cffea87a02c90df17a0: Nemůžu si pamatovat všechny ty práce. Podíváme se do poznámek.
cz.68d09cffeea27d9647bf7de0: Aha, dobrý nápad! Vyděláš si nějaký prachy a získáš můj respekt.
cz.68d09cfff3d29352310d26de: Možná by se něco našlo, nech mě se podívat.
cz.68d09df668c8128795a94493: Hej ty! Co tam stojíš? Dobrý, nestresuj, už mi o tobě řekli! Míříš do přístavu, jo? Plán je na hovno, ale dělej si co chceš.
cz.68d15172c829f7b87367051c: Potřebuješ prachy? Tak jo, podíváme se, kam tě můžu zařadit.
cz.68e009408c42d8ea235832d3: Konečně! Udělal jsi to všechno, jak jsem ti řekl, jo?
cz.68e00945790596888eff789e: Už jsem ti chtěl volat. Práce hotová?
cz.68e0094996ebb5f0df948018: Doufám, že máš tu práci hotovou, když sem jdeš.
cz.68e0096f03400edf1ba741cf: Ještě pracuju na tý práci. Přišel jsem si něco ujasnit.
cz.68e0097bb97e1d49ec9d3145: Tak jo, ptej se rychle a vypadni! Rozkaz nepočká.
cz.68e0097f00b5ce7e02bd7497: Co je kurva za problém? Ptej se na co chceš a makej na tý práci.
cz.68e00983d5e90fddf65cad03: Trochu pomalej, co? Fajn, ptej se rychle, dokud mám dobrou náladu.
cz.68e00986bc6793b47074af40: Není to zrovna vhodný. Ale jestli je to rychlá otázka, tak povídej. Ale neignoruj můj rozkaz – budeš litovat.
cz.68e0099a735cf1f097440475: Ještě není hotovo. Vrátím se později.
cz.68e009a8971ac96c291e2cc7: Proč jsi sem vůbec chodil? Mazej!
cz.68e009afcc00ded7361c6dfb: Tak proč tu kurva seš, ty troubo? Dostaň tu práci ze krku!
cz.68e009b36e31d8ecb1fb1863: Co tady teda stojíš? Dokonči tu fušku a pak si popovídáme.
cz.68e009b74bb927beb66b9cf3: Co tady děláš? Dokonči tu práci, pak si pokecáme.
cz.68f510660c8100a6bffea677: Tak co, jak to vypadá? Otevřel jsi už ty dveře?
cz.68f5106d52e32697fc1e8894: Jak jsou na tom ty dveře? Už jsi je otevřel?
cz.68f5107579aef5e938abf4ad: Jak jde práce, dveře vyřešený, nebo co?
cz.68f510830c31424232b031dd: Rychle jsi zpátky, co? Jsou ty dveře otevřený?
cz.68f5108a7cbc5b3c72ccc19d: Jestli jsi tady, tak jsi ty dveře otevřel, jo?
cz.68f510eb64970d5296719423: Koukám na tebe. Takže jsi ty dveře otevřel, jo?
cz.68f512828dd19da0e24e228b: Ještě ne. Jsem zaneprázdněnej s něčím jiným.
cz.68f51466f1158ed8e14e088a: Tak co tady zase chceš, co? Chceš ty informace – nejdřív dokonči tu zatracenou práci!
cz.68f51499384750b629deb27e: Co se tady poflakuješ? Chceš mě ojebat, nebo co?
cz.68f514a06846e22e1e57ab81: Nepromarnuj můj čas. Nejdřív práce, potom kecy!
cz.68f514a5552b3c2da6f215b0: Tak co ode mě chceš? Nejdřív dveře, potom informace – taková byla dohoda.
cz.68f514a902f8fc72a41a6ca7: Seš blbej, nebo co? Dohoda byla jasná jak facka. Proč jsi tady teda?
cz.68f51520448448f759954f69: Nemůžu najít ten tvůj zatracenej klíč. Nemůžeme to nějak zvládnout bez něj?
cz.68f51542eedb0109699c6680: Nějak se ti to plete, kámo. Řekl jsem, že dostaneš informace, až budou dveře otevřený, jednoduchý.
cz.68f5154de9d60063ac7db783: Nezačni to plést. Vzal sis tu práci, tak ji dokonči. Nebo vypadni, ale pak nechoď brečet pro práci.
cz.68f5155407381055d1e83da7: Seš drzej parchant. Tentokrát ti to prominu - teď už přestaň kecat a dělej tu práci. Dohoda je dohoda.
cz.68f5155c2017b0b3c8226adb: Ztratil jsi nit, že? Potřebuju, aby ty dveře byly otevřený, ty chceš informace. Dohoda je dohoda a porušovat dohody dělají jenom zasraný krysy. Ty nejsi krysa, že ne?
cz.68f5156567915f0d08d27b6c: Chceš změnit dohodu uprostřed? Ještě máš čas držet hubu a udělat to pořádně, ale to je poslední varování – už žádný takový sračky potom.
cz.690288d0cacc9f4c45029bda: Právě jsem si uvědomil, že jsem to nedokončil. Potřebuju ještě trochu času.
cz.6902892069f80486a0a13db9: Ještě na tom pracuju. Přišel jsem se tě na něco zeptat.
cz.690e01e627babe3f241e5b8f: Ale takhle se impérium nebuduje. Já věděl, že ten pravej byznys je v Přístavu.
cz.690e01f96b928e8b2df1af08: Jo... Tam se točily pořádný prachy.
cz.690e02632a4c1380b93fa503: Mysleli si, že z nich udělá velkýho šéfa pytel s dovozem?
