ch.69b1b0c525c49d5fcda30e6e: 所以，直升机的事情有消息了吗？
ch.69b1b0cb8115c508a8dbf053: 有，还是你妈天大的好消息！明明储备站里还有敌人，你却发信号让我的人进去了，你是脑子缺根筋还是怎么的？！
ch.69b1b0d18bec898858c5ff94: 我把能找到的敌人都消灭干净了。如果你指望我给整个军事基地来上一场大清洗，那好像是你们军队的职责吧。
ch.69b1b0d8374a086ce4f6fc37: 怎么干活是你的问题，不是我的！我的机师迎面撞上了 Glukhar 手下的那帮人——你管这个叫他妈的“安全”？
ch.69b1b0dec7b95fafb012a66c: 万幸你的人不是废物，所以他们找到你要的东西了没有？
ch.69b1b0e34f8c0490b5690e78: 找到了个屁！我可不会再把他们送回那个屠宰场里去了，明白了没？
ch.69b1b0e8e732b357af3a83d1: 行吧，所以我到底要找什么东西？
ch.69b1b0eece21994c47e4f03e: 特种润滑油，标着 AMG-10 的那种。要么是罐装的，要么就是成箱的。
ch.69b1b0f9dc91538356975433: 上哪，哪……蠢问题一个接一个。兵营中央广场，停着米里直升机的那个地方，在周边找找，或者看看火车站周围堆着的货物里有没有。
ch.69b1b104423294b54cb76d83: 整个基地太大了，单靠我一个人可没法彻底肃清整个地方。
ch.69b1b109baa31cfa9c9a5412: 虽然我讨厌你找借口的样子，但你说的有点道理。
ch.69b1b10e187a4c3720b85854: 所以他们拿到货物了吗？
ch.69b1b113042111c529cffbb2: 没有，他们在路上被 Glukhar 那帮人截住了，
ch.69b1b1189c99f1875621e4f5: 好了，那我要找的是什么？
ch.69b1b11e17d424b6761bb121: 特种润滑油，也叫液压油，AMG-10 型号的。
ch.69b1b12565c964a5f8c233d8: 你的机修师原本打算上哪找这东西来着？
ch.69b1b129a28bcd34a17c9d3b: 去军营广场上那架米里直升机周围看看吧，
ch.69e0fa8d50dc377cadeab6f5: 还好我的人不是和你们这些 PMC 一样的废物，要不然就逃不出来了！
ch.69e0fa9b6ba0a9df07883db3: 还好我派出去的人不是什么菜鸟，他们遇到状况后就及时撤出来了。
ch.69e0fab3a57b8e7f19e6d86d: 你自己搞出来的烂摊子，现在就交给你来收场，自己提着脑袋去储备站里找吧。
ch.69e0fadc67a1e509facf3f34: 我可不会再把宝贵的机修师送进那个地方了。既然是你提出来的要用那架直升机，那就由你负责搞定这件事。
ch.69e0faeb503634e6ccf1f121: 别他妈想着拿普通机油糊弄我！
ch.69e0fb10180fdd55010b571e: 一般是罐装的，或者装在其他容器里。没了这东西就没法飞。
ch.69e0fb2139034c3f7f2d9268: 如果你还想搭我的宝贝直升机，你就自己去搞明白。
ch.69e0fb4b778e97edc4a214cf: 如果那里没有的话，到火车站平台那边的仓库找找。哦，对了，搞不好军事学院的地下室里有，你应该知道的，标着黑主教棋子的那栋楼。

cz.69b1b0c525c49d5fcda30e6e: Tak co, nějaké novinky ohledně chopperu?
cz.69b1b0cb8115c508a8dbf053: Jo, kurva skvělé zprávy! Proč sakra jsi dal mým lidem zelenou, když tam pořád byli nepřátelé?!
cz.69b1b0d18bec898858c5ff94: Zlikvidoval jsem každého, koho jsem našel. Pokud jsi čekal kompletní vyčištění celé vojenské základny, je to tvůj problém.
cz.69b1b0d8374a086ce4f6fc37: Jak tu práci uděláš, to není můj problém! Moji technici narazili na Glukharovy kluky. Tohle je podle tebe „bezpečno“?
cz.69b1b0dec7b95fafb012a66c: Ještě že to nejsou žádní zelenáči. Dostali to, co potřebovali?
cz.69b1b0e34f8c0490b5690e78: Kéž by! A do dalšího mlýnku na maso je posílat nebudu, jasný?
cz.69b1b0eece21994c47e4f03e: Speciální mazivo. AMG-10. Bývá v kanystrech nebo bednách.
cz.69b1b0f9dc91538356975433: Kde, kde... Podívej se k té MI helikoptéře na buzerplace u kasáren, nebo prohledej náklad u vlakových nástupišť.
cz.69b1b104423294b54cb76d83: Nemůžu fyzicky garantovat stoprocentní bezpečnost na tak velkém prostoru.
cz.69b1b113042111c529cffbb2: Ne. Glukharovi kluci je dostali už při příchodu.
cz.69b1b12565c964a5f8c233d8: Kde to tvoji technici měli v plánu najít?
cz.69b1b129a28bcd34a17c9d3b: Podívej se k té MI helikoptéře na buzerplace u kasáren.
cz.69e0fa8d50dc377cadeab6f5: Kdyby to byli ještě větší zelenáči, tak by se odtamtud ani nedostali!
cz.69e0fa9b6ba0a9df07883db3: Ještě že jsem poslal zkušené borce. Stáhli se včas.
cz.69e0fab3a57b8e7f19e6d86d: Riskneš vlastní prdel a najdeš si to sám.
cz.69e0fadc67a1e509facf3f34: A cenné techniky už znova nepošlu. Jestli to chceš, běž sám.
cz.69e0faeb503634e6ccf1f121: A neopovažuj se mi přinést obyčejný motorový olej!
cz.69e0fb10180fdd55010b571e: Obvykle se skladuje v kanystrech nebo kontejnerech. Bez toho se nedá lítat.
cz.69e0fb2139034c3f7f2d9268: Jestli fakt stojíš o můj chopper, tak si poradíš.
cz.69e0fb4b778e97edc4a214cf: Pokud to nebude tam, zkus nástupiště, nákladové prostory, možná sklep akademie. Však víš, Black Bishop.

en.69b1b0c525c49d5fcda30e6e: So, any news on the chopper?
en.69b1b0cb8115c508a8dbf053: Yeah, great fucking news! Why the hell did you give my guys the green light while there were still hostiles there?!
en.69b1b0d18bec898858c5ff94: I took out everyone I found. If you expected a full sweep of the whole military base, that’s on you.
en.69b1b0d8374a086ce4f6fc37: How you do the job isn’t my problem! My techs ran into Glukhar’s boys. Is that your idea of “safe”?
en.69b1b0dec7b95fafb012a66c: Good thing they’re not green then. Did they get what they needed?
en.69b1b0e34f8c0490b5690e78: As if! And I’m not sending them back into a meat grinder, got it?
en.69b1b0e8e732b357af3a83d1: Fine. What am I looking for?
en.69b1b0eece21994c47e4f03e: Special lubricant. AMG-10. Comes in canisters or crates.
en.69b1b0f9dc91538356975433: Where, where… Check near the MI bird on the barracks square, or look through the cargo by the train platforms.
en.69b1b104423294b54cb76d83: I can’t physically guarantee full security on a site that big.
en.69b1b109baa31cfa9c9a5412: You piss me off, but you’re right.
en.69b1b10e187a4c3720b85854: Did they manage to grab the cargo?
en.69b1b113042111c529cffbb2: Nope. Glukhar’s boys caught them on the approach.
en.69b1b12565c964a5f8c233d8: Where were your techs planning to find it?
en.69b1b129a28bcd34a17c9d3b: Check near the MI bird on the barracks square.
en.69e0fa8d50dc377cadeab6f5: If they were any greener, they wouldn’t have made it out!
en.69e0fa9b6ba0a9df07883db3: Good thing I sent experienced guys. They pulled back in time.
en.69e0fab3a57b8e7f19e6d86d: You’ll risk your own ass and find it yourself.
en.69e0fadc67a1e509facf3f34: And I’m not sending valuable techs again. You want it, you go.
en.69e0faeb503634e6ccf1f121: And don’t you dare bring me regular engine oil!
en.69e0fb10180fdd55010b571e: Usually stored in canisters or containers. Can’t fly without it.
en.69e0fb2139034c3f7f2d9268: If you really want my chopper, you’ll figure it out.
en.69e0fb4b778e97edc4a214cf: If it’s not there, try the platforms, cargo areas, maybe the academy basement. You know, Black Bishop.

it.69b1b0cb8115c508a8dbf053: Sì, che cazzo di notizia fantastica! Perché diavolo ha dato il via libera ai miei uomini mentre c'erano ancora nemici lì?!
it.69b1b0d18bec898858c5ff94: Ho eliminato tutti quelli che ho trovato. Se ti aspettavi una bonifica completa dell'intera base militare, è colpa tua.
it.69b1b0d8374a086ce4f6fc37: Come svolge il lavoro non è un mio problema! I miei tecnici si sono imbattuti negli uomini di Glukhar. È questa la sua idea di "sicurezza"?
it.69b1b0dec7b95fafb012a66c: Meno male che non sono verdi, allora. Hanno ottenuto ciò di cui avevano bisogno?
it.69b1b0e34f8c0490b5690e78: Ma no! E non li rimanderò in quel tritacarne, capito?
it.69b1b0eece21994c47e4f03e: Lubrificante speciale. AMG-10. Disponibile in taniche o casse.
it.69b1b0f9dc91538356975433: Dove, dove… Controlla vicino all’elicottero MI nella piazza della caserma, oppure cerca tra i carichi vicino ai binari del treno.
it.69b1b104423294b54cb76d83: Non posso garantire fisicamente la totale sicurezza in un sito così vasto.
it.69b1b109baa31cfa9c9a5412: Mi fa arrabbiare, ma ha ragione.
it.69b1b10e187a4c3720b85854: Sono riusciti a impossessarsi del carico?
it.69b1b113042111c529cffbb2: No. Gli uomini di Glukhar li hanno intercettati mentre si avvicinavano.
it.69b1b1189c99f1875621e4f5: Va bene. Di cosa ho bisogno?
it.69b1b12565c964a5f8c233d8: Dove pensavano di trovarlo i suoi tecnici?
it.69b1b129a28bcd34a17c9d3b: Controlli vicino all'uccello MI nella piazza della caserma.
it.69e0fa8d50dc377cadeab6f5: Se fossero stati ancora più inesperti, non ce l'avrebbero fatta!
it.69e0fa9b6ba0a9df07883db3: Meno male che ho mandato dei ragazzi esperti. Si sono ritirati in tempo.
it.69e0fab3a57b8e7f19e6d86d: Rischierà la vita e lo scoprirà da solo.
it.69e0fadc67a1e509facf3f34: E non manderò di nuovo tecnici di valore. Se lo vuoi, ci vai tu.
it.69e0faeb503634e6ccf1f121: E non osare portarmi del normale olio motore!
it.69e0fb10180fdd55010b571e: Di solito conservato in bombole o contenitori. Non si può volare senza.
it.69e0fb2139034c3f7f2d9268: Se vuoi davvero il mio elicottero, troverai il modo.
it.69e0fb4b778e97edc4a214cf: Se non è lì, prova sulle piattaforme, nelle aree di carico, magari nel seminterrato dell'accademia. Sai com'è, Black Bishop.

kr.69b1b0cb8115c508a8dbf053: 아주 좋은 소식이네! 왜 자네가 조명탄을 쏴서 우리 애들이 와도 좋다고 했을 떄 여전히 적이 남아있던 거지?!
kr.69b1b0d18bec898858c5ff94: 내 눈에 보이는 건 닥치는 대로 쏴죽이고 다녔다고. 나더러 그 기지를 통째로 쓸어버리라 한거면, 그건 자네의 희망사항 아니야?
kr.69b1b0d8374a086ce4f6fc37: 자네가 어떻게 일을 처리하는 지 내가 신경이나 쓸 것 같나! 우리 공병 애들이 가다가 글루하 애들이랑 만났다는데, 이게 자네가 보기엔 “안전”한 건가?
kr.69b1b0dec7b95fafb012a66c: 짬찌 새끼들은 아니라서 살아 나오긴 했네. 그래서 필요한 건 가지고 나왔대?
kr.69b1b0e34f8c0490b5690e78: 가지고 나왔겠나! 난 무슨 일이 있어도 다신 그 곳으로 우리 애들을 보낼 생각은 추호도 없네, 알겠나?
kr.69b1b0e8e732b357af3a83d1: 그래, 그래. 뭘 찾으면 되는 거지?
kr.69b1b0eece21994c47e4f03e: 특수 윤활유네. AMG-10이라고 하는 물건인데, 전용 용기나 상자 따위에 있을 걸세.
kr.69b1b0f9dc91538356975433: 어디에 있었더라, 보자… Mi-26 헬기 근처에 있는 막사 안에 있거나, 아니면 기차역 플랫폼에 있을 거다.
kr.69b1b104423294b54cb76d83: 내가 그 정도나 되는 구역을 확보하는 건 물리적으로 불가능해.
kr.69b1b109baa31cfa9c9a5412: 하, 새끼.. 말은 또 잘 하는구만.
kr.69b1b10e187a4c3720b85854: 필요한 건 챙겨 오지도 못 했겠네?
kr.69b1b113042111c529cffbb2: 그런 셈이지. 가는 길에 글루하 새끼들한테 걸려 버려가지고.
kr.69b1b12565c964a5f8c233d8: 그 공병 애들은 어디로 가려고 했는데?
kr.69b1b129a28bcd34a17c9d3b: Mi-26 헬기 근처에 있는 막사에 가려고 했었네.
kr.69e0fa8d50dc377cadeab6f5: 짬 찬 애들이 아니였으면 살아 돌아오지도 못 했다고!
kr.69e0fa9b6ba0a9df07883db3: 그나마 짬 찬 애들을 보내서 망정이지. 제 때에 빠져나올 수 있었으니까.
kr.69e0fadc67a1e509facf3f34: 난 공병 애들이 없으면 안 되니까, 타고 싶은 사람이 가져와야지. 안 그렇나?

pl.69b1b0c525c49d5fcda30e6e: So, any news on the chopper?
pl.69b1b0cb8115c508a8dbf053: Yeah, great fucking news! Why the hell did you give my guys the green light while there were still hostiles there?!
pl.69b1b0d18bec898858c5ff94: I took out everyone I found. If you expected a full sweep of the whole military base, that’s on you.
pl.69b1b0d8374a086ce4f6fc37: How you do the job isn’t my problem! My techs ran into Glukhar’s boys. Is that your idea of “safe”?
pl.69b1b0dec7b95fafb012a66c: Good thing they’re not green then. Did they get what they needed?
pl.69b1b0e34f8c0490b5690e78: As if! And I’m not sending them back into a meat grinder, got it?
pl.69b1b0e8e732b357af3a83d1: Fine. What am I looking for?
pl.69b1b0eece21994c47e4f03e: Special lubricant. AMG-10. Comes in canisters or crates.
pl.69b1b0f9dc91538356975433: Where, where… Check near the MI bird on the barracks square, or look through the cargo by the train platforms.
pl.69b1b104423294b54cb76d83: I can’t physically guarantee full security on a site that big.
pl.69b1b109baa31cfa9c9a5412: You piss me off, but you’re right.
pl.69b1b10e187a4c3720b85854: Did they manage to grab the cargo?
pl.69b1b113042111c529cffbb2: Nope. Glukhar’s boys caught them on the approach.
pl.69b1b12565c964a5f8c233d8: Where were your techs planning to find it?
pl.69b1b129a28bcd34a17c9d3b: Check near the MI bird on the barracks square.
pl.69e0fa8d50dc377cadeab6f5: If they were any greener, they wouldn’t have made it out!
pl.69e0fa9b6ba0a9df07883db3: Good thing I sent experienced guys. They pulled back in time.
pl.69e0fab3a57b8e7f19e6d86d: You’ll risk your own ass and find it yourself.
pl.69e0fadc67a1e509facf3f34: And I’m not sending valuable techs again. You want it, you go.
pl.69e0faeb503634e6ccf1f121: And don’t you dare bring me regular engine oil!
pl.69e0fb10180fdd55010b571e: Usually stored in canisters or containers. Can’t fly without it.
pl.69e0fb2139034c3f7f2d9268: If you really want my chopper, you’ll figure it out.
pl.69e0fb4b778e97edc4a214cf: If it’s not there, try the platforms, cargo areas, maybe the academy basement. You know, Black Bishop.

po.69b1b0c525c49d5fcda30e6e: E aí, alguma novidade sobre o helicóptero?
po.69b1b0cb8115c508a8dbf053: Sim, ótimas notícias, porra! Porquê diabos você deu sinal verde para meus caras enquanto ainda havia inimigos lá?!
po.69b1b0d18bec898858c5ff94: Eliminei todos que encontrei. Se você esperava uma varredura completa de toda a base militar, isso é problema seu.
po.69b1b0d8374a086ce4f6fc37: Como você faz o trabalho não é meu problema! Meus técnicos se encontraram com os caras do Glukhar. É isso que você chama de "seguro"?
po.69b1b0dec7b95fafb012a66c: Ainda bem que não são novatos então. Eles conseguiram o que precisavam?
po.69b1b0e34f8c0490b5690e78: Claro que não! E não vou mandá-los de volta para o picador de carne, entendeu?
po.69b1b0e8e732b357af3a83d1: Tudo bem. O que estou procurando?
po.69b1b0eece21994c47e4f03e: Lubrificante especial. AMG-10. Vem em galões ou caixotes.
po.69b1b0f9dc91538356975433: Onde, onde… Verifique perto do helicóptero MI na praça dos barracões, ou procure nas cargas perto das plataformas de trem.
po.69b1b104423294b54cb76d83: Não posso garantir fisicamente segurança total num local tão grande.
po.69b1b109baa31cfa9c9a5412: Você me irrita, mas você está certo.
po.69b1b113042111c529cffbb2: Não. Os caras do Glukhar os pegaram na aproximação.
po.69b1b1189c99f1875621e4f5: Tudo bem. O que eu preciso?
po.69b1b129a28bcd34a17c9d3b: Verifique perto do helicóptero MI na praça dos barracões.
po.69e0fa8d50dc377cadeab6f5: Se fossem mais novatos, não teriam saído!
po.69e0fa9b6ba0a9df07883db3: Ainda bem que mandei caras experientes. Recuaram a tempo.
po.69e0fab3a57b8e7f19e6d86d: Você que arrisque o seu próprio rabo e encontre sozinho.
po.69e0fadc67a1e509facf3f34: E não vou mandar técnicos valiosos de novo. Você quer, você vai.
po.69e0faeb503634e6ccf1f121: E não ouse me trazer óleo de motor comum!
po.69e0fb10180fdd55010b571e: Geralmente armazenado em galões ou contêineres. Não dá para voar sem isso.
po.69e0fb2139034c3f7f2d9268: Se você realmente quer meu helicóptero, vai descobrir.
po.69e0fb4b778e97edc4a214cf: Se não estiver lá, tente as plataformas, áreas de carga, talvez o porão da academia. Você sabe, Bispo Preto.

ru.69b1b0d8374a086ce4f6fc37: Как ты делаешь работу – меня не колышит! Техников там бойцы Глухаря встретили, это по-твоему безопасно?
ru.69b1b0dec7b95fafb012a66c: Тогда хорошо, что техники не зелёные. Они забрали, что было нужно?
ru.69b1b0e34f8c0490b5690e78: Хер там! И во второй раз отправлять их на убой я не буду, понял?
ru.69b1b0eece21994c47e4f03e: Смазку одну, особую. Называется АМГ-10, хранится в канистрах или ящиках специальных.
ru.69b1b0f9dc91538356975433: Где-где… У «Мишки» на плацу глянь, или на перроне поищи среди грузов.
ru.69b1b104423294b54cb76d83: Я физически не могу гарантировать тебе полную безопасность на таком большом объекте.
ru.69b1b109baa31cfa9c9a5412: Бесишь ты меня, но говоришь правильно.
ru.69b1b113042111c529cffbb2: Хер там. Их ещё на подходах бойцы Глухаря встретили.
ru.69b1b12565c964a5f8c233d8: А где техники собирались её найти?
ru.69b1b129a28bcd34a17c9d3b: В первую очередь рядом с «Мишкой» на плацу.
ru.69e0fa8d50dc377cadeab6f5: Если б они позеленее были, может и уйти бы не смогли!
ru.69e0fa9b6ba0a9df07883db3: Благо я проверенных парней на задачу отправил, успели отступить вовремя.
ru.69e0fab3a57b8e7f19e6d86d: Сам искать будешь и своей собственной жопой рисковать.
ru.69e0fadc67a1e509facf3f34: И во второй раз я такие ценные кадры туда не отправлю. Тебе надо – ты и мотайся.
ru.69e0faeb503634e6ccf1f121: И только попробуй притащить мне машинное масло!

vi.69b1b0d8374a086ce4f6fc37: How you do the job isn’t my problem! My techs ran into Glukhar’s boys. Is that your idea of “safe”?
vi.69b1b0dec7b95fafb012a66c: Good thing they’re not green then. Did they get what they needed?
vi.69b1b0e34f8c0490b5690e78: As if! And I’m not sending them back into a meat grinder, got it?
vi.69b1b0e8e732b357af3a83d1: Fine. What am I looking for?
vi.69b1b0eece21994c47e4f03e: Special lubricant. AMG-10. Comes in canisters or crates.
vi.69b1b0f9dc91538356975433: Where, where… Check near the MI bird on the barracks square, or look through the cargo by the train platforms.
vi.69b1b104423294b54cb76d83: I can’t physically guarantee full security on a site that big.
vi.69b1b109baa31cfa9c9a5412: You piss me off, but you’re right.
vi.69b1b10e187a4c3720b85854: Did they manage to grab the cargo?
vi.69b1b113042111c529cffbb2: Nope. Glukhar’s boys caught them on the approach.
vi.69b1b12565c964a5f8c233d8: Where were your techs planning to find it?
vi.69b1b129a28bcd34a17c9d3b: Check near the MI bird on the barracks square.
vi.69e0fa8d50dc377cadeab6f5: If they were any greener, they wouldn’t have made it out!
vi.69e0fa9b6ba0a9df07883db3: Good thing I sent experienced guys. They pulled back in time.
vi.69e0fab3a57b8e7f19e6d86d: You’ll risk your own ass and find it yourself.
vi.69e0fadc67a1e509facf3f34: And I’m not sending valuable techs again. You want it, you go.
vi.69e0faeb503634e6ccf1f121: And don’t you dare bring me regular engine oil!
vi.69e0fb10180fdd55010b571e: Usually stored in canisters or containers. Can’t fly without it.
vi.69e0fb2139034c3f7f2d9268: If you really want my chopper, you’ll figure it out.
vi.69e0fb4b778e97edc4a214cf: If it’s not there, try the platforms, cargo areas, maybe the academy basement. You know, Black Bishop.

ch.69b29e8b3b0359d6c3b2ae25: 我把润滑油给你的直升机找来了。(上交 AMG-10)
ch.69b29e91f9c1bbad7f095031: 把东西放在门口吧，我会让狗腿们把直升机整备好的。
ch.69b29e9cef2ec00a6b313d86: 情况是这样的……我和飞行员谈了一下，所以我直说好了：
ch.69b29ec75e95813ee6a6a14f: 那我折腾这一通到底是为了什么？！
ch.69b29ecdfc357f883af19b4d: 冷静点，行吗？我又不是在拿你寻开心。
ch.69b29eeb35d7d357e1347951: 为什么上船的时候不能坐直升机进去？
ch.69b29ef3280e0ca3cfdc02d7: 你认真的？到底是什么原因？
ch.69b29ef925620fd0b79f33c3: 你会坐上那架直升机的，只不过仅限撤离的时候。
ch.69b29f03a8894d44143addfb: 为什么上船的时候不能坐直升机进去？
ch.69b2a63c510676717e11c977: 风险太高了。谁也不知道船上到底是什么人，搞不好直升机都会折进去，还要搭上整个机组。
ch.69b2a6413988ff46d7255a0f: 这是他们告诉你的，还是单纯你自己不想冒这个险？
ch.69e114d62571f3310c8c8aaa: 他们不会贸然飞到那艘船上的，我们对船上的情况一无所知。
ch.69e11506e11e3b6cbe5a76ef: 你会坐上那架直升机的，只不过仅限撤离的时候。进去的时候你就自己想其他办法吧。
ch.69e1150ad51d1916dd6045ee: 进去的时候你就自己想其他办法吧。
ch.69e115315d26e78e846b750e: 进去的时候你就自己想其他办法吧。
ch.69e115509d51eac968b28895: 所以这直升机你是坐还是不坐？
ch.69e1158f7751ae091bdf8e09: 所以这直升机你是坐还是不坐？
ch.69e115b1b32c7453f6052a4b: 直升机只能在合适的停机坪上起降。你说的那条船上最好是有这样的地方。
ch.69e115b655dca8595e9fcdd1: 把地方清空，打上一颗信号弹，然后直升机就会来接你了。
ch.69e115d540248bc99d17d2b1: 别忘了带钱。直升机每次出动都是要花钱的，别逼我们把你扔在船上。

cz.69b29e8b3b0359d6c3b2ae25: Přinesl jsem olej pro tvou helikoptéru. (Předat AMG-10)
cz.69b29e91f9c1bbad7f095031: Nech to u vchodu. Řeknu klukům, ať mašinu připraví.
cz.69b29e9cef2ec00a6b313d86: Situace se má tak... Mluvil jsem s piloty. Budu k tobě upřímnej:
cz.69b29ec75e95813ee6a6a14f: Tak k čemu to sakra celé bylo?!
cz.69b29ecdfc357f883af19b4d: Klídek, jo? Nesnažím se tě ojebávat.
cz.69b29ef3280e0ca3cfdc02d7: Myslíš to vážně? V čem je problém?
cz.69b29ef925620fd0b79f33c3: Dostaneš chopper, ale jenom na extraction z lodi.
cz.69b2a63c510676717e11c977: Moc velký risk. Nikdo neví, kdo se na té lodi zakopal. Mohl bych přijít o mašinu i o posádku.
cz.69b2a6413988ff46d7255a0f: Tohle ti řekli oni, nebo jenom nechceš riskovat vlastní helikoptéru?
cz.69e11506e11e3b6cbe5a76ef: Dostaneš chopper, ale jenom na extraction z lodi.
cz.69e1150ad51d1916dd6045ee: Abys se dostal dovnitř, budeš muset vymyslet něco jinýho.
cz.69e115315d26e78e846b750e: Abys se dostal dovnitř, budeš muset vymyslet něco jinýho.
cz.69e115509d51eac968b28895: Takže, bereš ten chopper, nebo ne?
cz.69e1158f7751ae091bdf8e09: Takže, bereš tu helikoptéru, nebo ne?
cz.69e115b1b32c7453f6052a4b: Chopper tě může vyzvednout jen z pořádné přistávací zóny. Doufám, že ta tvoje loď nějakou má.
cz.69e115b655dca8595e9fcdd1: Vyčisti to, odpal signální světlici a mašina přiletí.
cz.69e115d540248bc99d17d2b1: Nezapomeň si vzít hotovost. Každej let něco stojí.

en.69b29e8b3b0359d6c3b2ae25: I’ve brought the oil for your helicopter. (Hand over the AMG-10)
en.69b29e91f9c1bbad7f095031: Leave it by the entrance. I’ll have the boys prep the bird.
en.69b29e9cef2ec00a6b313d86: Here’s the situation… I talked to the pilots. I’ll be straight with you:
en.69b29ec75e95813ee6a6a14f: Then what the hell was all that for?!
en.69b29ecdfc357f883af19b4d: Calm down, alright? I’m not screwing you over.
en.69b29eeb35d7d357e1347951: Why won’t they do the insertion?
en.69b29ef3280e0ca3cfdc02d7: Are you serious? What’s the problem?
en.69b29ef925620fd0b79f33c3: You’ll get the chopper, but only for extraction from the ship.
en.69b2a63c510676717e11c977: Too risky. There’s no telling who’s dug in on that ship. I could lose the bird, crew included.
en.69b2a6413988ff46d7255a0f: Is that what they told you, or you just don’t want to risk your heli?
en.69e114d62571f3310c8c8aaa: they’re not flying to some unknown ship.
en.69e11506e11e3b6cbe5a76ef: You’ll get the chopper, but only for extraction from the ship.
en.69e1150ad51d1916dd6045ee: To get in, you’ll have to figure something else out.
en.69e115315d26e78e846b750e: To get in, you’ll have to figure something else out.
en.69e115509d51eac968b28895: So, you taking the chopper or not?
en.69e115760a272fe1f22b4175: And I don’t have spare pilots.
en.69e1158f7751ae091bdf8e09: So, you taking the heli or not?
en.69e115b1b32c7453f6052a4b: The chopper can only pick you up from a proper landing zone. Hope your ship’s got one.
en.69e115b655dca8595e9fcdd1: Clear it, pop a signal flare, and the bird will come in.
en.69e115d540248bc99d17d2b1: Don’t forget to bring cash. Every flight costs money.

it.69b29e8b3b0359d6c3b2ae25: Ho portato l'olio per il suo elicottero. (Consegna l'AMG-10)
it.69b29e91f9c1bbad7f095031: Lo lascio all'ingresso. Dirò ai ragazzi di preparare l'uccello.
it.69b29e9cef2ec00a6b313d86: La situazione è questa... Ho parlato con i piloti. Sarò sincero con te:
it.69b29ec75e95813ee6a6a14f: Allora a che diavolo è servito tutto questo?!
it.69b29ecdfc357f883af19b4d: Si calmi, va bene? Non la sto fregando.
it.69b29ef3280e0ca3cfdc02d7: Dici sul serio? Qual è il problema?
it.69b29ef925620fd0b79f33c3: Avrete l'elicottero, ma solo per l'evacuazione dalla nave.
it.69b29f03a8894d44143addfb: Qual è il problema con l'inserimento?
it.69b2a63c510676717e11c977: Troppo rischioso. Non si può sapere chi si sia trincerato su quella nave. Potrei perdere l'aereo, equipaggio compreso.
it.69b2a6413988ff46d7255a0f: È questo che le hanno detto, o semplicemente non vuole mettere a rischio il suo elicottero?
it.69e114d62571f3310c8c8aaa: Non stanno volando verso una nave sconosciuta.
it.69e11506e11e3b6cbe5a76ef: Avrete l'elicottero, ma solo per l'evacuazione dalla nave.
it.69e115760a272fe1f22b4175: E non ho piloti di riserva.
it.69e115b1b32c7453f6052a4b: L'elicottero può prelevarla solo da una zona di atterraggio adeguata. Spero che la tua nave ne abbia una.
it.69e115b655dca8595e9fcdd1: Sgombera l'area, lancia un razzo di segnalazione e l'elicottero arriverà.
it.69e115d540248bc99d17d2b1: Non dimenticare di portare contanti. Ogni volo costa denaro.

jp.69b29e8b3b0359d6c3b2ae25: ヘリ用のオイルを持ってきたぞ。(AMG-10 を渡す)
jp.69b29e91f9c1bbad7f095031: 入口のそばに置いておけ。機体の準備は部下に任せる。
jp.69b29e9cef2ec00a6b313d86: 事情はこうだ... パイロットたちと話した。率直に言うと、
jp.69b29ec75e95813ee6a6a14f: Then what the hell was all that for?!
jp.69b29ecdfc357f883af19b4d: Calm down, alright? I’m not screwing you over.
jp.69b29eeb35d7d357e1347951: Why won’t they do the insertion?
jp.69b29ef3280e0ca3cfdc02d7: 本気で言ってるのか？何が問題なんだ？
jp.69b29ef925620fd0b79f33c3: ヘリは用意するが、船からの脱出用だけだ。
jp.69b29f03a8894d44143addfb: 入るのにどんな問題があるんだ？
jp.69b2a63c510676717e11c977: リスクが高すぎる。あの船に誰が潜んでいるか分からない。機体も乗組員もすべて失うことになるかもしれない。

pl.69b29e8b3b0359d6c3b2ae25: I’ve brought the oil for your helicopter. (Hand over the AMG-10)
pl.69b29e91f9c1bbad7f095031: Leave it by the entrance. I’ll have the boys prep the bird.
pl.69b29e9cef2ec00a6b313d86: Here’s the situation… I talked to the pilots. I’ll be straight with you:
pl.69b29ec75e95813ee6a6a14f: Then what the hell was all that for?!
pl.69b29ecdfc357f883af19b4d: Calm down, alright? I’m not screwing you over.
pl.69b29eeb35d7d357e1347951: Why won’t they do the insertion?
pl.69b29ef3280e0ca3cfdc02d7: Are you serious? What’s the problem?
pl.69b29ef925620fd0b79f33c3: You’ll get the chopper, but only for extraction from the ship.
pl.69b2a63c510676717e11c977: Too risky. There’s no telling who’s dug in on that ship. I could lose the bird, crew included.
pl.69b2a6413988ff46d7255a0f: Is that what they told you, or you just don’t want to risk your heli?
pl.69e114d62571f3310c8c8aaa: they’re not flying to some unknown ship.
pl.69e11506e11e3b6cbe5a76ef: You’ll get the chopper, but only for extraction from the ship.
pl.69e1150ad51d1916dd6045ee: To get in, you’ll have to figure something else out.
pl.69e115315d26e78e846b750e: To get in, you’ll have to figure something else out.
pl.69e115509d51eac968b28895: So, you taking the chopper or not?
pl.69e115760a272fe1f22b4175: And I don’t have spare pilots.
pl.69e1158f7751ae091bdf8e09: So, you taking the heli or not?
pl.69e115b1b32c7453f6052a4b: The chopper can only pick you up from a proper landing zone. Hope your ship’s got one.
pl.69e115b655dca8595e9fcdd1: Clear it, pop a signal flare, and the bird will come in.
pl.69e115d540248bc99d17d2b1: Don’t forget to bring cash. Every flight costs money.

po.69b29e8b3b0359d6c3b2ae25: Trouxe o óleo para o seu helicóptero. (Entregar o AMG-10)
po.69b29e91f9c1bbad7f095031: Deixa na entrada. Vou mandar os caras prepararem a máquina.
po.69b29e9cef2ec00a6b313d86: É o seguinte… Falei com os pilotos. Vou ser direto com você:
po.69b29ec75e95813ee6a6a14f: Então pra que diabos foi tudo isso?!
po.69b29ecdfc357f883af19b4d: Calma, tá? Não estou te enganando.
po.69b29eeb35d7d357e1347951: Por que eles não farão a inserção?

po.69b29ef925620fd0b79f33c3: Você vai ter o helicóptero, mas só para extração do navio.
po.69b29f03a8894d44143addfb: Qual é o problema com a inserção?
po.69b2a63c510676717e11c977: Arriscado demais. Não tem como saber quem está entrincheirado naquele navio. Posso perder a aeronave, tripulação incluída.
po.69b2a6413988ff46d7255a0f: Foi isso que te disseram, ou você simplesmente não quer arriscar o seu helicóptero?
po.69e114d62571f3310c8c8aaa: eles não vão voar até algum navio desconhecido.
po.69e11506e11e3b6cbe5a76ef: Você vai ter o helicóptero, mas só para extração do navio.
po.69e1150ad51d1916dd6045ee: Para entrar, vai ter que descobrir outro jeito.
po.69e115315d26e78e846b750e: Para entrar, vai ter que descobrir outro jeito.
po.69e115509d51eac968b28895: Então, vai querer o helicóptero ou não?
po.69e1158f7751ae091bdf8e09: Então, vai querer o helicóptero ou não?
po.69e115b1b32c7453f6052a4b: O helicóptero só pode te buscar em uma zona de pouso adequada. Espero que o seu navio tenha uma.
po.69e115b655dca8595e9fcdd1: Limpe a área, acenda um sinalizador, e a aeronave vai chegar.
po.69e115d540248bc99d17d2b1: Não esqueça de trazer dinheiro. Todo voo tem um custo.

es.69b29e8b3b0359d6c3b2ae25: Te he traído el aceite para tu helicóptero. (Entrega el AMG-10)

es.69e114d62571f3310c8c8aaa: no van a volar hacia un barco desconocido.
es.69e11506e11e3b6cbe5a76ef: Tendrás tu helicóptero, pero solo para extraer del barco.
es.69e1150ad51d1916dd6045ee: Para entrar, vas a tener que ingeniártelas y encontrar otra manera.

es.69e1158f7751ae091bdf8e09: Entonces, ¿vas a querer el helicóptero o no?

es.69e115b655dca8595e9fcdd1: Despeja el área, dispara una bengala y el helicóptero vendrá a buscarte.
es.69e115d540248bc99d17d2b1: No olvides llevar el dinero. Cada vuelo cuesta pasta.

ch.69b29bc509f4a9c22739144e: 我带来了你要的滤波器。
ch.69b29bcb80e80ac196d97d47: 出门的时候交给我的手下就行。
ch.69b29bd1fdced3249f170cdf: 所以现在我们能聊聊你那架直升机的事情了？
ch.69b29bd6ab43ad2908ff3199: 好了，我们是可以谈谈。首先，那架飞机还需要维护。
ch.69b29bdf27b70dfebb0f7b98: 所以我只要等着就好了？
ch.69b29be537964e43c9dbfd85: 啥？你是不是还指望我派人给你的藏身处送瓶啤酒，免得你等得无聊了？
ch.69b29bed176d68aad268ecab: 去储备站好好找找，给我弄一种航空润滑油回来，叫 AMG-10 的那种。
ch.69b29bf380bf4d274f26c552: 那我具体该上哪儿去找？
ch.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: 你是不是以为帮我干了点活，自己就有资格来和我谈条件，让我帮你把一切都准备好了？
ch.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: 以及，不，我不会让你靠近那架飞机的，想都别想。
ch.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: 要么是用罐子装的，要么就是在特殊的容器里。
ch.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: 你想搭直升机，就用用脑子，自己去找！

cz.69b29bc509f4a9c22739144e: Přinesl jsem ty filtry, co jsi chtěl.
cz.69b29bcb80e80ac196d97d47: Předej je mým lidem při odchodu.
cz.69b29bd1fdced3249f170cdf: Takže teď už se můžeme pobavit o té tvojí helikoptéře?
cz.69b29bd6ab43ad2908ff3199: Dobrá, můžeme si pokecat. Nejdřív ale potřebuje údržbu.
cz.69b29be537964e43c9dbfd85: Co bys chtěl, abych ti poslal pivo do hideoutu, aby ses nenudil?
cz.69b29bed176d68aad268ecab: Prohledej základnu Reserve. Budeš potřebovat leteckej olej, jmenuje se AMG-10.
cz.69b29bf380bf4d274f26c552: A kde přesně to mám hledat?
cz.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: Fakt si myslíš, že po tom všem, co jsi udělal, ti budu pomáhat ještě s tvojí prací?
cz.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: A ne, k takovému stroji tě ani nepustím.
cz.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: Skladuje se v kanystrech nebo speciálních kontejnerech.
cz.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: Jestli chceš tu helikoptéru, zapoj mozek a najdi si to sám.

en.69b29bc509f4a9c22739144e: I brought the filters you asked for.
en.69b29bcb80e80ac196d97d47: Hand them over to my guys on the way out.
en.69b29bd1fdced3249f170cdf: So now we can talk about your helicopter?
en.69b29bd6ab43ad2908ff3199: Alright, we can talk. First, it needs maintenance.
en.69b29bdf27b70dfebb0f7b98: So I just have to wait?
en.69b29be537964e43c9dbfd85: What, you want me to send you a beer to your hideout so you don’t get bored?
en.69b29beaaa0a7717b85c56c0: Then what needs to be done?
en.69b29bed176d68aad268ecab: Check the Reserve base. You’ll need aviation oil, called AMG-10.
en.69b29bf380bf4d274f26c552: And where exactly should I look for it?
en.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: You really think that after everything you’ve done I’m going to help you with your job too?
en.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: And no, I’m not letting you anywhere near a machine like that.
en.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: It’s stored in canisters or special containers.
en.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: You want the helicopter, use your head and find it yourself.

it.69b29bc509f4a9c22739144e: Ho portato i filtri che mi avevi chiesto.
it.69b29bcb80e80ac196d97d47: Lo consegno ai miei uomini mentre esce.
it.69b29bd1fdced3249f170cdf: Allora, ora possiamo parlare del suo elicottero?
it.69b29bd6ab43ad2908ff3199: Va bene, possiamo parlare. Per prima cosa, ha bisogno di manutenzione.
it.69b29be537964e43c9dbfd85: Cosa, vuoi che ti mandi una birra al tuo nascondiglio per non annoiarti?
it.69b29bed176d68aad268ecab: Controlla la base di riserva. Avrà bisogno di carburante per aviazione, denominato AMG-10.
it.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: Pensi davvero che, dopo tutto quello che ha fatto, io la aiuterò anche nel suo lavoro?
it.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: E no, non le permetterò di avvicinarsi a una macchina del genere.
it.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: È conservato in contenitori o in speciali recipienti.
it.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: Se vuoi l'elicottero, usa il cervello e trovalo da solo.

jp.69b29bc509f4a9c22739144e: あんたに頼まれたフィルターを持ってきたぞ。
jp.69b29bcb80e80ac196d97d47: 帰る時にうちの連中に渡しておけ。
jp.69b29bd1fdced3249f170cdf: それで、あんたのヘリについて話せるか？
jp.69b29bd6ab43ad2908ff3199: いいだろう、話してやる。まず、メンテナンスが必要だ。
jp.69b29bdf27b70dfebb0f7b98: それじゃあ待つしかないのか？
jp.69b29be537964e43c9dbfd85: 何だ、退屈しないよう隠れ家にビールでも送ってほしいってのか？
jp.69b29beaaa0a7717b85c56c0: じゃあ何をすればいいんだ？
jp.69b29bed176d68aad268ecab: Reserve を確認してこい。AMG-10 と呼ばれる航空用オイルが必要だ。
jp.69b29bf380bf4d274f26c552: 具体的にどこを探せばいいんだ？
jp.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: 今までお前がやってきたことを考えれば、俺がお前の仕事まで手伝うと思ってるのか？
jp.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: だが、お前をそんな機械に近づかせるつもりはない。
jp.69e1e8692692e0a082d4ca84: そんなことはしないぞ、ルーキー！
jp.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: 缶や専用の容器に保管されている。
jp.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: ヘリが欲しいなら、頭を使って自分で探せ。

kr.69b29bcb80e80ac196d97d47: 나가는 길에 우리 애들한테 넘기고 가.
kr.69b29bd6ab43ad2908ff3199: 그래, 얘기해 보지. 일단 첫째, 헬기를 좀 정비해야 해.
kr.69b29be537964e43c9dbfd85: 뭐, 시시해서 죽고 싶어지지 말라고 자네 은신처에 맥주라도 보내주랴?
kr.69b29bed176d68aad268ecab: 리저브 기지를 가 봐. 자네가 찾아와야 하는 건 AMG-10이라고 하는 항공유야.
kr.69b29bf380bf4d274f26c552: 어디를 뒤져보면 되는지 구체적으로 좀 알려줄 수 있나?
kr.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: 자네가 지금까지 한 게 있는데 나더러 자네 심부름마저 도와달라고?
kr.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: 그리고, 안돼. 헬기 근처엔 얼씬도 못 할 줄 알아.
kr.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: 용기나 특수 보관함에 보관되어 있을 거다.
kr.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: 헬리콥터를 타고 싶거든, 직접 짱구를 굴리던가 해서 알아내.

es.69b29bcb80e80ac196d97d47: Dáselos a mis chicos al salir.
es.69b29bd1fdced3249f170cdf: Entonces, ¿ya podemos hablar de tu helicóptero?
es.69b29bd6ab43ad2908ff3199: Vale, podemos hablar. Pero primero, necesita mantenimiento.
es.69b29be537964e43c9dbfd85: ¿Qué, quieres que te envíe una cerveza a tu refugio para entretenerte?

es.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: ¿De verdad crees que después de todo lo que has hecho también voy a ayudarte con tu trabajo?
es.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: Y no, no voy a dejar que te acerques a una máquina como esa.
es.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: Lo guardan en latas o bidones especiales.
es.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: Si quieres el helicóptero, usa la cabeza y encuéntralo tú mismo.

es-mx.69b29bed176d68aad268ecab: Revisa la base de Reserva. Necesitarás aceite de aviación, llamado AMG-10.
es-mx.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: ¿De verdad crees que después de todo lo que has hecho también voy a ayudarte con tu trabajo?
es-mx.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: Y no, no voy a dejar que te acerques a una máquina como esa.
es-mx.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: Lo guardan en latas o bidones especiales.
es-mx.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: Si quieres el helicóptero, usa la cabeza y encuéntralo tú mismo.

tu.69b29bc509f4a9c22739144e: I brought the filters you asked for.
tu.69b29bcb80e80ac196d97d47: Hand them over to my guys on the way out.
tu.69b29bd1fdced3249f170cdf: So now we can talk about your helicopter?
tu.69b29bd6ab43ad2908ff3199: Alright, we can talk. First, it needs maintenance.
tu.69b29bdf27b70dfebb0f7b98: So I just have to wait?
tu.69b29be537964e43c9dbfd85: What, you want me to send you a beer to your hideout so you don’t get bored?
tu.69b29beaaa0a7717b85c56c0: Then what needs to be done?
tu.69b29bed176d68aad268ecab: Check the Reserve base. You’ll need aviation oil, called AMG-10.
tu.69b29bf380bf4d274f26c552: And where exactly should I look for it?
tu.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: You really think that after everything you’ve done I’m going to help you with your job too?
tu.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: And no, I’m not letting you anywhere near a machine like that.
tu.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: It’s stored in canisters or special containers.
tu.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: You want the helicopter, use your head and find it yourself.

ru.69b29bc509f4a9c22739144e: Я принёс фильтры, которые тебе нужны.
ru.69b29bd1fdced3249f170cdf: Теперь мы можем поговорить про твой вертолёт?
ru.69b29bd6ab43ad2908ff3199: Ладно, поговорим. Для начала его надо обслужить.
ru.69b29be537964e43c9dbfd85: Может, тебе ещё и пива в твой подвал отправить, чтобы не скучно было?
ru.69b29bed176d68aad268ecab: Поищи на базе РосРезерва авиационное масло, АМГ-10 называется.
ru.69b29bf8e15b87617d8610ab: Ты реально думаешь, что после всего, что ты сделал, я буду ещё и помогать тебе с твоей работой?
ru.69e1e85eeed5c8f21019cc76: Нет, тебя я и близко к такой серьёзной машине не подпущу.
ru.69e1e87394831b1ac378af39: Храниться может в канистрах или в специальных контейнерах.
ru.69e1e87d77f005a16e5180b1: Тебе вертушка нужна, ты и голову включай.

ch.69b2b2c7db8e28a3ed015406: 我找到了直升机需要的那种润滑油。(上交 AMG-10)
ch.69b2b2d28b130fabee0bbc6d: 我就直接告诉你吧：我们对那艘船的情况一无所知，为了搭你一程就直奔那里实在是太冒险了。
ch.69b2b2deace2ca32759295f1: 要是船上的人突然朝直升机开火怎么办？
ch.69b2b2e62edb4b17b91a2b6c: 好吧，那你说怎么办？我总得想办法登船才行。
ch.69b2b2ec75114fb9aa5bd975: 所以，怎么说？难道交易就这么泡汤了？
ch.69b2b2efa0bdd9cfd2b2dc8a: 我会让你搭上直升机的，但只有撤离的时候能出动，也就是你确保船上已经安全之后才行。
ch.69b2b2f52a1c8f66b7db7507: 行吧，如果我打算出来，那我该怎么呼叫直升机？
ch.69b2b2fee6e4d3a8d7c7e6d4: 首先，找一块合适的停机坪——如果那艘船真的像你说的那样，船上应该有类似的地方。
ch.69b2b318d3692bb8b2d831bb: 记得随身带些钱，上飞机前付给飞行员。
ch.69e1f9055c2b96f58d4cc358: 把东西留在门口那吧，我会让狗腿们来接手的，不过关于那架直升机，还有一件事。
ch.69e1f911056807b99d38f35e: 我和飞行员谈过了，他们也同意我的意见。
ch.69e1f9324661d12333a13374: 你自己愿意冒这个险是一回事，但我没法在这种情况下贸然派我的飞行员和直升机陪你一起送死。
ch.69e1f93ecc0d5e37c8cc65e0: 至于登船这一趟，你还是另想办法吧，对不住了。
ch.69e1f9481b64b04f1849165b: 保证周边安全之后，再打一颗信号弹就行了。
ch.69e1f9545c8ec184e1eaae79: 虽然你之前的确信守承诺，但我可不会白耗油料带着你到处飞。

cz.69b2b2c7db8e28a3ed015406: Přinesl jsem olej pro helikoptéru. (Předat AMG-10)
cz.69b2b2d28b130fabee0bbc6d: Řeknu ti to na rovinu: je moc nebezpečný tě vysadit na nějakou neznámou loď.
cz.69b2b2deace2ca32759295f1: Co když někdo z té lodi začne po helikoptéře střílet?
cz.69b2b2e62edb4b17b91a2b6c: Tak co navrhuješ? Na tu loď se pořád potřebuju dostat.
cz.69b2b2efa0bdd9cfd2b2dc8a: Dám ti helikoptéru, ale jenom na extraction, až bude situace bezpečná.
cz.69b2b2f52a1c8f66b7db7507: Tak jo. Jak ji pak odtamtud přivolám?
cz.69b2b2fee6e4d3a8d7c7e6d4: Nejdřív najdi pořádnou přistávací zónu. Na té lodi by nějaká měla být.
cz.69b2b318d3692bb8b2d831bb: Vezmi si s sebou hotovost a zaplať pilotům.
cz.69e1f9055c2b96f58d4cc358: Nech to u vchodu, předám to mým lidem. Ale ohledně té helikoptéry je tu ještě jedna věc.
cz.69e1f911056807b99d38f35e: Mluvil jsem s piloty a souhlasí.
cz.69e1f9324661d12333a13374: To, že riskuješ ty, je jedna věc, ale nemůžu tam poslat své piloty a stroj naslepo.
cz.69e1f93ecc0d5e37c8cc65e0: Na výsadek si budeš muset najít jinej způsob. Promiň.
cz.69e1f9481b64b04f1849165b: Ujisti se, že je to bezpečné, a pak odpal signální světlici.
cz.69e1f9545c8ec184e1eaae79: Předtím jsi slovo dodržel, ale zadarmo tě vozit nebudu.

en.69b2b2c7db8e28a3ed015406: I brought the oil for the helicopter. (Hand over the AMG-10)
en.69b2b2d28b130fabee0bbc6d: I’ll tell you straight: it’s too dangerous to drop you onto some unknown ship.
en.69b2b2deace2ca32759295f1: What if someone on that ship starts shooting at the helicopter?
en.69b2b2e62edb4b17b91a2b6c: So what do you suggest? I still need to get on that ship.
en.69b2b2efa0bdd9cfd2b2dc8a: I’ll give you the helicopter, but only for extraction, when things are already safe.
en.69b2b2f52a1c8f66b7db7507: Alright. How do I call it in once I’m there?
en.69b2b2fee6e4d3a8d7c7e6d4: First find a proper landing zone. There should be one on the ship.
en.69b2b318d3692bb8b2d831bb: Bring some cash with you and pay the pilots.
en.69e1f9055c2b96f58d4cc358: Leave it at the entrance, I’ll pass it to my guys. But there’s one other thing about the helicopter.
en.69e1f911056807b99d38f35e: I talked to the pilots, and they agree.
en.69e1f9324661d12333a13374: You taking risks is one thing, but I can’t send my pilots and the machine in blind.
en.69e1f93ecc0d5e37c8cc65e0: For insertion, you’ll have to find another way. Sorry.
en.69e1f9481b64b04f1849165b: Make sure it’s secure, then fire a signal flare.
en.69e1f9545c8ec184e1eaae79: You kept your word before, but I’m not flying you around for free.

it.69b2b2c7db8e28a3ed015406: Ho portato l'olio per l'elicottero. (Consegna l'AMG-10)
it.69b2b2d28b130fabee0bbc6d: Te lo dico chiaramente: è troppo pericoloso lasciarlo su una nave sconosciuta.
it.69b2b2deace2ca32759295f1: E se qualcuno su quella nave iniziasse a sparare all'elicottero?
it.69b2b2e62edb4b17b91a2b6c: Allora, cosa mi consigli? Devo comunque salire su quella nave.
it.69b2b2efa0bdd9cfd2b2dc8a: Ti darò l'elicottero, ma solo per l'evacuazione, quando la situazione sarà già sicura.
it.69b2b2f52a1c8f66b7db7507: Va bene. Come faccio a dare il via una volta arrivato lì?
it.69b2b2fee6e4d3a8d7c7e6d4: Per prima cosa trova una zona di atterraggio adeguata. Dovrebbe essercene una sulla nave.
it.69b2b318d3692bb8b2d831bb: Porta con te del denaro contante e paga i piloti.
it.69e1f9055c2b96f58d4cc358: Lo lasci all'ingresso, lo passerò ai miei ragazzi. Ma c'è un'altra cosa riguardo all'elicottero.
it.69e1f911056807b99d38f35e: Ho parlato con i piloti e sono d'accordo.
it.69e1f9324661d12333a13374: Che tu corra dei rischi è un conto, ma non posso mandare i miei piloti e l'aereo alla cieca.
it.69e1f93ecc0d5e37c8cc65e0: Per l'inserimento, dovrai trovare un altro modo. Mi dispiace.
it.69e1f9481b64b04f1849165b: Assicurati che sia sicuro, poi lancia un razzo di segnalazione.
it.69e1f9545c8ec184e1eaae79: In passato ha mantenuto la parola data, ma non la diffonderò gratuitamente.

kr.69b2b2c7db8e28a3ed015406: 헬기에 쓸 수 있는 윤활유를 가져왔다. (AMG-10 건네기)
kr.69b2b2d28b130fabee0bbc6d: 본론으로 들어가지. 뭐 하는 배인지도 모르는 곳에 자네를 데려다 주진 않을 걸세.
kr.69b2b2deace2ca32759295f1: 만약 배 안에 있는 누군가가 우리 헬기에 총질이라도 하면 어쩔 생각인가?
kr.69b2b2e62edb4b17b91a2b6c: 그러면 어쩌라는 건데? 난 그 배에 가야만 한다고.
kr.69b2b2efa0bdd9cfd2b2dc8a: 헬기를 띄워줄 순 있네. 다만 자네가 그 배에서 나올 때에만 보낼 걸세. 그거도 헬기를 보내기 안전할 때에만.
kr.69b2b2fee6e4d3a8d7c7e6d4: 착륙 지점으로 쓸만한 곳을 찾게. 그 배에 그런 곳이 한 곳쯤은 있을 걸세.
kr.69e1f9055c2b96f58d4cc358: 입구에 놔두면 내가 우리 애들한테 전달하지. 하지만 헬기에 대해서 한 가지 더 알려줄 게 있네.
kr.69e1f911056807b99d38f35e: 조종사들하고도 얘기해 봤는데, 그들도 그렇게 생각하더군.
kr.69e1f9324661d12333a13374: 자네가 위험을 감수하겠다는 건 알겠는데, 나는 무작정 헬기랑 조종사들을 보낼 수가 없는 노릇이네.
kr.69e1f93ecc0d5e37c8cc65e0: 그 배로 가는 방법은 직접 찾아야 할 걸세, 미안하네.
kr.69e1f9481b64b04f1849165b: 반드시 착륙 지점이 안전한지 확인 한 다음에 신호탄을 쏘게.
kr.69e1f9545c8ec184e1eaae79: 자네가 약속을 잘 지키는 사람이란 건 알지만, 공짜로 해주기엔 어렵다네.

pl.69b2b2c7db8e28a3ed015406: I brought the oil for the helicopter. (Hand over the AMG-10)
pl.69b2b2d28b130fabee0bbc6d: I’ll tell you straight: it’s too dangerous to drop you onto some unknown ship.
pl.69b2b2deace2ca32759295f1: What if someone on that ship starts shooting at the helicopter?
pl.69b2b2e62edb4b17b91a2b6c: So what do you suggest? I still need to get on that ship.
pl.69b2b2efa0bdd9cfd2b2dc8a: I’ll give you the helicopter, but only for extraction, when things are already safe.
pl.69b2b2f52a1c8f66b7db7507: Alright. How do I call it in once I’m there?
pl.69b2b2fee6e4d3a8d7c7e6d4: First find a proper landing zone. There should be one on the ship.
pl.69b2b318d3692bb8b2d831bb: Bring some cash with you and pay the pilots.
pl.69e1f9055c2b96f58d4cc358: Leave it at the entrance, I’ll pass it to my guys. But there’s one other thing about the helicopter.
pl.69e1f911056807b99d38f35e: I talked to the pilots, and they agree.
pl.69e1f9324661d12333a13374: You taking risks is one thing, but I can’t send my pilots and the machine in blind.
pl.69e1f93ecc0d5e37c8cc65e0: For insertion, you’ll have to find another way. Sorry.
pl.69e1f9481b64b04f1849165b: Make sure it’s secure, then fire a signal flare.
pl.69e1f9545c8ec184e1eaae79: You kept your word before, but I’m not flying you around for free.

po.69b2b2c7db8e28a3ed015406: Trouxe o óleo para o helicóptero. (Entregar o AMG-10)
po.69b2b2d28b130fabee0bbc6d: "Vou ser direto: é perigoso demais te largar em algum navio desconhecido."
po.69b2b2deace2ca32759295f1: E se alguém naquele navio começar a atirar no helicóptero?
po.69b2b2e62edb4b17b91a2b6c: Então o que você sugere? Ainda preciso embarcar naquele navio.
po.69b2b2ec75114fb9aa5bd975: Então o quê, o acordo está cancelado?
po.69b2b2efa0bdd9cfd2b2dc8a: Vou te dar o helicóptero, mas só para a extração, quando as coisas já estiverem seguras.
po.69b2b2f52a1c8f66b7db7507: Certo. Como faço para chamá-lo quando estiver lá?
po.69b2b2fee6e4d3a8d7c7e6d4: Primeiro encontre uma zona de pouso adequada. Deve haver uma no navio.
po.69b2b318d3692bb8b2d831bb: Traga algum dinheiro e pague os pilotos.
po.69e1f9055c2b96f58d4cc358: Deixe na entrada, eu repasso para os meus caras. Mas tem mais uma coisa sobre o helicóptero.
po.69e1f911056807b99d38f35e: Conversei com os pilotos, e eles concordam.
po.69e1f9324661d12333a13374: Você correr riscos é uma coisa, mas não posso mandar meus pilotos e a máquina às cegas.
po.69e1f93ecc0d5e37c8cc65e0: Para a inserção, você vai ter que encontrar outra forma. Desculpa.
po.69e1f9481b64b04f1849165b: Garanta que está seguro, depois dispare um sinalizador.
po.69e1f9545c8ec184e1eaae79: Você cumpriu sua palavra antes, mas não vou te levar de graça.

es.69b2b2c7db8e28a3ed015406: He traído el aceite para el helicóptero. (Entrega el AMG-10)
es.69b2b2d28b130fabee0bbc6d: Te lo diré sin rodeos: es demasiado peligroso dejarte descender sobre un barco desconocido.
es.69b2b2deace2ca32759295f1: ¿Qué pasa si alguien en ese barco empieza a disparar al helicóptero?
es.69b2b2e62edb4b17b91a2b6c: ¿Y qué sugieres? Necesito subir a ese barco.
es.69b2b2efa0bdd9cfd2b2dc8a: Te daré el helicóptero, pero solo para la extracción, cuando ya todo esté seguro.
es.69b2b2f52a1c8f66b7db7507: De acuerdo. ¿Cómo lo solicito cuando esté allá?
es.69b2b2fee6e4d3a8d7c7e6d4: Primero busca una zona de aterrizaje adecuada. Debería haber una en el barco.
es.69b2b318d3692bb8b2d831bb: Lleva algo de dinero en efectivo y paga a los pilotos.
es.69e1f9055c2b96f58d4cc358: Déjalo en la entrada; se lo pasaré a mis chicos. Pero hay otro asunto sobre el helicóptero…
es.69e1f911056807b99d38f35e: He hablado con los pilotos y están de acuerdo.
es.69e1f9324661d12333a13374: Que tú tomes riesgos es una cosa, pero no puedo enviar a mis pilotos y al helicóptero a ciegas.
es.69e1f93ecc0d5e37c8cc65e0: Para la inserción, tendrás que encontrar otra forma. Lo siento.
es.69e1f9481b64b04f1849165b: Asegúrate de que sea segura y luego dispara una bengala.
es.69e1f9545c8ec184e1eaae79: Has cumplido tu palabra antes, pero no voy a trasladarte gratis.

ru.69b2b2c7db8e28a3ed015406: Я принёс масло для вертолёта. (передать АМГ-10)
ru.69b2b2d28b130fabee0bbc6d: Я тебе прямо скажу: уж больно опасно тебя десантировать хрен знает куда.
ru.69b2b2deace2ca32759295f1: А если с корабля кто-то по вертолёту палить начнёт?
ru.69b2b2e62edb4b17b91a2b6c: И что ты предлагаешь? Мне нужно попасть на этот корабль.
ru.69b2b2efa0bdd9cfd2b2dc8a: Вертолёт я тебе дам, но только для эвакуации, когда опасности уже не будет.
ru.69b2b2f52a1c8f66b7db7507: Ладно. Как вызвать вертолёт, когда я буду там?
ru.69b2b2fee6e4d3a8d7c7e6d4: Сначала найди площадку для посадки, на корабле такая наверняка есть.
ru.69b2b318d3692bb8b2d831bb: Захвати с собой валюту и передай пилотам.
ru.69e1f9055c2b96f58d4cc358: Оставь у входа, я передам своим парням. Вот только с вертолётом есть одна проблема.
ru.69e1f911056807b99d38f35e: Я с пилотами пообщался, они подтвердили.
ru.69e1f9324661d12333a13374: Ты-то ладно, сам все риски на себя берёшь. А вот вертолёт и пилотов своих вслепую я отправлять не могу.
ru.69e1f93ecc0d5e37c8cc65e0: А вот для десанта тебе надо что-то другое найти, извиняй.
ru.69e1f9481b64b04f1849165b: Убедись, что вокруг безопасно и после этого подай сигнал РСП.
ru.69e1f9545c8ec184e1eaae79: Хоть ты меня и не кинул с тем кейсом, но бесплатно тебя катать на вертолёте я не буду.

ch.69b2decaee6a46f780dd705e: 我已经把那些走私者的营地给清理干净，你和他们谈了吗？
ch.69b2decf6286f613d4998795: 谈了，要不是你出动把营地里的那些人赶跑，他们肯定理都不理你。
ch.69b2ded5b4425f3cb430aa39: 所以他们愿意提供交通工具了？
ch.69b2dedb052682d676bafec3: 是的，他们有一艘气垫船，到时候会在海岸线那接你，不过有一个额外的条件。
ch.69b2dedf82d7653237be8437: 所以就是要收钱的意思咯？
ch.69b2dee3b3f67304ac37be9a: 问题不在这，收钱办事本来就是这地方的规矩！我说的是别的。
ch.69b2deeb1e59a77390525338: 他们那艘船很多地方都要用，而且谁也不知道你那艘船上有什么等着你。所以他们只愿意把你送过去，不负责接你回来。
ch.69b2deef3b081662b55893bb: 管杀不管埋是吧，这有什么用？
ch.69b2def3c280b82088a98230: 你爱怎么想怎么想。他们可不会干等着，等你把船翻个底朝天再接你回去。条件就是这么开的，现在也没有更好的选择。
ch.69b2def8e38ec4ea556ac16c: 所以我得另外想办法才能下船了。
ch.69b2defd4612a1fce82e855b: 对。但至少送你过去这一步不会坑你。准备好了就去海边，找到那艘气垫船，记得带钱。

cz.69b2decaee6a46f780dd705e: Vyčistil jsem tábory pašeráků. Mluvil jsi s nimi?
cz.69b2decf6286f613d4998795: Jo. A nebýt tebe, tak by se s námi vůbec neobtěžovali bavit.
cz.69b2dedb052682d676bafec3: Jo. Mají vznášedlo. Vyzvednou tě z pobřeží. Ale má to háček.
cz.69b2dee3b3f67304ac37be9a: To není háček, takhle to tady prostě chodí! Myslím něco jinýho.
cz.69b2deeb1e59a77390525338: To plavidlo potřebují na spoustě míst a nikdo neví, co na té tvé lodi čeká. Takže jsou ochotní tě tam jen vysadit, ale zpátky už tě nevezmou.
cz.69b2deef3b081662b55893bb: A jak mi to jako má pomoct?
cz.69b2def3c280b82088a98230: Říkej si tomu, jak chceš. Nebudou tam tvrdnout, zatímco ty budeš prohledávat každý roh. Tohle jsou podmínky a lepší dohodu teď prostě nedostaneš.
cz.69b2def8e38ec4ea556ac16c: Takže budu muset najít jiný způsob, jak z té lodi udělat exfil.
cz.69b2defd4612a1fce82e855b: Jo. Ale s vysazením tě nepodrazí, neboj. Až budeš připravený, jdi k pobřeží, najdi vznášedlo a přines hotovost.

en.69b2decaee6a46f780dd705e: I cleared the smugglers’ camps. Did you talk to them?
en.69b2decf6286f613d4998795: Yeah. And if it wasn’t for you, they wouldn’t have even bothered talking.

it.69b2ded5b4425f3cb430aa39: Quindi sono pronti a fornire il trasporto?

it.69b2dee3b3f67304ac37be9a: Non è una fregatura, è semplicemente così che funzionano gli affari da queste parti! Intendo dire qualcos'altro.
it.69b2deeb1e59a77390525338: Hanno bisogno di quell'aereo in molti posti, e nessuno sa cosa vi aspetti su quella vostra nave. Per questo sono disposti solo a lasciarvi lì, non a venirvi a riprendere.
it.69b2deef3b081662b55893bb: E in che modo questo dovrebbe aiutarmi?
it.69b2def3c280b82088a98230: Chiamatelo come volete. Non resteranno lì ad aspettare mentre voi setacciate ogni angolo là fuori. Queste sono le condizioni, e al momento non otterrete un accordo migliore.
it.69b2def8e38ec4ea556ac16c: Quindi dovrò trovare un altro modo per fuggire dalla nave.
it.69b2defd4612a1fce82e855b: Sì. Ma non ti fregheranno durante l'inserimento, non preoccuparti. Quando sei pronto, dirigiti verso la riva, trova l'hovercraft e porta dei contanti.

kr.69b2decf6286f613d4998795: 당연하지. 그리고 선생이 아니였으면 그 양반들은 나랑 대화도 안 하려고 했을걸.
kr.69b2ded5b4425f3cb430aa39: 그럼 그 사람들이 나한테 배라도 제공해 준대?
kr.69b2dedb052682d676bafec3: 그렇지, 그 양반들은 호버크래프트가 따로 있다 하더라. 그 양반들이 형씨를 해안가에서 태워줄 건데, 그냥은 못 해준다 그러더라고.
kr.69b2dee3b3f67304ac37be9a: 솔직히 그건 되게 당연한 소리잖아! 다들 여기서 이렇게 장사하는 거라고. 하여튼, 내 말은, 다른 조건이 있다는 거야.
kr.69b2deeb1e59a77390525338: 그 양반들은 호버크래프트를 써야 할 곳이 많거든. 게다가 선생이 가려고 하는 그 배에는 뭐가 있을지 모르잖아. 그래서 그 사람들은 선생을 거기에 데려다 주기만 하고, 다시 데리러 돌아오진 않겠대.
kr.69b2def3c280b82088a98230: 뭐라고 생각하던 그건 선생 맘이야. 선생이 거기서 뭘 막 뒤지고 있는 동안 그 양반들이 마냥 기다려 줄 수 있는 노릇은 아니라는 얘기야. 그게 그 양반들의 조건이고, 지금으로써는 이게 최선인 셈이지.
kr.69b2def8e38ec4ea556ac16c: 그러면 그 호버크래프트로 그 배에서 탈출하는 건 접어야 겠군.
kr.69b2defd4612a1fce82e855b: 그런 셈이지. 하지만 그 양반들이 그 배까지는 데려다 줄 거니까 걱정하진 마. 선셍이 갈 준비만 되면 해안가로 가서 호버크래프트를 찾아가. 표값 챙기는 거 잊지 말고.

po.69b2def8e38ec4ea556ac16c: Então vou ter que encontrar outra forma de sair do navio.
po.69b2defd4612a1fce82e855b: Sim. Mas eles não vão te enganar na inserção, não se preocupe. Quando estiver pronto, vá para a costa, encontre o hovercraft e traga dinheiro.

es.69b2decaee6a46f780dd705e: He despejado los campamentos de los contrabandistas. ¿Has hablado con ellos?

es.69b2dedb052682d676bafec3: Sí. Tienen un aerodeslizador. Te recogerán por la costa. Pero hay una condición.

es.69b2deeb1e59a77390525338: Necesitan esa nave en muchos sitios, y nadie sabe lo que espera en ese barco del que hablas. Así que solo están dispuestos a dejarte allí, no a recogerte de regreso.

es.69b2def8e38ec4ea556ac16c: Entonces, su nave no me evacuará del barco, ¿correcto?
es.69b2defd4612a1fce82e855b: Exacto. Pero no te joderán con la inserción, no te preocupes. Cuando estés listo, dirígete a la costa, busca el aerodeslizador y lleva la pasta.

ch.69b3fea8a714496c88c72ad5: 我把弹药带来了，你应该能用得上。
ch.69b3feb36d6f2571431b616f: 现在你得证明自己不是在给 Skier 跑腿才行。
ch.69b3feba2fcc4b6b5aa2078a: 去搞他，狠狠干他娘的一票。
ch.69b3fec21f84041eaf366a80: 不止是“主意”，我可是准备好了一整套计划！现在他正等着城里南边各个藏匿点发回的报告，有个跑腿的在替他收集这些东西。
ch.69b3fec66a6f575e847c0cd6: 你是想让我把那人干掉？
ch.69b3feca93f9e8f94680f669: 不用那么麻烦。那个狗腿之前在海关附近被人惊动了，于是把文件藏起来以防万一。那小子早就跑没影了，但把文件夹给落下了。
ch.69b3fecff4f54db2d18d697c: 所以我要在这人回去拿到文件之前把东西截住？
ch.69b3fedc17d494f0ec0b4624: 把那些文件毁了。让 Skier 永远拿不到他的情报。把它们烧掉，在海关拿到文件之后就直接开始烧！
ch.69b3fedf08b508ac2e807227: 明白。所以我要上哪去找那堆东西？
ch.69b3fee3c5856d56463cdb01: 他从有实验室的那栋楼——你们雇佣兵管它叫医疗楼的那个地方——往烂尾工地跑的时候，本地的混混突然开火，把他给逼进中间的那些土沟里了，文件应该就在那附近。

cz.69b3fea8a714496c88c72ad5: Přinesl jsem tu munici. To by mělo pomoct.
cz.69b3feacd42958117a3fa0b0: Hoď to na to volné sedadlo.
cz.69b3feb36d6f2571431b616f: Teď dokážeš, že nelítáš pro Skiera.
cz.69b3fec21f84041eaf366a80: Víc než to. Mám rovnou celý plán! Právě teď čeká na zprávy ze všech svých tajných skrýší v jižní části města, sbírá je pro něj kurýr.
cz.69b3feca93f9e8f94680f669: Ještě jednodušší. Někdo už ho vyplašil kousek od Customs. Dokumenty pro jistotu schoval. Ten kluk sice utekl, ale nechal tam složku.
cz.69b3fecff4f54db2d18d697c: Takže to seberu dřív, než se vrátí?
cz.69b3fedc17d494f0ec0b4624: Ty dokumenty zničíš. Postarej se, aby je Skier už nikdy nenašel. Spal je přímo tam na Customs!
cz.69b3fee3c5856d56463cdb01: Zahnali ho do rokle, když utíkal od budovy laboratoří směrem ke staveništi. Budou někde tam.

en.69b3fea8a714496c88c72ad5: I brought the ammo. That should help.
en.69b3feacd42958117a3fa0b0: Drop it on the empty seat.

en.69b3fec21f84041eaf366a80: More than that. I’ve got a whole plan! Right now he’s waiting on reports from all his stashes in the southern part of the city, got a runner collecting them.
en.69b3fec66a6f575e847c0cd6: You want me to take him out?
en.69b3feca93f9e8f94680f669: Even simpler. Someone already spooked him near customs. He stashed the documents just in case. The kid got away, but left the folder behind.
en.69b3fecff4f54db2d18d697c: So I intercept it before he gets back?
en.69b3fedc17d494f0ec0b4624: You destroy those documents. Make sure Skier never finds them. Burn them right there at customs!
en.69b3fedf08b508ac2e807227: Got it. Where do I find them?
en.69b3fee3c5856d56463cdb01: He got pinned down in a ravine, running from the lab building toward construction. They’ll be somewhere around there.

ch.69b403c9a0bcc3fb77bc9543: 我已经把 Skier 的报告处理掉了。
ch.69b403cd9ade35925c73cd3b: 你确定是按我说的把它们彻底烧掉了？
ch.69b403d1b55e961794a54f6e: 烧了。现在你该帮我了吧？
ch.69b403d51063ef49981835fa: 行吧……或许以后还能再合作。至于运输，走私者那边也许有办法，但他们不会白帮你。
ch.69b403d9a06049d3815a866b: 这我能想到。我需要做什么？
ch.69b403fd506e2b9f14f6fafa: 听说最近有不少外人跑到他们海岸线和立交桥那边的营地晃悠。你把那些人清理掉，我就跟他们说是你帮的忙。
ch.69b404012710b9b84145489a: 立交桥那个营地怎么找？
ch.69b404053d654b2a895c262e: 从 Ultra 正门出来，过马路，再过一条铁轨就看到了。整个营地是用集装箱搭起来的，有大铁棚子、帐篷，还有一些临时搭的破屋子。那边有个红星标记，很显眼。
ch.69b4040d1affd654cc84f7f9: 海岸线不是有条路通往海关方向么？从疗养院东楼出发，往海关方向下坡，有一大片空地。过了那片地之后，你会看到几个棚屋和一些集装箱围起来的地方，那里就是了。
ch.69b40414d3d4c0deb820208e: 行。什么时候能给我消息？
ch.69b404195f653bda18967aed: 等你把事办完回来，我这边也差不多有消息了。不过你要是想听到好消息，就别拖拖拉拉的。

cz.69b403c9a0bcc3fb77bc9543: Zbavil jsem se těch Skierových zpráv.
cz.69b403cd9ade35925c73cd3b: Spal jsi je, jak jsem říkal?
cz.69b403d51063ef49981835fa: Fajn, možná někdy v budoucnu zase budeme spolupracovat… Co se týče dopravy, pašeráci by mohli něco mít. Ale zadarmo ti nepomůžou.
cz.69b403d9a06049d3815a866b: No, to se dalo čekat. Co musím udělat?
cz.69b403fd506e2b9f14f6fafa: Slyšel jsem, že se jim v táborech na Shoreline a Interchange ukazuje spousta cizáků. Vyčisti to tam a já jim řeknu, že jsi jim pomohl ty.
cz.69b404012710b9b84145489a: Jak najdu ten tábor na Interchange?
cz.69b404053d654b2a895c262e: Vyraz od Ultra, přejdi silnici a železnici a narazíš přímo do něj. Kontejnerový kemp, velký přístřešek, stany, provizorní boudy. Je označený červenou hvězdou, nemůžeš to minout.
cz.69b404098ce72be14b49f9eb: Jak najdu ten tábor na Shoreline?
cz.69b4040d1affd654cc84f7f9: Sejdi od sanatoria směrem ke Customs, je tam velké otevřené pole. Za ním uvidíš několik hangárů s přepravními kontejnery.
cz.69b40414d3d4c0deb820208e: Tak jo. Kdy od tebe můžu čekat nějaké zprávy?
cz.69b404195f653bda18967aed: Než s tím skončíš a vrátíš se, budu mít pro tebe informace. Ale neměl by ses flákat, jestli chceš dobré zprávy.

en.69b403c9a0bcc3fb77bc9543: I got rid of Skier’s reports.
en.69b403cd9ade35925c73cd3b: You burned them like I said?
en.69b403d51063ef49981835fa: Fine, maybe we can work together again, someday… As for transport, the smugglers might have something. But they won’t help you for free.
en.69b403d9a06049d3815a866b: Well, that’s expected. What do I need to do?
en.69b403fd506e2b9f14f6fafa: Heard they’ve had a lot of outsiders showing up at their camps on the shore and interchange. You clear them out, I’ll tell them it was you who helped.
en.69b404012710b9b84145489a: How do I find the interchange camp?
en.69b404053d654b2a895c262e: Head out from Ultra, cross the road and the railway, you’ll run straight into it. Container camp, big canopy, tents, makeshift shacks. There’s a red star marking it, you won’t miss it.
en.69b404098ce72be14b49f9eb: How do I find the shoreline camp?
en.69b4040d1affd654cc84f7f9: Go down from the health resort toward customs, there’s a big open field. Past that you’ll see a few hangars with shipping containers.
en.69b40414d3d4c0deb820208e: Alright. When can I expect news from you?
en.69b404195f653bda18967aed: By the time you’re done and back, I’ll have info for you. But don’t drag your feet if you want good news.

it.69b403c9a0bcc3fb77bc9543: Ho eliminato i rapporti di Skier.
it.69b403cd9ade35925c73cd3b: Li ha bruciati come le avevo detto?
it.69b403d51063ef49981835fa: Va bene, forse potremo lavorare di nuovo insieme, un giorno… Per quanto riguarda il trasporto, i contrabbandieri potrebbero avere qualcosa. Ma non la aiuteranno gratuitamente.
it.69b403d9a06049d3815a866b: Beh, me lo aspettavo. Cosa devo fare?
it.69b403fd506e2b9f14f6fafa: Ho sentito che si sono presentati molti estranei nei loro accampamenti sulla costa e allo svincolo. Tu li elimini, io dirò loro che sei stata tu ad aiutarli.
it.69b404012710b9b84145489a: Come posso trovare il campo di smistamento?
it.69b404053d654b2a895c262e: Esci da Ultra, attraversa la strada e i binari, e lo troverai subito. Un accampamento di container, una grande tettoia, tende, baracche di fortuna. C'è una stella rossa che lo indica, non potrai non vederlo.
it.69b404098ce72be14b49f9eb: Come faccio a trovare l'accampamento sulla costa?
it.69b4040d1affd654cc84f7f9: Scendi dal centro benessere verso la dogana, c'è un grande campo aperto. Superato quello, vedrai alcuni hangar con dei container.
it.69b40414d3d4c0deb820208e: Va bene. Quando posso aspettarmi notizie da te?
it.69b404195f653bda18967aed: Quando avrà finito e sarà tornato, avrò delle informazioni per te. Ma non perdere tempo se vuoi buone notizie.

kr.69b403d51063ef49981835fa: 그래, 이제야 좀 다시 일 해볼 만할 거 같은데, 언젠간. 운송 수단 건은 말이야, 이 지역의 밀수꾼들이 도와줄 수 있을 거 같더라. 근데 절대 그냥 태워줄 생각은 없어 보여.
kr.69b403d9a06049d3815a866b: 그 정도는 예상했어. 내가 뭘 해주면 되지?
kr.69b403fd506e2b9f14f6fafa: 그 양반들이 해안가랑 인터체인지에서 물건을 적재해두는 곳에 자꾸 어떤 새끼들이 설친다 그러더라고. 그래서 네가 가서 조져버려. 그러면 그 양반들한테 네가 그 설치는 놈들을 조진 사람이라고 얘기 정도는 해줄 수 있어.
kr.69b404012710b9b84145489a: 인터체인지에 있는 캠프는 무슨 수로 찾지?
kr.69b404053d654b2a895c262e: 울트라 몰 밖으로 나가서 도로랑 열차 선로들을 건너면 바로 있을 거야. 컨테이너 캠프인데, 거기에 커다란 천막이랑 텐트들, 그리고 가건물들이 좀 있는 곳인데, 빨간 별표를 쳐 놔서 쉽게 찾을 수 있을 거야.
kr.69b404098ce72be14b49f9eb: 해안가에 있는 캠프는 무슨 수로 찾지?
kr.69b4040d1affd654cc84f7f9: 리조트에서 내려와서 세관 쪽으로 가다 보면 넓은 공터가 있는데, 그 쪽으로 가면 화물 컨테이너로 된 격납고들이 보일 거야.
kr.69b40414d3d4c0deb820208e: 알았어. 언제쯤 오면 너한테 소식을 들을 수 있을까?
kr.69b404195f653bda18967aed: 네가 다 처리하고 나면 나한테 와, 그러면 그 양반들에 대해 좀 알려주지. 좋은 소식을 듣고 싶다면 서두르는 게 좋을 거야.

po.69b403c9a0bcc3fb77bc9543: Me livrei dos relatórios do Skier.
po.69b403cd9ade35925c73cd3b: Você os queimou como eu disse?

po.69b403d9a06049d3815a866b: Bem, isso era de se esperar. O que preciso fazer?

po.69b404012710b9b84145489a: Como encontro o acampamento de Interchange?
po.69b404053d654b2a895c262e: Saia do Ultra, cruze a estrada e a ferrovia, você vai cair direto nele. Acampamento de contêineres, grande toldo, tendas, barracos improvisados. Tem uma estrela vermelha marcando, você não vai perder.
po.69b404098ce72be14b49f9eb: Como encontro o acampamento em Shoreline?
po.69b4040d1affd654cc84f7f9: Desça do resort em direção à Customs, tem um grande campo aberto. Depois disso você vai ver alguns hangares com contêineres de carga.
po.69b40414d3d4c0deb820208e: Certo. Quando posso esperar notícias suas?
po.69b404195f653bda18967aed: Quando você terminar e voltar, terei informações para você. Mas não enrole se quiser boas notícias.

es-mx.69b403d9a06049d3815a866b: Bueno, eso era de esperarse. ¿Qué tengo que hacer?
es-mx.69b403fd506e2b9f14f6fafa: Escuché que han tenido muchos forasteros apareciendo por sus campamentos en la Costa y en Intercambio. Si los sacas de ahí, les diré que tú fuiste quien los ayudó.
es-mx.69b404053d654b2a895c262e: Desde la entrada del ULTRA, cruzas la carretera y las vías del tren, y te lo toparás justo enfrente. Un campamento de contenedores, con una carpa grande, tiendas de campaña y chozas improvisadas. Tiene una estrella roja pintada; no tiene pierde.
es-mx.69b4040d1affd654cc84f7f9: Bajas desde el Sanatorio hacia Aduanas y hay un campo abierto enorme. Pasando ese campo, verás unos hangares con contenedores de transporte.
es-mx.69b40414d3d4c0deb820208e: Está bien. ¿Cuándo puedo esperar noticias de tu parte?
es-mx.69b404195f653bda18967aed: Para cuando termines y regreses, ya tendré la información para ti. Pero no te demores si quieres buenas noticias.

tu.69b403c9a0bcc3fb77bc9543: I got rid of Skier’s reports.
tu.69b403cd9ade35925c73cd3b: You burned them like I said?
tu.69b403d51063ef49981835fa: Fine, maybe we can work together again, someday… As for transport, the smugglers might have something. But they won’t help you for free.
tu.69b403d9a06049d3815a866b: Well, that’s expected. What do I need to do?
tu.69b403fd506e2b9f14f6fafa: Heard they’ve had a lot of outsiders showing up at their camps on the shore and interchange. You clear them out, I’ll tell them it was you who helped.
tu.69b404012710b9b84145489a: How do I find the interchange camp?
tu.69b404053d654b2a895c262e: Head out from Ultra, cross the road and the railway, you’ll run straight into it. Container camp, big canopy, tents, makeshift shacks. There’s a red star marking it, you won’t miss it.
tu.69b404098ce72be14b49f9eb: How do I find the shoreline camp?
tu.69b4040d1affd654cc84f7f9: Go down from the health resort toward customs, there’s a big open field. Past that you’ll see a few hangars with shipping containers.
tu.69b40414d3d4c0deb820208e: Alright. When can I expect news from you?
tu.69b404195f653bda18967aed: By the time you’re done and back, I’ll have info for you. But don’t drag your feet if you want good news.

ru.69b403cd9ade35925c73cd3b: Чё, сжёг прям, как я сказал?
ru.69b403d1b55e961794a54f6e: Да. Теперь ты займёшься моим делом?
ru.69b403d51063ef49981835fa: Ладно, может и поработаем ещё… Транспорт может быть у контрабандистов, но за просто так они тебе помогать не будут.
ru.69b403d9a06049d3815a866b: Это понятно. Что нужно от меня?
ru.69b403fd506e2b9f14f6fafa: Я слышал, что у них сейчас много чужого народу стало шастать по лагерям на развязке и берегу. Если зачистишь их, я передам парням, что это ты помог.
ru.69b404053d654b2a895c262e: Если пойдёшь от «Ультры» через дорогу и ж/дшку, уткнёшься в лагерь из контейнеров с крупным навесом, палатками и времянками. Он ещё красной звездой помечен, не потеряешься.
ru.69b4040d1affd654cc84f7f9: Если прям от санатория спускаться в сторону таможки, там будет поле здоровое, и за ним как раз несколько ангаров с морскими контейнерами.
ru.69b40414d3d4c0deb820208e: Понятно. А когда ждать новостей от тебя?
ru.69b404195f653bda18967aed: Когда ты всё сделаешь и вернёшься, инфа уже будет. Только не откладывай, а то всё будет зря.

ch.69b4161705319a6b84fc02ad: 我已经把那些走私者的营地清理干净了。
ch.69b4161a24323706ed7bbb12: 看来你还有点机会把我的信任挣回来……今后再说吧。
ch.69b4161fc4d221cda1627cd2: 走私者那边呢？你跟他们谈了吗？
ch.69b41623efb16a525eb1a09c: 谈了。他们有一艘气垫船。不过有个条件。
ch.69b41631731ebd1ceaa36547: 怎么，你以为是免费送你一程？想啥呢？
ch.69b4163ad8dcf537fef5e265: 那帮走私的只负责把你送过去。没人会在那儿傻等你办完事再把你接回来。
ch.69b41643cd85c4c5377637c0: 你叫个屁，这关我什么事？也不关他们的事！那艘气垫船用途多了去了，没人会为了你冒险把船给搭进去。
ch.69b41648aa37120828a0ba33: 所以这就是最终条件了？
ch.69b4164b3b3913793c048e3e: 我可不会再帮你去谈条件了。至于怎么从那艘船上撤离，你自己想办法去。
ch.69b416527cd6ea6a106360f7: 他们会在海岸线那边等你，靠近港口码头的那一边。还有，别忘了带钱。

cz.69b4161a24323706ed7bbb12: Možná máš fakt šanci získat moji důvěru zpátky. Někdy…
cz.69b4161fc4d221cda1627cd2: A co ti pašeráci? Mluvil jsi s nimi?
cz.69b41623efb16a525eb1a09c: Jo. Mají vznášedlo. Ale má to háček.
cz.69b41631731ebd1ceaa36547: Cože, ty sis myslel, že to bude jízda zadarmo? Vážně?
cz.69b41636f9033d7ad142480b: Fajn. V čem je tedy ten háček?
cz.69b4163ad8dcf537fef5e265: Pašeráci zajistí jen tvé vysazení. Nikdo tam na tebe nebude čekat, až si vyřídíš svoje kšefty a vrátíš se.
cz.69b4164028ec40b267e7cbd2: Počkej, cože? Jak se mám jako dostat zpátky?
cz.69b41643cd85c4c5377637c0: Víš co, to není ani můj, ani jejich problém! Pro to vznášedlo mají lepší využití a nikdo ho kvůli tobě nebude riskovat.
cz.69b4164b3b3913793c048e3e: Znova tam vyjednávat nepůjdu. Takže si exfiltraci z té lodi vyřeš sám.
cz.69b416527cd6ea6a106360f7: Budou čekat na pobřeží, kousek vedle přístavního terminálu. A nezapomeň přinést hotovost.

en.69b4161a24323706ed7bbb12: Maybe you’ve actually got a shot at earning my trust back. Someday…
en.69b4161fc4d221cda1627cd2: What about the smugglers? You talked to them?
en.69b41623efb16a525eb1a09c: Yeah. They’ve got a hovercraft. But there’s a catch.
en.69b4162c069107bea22eb0ba: Let me guess, I have to pay?
en.69b41631731ebd1ceaa36547: What, you thought this was a free ride? Really?
en.69b4163ad8dcf537fef5e265: The smugglers will only handle your insertion. No one’s gonna be waiting around for you to finish your business and come back.
en.69b4164028ec40b267e7cbd2: Wait, what? How am I supposed to get back?
en.69b41643cd85c4c5377637c0: You know what, that’s neither my nor their problem! They’ve got better uses for that hovercraft, and nobody’s risking it for you.
en.69b41648aa37120828a0ba33: So those are the final conditions?
en.69b4164b3b3913793c048e3e: I’m not going back to negotiate for you. So figure out the extraction from the ship yourself.
en.69b4164f32849aeacc1126b1: Understood. Where do they pick me up?
en.69b416527cd6ea6a106360f7: They’ll be waiting on the coast, off to the side of the port terminal. And don’t forget to bring cash.

it.69b4161705319a6b84fc02ad: Ho ripulito gli accampamenti dei contrabbandieri.
it.69b4161a24323706ed7bbb12: Forse ha davvero una possibilità di riconquistare la mia fiducia. Un giorno...
it.69b4161fc4d221cda1627cd2: E i contrabbandieri? Hai parlato con loro?
it.69b41623efb16a525eb1a09c: Sì. Hanno un hovercraft. Ma c'è un problema.
it.69b41631731ebd1ceaa36547: Cosa, pensavi che fosse una passeggiata? Davvero?
it.69b41636f9033d7ad142480b: Va bene. Allora qual è il trucco?
it.69b4163ad8dcf537fef5e265: I contrabbandieri si occuperanno solo del tuo inserimento. Nessuno aspetterà che tu finisca la tua missione e torni indietro.
it.69b4164028ec40b267e7cbd2: Aspetta, cosa? Come dovrei tornare indietro?
it.69b41643cd85c4c5377637c0: Una cosa è certa, non è un problema né mio né loro! Hanno usi migliori per quell'hovercraft, e nessuno correrà dei rischi per lei.
it.69b41648aa37120828a0ba33: Quindi queste sono le condizioni finali?
it.69b4164b3b3913793c048e3e: Non tornerò indietro per negoziare per lei. Quindi organizzati da solo per l'evacuazione dalla nave.
it.69b4164f32849aeacc1126b1: Ricevuto. Dove mi vengono a prendere?
it.69b416527cd6ea6a106360f7: Ti aspetteranno sulla costa, sul lato del terminal portuale. E non dimenticare di portare contanti.

kr.69b4161705319a6b84fc02ad: 밀수꾼 캠프에 싸돌아 다니던 놈들은 정리했다.
kr.69b4161a24323706ed7bbb12: 어쩌면 잃어버린 신뢰도 되찾을 수 있을 거 같은데. 언젠간 말이야…
kr.69b41623efb16a525eb1a09c: 그래. 그 양반들은 호버크래프트가 있다고 하더라. 근데 조건이 있대.
kr.69b41631731ebd1ceaa36547: 뭐, 공짜로 태워줄 거라고 생각했어? 정말로?
kr.69b4163ad8dcf537fef5e265: 그 양반들은 네가 그 배에 갈 때까지만 태워다 줄 거야. 거기서 너가 네 용무를 보는 내내 기다려 줄 생각은 없다는 소리지.
kr.69b4164028ec40b267e7cbd2: 잠깐, 뭐라고? 그러면 거기서 무슨 수로 나가는데?
kr.69b41643cd85c4c5377637c0: 있지, 그건 나나 그 양반들 알 바가 아니야! 그 사람들은 호버크래프트를 써먹을 만한 더 좋은 곳이 있고, 너 하나 데리러 가겠다고 그 위험을 감수할 생각은 없다고.
kr.69b41648aa37120828a0ba33: 그러면 이게 최종적으로 결론이 난 건가?
kr.69b4164b3b3913793c048e3e: 너 때문에 다시 협상하러 갈 생각 없어. 그러니까 그 배에서 나갈 방법은 너가 알아서 해결해.
kr.69b416527cd6ea6a106360f7: 항구 터미널 옆쪽 해안가에서 대기하고 있을 거래. 현찰 준비하는 거 잊지 말고.

pl.69b41648aa37120828a0ba33: So those are the final conditions?

po.69b4161a24323706ed7bbb12: Talvez você realmente tenha uma chance de reconquistar minha confiança. Algum dia…
po.69b4161fc4d221cda1627cd2: E os contrabandistas? Você falou com eles?
po.69b41623efb16a525eb1a09c: Sim. Eles têm um hovercraft. Mas há um problema.
po.69b4162c069107bea22eb0ba: Deixa eu adivinhar, tenho que pagar?
po.69b41631731ebd1ceaa36547: O quê, você achou que seria de graça? Sério?
po.69b41636f9033d7ad142480b: Tudo bem. E qual é o problema então?
po.69b4163ad8dcf537fef5e265: Os contrabandistas só vão cuidar da sua inserção. Ninguém vai ficar esperando enquanto você termina seus negócios e volta.
po.69b4164028ec40b267e7cbd2: Espera, o quê? Como eu vou voltar?
po.69b41643cd85c4c5377637c0: Sabe o quê, isso não é problema nem meu, nem deles! Eles têm usos melhores para esse hovercraft, e ninguém vai arriscá-lo por você.
po.69b41648aa37120828a0ba33: Então essas são as condições finais?
po.69b4164b3b3913793c048e3e: Não vou voltar para negociar por você. Então descubra como sair do navio sozinho.
po.69b416527cd6ea6a106360f7: Eles vão estar esperando na costa, do lado do terminal portuário. E não se esqueça de trazer dinheiro.

es.69b4161705319a6b84fc02ad: He despejado los campamentos de los contrabandistas.
es.69b4161a24323706ed7bbb12: Tal vez tengas una oportunidad de volver a ganarte mi confianza. Algún día…
es.69b4161fc4d221cda1627cd2: ¿Qué hay de los contrabandistas? ¿Has hablado con ellos?
es.69b41623efb16a525eb1a09c: Sí. Tienen un aerodeslizador. Pero hay una condición.
es.69b41631731ebd1ceaa36547: ¿Qué, pensabas que esto sería gratis? ¿En serio?
es.69b41636f9033d7ad142480b: Vale. Entonces, ¿cuál es la otra condición?
es.69b4163ad8dcf537fef5e265: Los contrabandistas solo se encargarán de tu inserción. Nadie va a quedarse esperando a que termines tus asuntos y regreses.
es.69b4164028ec40b267e7cbd2: Espera, ¿qué? ¿Y cómo se supone que voy a volver?
es.69b41643cd85c4c5377637c0: ¿Sabes qué? ¡Ese no es problema mío ni suyo! Tienen mejores usos para ese aerodeslizador, y nadie va a arriesgarlo por ti.
es.69b41648aa37120828a0ba33: ¿Así que esas son las condiciones finales?
es.69b4164b3b3913793c048e3e: No voy a volver a negociar por ti. Así que tú resuelve el tema de la extracción del barco.
es.69b416527cd6ea6a106360f7: Estarán esperando en la costa, al lado de la terminal del puerto. Y no te olvides de llevar la pasta.

ru.69b4161705319a6b84fc02ad: Я зачистил лагеря контрабандистов от гостей.
ru.69b4161a24323706ed7bbb12: Может, у тебя реально есть шансы вернуть моё доверие. Когда-нибудь…
ru.69b4161fc4d221cda1627cd2: Так что с контрабандистами? Удалось договориться?
ru.69b41623efb16a525eb1a09c: Да, у них есть корабль на воздушной подушке. Но есть нюанс.
ru.69b41631731ebd1ceaa36547: А ты чё, бесплатно покататься хотел? Серьёзно?
ru.69b4163ad8dcf537fef5e265: Контрабандисты готовы обеспечить только заброску. Ждать, пока ты там все дыры облазишь и вернёшься, никто не будет.
ru.69b4164028ec40b267e7cbd2: Это почему? И как я вернусь без катера на землю?
ru.69b41643cd85c4c5377637c0: А вот знаешь, это чёт ни меня, ни пацанов не волнует! Им есть ещё куда приткнуть этот катер, да и серьёзно рисковать машиной ради тебя никто не готов.
ru.69b4164b3b3913793c048e3e: Сейчас я точно не поеду выбивать для тебя что-то получше. Так что насчёт эвакуации с корабля думай сам.
ru.69b416527cd6ea6a106360f7: Катер будет ждать на побережье, в стороне от портового терминала. И не забудь взять с собой денег.

ch.69b41b6e07ac99976c2ffb3f: 关于上船的事情，有消息了吗？
ch.69b41b72355668f84144e64d: 有是有，不过有一个小问题。
ch.69b41b7aca1d884027b4f9c2: 你要这么说，那现在就变成两个问题了。
ch.69b41b8159d85053662f9911: 走私者那边有一艘气垫船，他们愿意把你送过去。但他们不会等你，也不会负责把你接回来。
ch.69b41b8995754705650a1938: 他们说对船来说风险太高。说实话，我觉得就是太抢手了。我能理解，我这 BTR 赶活的间隙里连加油都来不及，更何况是他们。
ch.69b41b8dc88ec6975bc6cccc: 所以他们不会把我从那艘船上撤出来。
ch.69b41b9025e0fab78c549092: 对，不过至少能把你送上去，这点不用担心！记得带钱就行。
ch.69b41b9a72cfb0a93765d606: 气垫船会在海岸那边等着，靠近港口码头的一边。你准备好了就过去。

cz.69b41b6e07ac99976c2ffb3f: Nějaké novinky ohledně dopravy na loď?
cz.69b41b72355668f84144e64d: Jo, ale je tu jeden háček.
cz.69b41b8159d85053662f9911: Pašeráci mají vznášedlo a jsou ochotni tě tam dopravit. Ale nebudou na tebe čekat ani tě pak odtamtud dostávat.
cz.69b41b8995754705650a1938: Říkají, že je to pro vozidlo příliš riskantní. Upřímně řečeno, myslím si, že je po něm prostě velký zájem. Chápu to, sotva stíhám doplňovat palivo do svého BTR mezi zakázkami.
cz.69b41b9025e0fab78c549092: Tak tak. Ale aspoň tě tam dovezou, s tím si nedělej starosti! Jen si nezapomeň vzít s sebou hotovost.
cz.69b41b9a72cfb0a93765d606: Vznášedlo bude u pobřeží, vedle přístavního terminálu. Až budeš připravený, vydej se tam.

en.69b41b6e07ac99976c2ffb3f: Any news about transport to the ship?
en.69b41b8159d85053662f9911: The smugglers have a hovercraft and they’re willing to get you there. But they won’t wait for you or extract you after.
en.69b41b8995754705650a1938: They say it’s too risky for the craft. Honestly, I think it’s just in high demand. I get it, I barely keep my BTR fueled between jobs.
en.69b41b8dc88ec6975bc6cccc: So they won’t extract me from the ship.
en.69b41b9025e0fab78c549092: Yurp. But at least they’ll get you there, don’t worry about that! Just make sure you bring cash.
en.69b41b96215b151dfc64c011: Where do they pick me up?
en.69b41b9a72cfb0a93765d606: The hovercraft will be on the coast, off to the side of the port terminal. When you’re ready, head there.

it.69b41b6e07ac99976c2ffb3f: Ci sono novità riguardo al trasporto verso la nave?
it.69b41b7aca1d884027b4f9c2: Va bene, diciamo che sono due problemi.
it.69b41b8159d85053662f9911: I contrabbandieri hanno un hovercraft e sono disposti a portarla lì. Ma non la aspetteranno né verranno a recuperarla in seguito.
it.69b41b8995754705650a1938: Dicono che sia troppo rischioso per il veicolo. Onestamente, penso che sia semplicemente molto richiesto. Lo capisco, riesco a malapena a tenere il mio BTR rifornito tra un lavoro e l'altro.
it.69b41b8dc88ec6975bc6cccc: Quindi non mi porteranno via dalla nave.
it.69b41b9025e0fab78c549092: Già. Ma almeno la porteranno lì, non ti preoccupare di questo! Assicurati solo di portare dei contanti.
it.69b41b9a72cfb0a93765d606: L'hovercraft si troverà sulla costa, di lato rispetto al terminal portuale. Quando è pronto, vai lì.

kr.69b41b6e07ac99976c2ffb3f: 배로 가는 운송 수단은 어떻게 됐어?
kr.69b41b8159d85053662f9911: 그 사람들은 호버크래프트가 있어서 형을 태워줄 수 있대. 근데 배에 데려다 준 후에 형을 데리고 나올 생각은 없다고 하더라고.
kr.69b41b8995754705650a1938: 호버크래프트를 계속 정박시키기엔 위험하다고 하더라. 솔직히, 내 생각엔 쓸 곳이 많아서 그런 게 아닌가 싶어. 이해는 돼, 내 BTR도 사람들 태워주고 다니면서 연료 채우는 거도 빠듯하거든.

es-mx.69ba883f0ef457995f7beaf0: Necesito ayuda con el transporte. ¿No conoces a alguien que pueda subirme a un barco en el Golfo de Finlandia?
es-mx.69ba883f3036c10e446a5a75: Necesito llegar a un barco en el Golfo de Finlandia. ¿Por casualidad tienes un bote?
es-mx.69ba883f753c74dd91e40429: No, hombre. Apenas y pude arreglar este BTR, como para tener tiempo para botes.
es-mx.69ba883fa86b47af2836870b: Eres muy descarado, ¿lo sabías? ¿Pensabas que no me daría cuenta de que te pusiste del lado de Skier en aquel entonces?

tu.69ba883f0ef457995f7beaf0: I need help with a transport. Do you have anyone who could get me onto a ship in the gulf?
tu.69ba883f3036c10e446a5a75: I need to board a ship in the Gulf of Finland. Do you have a spare motor boat, maybe?
tu.69ba883f753c74dd91e40429: Nah man. I barely got this BTR back on its feet, no time for boats.
tu.69ba883fa86b47af2836870b: You got some nerve, you know that? Thought I wouldn’t find out you sided with Skier back then?
tu.69ba883faf637bdd5c55bead: Brother, for you I’d build one out of scrap if I had to! But you’re probably not ready to wait that long.
tu.69ba883fb170c77bed1f9e3f: You deal with transport, right? Any chance you’ve got a boat? I need to reach a ship out in the gulf.

ru.69ba883f0ef457995f7beaf0: Мне нужна помощь с транспортом. У нет тебя никого, кто мог бы доставить меня на судно в Финском заливе?
ru.69ba883f3036c10e446a5a75: Мне нужно попасть на одно судно в Финском заливе. У тебя случайно нет катера?
ru.69ba883f753c74dd91e40429: Не, я БТР-то этот еле восстановил, не до катеров было.
ru.69ba883fa86b47af2836870b: А не слишком ли ты оборзел, а? Думал, я так и не узнаю, что ты тогда на сторону Лыжника встал?
ru.69ba883faf637bdd5c55bead: Братан, ради тебя я б и новый из говна и палок собрал! Но вряд ли ты готов ждать так долго.
ru.69ba883fb170c77bed1f9e3f: Ты вроде транспортом занимаешься. Может, у тебя и катер есть? Мне нужно попасть на одно судно на заливе.

ch.69baa783d105e6a8ca78f882: 我登上了那艘破冰船。游荡者抢先一步，他们干掉了大部分船员。可以肯定的是，袭击期间有人激活了船上的防御系统，船上不同的区域都被封死了。
ch.69baa78880922b3ce68ac5a1: 也就是说，船员里有人活了下来？
ch.69baa78c073a373fa58eb027: 有个科学家之类的家伙把自己锁在试验区里了。嚷嚷着除非亲眼见到船长，否则打死也不会出来。
ch.69baa79452066aa804e1b531: 八成在舰桥上，但我得穿过所有封锁层才能到那里。
ch.69baa79cd2e0e5436d837faf: 现在我需要弄到爆破炸药，清理出前往舰桥的路。
ch.69baa7b3a832e385a4c6e887: 那艘船周围都是浮冰，船上也到处都是积雪。现在这个季节怎么还会有这种情况？
ch.69baa7bb4b8b2628468c0600: 所以肯定是其他原因在作祟咯？
ch.69baa7bf57c444cc373d5d18: 气候正在以我们意想不到的方式飞速变化。沙漠里反常地下起了雪，洋流紊乱的情况更是出乎所有专家的预料…
ch.69baa7c34367fd3cc2d9dcde: 你是说他们正在开发气象武器？
ch.69baa7e46c2362d71a03e692: 你的库存里不会刚好有那种爆破炸药吧？
ch.69baa7e8dc24812691fd6a86: 啥，你是觉得手榴弹的劲太小不成？
ch.69baa7ec8e7c8f4fcae582e7: 我要的是聚能装药的那种。
ch.69e27b8f7d22a698ebc4d18b: 但我听说 Prapor 那最近到了一批聚能炸药，去找他吧。
ch.69e27ba46fce443e1c1c3a20: 芬兰湾里的确有部分水域会受到拉多加湖流入寒流的影响，但我不确定这点寒流是否足以把海面都冻上。
ch.69e27bc72e83574e096d053d: 但与此同时，也不能排除真的是 TerraGroup 的实验在捣鬼。
ch.69e27be741abf460ccf24249: 更像是 TerraGroup 掌控的设施出了点状况，导致洋流出现了波动，引起局部地区气温异常降低。我不觉得他们具备操纵气候的能力，至少目前没有。
ch.69e2827296971677ee67091e: 我可不想让其他人发现塔科夫里还有这种东西。
ch.69e2827eb0d702db218eb44f: 类似的东西我有，但如果你胆敢把那玩意用在市区里的话，最好还是在外头自我了断，别回来见我了。

cz.69baa783d105e6a8ca78f882: Dostal jsem se na ledoborec. Roguové už tam byli a zabili většinu posádky. Během útoku se aktivoval obranný systém a uzavřel různé sekce lodi.
cz.69baa78880922b3ce68ac5a1: Takže to znamená, že někdo přežil?
cz.69baa78c073a373fa58eb027: Nějakej vědec se zamknul v laboratorním bloku. Odmítá vylézt, dokud neuvidí kapitána.
cz.69baa79452066aa804e1b531: Měl by být na můstku, ale abych se tam dostal, budu muset projít přes všechna ta uzavřená patra.
cz.69baa79cd2e0e5436d837faf: Právě teď potřebuju výbušniny, abych se dostal na můstek.
cz.69baa7b3a832e385a4c6e887: Loď je obklopená ledem a sněhem. Jak je to v tomhle ročním období vůbec možné?
cz.69baa7bb4b8b2628468c0600: Takže je za tím jiný důvod?
cz.69baa7bf57c444cc373d5d18: Klima se rychle mění. Abnormální sněžení na pouštích, posuny proudů tam, kde to nikdo nečekal...
cz.69baa7c71120b556286737a9: To je trochu přitažené za vlasy...
cz.69baa7e46c2362d71a03e692: Nemáš náhodou na skladě nějaké výbušniny, co by se daly nastražit?
cz.69e27b8f7d22a698ebc4d18b: Ale slyšel jsem, že Praporovi nedávno přišla zásilka kumulativních náloží. Zeptej se ho.
cz.69e27ba46fce443e1c1c3a20: V některých částech zálivu jsou studené proudy tekoucí z Ladožského jezera, ale nejsem si jistý, jestli to stačí k tomu, aby hladina zamrzla.
cz.69e27bc72e83574e096d053d: Ale nevylučoval bych, že na to mají vliv i experimenty TerraGroup.
cz.69e27be741abf460ccf24249: Spíš to vypadá, že nějaká nehoda v zařízení TerraGroup způsobila změny v proudech, což vedlo k lokálním teplotním výkyvům.
cz.69e2827296971677ee67091e: Nechci, aby se někdo dozvěděl, že tyhle nálože v Tarkově ještě vůbec jsou.
cz.69e2827eb0d702db218eb44f: Něco bych dokázal sehnat, ale jestli se to pokusíš použít ve městě, tak se sem ani nevracej.

en.69baa783d105e6a8ca78f882: I made it to the icebreaker. The Rogues were already there and killed most of the crew. During the assault, a defense system activated and sealed off different sections of the ship.
en.69baa78c073a373fa58eb027: Some scientist guy locked himself in a lab block. Refuses to come out until he sees the captain.
en.69baa79452066aa804e1b531: Should be on the bridge, but to get there I’ll have to go through all the sealed levels.
en.69baa79cd2e0e5436d837faf: Right now I need explosives to break into the bridge.
en.69baa7a042b433ae75c8d128: I can’t help you with that.
en.69baa7b3a832e385a4c6e887: The ship is surrounded by ice and snow. How is that possible this time of year?
en.69baa7bf57c444cc373d5d18: The climate is changing fast. Abnormal snowfalls in deserts, shifts in currents where no one expected them…
en.69baa7c34367fd3cc2d9dcde: You think they’re developing climate weapons?
en.69baa7e46c2362d71a03e692: You wouldn’t happen to have any plantable explosives in stock?
en.69baa7e8dc24812691fd6a86: What, grenades aren’t good enough for you now?
en.69e27b8f7d22a698ebc4d18b: But I heard Prapor recently got a shipment of shaped charges. Ask him.
en.69e27ba46fce443e1c1c3a20: There are cold currents in parts of the gulf coming from Lake Ladoga, but I’m not sure that’s enough to freeze the surface.
en.69e27bc72e83574e096d053d: But I wouldn’t rule out TerraGroup experiments affecting this as well.
en.69e27be741abf460ccf24249: It’s more likely some kind of accident at a TerraGroup facility caused changes in currents, leading to localized temperature shifts.
en.69e2827296971677ee67091e: I don’t want anyone finding out those charges are still around in Tarkov.
en.69e2827eb0d702db218eb44f: I can find something, but if you try to use it inside the city, don’t bother coming back.
