es-mx.69c26fbeaaf54b9114b920b1: Ni puta idea. Si estás tan desesperado, ve a ayudar. Nadie te lo impide.
es-mx.69c26fc149443295ddb1bcf9: ¿Qué está pasando exactamente con los Rogues?
es-mx.69c26fc5faaed5ba0f32fb5b: No conozco los detalles y no voy a meterme en eso. Ve a preguntárselo tú mismo; verás que primero te dispararán y ni se molestarán en hacer preguntas después.
es-mx.69c26fcff4fb245d4052d0a5: Hablas como si esto también te hubiera afectado a ti, no solo a ellos. ¿Qué está pasando?
es-mx.69c26fd46d94d80e1f2e99a7: ¡Bueno, sí me afectó a mí también! Perdí un montón de trabajos con los que contaba.
es-mx.69c26fdb55421fa7915055ca: Lo entiendo. Si elimino a algunos de esos Rogues, a los contrabandistas no les importará, ¿verdad?
es-mx.69c26fe3b8c81e60165d203e: Ya te lo dije, haz lo que quieras. Ya tengo suficientes problemas como para preocuparme por eso.
es-mx.69c26fe9ccc9427f185028a6: Está bien. Volveré cuando me haya ocupado de los Rogues.
es-mx.69cd29fc535ddb127466339d: Necesito que revises la ruta desde la zona de la reserva natural hasta la planta de tratamiento de agua. Si sacan a su hombre, sabrán que tú les ayudaste.
es-mx.69cd29fc559c82a9ae079876: No tan rápido, hombre. En estos momentos, los Rogues tienen secuestrado a uno de los comandantes de los contrabandistas en su base, y eso es un gran problema.
es-mx.69cd29fc5f60f53bc1373ea8: Honestamente, no esperaba que ayudaras tanto. Los propios contrabandistas me preguntaron de dónde demonios habían salido esos refuerzos.
es-mx.69cd29fc6e08b184a68dd66b: Lo principal es asegurarte de que la ruta esté despejada y de que no haya nada inesperado esperándote por allí. Marca el inicio y el final con balizas estroboscópicas para que sepan que realmente la revisaste.
es-mx.69cd29fc93fbdf17c4145e17: ¿Entonces solo tengo que recorrer el camino desde el bosque hasta el faro?
es-mx.69cd29fc981ed8fc1cb71c5f: ¿Quieres que haga una extracción en solitario desde su base?
es-mx.69cd29fcab815e9e3a4746d8: No te precipites. Mejor espera a que terminen sus operaciones. Por ahora, ocúpate de lo tuyo en ese barco y luego regresa.
es-mx.69cd29fcb5deaf285e0d4828: Recorté el número de Rogues. ¿Eso cambió algo?
es-mx.69cd29fcbb3e033747a9ab27: ¿Entonces ahora hay una posibilidad de llegar más fácilmente al rompehielos?
es-mx.69cd29fcd496b670a277f29f: De acuerdo. ¿Y luego vuelvo directamente contigo?
es-mx.69cd29fce3826a54b4162935: Si alguien intenta asaltar ese lugar, matarán al comandante de inmediato. Pero los muchachos tienen un plan.
es-mx.69cd2d46bf317ddda2966a97: Bueno, obviamente es mejor que esperemos a que terminen sus operaciones. Pero por lo que he escuchado, ya se están preparando, así que para cuando volvamos a hablar, todo estará resuelto.

tu.69c26f73eba61e997c4aff97: Listen, is there any chance to work something out with the smugglers for a more convenient way to reach the ship?
tu.69c26f797b4f3391e6f85ed9: Something wrong with the hovercraft we arranged for you?
tu.69c26f7ec63c84219913e4b3: The pickup point’s bad. Too risky.
tu.69c26f820e77db10f637c7b7: Told you already, they’re not exactly fans of your kind…
tu.69c26f8503c92336c0183f26: I wouldn’t be asking if it wasn’t important. I’m ready to pay well and put in the work if it makes getting to the icebreaker easier.
tu.69c26f89588f2b8c7c2b085d: We’ve got a whole damn icebreaker sitting around now? And Rosatom just decided to leave something that big in Tarkov?
tu.69c26f8cfdece10c662a5652: Yeah, but it’s a private ship. Nothing to do with the government.
tu.69c26f91085b9f24ef5bcd42: Then I’m not asking whose it is. I’d like to stay alive, if you catch my drift.
tu.69c26f9562e25292bb1de39b: So what about transport? Can you find out if there’s a better route?
tu.69c26f993bf471cf832f7c48: If I were you, I’d drop it right now. They’ve got some shit going on with those USEC defectors, so they’ve got zero time for you and your requests.
tu.69c26fa4dd8a60a4117ef193: You don’t get it. They’ve got real problems right now. Be glad they haven’t canceled your boat deal already.
tu.69c26fa756a96921599aaa6a: Even if I pay a lot?
tu.69c26fbacbc44780b29627f1: Then maybe I help them deal with those USECs?
tu.69c26fbeaaf54b9114b920b1: Hell if I know. If you’re that desperate, go help. No one’s stopping you.
tu.69c26fc149443295ddb1bcf9: What exactly is going on with the Rogues?
tu.69c26fc5faaed5ba0f32fb5b: Don’t know the details, and I’m not getting into it. Go ask them yourself, they’ll shoot you first and ask questions never.
tu.69c26fcff4fb245d4052d0a5: You’re talking like this hit you too, not just them. What’s going on?
tu.69c26fd46d94d80e1f2e99a7: Well it did hit me too! I lost a chunk of jobs I was counting on.
tu.69c26fdb55421fa7915055ca: Got it. If I thin out some of those Rogues, the smugglers won’t mind, right?
tu.69c26fe3b8c81e60165d203e: I already told you, do what you want. I’ve got enough shit on my plate as it is.
tu.69c26fe9ccc9427f185028a6: Alright. I’ll come back once I deal with the Rogues.
tu.69cd29fc535ddb127466339d: Need you to check the route from the nature reserve area to the water treatment plant. If they pull their guy out, they’ll remember you helped.
tu.69cd29fc559c82a9ae079876: Don’t rush it, man. Right now the Rogues are holding one of the smuggler commanders at their base, and that’s a big problem.
tu.69cd29fc5eeb8d699ff00d9d: So what do you need from me?
tu.69cd29fc5f60f53bc1373ea8: Didn’t expect you to help that much, honestly. Smugglers themselves asked me where the hell that kind of backup came from.
tu.69cd29fc6e08b184a68dd66b: Main thing is to make sure the route’s clear and nothing unexpected is waiting there. Mark the start and end with IR strobes so they know you actually checked it.
tu.69cd29fc93fbdf17c4145e17: So just walk the path from woods to the lighthouse?
tu.69cd29fc981ed8fc1cb71c5f: You want me to run a solo extraction from their base?
tu.69cd29fcab815e9e3a4746d8: Hold your horses. Better wait until they finish their operation. Do your thing on that ship for now, then come back.
tu.69cd29fcb5deaf285e0d4828: I cut down the Rogue numbers. Did that change anything?
tu.69cd29fcbb3e033747a9ab27: So there’s a chance now for an easier route to the icebreaker?
tu.69cd29fcd496b670a277f29f: Okay. Then go right back to you?
tu.69cd29fce3826a54b4162935: If anyone tries to storm that place, they’ll ice the commander right away. But the guys have a plan.
tu.69cd2d46bf317ddda2966a97: Well obviously we better wait until they’re done with their operation. But from what I hear, they’re already gearing up, so by the time we talk again, it’ll be clear.

ru.69c26f73eba61e997c4aff97: Слушай, может всё-таки есть вариант договориться с контрабандистами о более удобном транспорте на ледокол?
ru.69c26f797b4f3391e6f85ed9: А что с этим катером не так?
ru.69c26f7ec63c84219913e4b3: Точка сбора неудобная, слишком много рисков.
ru.69c26f820e77db10f637c7b7: Я ж тебе уже говорил, что они не очень ваших любят…
ru.69c26f8503c92336c0183f26: Так и я не стал бы спрашивать, если бы это не было важно. Я готов хорошо заплатить и поработать, чтобы облегчить путь на ледокол.
ru.69c26f89588f2b8c7c2b085d: У нас тут чё, ледокол где-то стоит? И такую махину росатомщики решили оставить в Таркове?
ru.69c26f8cfdece10c662a5652: Ага. Только ледокол этот частный, с государством никак не связан.
ru.69c26f91085b9f24ef5bcd42: Тогда не буду спрашивать, чей он. Мне ещё пожить охота.
ru.69c26f9562e25292bb1de39b: Так что с транспортом? Ты сможешь узнать о более удобном маршруте?
ru.69c26f993bf471cf832f7c48: Я б на твоём месте сразу губу закатал. У них сейчас и так какая-то заруба с отступниками началась, так что вообще не до тебя и твоих хотелок.
ru.69c26fa4dd8a60a4117ef193: Ты не понял. Им реально сейчас не до заказов, скажи спасибо, что прошлый твой договор с катером ещё не отменили.
ru.69c26fa756a96921599aaa6a: Даже если я заплачу большую сумму?
ru.69c26fbacbc44780b29627f1: Так может я им в этой зарубе помогу?
ru.69c26fbeaaf54b9114b920b1: Я хер знает. Но если тебе больше всех надо, иди и помогай. Мешать никто не будет.
ru.69c26fc149443295ddb1bcf9: А что именно с отступниками случилось?
ru.69c26fc5faaed5ba0f32fb5b: Деталей не знаю и лезть в это не хочу. Если сам попрёшься к ним узнавать, то и тебя подстрелят, спрашивать не будут.
ru.69c26fcff4fb245d4052d0a5: Ты говоришь так, будто проблемы начались у тебя, а не у контрабандистов. Что не так?
ru.69c26fd46d94d80e1f2e99a7: Так оно и на меня повлияло тоже! Часть заказов слетела, а я на них очень рассчитывал.
ru.69c26fdb55421fa7915055ca: Я тебя понял. Если я устраню несколько отрядов отступников, контрабандисты вряд ли будут возражать. Согласен?
ru.69c26fe3b8c81e60165d203e: Я уже сказал, делай как знаешь. У меня пока и без этого всего достаточно проблем.
ru.69c26fe9ccc9427f185028a6: Ясно. Я вернусь позже, когда решу вопрос с отступниками.
ru.69cd29fc535ddb127466339d: Надо проверить маршрут из заповедника к очистным. Если в результате они своего человека смогут спасти – точно твоё участие не забудут.
ru.69cd29fc559c82a9ae079876: Не торопи события. Сейчас отступники держат у себя на базе одного из командиров контрабандистов, и это большая проблема.
ru.69cd29fc5f60f53bc1373ea8: А я и не ожидал, что ты поможешь так сильно. Контрабандисты сами меня спросили, откуда такая поддержка свалилась.
ru.69cd29fc6e08b184a68dd66b: Главное, убедись, что дорога в порядке и что там нет никаких неожиданностей. Пометь начало и конец маршрута маячками, чтобы подтвердить, что реально был там.
ru.69cd29fc93fbdf17c4145e17: Просто пройти по тропе с леса на маяк?
ru.69cd29fc981ed8fc1cb71c5f: Хочешь, чтобы я в одного провёл эвакуацию с их базы?
ru.69cd29fcab815e9e3a4746d8: Не спеши. Лучше дождаться окончания их операции. Короче, поделай пока другие дела на этом своём корабле, а потом возвращайся.
ru.69cd29fcb5deaf285e0d4828: Я сократил численность отступников. Ситуация хоть как-то поменялась?
ru.69cd29fcbb3e033747a9ab27: Значит, есть шансы получить более лёгкий путь на ледокол?
ru.69cd29fce3826a54b4162935: Если кто-то начнёт штурмовать позиции отступников, они сразу командира кокнут. Но у наших пацанов есть план.
ru.69cd2d46bf317ddda2966a97: Конечно лучше подождать, пока они проведут свою операцию. Но я слышал, что они уже на низком старте, так что к следующей нашей встрече всё будет понятно.

in.69cd29fc5eeb8d699ff00d9d: So what do you need from me?
in.69cd29fc5f60f53bc1373ea8: Didn’t expect you to help that much, honestly. Smugglers themselves asked me where the hell that kind of backup came from.
in.69cd29fc6e08b184a68dd66b: Main thing is to make sure the route’s clear and nothing unexpected is waiting there. Mark the start and end with IR strobes so they know you actually checked it.
in.69cd29fc93fbdf17c4145e17: So just walk the path from woods to the lighthouse?
in.69cd29fc981ed8fc1cb71c5f: You want me to run a solo extraction from their base?
in.69cd29fcab815e9e3a4746d8: Hold your horses. Better wait until they finish their operation. Do your thing on that ship for now, then come back.
in.69cd29fcb5deaf285e0d4828: I cut down the Rogue numbers. Did that change anything?
in.69cd29fcbb3e033747a9ab27: So there’s a chance now for an easier route to the icebreaker?
in.69cd29fcd496b670a277f29f: Okay. Then go right back to you?
in.69cd29fce3826a54b4162935: If anyone tries to storm that place, they’ll ice the commander right away. But the guys have a plan.
in.69cd2d46bf317ddda2966a97: Well obviously we better wait until they’re done with their operation. But from what I hear, they’re already gearing up, so by the time we talk again, it’ll be clear.

th.69c26f797b4f3391e6f85ed9: Something wrong with the hovercraft we arranged for you?
th.69c26f7ec63c84219913e4b3: The pickup point’s bad. Too risky.
th.69c26f820e77db10f637c7b7: Told you already, they’re not exactly fans of your kind…
th.69c26f8503c92336c0183f26: I wouldn’t be asking if it wasn’t important. I’m ready to pay well and put in the work if it makes getting to the icebreaker easier.
th.69c26f89588f2b8c7c2b085d: We’ve got a whole damn icebreaker sitting around now? And Rosatom just decided to leave something that big in Tarkov?
th.69c26f8cfdece10c662a5652: Yeah, but it’s a private ship. Nothing to do with the government.
th.69c26f91085b9f24ef5bcd42: Then I’m not asking whose it is. I’d like to stay alive, if you catch my drift.
th.69c26f9562e25292bb1de39b: So what about transport? Can you find out if there’s a better route?

th.69c26fa4dd8a60a4117ef193: You don’t get it. They’ve got real problems right now. Be glad they haven’t canceled your boat deal already.
th.69c26fa756a96921599aaa6a: Even if I pay a lot?
th.69c26fbacbc44780b29627f1: Then maybe I help them deal with those USECs?
th.69c26fbeaaf54b9114b920b1: Hell if I know. If you’re that desperate, go help. No one’s stopping you.
th.69c26fc149443295ddb1bcf9: What exactly is going on with the Rogues?
th.69c26fc5faaed5ba0f32fb5b: Don’t know the details, and I’m not getting into it. Go ask them yourself, they’ll shoot you first and ask questions never.
th.69c26fcff4fb245d4052d0a5: You’re talking like this hit you too, not just them. What’s going on?
th.69c26fd46d94d80e1f2e99a7: Well it did hit me too! I lost a chunk of jobs I was counting on.
th.69c26fdb55421fa7915055ca: Got it. If I thin out some of those Rogues, the smugglers won’t mind, right?
th.69c26fe3b8c81e60165d203e: I already told you, do what you want. I’ve got enough shit on my plate as it is.
th.69c26fe9ccc9427f185028a6: Alright. I’ll come back once I deal with the Rogues.

ch.69c2959bd43d09a74a1cc804: 我带了点东西来，这些够吗？
ch.69c2959ff828ae03f4ecf0cf: 先让我看看你都带了什么。
ch.69c295a5434c9fd52c786384: 我带了点伏特加。（上交伏特加）
ch.69c295b377ed12aaf250f56f: 我找到了一瓶私酿酒。（上交私酒）
ch.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: 哈哈，你连跑刀仔私酒都搞来了？卧槽可以啊，小心点放。
ch.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: 这有点面包干当零嘴。（上交黑麦面包干）
ch.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: 我带了点香肠，应该能下酒。（上交咸狗牛肉肠）
ch.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: 我吃这玩意吃了一辈子了，还是拿不准里面塞的到底是什么馅。行了，把它丢在那吧。
ch.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: 那我猜你这边还需要点时间才能有答复？
ch.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: 我哪知道。先继续坐气垫船，把你在那艘船上的事处理好。过段时间再回来，到时候就有明确答复了。
ch.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: 走私者那边成功把指挥官救出来了吗？
ch.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: 嗯。过程不算顺利，损失不小，但人是救出来了。
ch.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: 老实说，我还真没觉得他们能打得过那些游荡者。
ch.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: 那些走私的早在契约战争爆发之前就玩上枪了，他们之中还有不少本地的好手，都是服过兵役的狠角色。
ch.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: 那现在他们有时间帮我了吗？
ch.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: 我不能保证。是你自己选择掺和进这堆事的。不过我正好要过去一趟，可以顺便帮你问问。
ch.69c29781d118786f801867ad: 有什么是我能做的吗？你懂的，促成你们谈判。
ch.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: 他们的损失也真不少，不过暂时把游荡者压住了。所以接下来既要哀悼……也要庆祝。懂我意思吧？
ch.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: 对！带点吃的喝的，肯定能让场面好看很多。我这边可没时间替你准备这些。
ch.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: 怎么，你不信我这张嘴？下次我们再聊的时候，我已经全给你摆平了。
ch.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: 所以他们完全靠的是自己的人？
ch.6a046c943e2007344936e577: 哪能呢。冲突升级之后，那些小伙子很快就和一些 BEAR 搭上了线，还谈成了交易。走私者负责给几个 PMC 单位供应上好的武器，雇佣兵那边则帮忙出面平事儿。
ch.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: 当所有通信手段都玩逑了之后，有些 BEAR 就和走私者们混到一起去了。至少比困守在原地，等什么狗屁指挥部的命令安全些。

cz.69c2959bd43d09a74a1cc804: Přinesl jsem nějaké věci. Stačí to?
cz.69c295a5434c9fd52c786384: Mám tu nějakou vodku. (Předat láhev vodky)
cz.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: Ty máš Hatchlinga? Kurva jo, chlape, polož ho opatrně.
cz.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: Tady jsou nějaké suchary na zub. (Předat suchary)
cz.69c295bf53a40dc2360f164e: Něco na zub se hodí! Sem s tím...
cz.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: Přinesl jsem salám, myslel jsem, že by se mohl hodit. (Předat klobásu)
cz.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: Žeru tyhle sračky celej život, ale stejně pořád nevěřím tomu, co v tom je. No nic, hoď to sem.
cz.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: Hádám, že na odpověď si budu muset chvíli počkat?
cz.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: Čert ví. Prozatím dál používej vznášedlo a vyřiď si své záležitosti na lodi. Vrať se později, to už budeme mít jasnou odpověď.
cz.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: Tak co, zvládli ti pašeráci zachránit toho velitele?
cz.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: Jo. Neobešlo se to bez potíží, měli ztráty. Ale svého velitele dostali ven.
cz.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: Upřímně, ani jsem si nemyslel, že by pašeráci měli proti Rogues šanci.
cz.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: Pašeráci měli k lidem se zbraněmi blízko už před Válkama kontraktorů, a navíc je mezi nimi spousta místních nadšenců s pořádným výcvikem.
cz.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: Takže teď už mají čas mi pomoct?
cz.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: Nemůžu nic slíbit. Sám ses rozhodl se do toho zaplést. Ale stejně tam mám namířeno, tak se na tvou situaci taky poptám.
cz.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: Ztratili sice dost lidí, ale s Rogues se prozatím vypořádali. Takže se bude držet smutek... a taky slavit. Chápeš, co tím chci říct?
cz.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: Přesně tak! Přines nějaké zásoby, pomůže to. Já sám na to nemám čas.
cz.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: Cože, ty pochybuješ o mých přesvědčovacích schopnostech? Až spolu budeme mluvit příště, budu mít všechno vyřešené.
cz.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: Takže spoléhají výhradně na vlastní lidi?
cz.6a046c943e2007344936e577: Ale kdepak. Jakmile ten konflikt naplno vypukl, kluci se rychle spojili s pár lidmi z BEAR a dohodli se. Pašeráci zásobovali určité jednotky kvalitními zbraněmi výměnou za podporu.
cz.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: Jakmile šlo veškeré spojení do sraček, někteří z těch BEARů zůstali s pašeráky. Bezpečnější než jen tak sedět a čekat na rozkazy od velení.

en.69c2959bd43d09a74a1cc804: Brought some stuff. Is that enough?
en.69c295a5434c9fd52c786384: Got some vodka. (Hand over the bottle of vodka)
en.69c295b377ed12aaf250f56f: Found some moonshine. (Hand over the bottle of moonshine)
en.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: You got the Hatchling? Fuck yeah man, put it down carefully.
en.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: Here are some crackers for snacks. (Hand over the croutons)
en.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: Brought some sausage, thought it might help. (Hand over the sausage)
en.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: Been eating this crap my whole life, still don’t trust what’s in it. Alright, toss it here.
en.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: Guessing it’ll take some time for the answer?
en.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: Hell if I know. For now, keep using the hovercraft and handle your business on the ship. Come back later, we’ll have a clear answer then.
en.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: So, did the smugglers pull off the commander's rescue?
en.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: Yeah. Didn’t go clean, they took losses. But they got their commander out.
en.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: Honestly, I didn’t even think the smugglers stood a chance against the Rogues.
en.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: The smugglers already were tied to guns even before the Contract Wars, and there are plenty of local enthusiasts among them with solid training.
en.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: So now they’ve got time to help me?
en.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: Can’t promise anything. You chose to get involved in all this. But I’m heading over there anyway, I’ll ask about your situation too.
en.69c29781d118786f801867ad: Anything I can do to influence that?
en.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: They lost a lot of people, but they handled the Rogues for now. So there’ll be mourning… and celebration. You get what I’m saying?
en.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: Exactly! Bring some supplies, it’ll help. I don’t have time to deal with that myself.
en.69c297905e9ade83c68d6d03: Alright, I’ll get what I can.
en.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: What, you doubt my persuasion skills? Next time we talk, I’ll have everything sorted.
en.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: So they rely entirely on their own people?
en.6a046c943e2007344936e577: Nah. Once the conflict really kicked off, the boys got in touch with some BEARs fast and worked out a deal. The smugglers supplied certain units with quality weapons in exchange for support.
en.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: Once all communications went to shit, some of those BEAR guys stayed with the smugglers. Safer than sitting around waiting for orders from command.

it.69c2959bd43d09a74a1cc804: Ho portato un po' di roba. È abbastanza?
it.69c295a5434c9fd52c786384: Ho della vodka. (Consegna la bottiglia di vodka)
it.69c295b377ed12aaf250f56f: Ho trovato del liquore di contrabbando. (Consegna la bottiglia di liquore di contrabbando)
it.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: Ha preso l'Hatchling? Cazzo, sì, lo metta giù con attenzione.
it.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: Ecco dei cracker per uno spuntino. (Consegna i crostini)
it.69c295bf53a40dc2360f164e: Qualche snack andrà bene! Me li dia...
it.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: Ho portato delle salsicce, ho pensato che potessero servire. (Consegna le salsicce)
it.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: Ho mangiato questa schifezza per tutta la vita, eppure continuo a non fidarmi di ciò che contiene. Va bene, lo butti qui.
it.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: Immagino che ci vorrà un po' di tempo per avere una risposta?
it.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: Che diavolo ne so. Per ora, continua a usare l'hovercraft e occupati dei tuoi affari sulla nave. Torna più tardi, a quel punto avremo una risposta chiara.
it.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: Allora, i contrabbandieri sono riusciti a salvare il comandante?
it.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: Sì. Non è andata liscia, hanno subito delle perdite. Ma sono riusciti a portare in salvo il loro comandante.
it.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: Onestamente, non pensavo nemmeno che i contrabbandieri avessero una possibilità contro i Rogues.
it.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: I contrabbandieri erano già legati alle armi anche prima delle Guerre dei Contratti, e tra loro ci sono molti appassionati locali con una solida preparazione.
it.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: Quindi ora hanno tempo per aiutarmi?
it.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: Non posso promettere nulla. Hai scelto tu di farti coinvolgere in tutto questo. Ma io ci vado comunque, chiederò anche della tua situazione.
it.69c29781d118786f801867ad: C'è qualcosa che posso fare per influire su questo?
it.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: Hanno perso molte persone, ma per ora hanno avuto la meglio sui Rogues. Quindi ci saranno lutti… e festeggiamenti. Capisci cosa intendo?
it.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: Esatto! Porta delle provviste, saranno utili. Non ho tempo di occuparmene io.
it.69c297905e9ade83c68d6d03: Va bene, farò quello che posso.
it.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: Che c'è, dubiti delle mie capacità di persuasione? La prossima volta che parleremo, avrò sistemato tutto.
it.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: Quindi si affidano interamente alla propria gente?
it.6a046c943e2007344936e577: No. Una volta che il conflitto è davvero scoppiato, i ragazzi hanno contattato rapidamente alcuni BEAR e hanno concluso un accordo. I contrabbandieri hanno fornito a determinate unità armi di qualità in cambio di sostegno.
it.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: Una volta che tutte le comunicazioni sono andate a rotoli, alcuni di quei tizi della BEAR sono rimasti con i contrabbandieri. Era più sicuro che stare lì ad aspettare ordini dal comando.

jp.69c2959bd43d09a74a1cc804: Brought some stuff. Is that enough?
jp.69c295a5434c9fd52c786384: Got some vodka. (Hand over the bottle of vodka)
jp.69c295b377ed12aaf250f56f: Found some moonshine. (Hand over the bottle of moonshine)
jp.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: You got the Hatchling? Fuck yeah man, put it down carefully.
jp.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: Here are some crackers for snacks. (Hand over the croutons)
jp.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: Brought some sausage, thought it might help. (Hand over the sausage)
jp.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: Been eating this crap my whole life, still don’t trust what’s in it. Alright, toss it here.
jp.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: Guessing it’ll take some time for the answer?
jp.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: Hell if I know. For now, keep using the hovercraft and handle your business on the ship. Come back later, we’ll have a clear answer then.
jp.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: So, did the smugglers pull off the commander's rescue?
jp.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: Yeah. Didn’t go clean, they took losses. But they got their commander out.
jp.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: Honestly, I didn’t even think the smugglers stood a chance against the Rogues.
jp.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: The smugglers already were tied to guns even before the Contract Wars, and there are plenty of local enthusiasts among them with solid training.
jp.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: So now they’ve got time to help me?
jp.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: Can’t promise anything. You chose to get involved in all this. But I’m heading over there anyway, I’ll ask about your situation too.
jp.69c29781d118786f801867ad: Anything I can do to influence that?
jp.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: They lost a lot of people, but they handled the Rogues for now. So there’ll be mourning… and celebration. You get what I’m saying?
jp.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: Exactly! Bring some supplies, it’ll help. I don’t have time to deal with that myself.
jp.69c297905e9ade83c68d6d03: Alright, I’ll get what I can.
jp.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: What, you doubt my persuasion skills? Next time we talk, I’ll have everything sorted.
jp.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: So they rely entirely on their own people?
jp.6a046c943e2007344936e577: Nah. Once the conflict really kicked off, the boys got in touch with some BEARs fast and worked out a deal. The smugglers supplied certain units with quality weapons in exchange for support.
jp.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: Once all communications went to shit, some of those BEAR guys stayed with the smugglers. Safer than sitting around waiting for orders from command.

kr.69c2959bd43d09a74a1cc804: 먹을 걸 좀 가져왔어. 이 정도면 충분할까?
kr.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: 맹렬한 도끼런 밀주라고? 쩌는데, 거기에 안 깨지게 놔둬.
kr.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: 간식 거리로 크래커 좀 준비해 봤어. (크루통 건네주기)
kr.69c295bf53a40dc2360f164e: 간식도 좀 있으면 좋지! 여기에 놔둬…
kr.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: 소시지를 좀 가져왔는데, 이것도 있으면 좋을 거 같아. (소시지 건네기)
kr.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: 내 한평생 이 쓰레기 같은 걸 먹고 자랐는데, 아직도 안에 뭐가 들었는진 모르겠더라. 하튼, 여기에 놔둬.
kr.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: 또 다시 답을 들으려면 시간이 좀 걸리겠지?
kr.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: 나라고 알겠어. 지금 당장은 호버크래프트 타고 다니면서 네 용무부터 처리하고 있어봐. 나중에 와 보면 그땐 내가 확답을 줄 수 있겠지.
kr.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: 그래서, 그 밀수꾼들이 자기네 우두머리를 구출하는 데 성공했대?
kr.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: 그래, 그런데 일이 잘 풀린 건 아니래. 사상자가 좀 나왔다나. 아무튼 구출엔 성공했대.
kr.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: 솔직히 말해서 로그들을 상대로 해낼 거라곤 생각도 못 했는데.
kr.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: 이 밀수꾼 양반들은 계약 전쟁 시기 전부터 이미 총질 좀 하는 사람들이랑 연을 맺었었고, 제대로 된 훈련까지 받은 민간인들까지 꽤 있더라고.
kr.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: 그래서 이제 날 도와줄 수 있을 만큼 여유가 생겼대?
kr.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: 장담할 순 없어. 넌 이 난장판에 끼어들기로 결정했잖아. 하튼, 난 그 양반들한테 가볼 생각이라 네 상황에 대해서도 물어볼게.
kr.69c29781d118786f801867ad: 내가 도와줄 수 있는 게 있을까?
kr.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: 그 양반들도 병력 손실이 상당했는데, 그래도 지금 당장은 로그 놈들을 손 봐주는 데는 성공했자. 그래서 아마 그 사람들을 위해 추모할 겸… 축하 파티를 하려고 하더라고. 무슨 말인지 알겠지?
kr.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: 바로 그거야! 먹을 걸 좀 챙겨다 줘봐, 도움이 될 거야. 난 그거까지 신경 쓰긴 어려울 거 같거든.
kr.69c297905e9ade83c68d6d03: 그래, 내가 가져갈 수 있을 만큼 챙겨가지.
kr.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: 뭐, 내 협상 능력을 의심하기라도 하는 거야? 다음에 또 얘기할 때가 되면, 아마 전부 다 얘기가 됐을 거야.
kr.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: 그러면 그 사람들은 자기네 사람들에만 의존하는 건가?
kr.6a046c943e2007344936e577: 아니. 분쟁이 치열해지기 시작할 때, 그 양반들은 몇몇 BEAR 대원들하고 빨리 연을 맺고 일하기 시작했어. 밀수꾼들이 그 BEAR 용병들한테 품질 좋은 장비들을 보내주는 대가로 그 용병들의 지원을 얻어냈지.
kr.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: 모든 통신이 두절되면서 몇몇 BEAR 용병들은 그 밀수꾼들 밑으로 들어갔어. 가만히 죽치고 앉아서 지휘부 명령만 기다리는 것보단 낫겠다면서.

po.69c2959ff828ae03f4ecf0cf: Vamos ver o que você tem.
po.69c295a5434c9fd52c786384: Trouxe uma vodka. (Entregar a garrafa de vodka)
po.69c295b377ed12aaf250f56f: Encontrei uma aguardente. (Entregar a garrafa de aguardente)
po.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: Você conseguiu o Hatchling? Porra, aí sim cara, coloca com cuidado.
po.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: Aqui estão alguns biscoitos para petiscar. (Entregar os croutons)
po.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: Trouxe uma linguiça, achei que poderia ajudar. (Entregar a linguiça)
po.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: Como essa porcaria a vida toda, ainda não confio no que tem aqui dentro. Tudo bem, joga aqui.
po.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: Imagino que vai demorar um tempo para ter uma resposta?
po.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: Sei lá. Por enquanto, continue usando o hovercraft e cuida dos seus negócios no navio. Volta mais tarde, aí teremos uma resposta clara.
po.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: Então, os contrabandistas conseguiram resgatar o comandante?
po.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: Sim. Não foi limpo, tiveram baixas. Mas conseguiram tirar o comandante.
po.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: Honestamente, nem achei que os contrabandistas tinham chance contra os Rogues.
po.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: Os contrabandistas já tinham ligação com armas antes mesmo das Contract Wars, e há muitos entusiastas locais entre eles com treinamento sólido.
po.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: Então agora eles têm tempo para me ajudar?
po.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: Não posso prometer nada. Você escolheu se envolver em tudo isso. Mas vou lá de qualquer jeito, vou perguntar sobre a sua situação também.
po.69c29781d118786f801867ad: Há algo que eu possa fazer para influenciar isso?
po.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: Eles perderam muita gente, mas deram um jeito nos Rogues por enquanto. Então vai ter luto… e celebração. Você entende o que estou dizendo?
po.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: Exatamente! Traga alguns suprimentos, vai ajudar. Não tenho tempo para cuidar disso sozinho.
po.69c297905e9ade83c68d6d03: Certo, vou pegar o que conseguir.
po.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: O quê, você duvida das minhas habilidades de persuasão? Na próxima vez que conversarmos, terei tudo resolvido.
po.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: Então eles dependem totalmente dos seus próprios homens?
po.6a046c943e2007344936e577: Não. Quando o conflito realmente começou, os caras entraram em contato com uns BEARs rapidamente e fizeram um acordo. Os contrabandistas forneceram armas de qualidade para certas unidades em troca de apoio.
po.6a046cb9795e2adfc9062894: E o que aconteceu depois disso?
po.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: Quando todas as comunicações foram por água abaixo, alguns daqueles caras do BEAR ficaram com os contrabandistas. Mais seguro do que ficar esperando ordens do comando.

es.69c295a5434c9fd52c786384: Tengo vodka. (Entrega la Botella de vodka)
es.69c295b377ed12aaf250f56f: He encontrado algo de aguardiente. (Entrega la Botella de aguardiente)
es.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: ¿Has traído el Hatchling? ¡Joder, sí, tío! Ponlo con cuidado.
es.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: Aquí tienes unos aperitivos. (Entrega los Picatostes)
es.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: Traje salchichas; pensé que podrían venir bien. (Entrega las Salchichas)
es.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: Llevo toda la vida comiendo esta porquería, y aun así no me fío de lo que están hechas. Vale, déjamelas aquí.
es.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: ¿Supongo que la respuesta tardará un poco?
es.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: Ni puñetera idea. Por ahora, sigue usando el aerodeslizador y ocúpate de tus asuntos en el barco. Vuelve más tarde; para entonces tendremos una respuesta definitiva.
es.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: Entonces, ¿los contrabandistas lograron rescatar al comandante?
es.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: Sí. No salió del todo bien, sufrieron bajas. Pero sacaron a su comandante de allí.
es.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: Honestamente, no creía que los contrabandistas tuvieran alguna posibilidad contra los Rogues.
es.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: Los contrabandistas ya estaban vinculados al mundo de las armas incluso antes de las Contract Wars, y cuentan con muchos entusiastas locales muy bien entrenados entre sus filas.
es.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: ¿Así que ahora tienen tiempo para ayudarme?
es.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: No puedo prometerte nada. Tú elegiste meterte en todo esto. Pero voy a ir para allá de todos modos; también preguntaré por tu situación.
es.69c29781d118786f801867ad: ¿Hay algo que pueda hacer para influir en eso?
es.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: Han perdido a mucha gente, pero por ahora se las han arreglado con los Rogues. Así que estarán de luto… y celebrando. ¿Entiendes lo que quiero decir?
es.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: ¡Exacto! Trae provisiones; eso ayudará. No tengo tiempo para ocuparme de eso por mi cuenta.
es.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: ¿Qué, dudas de mis poderes de persuasión? La próxima vez que hablemos, tendré todo resuelto.
es.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: ¿Así que dependen por completo de su propia gente?
es.6a046c943e2007344936e577: Nah. En cuanto el conflicto se desató de verdad, los chicos enseguida se pusieron en contacto con algunos miembros de BEAR y llegaron a un acuerdo. Los contrabandistas suministraron armas de calidad a ciertas unidades a cambio de apoyo.
es.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: Cuando todas las comunicaciones se fueron a la mierda, algunos de esos hombres del BEAR se quedaron con los contrabandistas. Era más seguro que quedarse esperando órdenes del mando.

es-mx.69c295a5434c9fd52c786384: Traje vodka. (Entrega la Botella de vodka)
es-mx.69c295b377ed12aaf250f56f: Encontré un poco de licor casero. (Entrega la Botella de licor casero)
es-mx.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: ¿Trajiste el Hatchling? ¡A huevo, hombre! Ponlo con cuidado.
es-mx.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: Para comer, aquí tengo algo crujiente. (Entrega los Crotones)
es-mx.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: Traje salchichas; pensé que podrían venir bien. (Entrega las Salchichas)
es-mx.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: He comido esta porquería toda mi vida, y aun así no confío de qué están hechas. Está bien, échalas pa'cá.
es-mx.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: Supongo que la respuesta tardará un poco, ¿no?
es-mx.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: Ni puta idea. Por ahora, sigue usando el aerodeslizador y ocúpate de tus asuntos en el barco. Regresa más tarde; para entonces tendremos una respuesta definitiva.
es-mx.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: Entonces, ¿los contrabandistas lograron rescatar al comandante?
es-mx.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: Sí. No salió del todo bien, sufrieron bajas. Pero sacaron a su comandante de ahí.
es-mx.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: Honestamente, no creía que los contrabandistas tuvieran alguna posibilidad contra los Rogues.
es-mx.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: Los contrabandistas ya estaban vinculados al mundo de las armas incluso antes de la Guerra de los Contratos, y cuentan con muchos aficionados locales bien entrenados entre sus filas.
es-mx.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: ¿Así que ahora tienen tiempo para ayudarme?
es-mx.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: No puedo prometerte nada. Tú elegiste meterte en todo esto. Pero voy a ir para allá de todos modos; también preguntaré por tu situación.
es-mx.69c29781d118786f801867ad: ¿Hay algo que pueda hacer para influir en eso?
es-mx.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: Perdieron a mucha gente, pero por ahora se las arreglaron con los Rogues. Así que estarán de luto… y celebrando. ¿Entiendes lo que quiero decir?
es-mx.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: ¡Exacto! Lleva algunos suministros; eso ayudará. No tengo tiempo para ocuparme de eso por mi cuenta.
es-mx.69c297905e9ade83c68d6d03: De acuerdo, conseguiré lo que pueda.
es-mx.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: ¿Qué, dudas de mis habilidades de persuasión? La próxima vez que hablemos, tendré todo resuelto.
es-mx.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: ¿Así que dependen totalmente de su propia gente?
es-mx.6a046c943e2007344936e577: Nah. Cuando el conflicto comenzó de verdad, los muchachos se pusieron en contacto de inmediato con algunos BEAR y llegaron a un acuerdo. Los contrabandistas suministraron armas de calidad a ciertas unidades a cambio de apoyo.
es-mx.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: Cuando todas las comunicaciones se fueron a la mierda, algunos de esos hombres del BEAR se quedaron con los contrabandistas. Era más seguro que quedarse esperando órdenes del mando.

tu.69c2959bd43d09a74a1cc804: Brought some stuff. Is that enough?
tu.69c295a5434c9fd52c786384: Got some vodka. (Hand over the bottle of vodka)
tu.69c295b377ed12aaf250f56f: Found some moonshine. (Hand over the bottle of moonshine)
tu.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: You got the Hatchling? Fuck yeah man, put it down carefully.
tu.69c295bba0c15c86461146df: Here are some crackers for snacks. (Hand over the croutons)
tu.69c295c30569ecd0e7f9772d: Brought some sausage, thought it might help. (Hand over the sausage)
tu.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: Been eating this crap my whole life, still don’t trust what’s in it. Alright, toss it here.
tu.69c295e6459ac3bacdd98c0e: Guessing it’ll take some time for the answer?
tu.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: Hell if I know. For now, keep using the hovercraft and handle your business on the ship. Come back later, we’ll have a clear answer then.
tu.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: So, did the smugglers pull off the commander's rescue?
tu.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: Yeah. Didn’t go clean, they took losses. But they got their commander out.
tu.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: Honestly, I didn’t even think the smugglers stood a chance against the Rogues.
tu.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: The smugglers already were tied to guns even before the Contract Wars, and there are plenty of local enthusiasts among them with solid training.
tu.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: So now they’ve got time to help me?
tu.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: Can’t promise anything. You chose to get involved in all this. But I’m heading over there anyway, I’ll ask about your situation too.
tu.69c29781d118786f801867ad: Anything I can do to influence that?
tu.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: They lost a lot of people, but they handled the Rogues for now. So there’ll be mourning… and celebration. You get what I’m saying?
tu.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: Exactly! Bring some supplies, it’ll help. I don’t have time to deal with that myself.
tu.69c297905e9ade83c68d6d03: Alright, I’ll get what I can.
tu.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: What, you doubt my persuasion skills? Next time we talk, I’ll have everything sorted.
tu.6a046c79d5fea0c8d0320f7b: So they rely entirely on their own people?
tu.6a046c943e2007344936e577: Nah. Once the conflict really kicked off, the boys got in touch with some BEARs fast and worked out a deal. The smugglers supplied certain units with quality weapons in exchange for support.
tu.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: Once all communications went to shit, some of those BEAR guys stayed with the smugglers. Safer than sitting around waiting for orders from command.

ru.69c295b64cda524f69729c36: «Топориста» что ли нашёл? Ну красавец, аккуратно только положь, чтоб не разбился.
ru.69c295bf53a40dc2360f164e: Закуска градус крадёт, паря! Давай их сюда…
ru.69c295c81a377e6dae3b9951: Хоть я эту колбасу всю жизнь жру, а подозрений к составу меньше не стало. Ладно, закидывай сюда.
ru.69c295ea52e4d220d5da2425: Хер знает. Пока что можешь продолжать ездить на ледокол на катере и делать там свои дела. А ко мне вернись как-нибудь попозже, там уже точно всё прояснится.
ru.69c2975a5b2ce2b83ba4ad18: Ну что, контрабандисты уже провели операцию по спасению своего человека с очистных?
ru.69c2975f97ff0db8824b6193: Да. Прошло не очень гладко, уходили с потерями. Но командира вытащили.
ru.69c29768b491121fe8dfcf5e: Честно, я даже не думал, что у контрабандистов есть шансы против отступников.
ru.69c2976c9794d072f119045b: У контрабандистов ещё до Контрактных войн были подвязки по теме оружия, и местных энтузиастов с неплохой подготовкой среди них немало.
ru.69c297790e7489f08e44b1c2: Теперь у них появится время на то, чтобы помочь мне в ответ?
ru.69c2977d85a3c5d5d4481d00: Ничего обещать не могу, ты сам решил во всё это влезть. Но я планирую заехать к ним и спросить по своим делам. За тебя тоже узнаю.
ru.69c29781d118786f801867ad: Я могу как-то повлиять на результат этой встречи?
ru.69c29785f17732668683e8f5: У контрабандистов много народу полегло, но и с отступниками они вроде разобрались пока что. Так что будут и поминки, и триумф. Понимаешь, к чему я веду?
ru.69c2978c450bd35541e2cbe5: Да! Если притащишь гостинцев, здорово поможешь, а то у меня времени на это нет.
ru.69cd2fe686341610bc5e89be: Ты чё, в моих навыках сомневаешься? К следующей нашей встрече вся инфа уже будет у меня.
ru.6a046c943e2007344936e577: Не. Когда серьёзная заруба началась, парни быстро на бирцов вышли и договорились о сотрудничестве. Контрабандисты снабжали некоторые подразделения хорошим оружием в обмен на поддержку.
ru.6a046cce74819baf1327727e: Когда вся связь накрылась, часть бирцов осталась с контрабандистами. Это было надёжнее, чем ждать приказов от руководства.

ch.69c2abba6ba87bd6105ae5be: 你那边跟走私者谈得怎么样了？没把我搭船这事忘了吧？
ch.69c2abbe66b9e276b4e9116d: 怎么可能忘！我慢慢跟你说……嗝……你身上有没有什么能解酒的东西？
ch.69c2abcb5a57db5a4792ec37: 唉，真他妈难受……算了，扛一扛吧。
ch.69c2abd7d61ede7a2e39c360: 给你。（上交安乃近止痛药）
ch.69c2abdcb14d5c59396869b2: 我不爱吃药……不过还是谢了。
ch.69c2abe1189dd202e8d261d0: 幸好我带了这个。（上交淡啤酒）
ch.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: 卧槽，这才对味！你可真是救了我这条狗命啊！
ch.69c2abebe092822a4c4ab85e: 我就知道你用得上这个。（上交牛肉罐头）
ch.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: 你都这样了还开车呢？行吧，给你这个。（上交塔克肉干）
ch.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: 能不能弄点带肥肉的来，吃着香点？算了，有得吃就行。
ch.69c2abfcd24e8c49f6622a2d: 你运气不错。（上交罐装腌黄瓜）
ch.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: 还好我资源管理做得好，给我留点！（上交纯净水）
ch.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: 不行不行，要一口气全喝光，我们就得翻到路边去了……不过还是谢了！
ch.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: 这小玩意儿可救过我不止一次。（上交Aquamari水瓶）
ch.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: 哟……Aquamari 啊，我自己可从来舍不得买，太贵了。拿来吧。
ch.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: 你帮着把游荡者那摊子事收拾得差不多了。所以嘛，我这边也给你谈下来了。
ch.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: 他们把气垫船换到更安全的位置了？
ch.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: 还不止！他们现在可以直接把你从家里送到破冰船上。或者你那个藏身处，随你怎么叫。
ch.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: 听起来太离谱了。我可不会把藏身处的坐标给他们。
ch.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: 那你就给个附近合适的位置就行了，这事没你想的那么复杂。
ch.69c2ac59939d44679333a0cd: 那行吧。他们什么时候能准备好？
ch.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: 他们已经在开始准备了。等你回去的时候，应该就差不多搞定了。记住，运费你自己出，而且价格可不低。
ch.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: 可以，没问题。谢了，这一路帮了不少忙。
ch.69c2ac9efd161eeccaffc47f: 完美！他们需要时间准备吗？
ch.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: 我们现在说话这会儿他们就已经在忙了。所以别担心，你回去的时候就能用了。就是记得准备好钱。

cz.69c2abba6ba87bd6105ae5be: Tak co, jak to dopadlo s těma pašerákama? Nezapomněl jsi na můj transport?
cz.69c2abbe66b9e276b4e9116d: Jasně že nezapomněl! Všechno ti řeknu… Uf… Nemáš něco na kocovinu?
cz.69c2abcb5a57db5a4792ec37: Do prdele… No nic, to přežiju.
cz.69c2abe1189dd202e8d261d0: Ještě že jsem vzal tohle. (Předat láhev piva)
cz.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: Ty vole, tak to je ono! Zachránils mě!
cz.69c2abebe092822a4c4ab85e: Říkal jsem si, že se ti to bude hodit. (Předat konzervu hovězího masa)
cz.69c2abf0a31ea5620556a995: Není to špatný, není to špatný…
cz.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: Proč vlastně takhle vůbec jezdíš? No tak jo, na. (Předat balení sušeného masa)
cz.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: Nemáš tam něco tučnějšího? Ale co, beru.
cz.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: Naštěstí umím dobře hospodařit se zásobama. Nech mi taky trochu! (Předat kanystr s čištěnou vodou)
cz.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: Ne, sorry. Jestli to nevypiju všechno naráz, tak tu ztvrdneme na pěkně dlouho... Ale díky!
cz.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: Tenhle nápoj mě zachránil už nejednou. (Předat láhev Aquamari)
cz.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: Opa… Aquamari jsem si sám nikdy nekoupil, je to kurva drahý. Sem s tím.
cz.69c2ac37b7a6d5636c7beb50: Tak co ten můj transport k ledoborci?
cz.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: Udělal jsi hodně pro to, aby se vyřešil ten bordel s Rogue. Takže jo, něco jsem domluvil.
cz.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: Přesunou to vznášedlo na lepší místo?
cz.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: Ještě líp! Jsou připraveni tě hodit na ledoborec přímo z tvé základny. Nebo jak tomu svému sklepu vlastně říkáš.
cz.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: To zní až moc dobře, než aby to byla pravda. Svoje souřadnice úkrytu jim nedám.
cz.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: Tak jim dej nějaké místo poblíž. Není to tak složitý, kámo.
cz.69c2ac59939d44679333a0cd: To je fuk. Kdy budou připravení?
cz.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: Už to začínají připravovat. Než se vrátíš domů, bude to hotové. Jen pamatuj, že poplatky za dopravu platíš ty, a není to zrovna levná záležitost.
cz.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: To beru. Díky za veškerou pomoc.
cz.69c2ac9efd161eeccaffc47f: Perfektní! Potřebují čas, aby všechno připravili?
cz.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: Už na tom pracují, zatímco spolu mluvíme. Takže se neboj, až se vrátíš, bude to připravené. Jen buď připravenej platit.
cz.69c2aca6f4a24af94d175e3e: To se dalo čekat… No, díky za pomoc.

en.69c2abba6ba87bd6105ae5be: So, how did it go with the smugglers? You didn’t forget about my transport?
en.69c2abbe66b9e276b4e9116d: Of course I didn’t! I’ll tell you everything… Ugh… You got anything for a hangover?
en.69c2abe1189dd202e8d261d0: Good thing I brought this then. (Hand over the bottle of beer)
en.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: Oh damn, now that’s what I’m talking about! You saved me!
en.69c2abebe092822a4c4ab85e: Figured you’d need this. (Hand over the can of beef stew)
en.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: Why are you even driving like this? Fine, here. (Hand over the pack of dried meat)
en.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: Got anything fattier? Eh, whatever, I’ll take it.
en.69c2abfcd24e8c49f6622a2d: Lucky you. (Hand over the jar of pickles)
en.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: Thankfully I’m good at resource management. Leave some for me! (Hand over the canister with purified water)
en.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: Nah, sorry. We’re gonna be stuck here for a while if I don’t chug it all… But thanks!
en.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: This little drink saved me more than once. (Hand over the bottle of Aquamari)
en.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: Opa… Never bought Aquamari myself, too damn expensive. Hand it over.
en.69c2ac37b7a6d5636c7beb50: So what about my transport to the icebreaker?
en.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: You did a lot to wrap up that Rogue mess. So yeah, I worked something out.
en.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: They’re gonna move the hovercraft to a better spot?
en.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: Even better! They’re ready to drop you onto the icebreaker straight from your base. Or whatever you call that basement of yours.
en.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: Sounds too good to be true. I’m not giving them my hideout coordinates.
en.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: Then give them something nearby. It’s not that complicated, dude.
en.69c2ac59939d44679333a0cd: Whatever. When will they be ready?
en.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: They’re already getting things set up. By the time you’re back home, it’ll be ready. Just remember, transport fees are on you, and it’s really not cheap.
en.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: That works. Thank you for all the help.
en.69c2ac9efd161eeccaffc47f: Perfect! Do they need time to prepare everything?
en.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: They’re already working on it while we’re talking. So don’t worry, it’ll be ready when you get back. Just be ready to pay.
en.69c2aca6f4a24af94d175e3e: Figures… Well, thanks for the help.

it.69c2abba6ba87bd6105ae5be: Allora, com'è andata con i contrabbandieri? Non ti sei dimenticato del mio carico?
it.69c2abbe66b9e276b4e9116d: Certo che no! Ti dirò tutto… Uff… Hai qualcosa per i postumi della sbornia?
it.69c2abe1189dd202e8d261d0: Meno male che l'ho portato, allora. (Consegna la bottiglia di birra)
it.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: Oh cavolo, ecco di questo che stavo parlando! Mi ha salvato!
it.69c2abebe092822a4c4ab85e: Ho pensato che ti sarebbe servito. (Ti porge la lattina di stufato di manzo)
it.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: Perché guida in questo modo? Va bene, ecco. (Consegna il pacchetto di carne essiccata)
it.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: Hai qualcosa di più grasso? Eh, va bene, lo prendo.
it.69c2abfcd24e8c49f6622a2d: Che fortuna. (Consegna il barattolo di sottaceti)
it.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: Per fortuna sono bravo a gestire le risorse. Lasciatene un po' anche a me! (Consegna la tanica con l'acqua purificata)
it.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: No, mi dispiace. Rimarremo bloccati qui per un po' se non me lo bevo tutto d'un fiato... Ma grazie!
it.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: Questa bevandina mi ha salvato più di una volta. (Consegna la bottiglia di Aquamari)
it.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: Opa… Non ho mai comprato Aquamari, è troppo dannatamente costoso. Me lo dia.
it.69c2ac37b7a6d5636c7beb50: E per quanto riguarda il mio trasporto fino alla nave rompighiaccio?
it.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: Lei ha fatto molto per risolvere quel pasticcio con i Rogue. Quindi sì, ho trovato una soluzione.
it.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: Spostano l'hovercraft in un punto migliore?
it.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: Ancora meglio! Sono pronti a lanciarla direttamente sul rompighiaccio dalla sua base. O come mai chiama quel suo seminterrato.
it.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: Sembra troppo bello per essere vero. Non darò loro le coordinate del mio nascondiglio.
it.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: Poi dai loro qualcosa nelle vicinanze. Non è poi così complicato, amico.
it.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: Stanno già preparando tutto. Quando tornerà a casa, sarà pronto. Ricorda solo che le spese di trasporto sono a suo carico, e non sono affatto economiche.
it.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: Va bene così. Grazie per tutto l'aiuto.
it.69c2ac9efd161eeccaffc47f: Perfetto! Hanno bisogno di tempo per preparare tutto?
it.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: Ci stanno già lavorando mentre parliamo. Quindi non ti preoccupare, sarà pronto al tuo ritorno. Preparati solo a pagare.
it.69c2aca6f4a24af94d175e3e: Ci avrei scommesso… Beh, grazie per l’aiuto.

kr.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: 오, 이게 제대로 된 숙취 해소제지! 너가 날 살렸어!
kr.69c2abebe092822a4c4ab85e: 이게 너한테 필요할 거 같더라고. (소고기 스튜 통조림 건네기)
kr.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: 왜 이따구로 운전하는 건데? 자, 옛다. (육포 한 봉지 건네기)
kr.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: 좀 더 기름진 건 없어? 에휴, 됐다. 이거면 되겠지.
kr.69c2abfcd24e8c49f6622a2d: 너 정말 운 좋은 줄 알아. (피클 병 건네기)
kr.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: 내가 좀 자원 관리를 잘 하거든. 야, 내 몫도 좀 남겨놔! (정제수 통 건네기)
kr.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: 미안한데 그건 안 될 거 같아. 내가 이걸 다 들이켜지 않으면 우리 여기서 한참 썩어야 할걸… 그래도 생각해서 준 건 고마워!
kr.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: 이 물통이 날 몇 번이나 살려줬지. (아쿠아마리 물통 건네기)
kr.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: 웜메, 씨벌… 아쿠아마리 물통들은 죄 비싸가지고 내 돈주고 사본 적이 없는데. 이리 내놔.
kr.69c2ac37b7a6d5636c7beb50: 그래서 쇄빙선으로 갈 내 운송 수단은 어떻게 됐어?
kr.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: 그 로그 새끼들 조지느라 정말 고생했어. 그래, 그래서 내가 좀 약을 쳐봤지.
kr.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: 그 사람들이 호버크래프트를 더 좋은 곳으로 옮겨준대?
kr.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: 그보다 더 좋은 조건이지! 네 은신처인지 지하 기지인지 모를 곳에서 바로 쇄빙선으로 갈 수 있게 해준대.
kr.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: 너무 후하게 나오니까 수상한데. 내 은신처 좌표를 그대로 넘겨주긴 어렵겠는걸.
kr.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: 그러면 근처에 있는 아무 곳이라도 알려주던가.
kr.69c2ac59939d44679333a0cd: 아무튼 간에, 언제쯤 준비될 것 같대?
kr.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: 그 양반들은 이미 준비하고 있더라. 네가 도착했을 때 쯤이면 이미 준비는 다 마쳤을 거야. 표값 챙기는 거만 잊지 마, 뒤지게 비싸니까.
kr.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: 그 정도면 됐다, 도와줘서 정말 고마워.
kr.69c2ac9efd161eeccaffc47f: 좋았어! 혹시 그 사람들이 준비할 시간이 좀 필요한가?
kr.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: 우리가 얘기하는 동안에 이미 준비하고 있다 하더라. 그러니까 걱정하지 마셔, 돌아갈 떄 쯤이면 이미 준비는 다 됐을 테니까. 표값이나 준비하면 돼.
kr.69c2aca6f4a24af94d175e3e: 그럴 거 같더라… 뭐, 도와줘서 고마워.

pl.69c2abba6ba87bd6105ae5be: So, how did it go with the smugglers? You didn’t forget about my transport?
pl.69c2abbe66b9e276b4e9116d: Of course I didn’t! I’ll tell you everything… Ugh… You got anything for a hangover?
pl.69c2abe1189dd202e8d261d0: Good thing I brought this then. (Hand over the bottle of beer)
pl.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: Oh damn, now that’s what I’m talking about! You saved me!
pl.69c2abebe092822a4c4ab85e: Figured you’d need this. (Hand over the can of beef stew)
pl.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: Why are you even driving like this? Fine, here. (Hand over the pack of dried meat)
pl.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: Got anything fattier? Eh, whatever, I’ll take it.
pl.69c2abfcd24e8c49f6622a2d: Lucky you. (Hand over the jar of pickles)
pl.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: Thankfully I’m good at resource management. Leave some for me! (Hand over the canister with purified water)
pl.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: Nah, sorry. We’re gonna be stuck here for a while if I don’t chug it all… But thanks!
pl.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: This little drink saved me more than once. (Hand over the bottle of Aquamari)
pl.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: Opa… Never bought Aquamari myself, too damn expensive. Hand it over.
pl.69c2ac37b7a6d5636c7beb50: So what about my transport to the icebreaker?
pl.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: You did a lot to wrap up that Rogue mess. So yeah, I worked something out.
pl.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: They’re gonna move the hovercraft to a better spot?
pl.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: Even better! They’re ready to drop you onto the icebreaker straight from your base. Or whatever you call that basement of yours.
pl.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: Sounds too good to be true. I’m not giving them my hideout coordinates.
pl.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: Then give them something nearby. It’s not that complicated, dude.
pl.69c2ac59939d44679333a0cd: Whatever. When will they be ready?
pl.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: They’re already getting things set up. By the time you’re back home, it’ll be ready. Just remember, transport fees are on you, and it’s really not cheap.
pl.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: That works. Thank you for all the help.
pl.69c2ac9efd161eeccaffc47f: Perfect! Do they need time to prepare everything?
pl.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: They’re already working on it while we’re talking. So don’t worry, it’ll be ready when you get back. Just be ready to pay.
pl.69c2aca6f4a24af94d175e3e: Figures… Well, thanks for the help.

po.69c2abba6ba87bd6105ae5be: Então, como foi com os contrabandistas? Você não esqueceu do meu transporte?
po.69c2abbe66b9e276b4e9116d: Claro que não! Vou te contar tudo… Ugh… Você tem alguma coisa para ressaca?
po.69c2abcb5a57db5a4792ec37: Bom, merda… Tudo bem, vou sobreviver.
po.69c2abe1189dd202e8d261d0: Ainda bem que trouxe isso então. (Entregar a garrafa de cerveja)
po.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: Nossa, agora sim! Você me salvou!
po.69c2abebe092822a4c4ab85e: Achei que ia precisar disso. (Entregar a lata de carne ensopada)
po.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: Por que você está dirigindo assim? Tudo bem, aqui. (Entregar o pacote de carne seca)
po.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: Tem algo mais gorduroso? Eh, tanto faz, fico com isso.
po.69c2abfcd24e8c49f6622a2d: Você tem sorte. (Entregar o pote de picles)
po.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: Felizmente sou bom em gerenciamento de recursos. Deixa um pouco para mim! (Entregar o galão de água purificada)
po.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: Não, desculpa. A gente vai ficar preso aqui por um tempo se eu não beber tudo… Mas obrigado!
po.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: Essa bebidinha me salvou mais de uma vez. (Entregar a garrafa de Aquamari)
po.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: Opa… Nunca comprei Aquamari, caro demais. Passa aqui.
po.69c2ac37b7a6d5636c7beb50: E o meu transporte para o quebra-gelo?
po.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: Você fez muito para resolver aquela bagunça dos Rogues. Então sim, resolvi uma coisa.
po.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: Vão mover o hovercraft para um lugar melhor?
po.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: Ainda melhor! Estão prontos para te largar no quebra-gelo direto da sua base. Ou como quer que você chame aquele porão seu.
po.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: Parece bom demais para ser verdade. Não vou dar a eles as coordenadas do meu esconderijo.
po.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: Então dê algo próximo. Não é tão complicado, cara.
po.69c2ac59939d44679333a0cd: Tanto faz. Quando vão estar prontos?
po.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: Já estão organizando tudo. Quando você voltar para casa, vai estar pronto. Só lembre, as taxas de transporte são por sua conta, e não são baratas.
po.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: Combinado. Obrigado por toda a ajuda.
po.69c2ac9efd161eeccaffc47f: Perfeito! Eles precisam de tempo para preparar tudo?
po.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: Já estão trabalhando nisso enquanto conversamos. Não se preocupe, vai estar pronto quando você voltar. Só esteja pronto para pagar.

es.69c2abba6ba87bd6105ae5be: ¿Y qué tal te fue con los contrabandistas? No te habrás olvidado de mi transporte, ¿verdad?
es.69c2abbe66b9e276b4e9116d: ¡Claro que no! Te lo contaré todo… Uf… ¿Tienes algo para la resaca?
es.69c2abe1189dd202e8d261d0: Menos mal que traje esto. (Entrega la Botella de cerveza)
es.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: ¡Joder, eso es justo lo que necesitaba! ¡Me has salvado!
es.69c2abebe092822a4c4ab85e: Pensé que necesitarías esto. (Entrega la Lata de estofado de carne de res)
es.69c2abf0a31ea5620556a995: No está mal, no está mal…
es.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: ¿Por qué conduces así? Vale, coge esto. (Entrega el Paquete de carne seca)
es.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: ¿No tienes algo más graso? Bah, da igual, me lo quedo.
es.69c2abfcd24e8c49f6622a2d: Qué suerte tienes. (Entrega el Frasco de pepinillos)
es.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: Menos mal que se me da bien gestionar los recursos. ¡Guárdame un poco! (Entrega la Garrafa con agua purificada)
es.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: Nah, lo siento, tío. Vamos a estar atascados aquí un rato si no me lo bebo todo… ¡Pero gracias!
es.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: Esta bebida me ha salvado más de una vez. (Entrega la Botella de Aquamari)
es.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: Opa… Nunca he comprado Aquamari, es demasiado cara para mí. Dámela.
es.69c2ac37b7a6d5636c7beb50: Vale, ¿y qué pasa con mi transporte a Icebreaker?
es.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: Hiciste mucho para resolver ese lío con los Rogues. Así que sí, te he conseguido algo.
es.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: ¿Van a trasladar el aerodeslizador a un sitio mejor?
es.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: ¡Aún mejor! Están listos para llevarte directamente desde tu base hasta el rompehielos. O como quieras llamar a ese sótano en el que vives.
es.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: Suena demasiado bueno para ser verdad. No pienso darles las coordenadas de mi refugio.
es.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: Venga ya, pues dales algo que esté cerca. No es tan complicado, hombre.
es.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: Ya están preparándolo todo. Para cuando vuelvas a casa, estará listo. Solo recuerda que los gastos de transporte corren por tu cuenta, y no es nada barato.
es.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: Me vale. Gracias por toda la ayuda.
es.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: Ya están trabajando en ello mientras hablamos. Así que no te preocupes, estará listo para cuando vuelvas. Solo prepárate, porque tendrás que pagar.
es.69c2aca6f4a24af94d175e3e: Me lo veía venir… Bueno, gracias por la ayuda.

ru.69c2abba6ba87bd6105ae5be: Как прошло у контрабандистов? Ты не забыл спросить про транспорт для меня?
ru.69c2abbe66b9e276b4e9116d: Обижаешь! Ща всё скажу… Дай только чё-нить от похмелья, а?
ru.69c2abcb5a57db5a4792ec37: Вот же ж говно, а… Ладно, значит надо держаться.
ru.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: О-о, вот это царский подгон! Спасаешь!
ru.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: А чё ж ты за руль в таком состоянии сел? Ладно, держи. (Передать мясо)
ru.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: Пожирнее ничё нет? Ладно, давай сюда.
ru.69c2ac00d7a9670ecd9faac7: Огурчики? Да это же идеально просто!
ru.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: Хорошо, что я запасливый. Только мне оставь! (Передать канистру с водой)
ru.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: Не, извиняй, иначе тут прям встанем… Но за воду спасибо!
ru.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: Тут немного, но эта водичка меня не раз спасала. (Передать воду Aquamari)
ru.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: Опа… Я «Aquamari» никогда не покупал, жаба душила. Давай сюда.
ru.69c2ac37b7a6d5636c7beb50: Так что там с транспортом на ледокол?
ru.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: Ты мощно приложился к тому, чтобы история с отступниками закончилась хорошо. Так что я обо всём договорился.
ru.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: Контрабандисты смогут подогнать катер на более удобную позицию?
ru.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: Лучше! Они готовы подкинуть тебя на ледокол прямо с твоей базы. Ну или как ты там свой подвал называешь.
ru.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: Звучит слишком хорошо. Но я не дам им координаты своего убежища.
ru.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: Ну так дай координаты недалеко от убежища, чё сложного-то?
ru.69c2ac59939d44679333a0cd: Ладно. Когда они будут готовы к заброске?
ru.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: Уже начали всё готовить, так что как вернёшься домой, всё будет на мази. Но учти, что транспортные расходы лягут на тебя, и это нихера не дёшево.
ru.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: Ладно, так тоже пойдёт. Спасибо тебе за помощь.
ru.69c2ac9efd161eeccaffc47f: Отлично! Им нужно какое-то время на подготовку?
ru.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: Пока мы тут болтаем, они уже всем занимаются. Так что не ссы, к твоему возвращению домой всё будет готово. Но расходы на тебе, так что готовься хорошо заплатить.
ru.69c2aca6f4a24af94d175e3e: Куда ж без этого… Спасибо за помощь.

ro.69c2abba6ba87bd6105ae5be: So, how did it go with the smugglers? You didn’t forget about my transport?
ro.69c2abbe66b9e276b4e9116d: Of course I didn’t! I’ll tell you everything… Ugh… You got anything for a hangover?
ro.69c2abe1189dd202e8d261d0: Good thing I brought this then. (Hand over the bottle of beer)
ro.69c2abe749a5a5c0597cb056: Oh damn, now that’s what I’m talking about! You saved me!
ro.69c2abebe092822a4c4ab85e: Figured you’d need this. (Hand over the can of beef stew)
ro.69c2abf3a13fe7430e234986: Why are you even driving like this? Fine, here. (Hand over the pack of dried meat)
ro.69c2abf840721b907b4bac20: Got anything fattier? Eh, whatever, I’ll take it.
ro.69c2abfcd24e8c49f6622a2d: Lucky you. (Hand over the jar of pickles)
ro.69c2ac031e0400664554d528: Thankfully I’m good at resource management. Leave some for me! (Hand over the canister with purified water)
ro.69c2ac074cf9df429fc873f9: Nah, sorry. We’re gonna be stuck here for a while if I don’t chug it all… But thanks!
ro.69c2ac0a08adf4ea96469ea3: This little drink saved me more than once. (Hand over the bottle of Aquamari)
ro.69c2ac0ec120da810fc0de63: Opa… Never bought Aquamari myself, too damn expensive. Hand it over.
ro.69c2ac37b7a6d5636c7beb50: So what about my transport to the icebreaker?
ro.69c2ac3b51df5ffb604b44f9: You did a lot to wrap up that Rogue mess. So yeah, I worked something out.
ro.69c2ac3fefcb2d05fa2192fa: They’re gonna move the hovercraft to a better spot?
ro.69c2ac42996fc564614a3c7f: Even better! They’re ready to drop you onto the icebreaker straight from your base. Or whatever you call that basement of yours.
ro.69c2ac4eed1b2486b848ffa9: Sounds too good to be true. I’m not giving them my hideout coordinates.
ro.69c2ac543fae54de7bcf52b5: Then give them something nearby. It’s not that complicated, dude.
ro.69c2ac59939d44679333a0cd: Whatever. When will they be ready?
ro.69c2ac5c1c6cf429bcc04878: They’re already getting things set up. By the time you’re back home, it’ll be ready. Just remember, transport fees are on you, and it’s really not cheap.
ro.69c2ac61849948d29458df52: That works. Thank you for all the help.
ro.69c2ac9efd161eeccaffc47f: Perfect! Do they need time to prepare everything?
ro.69c2aca19ed8fb93a3586361: They’re already working on it while we’re talking. So don’t worry, it’ll be ready when you get back. Just be ready to pay.
ro.69c2aca6f4a24af94d175e3e: Figures… Well, thanks for the help.

ch.69c694fe54902a092c8f5b55: 我是不会开门的！快走开！
ch.69c6950277827a8def933c71: 外面现在已经安全了，出来吧。
ch.69c69505740115554cad4f22: 我才不信！要是你想着强行把门撬开，你绝对会后悔的！
ch.69c6950aee17d6f7178af040: 你他妈到底是有什么毛病？
ch.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: 我手里有非常危险的生物材料。要是任何人敢打破门冲进来，我就直接把这容器给打开！
ch.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: 我把外头都清理干净了。船上到底发生什么了？
ch.69c69515de5679d81adee854: 你是瞎吗？！有人袭击了整艘船！
ch.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: 你他妈能不能冷静点！我已经把整层甲板都给清干净了！
ch.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: 我重复一遍：要是你敢破门而入的话，我就要被迫采取极端措施了！现在赶快给我滚！
ch.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: 你是打算在这里面蹲上多久，嗯？！
ch.69c69528251325810993a019: 想待多久就待上多久！在我看到船长之前，我是不会被你们骗出来的！
ch.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: 要是我拿他的录音在门口放，你恐怕也分辨不出来吧，你这个固执的傻瓜蛋！
ch.69c6953817a04ccf4f4468e5: 我这可是有摄像头……傻瓜蛋！
ch.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: 别紧张。甲板上已经没有其他敌人了，只有我们。
ch.69c695435b275432e7ec2784: 你觉得我会相信这种鬼话吗？
ch.69c69547905357a46947aa95: 我可不是和那群强盗一起上船的。要是你不愿意出来也行，至少告诉我你当时都看到了什么。
ch.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: 我看到了什么？一场突袭！就在我们打破无线电静默之后，就有一群雇佣兵登上了船！
ch.69c69550451d63f290810183: 为什么 Boreas 号突然和外界联系了？你们明明已经在原地待了这么长时间都没挪窝。
ch.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: 因为有一些傻子不知道怎么遵守指令，这就是原因！
ch.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: 看样子你不是很在乎他们的死活啊。
ch.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: 为什么我要在乎那帮海员的死活？他们就和没长脑子一样，根本不明白船上装载的东西有多重要！
ch.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: 我没有透露这种机密信息的权限，直到看到船长之前，我不会多说一个字！
ch.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: 那行吧……所以我该上哪去找你那个船长？
ch.69c69580eec943016c89b350: 袭击发生的时候他在舰桥上， 并且成功启动了船上的防御协议。你是没法轻易找到她的。
ch.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: 这样一来我得弄到通行权限才行。我到底该怎么去舰桥上？
ch.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: 要是我连舰桥都去不了，我他妈上哪去给你把那个该死的船长找来？！
ch.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: 啊，去他的保密条例。我直说吧：你得拿到他们发给海员的钥匙卡才能去舰桥那，那些密闭门光靠蛮力是没法强行打开的。
ch.69c6959c0f8b99954d828611: 我该上哪去弄到这些钥匙卡？
ch.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: 当时没人想到会启动防御协议，所以水手身上肯定没带着那些卡片。钥匙卡很可能还留在他们的个人舱室里，在上层甲板。
ch.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: 总有其他路能进到舰桥里吧。
ch.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: 舰桥有一扇外门一直关不严，最近才修过。搞不好你能直接破开。
ch.69c695be053fbdca39f48d79: 那扇门就在这一层甲板上吗？
ch.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: 在轮机舱顶上。但要进入轮机舱，你得先从工程师身上搞到轮机舱钥匙卡才行。和水手不一样，船上的工程师一直随身带着钥匙卡。
ch.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: 我还有问题想问你，你还在那吗？(敲门)
ch.69df9397e8dff956010f4e11: 看来是我自讨没趣了…… (离开)

cz.69c68cee54c9417156b71ac5: Je tam někdo? Haló! (Zaklepat na dveře)
cz.69c6950277827a8def933c71: Už je to bezpečné. Pojď ven.
cz.69c69505740115554cad4f22: Ne! A jestli se pokusíš ty dveře vyrazit, budeš toho litovat!
cz.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: Mám u sebe nebezpečné biomateriály. Jestli se někdo pokusí ty dveře vylomit, otevřu kontejner!
cz.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: Oblast je teď vyčištěná. Co se na té lodi stalo?
cz.69c69515de5679d81adee854: Ty to nevidíš?! Na loď zaútočili!
cz.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: Už se kurva uklidni! Vyčistil jsem celou palubu!
cz.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: Opakuju: jestli se pokusíš ty dveře vylomit, sáhnu k extrémním opatřením! Koukej odsud sakra vypadnout!
cz.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: A jak dlouho tam hodláš sedět, co?!
cz.69c69528251325810993a019: Jak dlouho bude potřeba! A dokud neuvidím kapitána, ke dveřím se ani nepřiblížím!
cz.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: Ani bys to nepoznal, kdybych ti pustil nahrávku jeho hlasu, ty debile!
cz.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: Klid. Na palubě už nezůstali žádní nepřátelé, jenom já.
cz.69c695435b275432e7ec2784: A to ti mám jako věřit?
cz.69c69547905357a46947aa95: Nepřišel jsem s těmi útočníky. Když nechceš jít ven, tak mi aspoň řekni, co jsi viděl.
cz.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: Co jsem viděl? Útok! Poté, co jsme porušili rádiové ticho, na loď vtrhli žoldáci!
cz.69c69550451d63f290810183: Proč se „Boreas“ ozval? Sedíte tu už celé roky.
cz.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: Protože dvojice idiotů neuměla poslouchat rozkazy, proto!
cz.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: Jejich smrt tě, jak se zdá, moc netrápí.
cz.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: Proč by mě měli zajímat dělníci bez mozku? Vůbec nechápali důležitost toho, co se tu přepravuje!
cz.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: Nemám oprávnění taková tajemství vyzrazovat. Bez kapitána neřeknu ani slovo!
cz.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: Tak jo… Takže kde najdu tvýho kapitána?
cz.69c69580eec943016c89b350: Během útoku byl na můstku a podařilo se mu aktivovat obranný protokol. Jen tak se k němu nedostaneš.
cz.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: V tom případě potřebuju přístup. Jak se dostanu na můstek?
cz.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: Jak ti mám sakra přivést kapitána, když se ani nedostanu na můstek?!
cz.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: Ále, čert to vem. Na můstek se bez námořnické karty nedostaneš, hrubou silou ty dveře neotevřeš.
cz.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: Námořníci je u sebe nenosili, protože nikdo nečekal, že se ten protokol aktivuje. Nejspíš je nechali v kajutách na horních palubách.
cz.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: Musí existovat i jiná cesta dovnitř.
cz.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: Jedny z vnějších dveří na můstek se nedávno opravovaly. Možná by se ti je podařilo vypáčit.
cz.69c695be053fbdca39f48d79: Jsou ty dveře někde na palubě?
cz.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: Nahoře nad strojovnou. Ale abys se tam dostal, budeš potřebovat inženýrskou kartu. Na rozdíl od námořníků je měli inženýři vždycky u sebe.
cz.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: Ještě se chci na něco zeptat. Jsi tam? (Zaklepat na dveře)
cz.69df9397e8dff956010f4e11: No tak to můžu jít rovnou do prdele… (Odejít)

en.69c68cee54c9417156b71ac5: Anyone there? Hello! (Knock on the door)
en.69c69505740115554cad4f22: No! And if you try to break the door down, you’ll regret it!
en.69c6950aee17d6f7178af040: What the hell is your problem?
en.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: I have dangerous biomaterials in my possession. If anyone attempts to breach this door, I’ll open the container!
en.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: The area is clear now. What happened on the ship?
en.69c69515de5679d81adee854: Can’t you see?! The ship was attacked!
en.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: Calm the fuck down already! I cleared the whole deck!
en.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: I repeat: if you attempt to breach the door, I will take extreme measures! Get the hell away from here!
en.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: And how long are you planning to sit in there, huh?!
en.69c69528251325810993a019: As long as it takes! And until I see the captain, I’m not even coming near the door!
en.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: You wouldn’t even notice if I played you a recording of his voice, you moron!
en.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: Relax. There are no enemies left on the deck, just me.
en.69c695435b275432e7ec2784: You expect me to believe that?
en.69c69547905357a46947aa95: I didn’t come here with the attackers. If you won’t come out, at least tell me what you saw.
en.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: What did I see? An assault! After we broke radio silence, mercenaries boarded the ship!
en.69c69550451d63f290810183: Why did the “Boreas” make contact? You’ve been sitting here for years.
en.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: Because a pair of idiots didn’t know how to follow orders, that’s why!
en.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: Their deaths don’t seem to bother you much.
en.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: Why should I care about laborers without brains? They had no understanding whatsoever of the importance of what’s being transported here!
en.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: I don’t have clearance to disclose such secrets. Without the captain, I’m not saying another word!
en.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: Okay then… So where do I find your captain?
en.69c69580eec943016c89b350: During the attack he was on the bridge, and he managed to activate the defense protocol. You won’t reach him easily.
en.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: Then I need access. How do I get to the bridge?
en.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: How the hell am I supposed to bring you the captain if I can’t even reach the bridge?!
en.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: Ah, to hell with it. You won’t get into the bridge without a sailor keycard, brute force won’t get those doors open.
en.69c6959c0f8b99954d828611: And where do I get these keycards?
en.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: The sailors didn’t carry them around because nobody expected the protocol to activate. They most likely left them in their cabins on the upper decks.
en.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: There must be another way in.
en.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: One of the external bridge doors was repaired recently. You might be able to force it open.
en.69c695be053fbdca39f48d79: Is that door somewhere on deck?
en.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: On top of the engine section. But to get there, you’ll need an engineer keycard. Unlike the sailors, the engineers always kept theirs on them.
en.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: I still have questions. You there? (Knock on the door)
en.69df9397e8dff956010f4e11: Well guess I’ll go fuck myself then… (Leave)

it.69c69505740115554cad4f22: No! E se provi a sfondare la porta, te ne pentirai!
it.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: Ho in mio possesso dei biomateriali pericolosi. Se qualcuno tenterà di sfondare questa porta, aprirò il contenitore!
it.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: L'area è ora libera. Che cosa è successo sulla nave?
it.69c69515de5679d81adee854: Non lo vedi?! La nave è stata attaccata!
it.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: Si calmi, cazzo! Ho ripulito l'intero ponte!
it.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: Ripeto: se provate a sfondare la porta, adotterò misure estreme! Andatevene da qui!
it.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: E per quanto tempo hai intenzione di restare lì dentro, eh?!
it.69c69528251325810993a019: Ci vorrà il tempo che ci vorrà! E finché non vedrò il capitano, non mi avvicinerò nemmeno alla porta!
it.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: Non se ne accorgerebbe nemmeno se le facessi ascoltare una registrazione della sua voce, idiota!
it.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: Rilassati. Non ci sono più nemici sul ponte, ci sono solo io.
it.69c69547905357a46947aa95: Non sono venuto qui con gli assalitori. Se non vuoi uscire, dimmi almeno cosa hai visto.
it.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: Cosa ho visto? Un assalto! Dopo aver interrotto il silenzio radio, i mercenari sono saliti a bordo della nave!
it.69c69550451d63f290810183: Perché i “Boreas” hanno preso contatto? Lei è rimasto seduto qui per anni.
it.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: Perché una coppia di idioti non sapeva come seguire gli ordini, ecco perché!
it.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: Le loro morti non sembrano turbarla più di tanto.
it.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: Perché dovrei preoccuparmi di operai senza cervello? Non avevano la minima comprensione dell'importanza di ciò che viene trasportato qui!
it.69c695614f24cef086d9031e: E di cosa si tratta esattamente?
it.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: Non ho l'autorizzazione a rivelare tali segreti. Senza il capitano, non dirò più una parola!
it.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: Va bene, allora… Allora, dove posso trovare il vostro capitano?
it.69c69580eec943016c89b350: Durante l'attacco si trovava sul ponte ed è riuscito ad attivare il protocollo di difesa. Non sarà facile raggiungerlo.
it.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: Allora ho bisogno di un accesso. Come faccio ad arrivare al ponte?
it.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: Come diavolo dovrei portarle al capitano se non riesco nemmeno a raggiungere il ponte?!
it.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: Ah, al diavolo. Non entrerà nel ponte senza una chiave magnetica da marinaio, la forza bruta non riuscirà ad aprire quelle porte.
it.69c6959c0f8b99954d828611: E dove posso trovare queste chiavi magnetiche?
it.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: I marinai non li portavano con sé perché nessuno si aspettava che il protocollo si attivasse. Probabilmente li avevano lasciati nelle loro cabine sui ponti superiori.
it.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: Ci deve essere un altro modo per entrare.
it.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: Una delle porte esterne del ponte è stata riparata di recente. Potrebbe essere possibile aprirla con la forza.
it.69c695be053fbdca39f48d79: Quella porta si trova da qualche parte sul ponte?
it.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: In cima alla sezione del motore. Ma per arrivarci, avrai bisogno di una tessera magnetica da ingegnere. A differenza dei marinai, gli ingegneri tenevano sempre la propria con sé.
it.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: Ho ancora delle domande. C'è qualcuno? (Bussano alla porta)
it.69df9397e8dff956010f4e11: Beh, immagino che me ne andrò a fanculo, allora… (Esce)
