kr.69c694fe54902a092c8f5b55: 절대 안 열어줄 겁니다! 저리 가십시오!
kr.69c69505740115554cad4f22: 절대 안 나갈 겁니다! 그리고 이 문을 부숴버리려 한다면 후회하게 될 겁니다!
kr.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: 지금 제 손엔 위험한 생체 물질을 들고 있습니다. 만일 누구라도 이 문을 뚫고 들어오려 한다면 용기를 열어버릴 겁니다!
kr.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: 이 구역은 정리됐다. 대체 배에서 무슨 일이 있었던 거지?
kr.69c69515de5679d81adee854: 상황 파악이 안 되십니까?! 배가 공격을 받았잖습니까!
kr.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: 씨발 좀 진정하라고! 내가 싹 다 정리했으니까!
kr.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: 다시 한 번 말하지만, 이 문을 부수려 한다면 극단적인 조치를 취할 수밖에 없습니다! 당장 여기서 나가십시오!
kr.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: 그러면 거기에 얼마나 오래 죽치고 있을 생각인데, 어?!
kr.69c69528251325810993a019: 필요한 만큼 있을 겁니다! 그리고 선장님을 직접 보기 전까진 절대 밖으로 나오지 않을 겁니다!
kr.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: 내가 선장의 목소리를 녹음해서 들려줄지 어떻게 알려고 그러냐, 등신아!
kr.69c6953817a04ccf4f4468e5: 여기 카메라가 있는 것도 안 보이시군요… 멍청이 같으니라고!
kr.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: 진정해. 여기에 더 이상 적은 없고, 나 혼자 뿐이다.
kr.69c69547905357a46947aa95: 난 여기를 습격한 놈들이랑 같이 온 놈이 아니야. 만약 네가 나오기 싫으면, 최소한 뭘 봤는지라도 말해주던가.
kr.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: 제가 뭘 봤냐고요? 당연히 습격이죠! 저희가 무선 침묵을 깨자마자 그 용병들이 배에 올라탔단 말입니다!
kr.69c69550451d63f290810183: 왜 보레아스 호가 무선 침묵을 깬거지? 넌 여기에 몇 년동안 있었을 거 아냐.
kr.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: 그야, 어떤 멍청이 같은 놈들이 지시를 따를 줄 모르니까죠!
kr.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: 걔네들이 죽은 건 신경도 안 쓰이나 보네.
kr.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: 왜 제가 그 머저리들을 신경이나 써야 한답니까? 그 녀석들은 이 곳에 뭐가 실렸는지 조차도 이해하지 못 하던 놈들인데!
kr.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: 전 그런 비밀을 누설할 권한이 없습니다. 선장이 허락해주지 않는 한은 말 할 생각 없습니다!
kr.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: 그래 그럼… 선장은 어디로 가면 찾을 수 있지?
kr.69c69580eec943016c89b350: 배가 공격받고 있을 때, 선장은 함교에 있었어서 방어 프로토콜을 실행할 수 있었습니다. 쉽게 접근하지도 못할 겁니다.
kr.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: 그러면 권한이 필요하겠군. 함교에 어떻게 접근하지?
kr.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: 아니, 그러면 내가 함교로 가지도 못 하는데 나보고 선장을 어떻게 데려오라는 건데?!
kr.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: 하, 될 대로 되라지. 선원에 키카드가 없으면 함교에 들어갈 수 없습니다. 무력으로 여는 것도 안 통할 겁니다.
kr.69c6959c0f8b99954d828611: 그러면 키카드는 어디서 구하면 되는 거지?
kr.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: 방어 프로토콜을 실행할 거라곤 생각도 못 했어서 선원들이 키카드를 들고 다니는 일은 없었습니다. 윗층에 있는 선원 숙소에 대부분의 키카드가 있을 겁니다.
kr.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: 다른 방법으로도 갈 수 있을 거 아냐.
kr.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: 최근에 함교의 출입문을 고쳤습니다. 아마도 그 문은 무력으로 열 수 있을 겁니다.
kr.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: 엔진실 구역에 있습니다. 하지만 거기로 가려면 엔지니어들이 쓰는 키카드가 필요할 겁니다. 엔지니어들은 항상 자기 키카드를 휴대하고 다녔습니다.
kr.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: 아직 물어볼 게 남아있다. 거기 안에 있나? (문 노크하기)

pl.69c68cee54c9417156b71ac5: Anyone there? Hello! (Knock on the door)
pl.69c69505740115554cad4f22: No! And if you try to break the door down, you’ll regret it!
pl.69c6950aee17d6f7178af040: What the hell is your problem?
pl.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: I have dangerous biomaterials in my possession. If anyone attempts to breach this door, I’ll open the container!
pl.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: The area is clear now. What happened on the ship?
pl.69c69515de5679d81adee854: Can’t you see?! The ship was attacked!
pl.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: Calm the fuck down already! I cleared the whole deck!
pl.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: I repeat: if you attempt to breach the door, I will take extreme measures! Get the hell away from here!
pl.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: And how long are you planning to sit in there, huh?!
pl.69c69528251325810993a019: As long as it takes! And until I see the captain, I’m not even coming near the door!
pl.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: You wouldn’t even notice if I played you a recording of his voice, you moron!
pl.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: Relax. There are no enemies left on the deck, just me.
pl.69c695435b275432e7ec2784: You expect me to believe that?
pl.69c69547905357a46947aa95: I didn’t come here with the attackers. If you won’t come out, at least tell me what you saw.
pl.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: What did I see? An assault! After we broke radio silence, mercenaries boarded the ship!
pl.69c69550451d63f290810183: Why did the “Boreas” make contact? You’ve been sitting here for years.
pl.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: Because a pair of idiots didn’t know how to follow orders, that’s why!
pl.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: Their deaths don’t seem to bother you much.
pl.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: Why should I care about laborers without brains? They had no understanding whatsoever of the importance of what’s being transported here!
pl.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: I don’t have clearance to disclose such secrets. Without the captain, I’m not saying another word!
pl.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: Okay then… So where do I find your captain?
pl.69c69580eec943016c89b350: During the attack he was on the bridge, and he managed to activate the defense protocol. You won’t reach him easily.
pl.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: Then I need access. How do I get to the bridge?
pl.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: How the hell am I supposed to bring you the captain if I can’t even reach the bridge?!
pl.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: Ah, to hell with it. You won’t get into the bridge without a sailor keycard, brute force won’t get those doors open.
pl.69c6959c0f8b99954d828611: And where do I get these keycards?
pl.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: The sailors didn’t carry them around because nobody expected the protocol to activate. They most likely left them in their cabins on the upper decks.
pl.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: There must be another way in.
pl.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: One of the external bridge doors was repaired recently. You might be able to force it open.
pl.69c695be053fbdca39f48d79: Is that door somewhere on deck?
pl.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: On top of the engine section. But to get there, you’ll need an engineer keycard. Unlike the sailors, the engineers always kept theirs on them.
pl.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: I still have questions. You there? (Knock on the door)
pl.69df9397e8dff956010f4e11: Well guess I’ll go fuck myself then… (Leave)

po.69c68cee54c9417156b71ac5: Tem alguém aí? Olá! (Bater na porta)
po.69c69505740115554cad4f22: Não! E se você tentar arrombar a porta, vai se arrepender!
po.69c6950aee17d6f7178af040: Qual é o seu problema, cara?
po.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: Tenho biomateriais perigosos em minha posse. Se alguém tentar forçar esta porta, vou abrir o contêiner!
po.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: A área está limpa agora. O que aconteceu no navio?
po.69c69515de5679d81adee854: Você não está vendo?! O navio foi atacado!
po.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: Se acalma, caralho! Limpei o convés inteiro!
po.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: Repito: se você tentar forçar a porta, vou tomar medidas extremas! Se manda daqui!
po.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: E por quanto tempo você planeja ficar aí dentro, hein?!
po.69c69528251325810993a019: O tempo que for necessário! E enquanto não ver o capitão, não vou nem chegar perto da porta!
po.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: Você nem perceberia se eu te passasse uma gravação da voz dele, seu idiota!
po.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: Relaxa. Não restam inimigos no convés, só eu.
po.69c695435b275432e7ec2784: Você espera que eu acredite nisso?
po.69c69547905357a46947aa95: Não vim com os invasores. Se não vai sair, pelo menos me diga o que você viu.
po.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: O que eu vi? Um assalto! Depois que quebramos o silêncio de rádio, mercenários embarcaram no navio!
po.69c69550451d63f290810183: Por que o "Boreas" entrou em contato? Vocês estão aqui há anos.
po.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: Porque um par de idiotas não sabia seguir ordens, por isso!
po.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: As mortes deles não parecem te incomodar muito.
po.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: Por que me importaria com trabalhadores sem cérebro? Eles não tinham nenhuma noção da importância do que está sendo transportado aqui!
po.69c695614f24cef086d9031e: E o quê exatamente é isso?
po.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: Não tenho autorização para revelar esses segredos. Sem o capitão, não digo mais uma palavra!
po.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: Certo então… Onde encontro o seu capitão?
po.69c69580eec943016c89b350: Durante o ataque ele estava na ponte, e conseguiu ativar o protocolo de defesa. Não vai chegar até ele facilmente.
po.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: Então preciso de acesso. Como chego à ponte?
po.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: Como diabos vou trazer o capitão para você se nem consigo chegar à ponte?!
po.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: Ah, foda-se. Você não vai entrar na ponte sem um cartão de acesso de marinheiro, força bruta não vai abrir essas portas.
po.69c6959c0f8b99954d828611: E onde consigo esses cartões de acesso?
po.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: Os marinheiros não os carregavam porque ninguém esperava que o protocolo fosse ativar. Provavelmente os deixaram em suas cabines nos conveses superiores.
po.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: Deve haver outro jeito de entrar.
po.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: Uma das portas externas da ponte foi reparada recentemente. Você pode conseguir forçá-la.
po.69c695be053fbdca39f48d79: Essa porta fica em algum lugar no convés?
po.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: Em cima da sala de motores. Mas para chegar lá, vai precisar de um cartão de acesso de engenheiro. Diferente dos marinheiros, os engenheiros sempre os mantinham consigo.
po.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: Ainda tenho perguntas. Você aí? (Bater na porta)
po.69df9397e8dff956010f4e11: Bom, acho que vou me mandar então… (Sair)

es.69c69505740115554cad4f22: ¡No! ¡Y si intentas derribar la puerta, te arrepentirás!
es.69c6950aee17d6f7178af040: ¿Pero qué pasa, cuál es el puto problema?
es.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: Tengo biomateriales peligrosos en mi poder. ¡Si alguien intenta forzar esta puerta, abriré el contenedor!
es.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: La zona ya está despejada. ¿Qué ha pasado en el barco?
es.69c69515de5679d81adee854: ¡¿Que no lo ves?! ¡La nave fue atacada!
es.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: ¡Cálmate de una vez, joder! ¡Ya he despejado toda la cubierta!
es.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: Te lo repito: si intentas forzar la puerta, ¡tomaré medidas drásticas! ¡Lárgate de aquí!
es.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: ¡¿Y cuánto tiempo piensas quedarte ahí dentro, eh?!
es.69c69528251325810993a019: ¡El tiempo que haga falta! ¡Y hasta que vea al capitán, ni pienso acercarme a la puerta!
es.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: ¡Ni te enterarías si te pusiera una grabación de su voz, imbécil!
es.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: Relaja. Ya no quedan enemigos en la cubierta, solo estoy yo.
es.69c69547905357a46947aa95: Yo no he llegado aquí con los atacantes. Si no piensas salir, al menos dime lo que has visto.
es.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: ¿Qué es lo que he visto? ¡Un asalto! ¡Unos mercenarios abordaron el barco en cuanto rompimos el silencio de radio!
es.69c69550451d63f290810183: ¿Por qué el "Boreas" estableció contacto? Llevan años aquí parados.
es.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: ¡Porque un par de idiotas no supieron seguir órdenes, por eso!
es.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: No parece que sus muertes te preocupen demasiado.
es.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: ¿Por qué debería preocuparme por unos trabajadores sin dos dedos de frente? ¡No tenían ni la más mínima idea de la importancia de lo que se transportaba aquí!
es.69c695614f24cef086d9031e: ¿Y de qué se trata eso exactamente?
es.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: No tengo autorización para revelar esos secretos. ¡Sin el capitán, no diré ni una palabra más!
es.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: Vale, pues… ¿Y dónde encuentro a tu capitán?
es.69c69580eec943016c89b350: Él estaba en el puente durante el ataque y logró activar el protocolo de defensa. No será fácil llegar hasta él.
es.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: Entonces necesito acceso. ¿Cómo llego al puente?
es.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: ¡¿Y cómo coño se supone que deba traerte al capitán si ni siquiera puedo llegar al puente?!
es.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: Ah, a la porra con esto. No podrás entrar al puente sin una tarjeta de acceso de la tripulación; no conseguirás abrir esas puertas por la fuerza.
es.69c6959c0f8b99954d828611: ¿Y dónde consigo esas tarjetas de acceso?
es.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: Los marineros no las llevaban encima porque nadie esperaba que se activara el protocolo. Lo más probable es que las dejaran en sus camarotes, en las cubiertas superiores.
es.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: Debe haber otra manera de entrar.
es.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: Una de las puertas externas del puente fue reparada recientemente. Quizá puedas forzarla para abrirla.
es.69c695be053fbdca39f48d79: ¿Esa puerta está en algún sitio de la cubierta?
es.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: Sobre la sección de los motores. Pero para llegar allí, necesitarás una tarjeta de acceso de ingeniero. A diferencia de los marineros, los ingenieros siempre llevaban las suyas encima.
es.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: Aún tengo algunas dudas. ¿Estás ahí? (Llama a la puerta)
es.69df9397e8dff956010f4e11: Pues supongo que mejor me voy a la mierda… (Vete)

es-mx.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: Debe haber otra forma de entrar.
es-mx.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: Una de las puertas externas del puente fue reparada recientemente. Quizá puedas forzarla para abrirla.
es-mx.69c695be053fbdca39f48d79: ¿Esa puerta está en algún lugar de la cubierta?
es-mx.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: Encima de la sección de los motores. Pero para llegar ahí, necesitarás una tarjeta de acceso de ingeniero. A diferencia de los marineros, los ingenieros siempre llevaban las suyas consigo.
es-mx.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: Aún tengo algunas preguntas. ¿Estás ahí? (Toca la puerta)
es-mx.69df9397e8dff956010f4e11: Bueno, pues supongo que será mejor que me vaya a la mierda… (Vete)

tu.69c68cee54c9417156b71ac5: Anyone there? Hello! (Knock on the door)
tu.69c69505740115554cad4f22: No! And if you try to break the door down, you’ll regret it!
tu.69c6950aee17d6f7178af040: What the hell is your problem?
tu.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: I have dangerous biomaterials in my possession. If anyone attempts to breach this door, I’ll open the container!
tu.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: The area is clear now. What happened on the ship?
tu.69c69515de5679d81adee854: Can’t you see?! The ship was attacked!
tu.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: Calm the fuck down already! I cleared the whole deck!
tu.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: I repeat: if you attempt to breach the door, I will take extreme measures! Get the hell away from here!
tu.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: And how long are you planning to sit in there, huh?!
tu.69c69528251325810993a019: As long as it takes! And until I see the captain, I’m not even coming near the door!
tu.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: You wouldn’t even notice if I played you a recording of his voice, you moron!
tu.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: Relax. There are no enemies left on the deck, just me.
tu.69c695435b275432e7ec2784: You expect me to believe that?
tu.69c69547905357a46947aa95: I didn’t come here with the attackers. If you won’t come out, at least tell me what you saw.
tu.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: What did I see? An assault! After we broke radio silence, mercenaries boarded the ship!
tu.69c69550451d63f290810183: Why did the “Boreas” make contact? You’ve been sitting here for years.
tu.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: Because a pair of idiots didn’t know how to follow orders, that’s why!
tu.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: Their deaths don’t seem to bother you much.
tu.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: Why should I care about laborers without brains? They had no understanding whatsoever of the importance of what’s being transported here!
tu.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: I don’t have clearance to disclose such secrets. Without the captain, I’m not saying another word!
tu.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: Okay then… So where do I find your captain?
tu.69c69580eec943016c89b350: During the attack he was on the bridge, and he managed to activate the defense protocol. You won’t reach him easily.
tu.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: Then I need access. How do I get to the bridge?
tu.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: How the hell am I supposed to bring you the captain if I can’t even reach the bridge?!
tu.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: Ah, to hell with it. You won’t get into the bridge without a sailor keycard, brute force won’t get those doors open.
tu.69c6959c0f8b99954d828611: And where do I get these keycards?
tu.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: The sailors didn’t carry them around because nobody expected the protocol to activate. They most likely left them in their cabins on the upper decks.
tu.69c695b3f03597034a172e47: There must be another way in.
tu.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: One of the external bridge doors was repaired recently. You might be able to force it open.
tu.69c695be053fbdca39f48d79: Is that door somewhere on deck?
tu.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: On top of the engine section. But to get there, you’ll need an engineer keycard. Unlike the sailors, the engineers always kept theirs on them.
tu.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: I still have questions. You there? (Knock on the door)
tu.69df9397e8dff956010f4e11: Well guess I’ll go fuck myself then… (Leave)

ru.69c69505740115554cad4f22: Нет! А если вы попробуете взломать дверь, то сами пожалеете!
ru.69c6950e74094dab44a766e4: У меня на руках опасные биоматериалы. Если кто-либо попробует взломать дверь, я открою контейнер!
ru.69c69512672e2a511e3a981a: Теперь тут безопасно. Что произошло на корабле?
ru.69c69515de5679d81adee854: А вы не видите! Корабль атакован!
ru.69c6951ae2a585ff5da1499b: Да не суетись ты! Я всю палубу уже зачистил!
ru.69c6951e8a8a589ce346b937: Я повторяю: при попытке взлома двери я пойду на крайние меры! Валите отсюда!
ru.69c695245a216c772caa0e2c: И долго ты так сидеть собираешься, а?!
ru.69c69528251325810993a019: Сколько нужно! И пока я не увижу капитана, я даже подходить к двери не буду!
ru.69c6952d3146df3bc2f27baf: Да ты ведь даже не отличишь, если я включу запись с его голосом, олень!
ru.69c6953e0803942e2d7cdfd0: Спокойно. На палубе больше не осталось противников, только я.
ru.69c695435b275432e7ec2784: Вы думаете, я в это поверю?
ru.69c69547905357a46947aa95: Я пришёл не с ними. Если не хотите выходить, хотя бы расскажите, что видели?
ru.69c6954c26194bde342ecf8b: Как что? Штурм! После того, как мы нарушили радиомолчание, сюда высадились наёмники!
ru.69c69550451d63f290810183: Почему «Борей» вышел на связь? Вы ведь давно здесь стоите.
ru.69c69554dd4f567077314ae3: Пара идиотов не умеет следовать приказам, вот почему!
ru.69c69558b777653bd5e19ab1: Их смерть вас не сильно заботит, да?
ru.69c6955d9d7cf0a4b6b3da78: А почему меня должны заботить рабочие руки без мозгов? Они и близко не понимали важности того, что здесь перевозится!
ru.69c69569669683cd4eda8428: У меня нет права разглашать такие секреты. Без капитана я больше ничего не скажу!
ru.69c6957a181ebc27fddc3bd8: Ладно… И где искать этого капитана?
ru.69c69580eec943016c89b350: Во время атаки он был на мостике и успел активировать защитный протокол. Так просто до него не добраться.
ru.69c695854d05d43be4752e1d: Значит, мне нужен доступ. Как его получить и как добраться до мостика?
ru.69c6958fea9f366a2934c653: Так как я приведу к тебе капитана, если я не могу выйти на мостик?!
ru.69c695957dbd714ab94fbc67: Чёрт с вами. Пройти в рубку без ключ-карты матроса не получится, силой эти двери не вскрыть.
ru.69c695a299e216cbf981f60f: Матросы не носили их при себе, потому что никто не ожидал активации протокола. Скорее всего оставили карты в каютах на этажах выше.
ru.69c695b8848492449f3906a4: Одну из внешних дверей в рубку недавно ремонтировали, её можно попробовать открыть силой.
ru.69c695c3280858511ee819ab: На крыше машинного отделения. Но чтобы туда попасть, вам нужна ключ-карта техника. В отличие от матросов, инженеры всегда держали карты рядом.
ru.69df938cb2978248ce38b30e: У меня есть ещё вопросы. Вы тут? (Постучать по двери)

ch.69c6ad9802938f9bc2cb439f: 那你倒是说说看我能上哪去？
ch.69c6ad9c4eca1aa856462c62: 我需要你的帮助。我确实上到了舰桥，但往前走了一段，发现一扇有密码锁的门。并且电梯也没法用了。
ch.69c6ada16eef33852088eb07: 所以确实没别的路子了……算了，我就帮你这一次。但你得保证你会把船长带到这来，还要确保他的安全！

it.69ca777f48ef468af45f1c67: Sono riuscito ad arrivare al ponte.
it.69ca778496c405cb70516068: Allora dov'è il capitano?! Sta cercando di ingannarmi?!
it.69ca7788299594319a412dd6: Si calmi! Ho mantenuto la parola data, ma il suo capitano è morto.
it.69ca779182f6cacea4020620: L'intero ponte era crivellato dai colpi di mitragliatrice provenienti dall'elicottero. I finestrini erano blindati, ma non era sufficiente. Il capitano aveva con sé una chiave magnetica nera, a differenza del resto dell'equipaggio.
it.69ca77b6a4e7580a6a124835: È tutto sotto controllo! Ma i materiali… Non possono restare qui ancora a lungo.
it.69ca77babf58fb5f4c5fa3d7: Allora qual è il problema? È riuscito a conservarli tutti in questo periodo, anche dopo anni a Tarkov.
it.69ca77be84ded5341ead7506: Durante l'assalto, l'integrità dei container è stata compromessa. Devono essere evacuati immediatamente dalla nave!
it.69ca77c21ee332e3a1d8c9ec: Allora apri la porta! Possiamo andarcene da qui in elicottero.
it.69ca77c847d6d9270462aa73: No! È troppo pericoloso. Sì, sì, assolutamente niente elicotteri!
it.69ca77cc5c031b98f9d1b0bd: Allora, cosa vuoi esattamente da me?
it.69ca77d2c0173078a9650200: Mi trovi un mezzo di trasporto sicuro…
it.69ca77e2226c663b67f26672: Cosa c'è che non va con l'evacuazione in elicottero?
it.69ca77e7ce732d25f3c434c2: Cosa, vuoi infettare l'intera città?! No, niente che si trasmetta per via aerea, assolutamente no…
it.69ca77fd697ded2e4b892417: Le consegnerò la chiave magnetica del mio scompartimento. Qui c'è un patrimonio in attrezzature per cui la gente pagherebbe a caro prezzo.
it.69ca78041f9f06d9f1f0e93a: Va bene. Ma non prometto nulla.
it.69ca781650a32e069fbad9ce: Va bene. Chiederò in giro. Ma non prometto nulla.
it.69ca78206254c87f8ddf92d9: È tutto sotto controllo! Ma ho bisogno di essere evacuato il prima possibile.
it.69ca78311c2b85bc2f13798c: Non sarà necessario! Chi altro potrebbe...
it.69ca7856fb88f50f1bcbeb1c: Va bene. Me ne occuperò io.
it.69ca7862eb373b6ba9b5dba5: Le consegnerò la chiave magnetica del mio scompartimento. Qui c'è un'attrezzatura del valore di una fortuna per cui la gente pagherebbe a caro prezzo.

po.69ca778496c405cb70516068: Então onde está o capitão?! Você está tentando me enganar?!
po.69ca7788299594319a412dd6: Calma! Cumpri minha palavra, mas o seu capitão está morto.
po.69ca779182f6cacea4020620: A ponte inteira foi crivada de tiros de metralhadora do helicóptero. As janelas eram blindadas, mas não foi suficiente. O capitão tinha um cartão de acesso preto com ele, diferente do restante da tripulação.
po.69ca77b6a4e7580a6a124835: Tudo está sob controle! Mas os materiais… Eles não podem ficar aqui muito mais tempo.
po.69ca77babf58fb5f4c5fa3d7: Qual é o problema então? Você conseguiu armazená-los todo esse tempo, mesmo depois de anos em Tarkov.
po.69ca77be84ded5341ead7506: Durante o assalto, a integridade dos contêineres foi comprometida. Eles precisam ser evacuados do navio imediatamente!
po.69ca77c21ee332e3a1d8c9ec: Então abra a porta! Podemos sair daqui de helicóptero.
po.69ca77c847d6d9270462aa73: Não! Perigoso demais. Sim, sim, absolutamente sem helicópteros!
po.69ca77cc5c031b98f9d1b0bd: Então o que exatamente você quer de mim?
po.69ca77d2c0173078a9650200: Encontre um transporte seguro para mim…
po.69ca77e2226c663b67f26672: Qual é o problema com a evacuação de helicóptero?
po.69ca77e7ce732d25f3c434c2: O quê, você quer infectar a cidade inteira?! Não, nada pelo ar, absolutamente não…
po.69ca77f809513142734629b9: E o que eu ganho com isso?
po.69ca77fd697ded2e4b892417: Vou entregar o cartão de acesso do meu compartimento. Há uma fortuna em equipamentos aqui que as pessoas pagarão caro.
po.69ca78041f9f06d9f1f0e93a: Justo. Mas não estou prometendo nada.
po.69ca781650a32e069fbad9ce: Certo. Vou perguntar por aí. Mas sem promessas.
po.69ca78206254c87f8ddf92d9: Tudo está sob controle! Mas preciso de evacuação o mais rápido possível.
po.69ca782b2ce6b90ec16fd281: Não vou tocar nesses biomateriais, cara.
po.69ca78311c2b85bc2f13798c: Você não vai precisar! Quem mais poderia…
po.69ca785ead16f090b775b182: E o que eu ganho com isso?
po.69ca7862eb373b6ba9b5dba5: Vou entregar o cartão de acesso do meu compartimento. Há uma fortuna em equipamentos aqui que as pessoas pagarão caro.

es.69ca7788299594319a412dd6: ¡Tranquilo! He cumplido con mi palabra, pero tu capitán está muerto.
es.69ca779182f6cacea4020620: Todo el puente fue acribillado por fuego de ametralladora desde un helicóptero. Las ventanas eran blindadas, pero no fue suficiente. A diferencia del resto de la tripulación, el capitán llevaba una tarjeta de acceso negra.
es.69ca77b6a4e7580a6a124835: ¡Todo está bajo control! Pero los materiales… No pueden quedarse aquí por mucho más tiempo.
es.69ca77babf58fb5f4c5fa3d7: Entonces, ¿cuál es el problema? Te las has arreglado para almacenarlos todo este tiempo, incluso después de años en Tarkov.
es.69ca77be84ded5341ead7506: La integridad de los contenedores se vio comprometida durante el asalto. ¡Hay que evacuarlos de la nave de inmediato!
es.69ca77c21ee332e3a1d8c9ec: ¡Entonces abre la puerta! Podemos salir de aquí en helicóptero.
es.69ca77c847d6d9270462aa73: ¡No! Es demasiado peligroso. Y sí, claro, ¡nada de helicópteros!
es.69ca77cc5c031b98f9d1b0bd: Entonces, ¿qué es exactamente lo que quieres de mí?
es.69ca77e2226c663b67f26672: ¿Qué tiene de malo la evacuación en helicóptero?
es.69ca77e7ce732d25f3c434c2: ¡¿Qué, quieres infectar a toda la ciudad?! No, nada de transporte aéreo, claro que no…
es.69ca77fd697ded2e4b892417: Te entregaré la tarjeta de acceso a mi compartimento. Aquí hay una fortuna en equipo por el que la gente pagará generosamente.
es.69ca78041f9f06d9f1f0e93a: Vale, de acuerdo. Pero no prometo nada.
es.69ca781650a32e069fbad9ce: Vale. Preguntaré por ahí. Pero no te prometo nada.
es.69ca78206254c87f8ddf92d9: ¡Todo está bajo control! Pero necesito que me evacúen lo antes posible.
es.69ca782b2ce6b90ec16fd281: No voy a tocar esos biomateriales, tío.
es.69ca7862eb373b6ba9b5dba5: Te entregaré la tarjeta de acceso a mi compartimento. Aquí hay una fortuna en equipo por el que la gente pagará generosamente.

tu.69ca777f48ef468af45f1c67: I made it to the bridge.
tu.69ca778496c405cb70516068: Then where is the captain?! Are you trying to deceive me?!
tu.69ca7788299594319a412dd6: Calm down! I kept my word, but your captain is dead.
tu.69ca779182f6cacea4020620: The whole bridge was riddled with machine gun fire from the helicopter. The windows were armored, but it wasn’t enough. The captain had a black keycard on him, unlike the rest of the crew.
tu.69ca77b6a4e7580a6a124835: Everything is under control! But the materials… They can’t stay here much longer.
tu.69ca77babf58fb5f4c5fa3d7: What’s the problem, then? You managed to store them all this time, even after years in Tarkov.
tu.69ca77be84ded5341ead7506: During the assault, the integrity of the containers was compromised. They need to be evacuated from the ship immediately!
tu.69ca77c21ee332e3a1d8c9ec: Then open the door! We can get out of here by helicopter.
tu.69ca77c847d6d9270462aa73: No! Far too dangerous. Yes, yes, absolutely no helicopters!
tu.69ca77cc5c031b98f9d1b0bd: Then what exactly do you want from me?
tu.69ca77e2226c663b67f26672: What’s wrong with the helicopter evac?
tu.69ca77e7ce732d25f3c434c2: What, you want to infect the whole city?! No, nothing airborne, absolutely not…
tu.69ca77f809513142734629b9: And what’s in it for me?
tu.69ca77fd697ded2e4b892417: I’ll hand over the keycard to my compartment. There’s a fortune in equipment here that people will pay dearly for.
tu.69ca78041f9f06d9f1f0e93a: Fair enough. But I’m not promising anything.
tu.69ca781650a32e069fbad9ce: Alright. I’ll ask around. But no promises.
tu.69ca78206254c87f8ddf92d9: Everything is under control! But I need evacuation as soon as possible.
tu.69ca782b2ce6b90ec16fd281: I’m not touching those biomaterials, dude.
tu.69ca78311c2b85bc2f13798c: You won’t have to! Who else could…
tu.69ca785ead16f090b775b182: And what’s in it for me?
tu.69ca7862eb373b6ba9b5dba5: I’ll hand over the keycard to my compartment. There’s a fortune in equipment here that people will pay dearly for.

ru.69ca778496c405cb70516068: И где тогда капитан?! Решили меня обмануть?!
ru.69ca7788299594319a412dd6: Спокойно! Я своё слово сдержал, а вот капитан ваш погиб.
ru.69ca779182f6cacea4020620: Весь мостик расстрелян с вертолёта. Окна там бронированные, но защиты оказалось недостаточно. У капитана при себе была ключ-карта чёрного цвета, а не как у остального персонала.
ru.69ca77b6a4e7580a6a124835: Всё под контролем! Но материалы… Их нельзя оставлять здесь надолго.
ru.69ca77babf58fb5f4c5fa3d7: А в чём дело? Вы ведь хранили их всю дорогу и несколько лет в Таркове.
ru.69ca77be84ded5341ead7506: Во время штурма целостность контейнеров нарушилась. Их нужно срочно вывезти с корабля!
ru.69ca77c21ee332e3a1d8c9ec: Тогда откройте дверь! Мы можем убраться отсюда на вертолёте.
ru.69ca77c847d6d9270462aa73: Нельзя! Слишком опасно. Да, да, на вертолёте никак нельзя!
ru.69ca77cc5c031b98f9d1b0bd: Чего вы тогда от меня хотите?
ru.69ca77e7ce732d25f3c434c2: Вы что, весь город заразить хотите?! Нет, наверх никак нельзя…
ru.69ca77f809513142734629b9: А какой в этом резон для меня?
ru.69ca77fd697ded2e4b892417: Я передам вам ключ-карту от этого отсека. Здесь останется целая куча оборудования, за которое вам дорого заплатят.
ru.69ca78041f9f06d9f1f0e93a: Пойдёт. Но я ничего не обещаю.
ru.69ca781650a32e069fbad9ce: Ладно, я поспрашиваю. Но ничего не обещаю.
ru.69ca78206254c87f8ddf92d9: Всё под контролем! Но мне нужна эвакуация, как можно скорее.
ru.69ca782b2ce6b90ec16fd281: Я к этим биоматериалам прикасаться не буду.
ru.69ca78311c2b85bc2f13798c: Да вам и не надо! Кто ещё может…
ru.69ca785ead16f090b775b182: А какой в этом резон для меня?
ru.69ca7862eb373b6ba9b5dba5: Я передам вам ключ-карту от этого отсека. Здесь останется целая куча оборудования, за которое вам дорого заплатят.

ch.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: 哦？那个该死的 BTR 去不了？
ch.69dd28741580354be1032098: 所以你是上我这要船来了。
ch.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: 想想就知道，我不觉得整个塔科夫还有能飞的直升机。
ch.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: 等等，一开始来这低三下四地请人帮忙的好像不是我吧？
ch.69dd2874513cd2ae28a7f544: 等等，那这么说，它还能飞吗？
ch.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: 也许你能用这架直升机把我带出塔科夫？
ch.69dd2874530e529ef964cfa6: 等等，那这么说，它还能飞吗？
ch.69dd287459515e0488e06641: 行吧。但武装直升机可不是弹药箱这种小物件，你可没法像走私弹药一样随便找个角落就能藏起来。你到底是怎么做到的？
ch.69dd28745a3c6ffca3b28064: 你是不是忘了自己在和谁说话了，嗯？
ch.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: 我要去的地方 BTR 去不了。
ch.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: 我可没说过那是军用直升机，而且我也不打算告诉你我是怎么搞到它的。
ch.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: 狗腿们会处理好的。但他们得跑一趟储备站，就是那个军事基地。
ch.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: 不，你只要清理一下整个地方，确保我的机师到了之后没人向他们开火就行。
ch.69dd2874ab50480c7b5b6155: 也许的确是这样，也许我根本不需要这么做！
ch.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: 你是不是觉得自己成个人物了，嗯？是不是，菜鸟？这玩意一靠近封锁线就会被打下来的，蠢货！
ch.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: 有一艘船，就在塔科夫外海不远的地方，我得想办法登上去。
ch.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: 我在基地里藏了一架直升机，你懂的，为了应对特殊情况。
ch.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: 但在塔科夫封锁区里飞就没事？
ch.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: 只要按照正确的航线飞，就没人会向它开火。
ch.69dd2874d36468b44f099980: 所以我还得负责把它给修好了？
ch.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: 那架直升机可是个货真价实的美人！你看到它就知道了。不过，如果能在起飞前给上上下下的部件再润滑一下就再好不过了。
ch.69dd2874f013e0279cd98c7b: 动脑子可不是你的本职工作，对吧？
ch.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: 你的意思是，你成功说服了上级，让你在塔科夫留着一整架武装直升机？
ch.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: 你这日子过得挺滋润啊！为了维持这种生活，是不是得花不少钱打点关系？
ch.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: 因为我他妈根本不在乎！你是在塔科夫，不是在什么狗屁新兵训练基地。
ch.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: 你对我的背景一无所知，包括军衔。
ch.69dd2874fe3f14687c44ca1f: 好吧，所以到底要我做什么？
ch.69e0a8f2306e1e0a9376383e: 你他妈到底是打算上哪儿去？
ch.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: 但问题是，我们这算是陆军。我甚至想不出谁能帮上忙。不过……
ch.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: 但这事情你知我知，明白了吗？
ch.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: 只要和关键人物搞好关系，没有什么不可能的。
ch.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: 以你的军衔，恐怕还轮不到你指点上面是怎么做事的。
ch.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: 又或者，按照文件上的定义，它已经不再是军用直升机了…
ch.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: 如果你还想我帮你的忙，就最好放尊敬些。
ch.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: 这他妈搞不好可是封锁区里唯一一架还能动弹的飞机了，结果你还来劲了！
ch.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: 你得保证那里一切安全才行。
ch.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: 办完之后记得在通往 Priozersk 森林保护区的路上打一颗信号弹。到时候他们就从那儿进来。

cz.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: Fakt jo? Ten zkurvenej BTR to nezvládne?
cz.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: Nemyslel jsem si, že v Tarkově ještě vůbec něco takovýho funguje.
cz.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: Počkej chvilku, přišel jsem snad já za tebou s nějakýma zkurvenýma prosbama?
cz.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: Takže bys mě v tom mohl z Tarkova i odlízt?
cz.69dd287459515e0488e06641: To beru. Ale stejně, bojový vozidlo není žádná bedna s municí. Něco takovýho jen tak neschováš v rohu. Jak se ti to vlastně povedlo?
cz.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: Tam, kam mám namířeno, mě to nedostane.
cz.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: Nikdy jsem neřekl, že je to bojový pták. A neřeknu ti, jak jsem k němu přišel.
cz.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: Moji lidi se o to postarají. Ale budou muset navštívit vojenskou základnu Reserve.
cz.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: Ne. Jenom zajisti, aby po mých technicích nikdo nestřílel, až tam dorazí.
cz.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: Dost si o sobě myslíš, co, zelenáči? Sestřelili by to hned na kordonu, ty kreténe!
cz.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: U pobřeží kousek od Tarkova kotví loď. Takže potřebuju něco, co se k ní dokáže dostat.
cz.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: Pro speciální případy mám na základně schovanou jednu mašinu.
cz.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: Takže uvnitř zóny Tarkova po ní střílet nebudou?
cz.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: Když s tím poletíš tam, kam máš, nikdo se tě nedotkne.
cz.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: Tahle kráska vás přežije! Přesto by neuškodilo pár věcí před startem namazat.
cz.69dd2874f013e0279cd98c7b: Přemýšlení teď není tvoje starost, ne?
cz.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: Chceš říct, že se ti podařilo ukecat šéfy, aby ti v Tarkově nechali bojovej vrtulník?
cz.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: To sis to ale pěkně zařídil! Musel jsi hodně podmazat, abys to udržel?
cz.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: Protože je mi to úplně u prdele! Jsi v Tarkově, ne na cvičišti.
cz.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: Nevíš nic o mý minulosti ani o mý hodnosti.
cz.69e0a8f2306e1e0a9376383e: Kam se to do prdele snažíš dostat?
cz.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: Problém je, že já jsem spíš přes pozemní síly. Ani nemám koho se zeptat. I když...
cz.69e0a94c6046b68442abee41: Možná by to šlo i jinak.
cz.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: Ale radši si to nech pro sebe, jasný?
cz.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: Jen musíš umět chodit v řeči se správnýma lidma.
cz.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: Nemáš na to hodnost, abys řešil, jak se věci dělají nahoře.
cz.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: A možná to ani není bojová mašina…
cz.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: Tak si dávej bacha na pusu, jestli chceš pomoct.
cz.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: Tohle je možná jediná funkční mašina, co ve městě zbyla, a ty nad ní ohrnuješ nos!
cz.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: Ty se postarej o to, aby tam bylo bezpečno.
cz.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: Jakmile budeš hotový, vystřel signální světlici v místě, kde se cesta střetává s Priozerským lesem. Tam odtud přijdou.

en.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: Oh yeah? That damn BTR can’t make it?
en.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: Didn’t think anything like that is still running in Tarkov.
en.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: Hold on a second, was that me coming to you with fucking requests?
en.69dd2874513cd2ae28a7f544: Hold on. Is it even operational?
en.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: So maybe you could fly me out of Tarkov on it too?
en.69dd2874530e529ef964cfa6: Hold on. Is it even operational?
en.69dd287459515e0488e06641: Fair enough. Still, a combat vehicle isn’t some ammo box. You don’t just hide something like that in a corner. How’d you pull it off?
en.69dd28745a3c6ffca3b28064: You forget who you’re talking to, huh?
en.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: It won’t get me where I’m going.
en.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: I never said it was a combat bird. And I’m not telling you how I got it.
en.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: My guys will handle it. But they’ll need to pay a visit to the Reserve military base.
en.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: Nah. Just make sure nobody’s shooting at my techs when they get there.
en.69dd2874ab50480c7b5b6155: Maybe I did, maybe I didn’t!
en.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: You think pretty highly of yourself, huh, rookie? They’d shoot it down at the cordon, dumbass!
en.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: There’s a ship sitting offshore near Tarkov. So I need something that can actually reach it.
en.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: For special cases, I’ve got a bird tucked away at my base.
en.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: So they’re not gonna shoot it inside the Tarkov zone?
en.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: If you fly it to proper spots, no one touches it.
en.69dd2874d36468b44f099980: So I’ve gotta fix it too?
en.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: This beauty will outlive you! Still, it wouldn't hurt to grease a few things before takeoff.
en.69dd2874f013e0279cd98c7b: Thinking’s not your job now, is it?
en.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: You’re saying you managed to talk your bosses into keeping a combat helicopter in Tarkov?
en.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: You’ve got yourself set up pretty well! Had to grease a lot of palms to keep it?
en.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: Because I don’t give a damn! You’re in Tarkov, not on a training ground.
en.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: You don’t know anything about my background or my rank.
en.69dd2874fe3f14687c44ca1f: Fine. What needs to be done?
en.69e0a8f2306e1e0a9376383e: Where the hell are you trying to get to?
en.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: Problem is, I’m more of a ground forces type. Don’t even have anyone to ask. Although...
en.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: But you better keep that to yourself, got it?
en.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: Just have to be slick with the right people.
en.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: You don’t have the rank to worry about how things get done up top.
en.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: And maybe it’s not even a combat bird…
en.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: So watch what you say if you want help.
en.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: This might be the only working bird left in the city and you’re turning your nose up!
en.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: You make sure it’s safe there.
en.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: Once you’re done, fire a signal flare where the path meets the Priozersk forest. That’s where they’ll come in.

it.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: Ah sì? Quel maledetto BTR non ce la fa?
it.69dd28741580354be1032098: Quindi ha bisogno di una barca.
it.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: Non pensavo che una cosa del genere fosse ancora in funzione a Tarkov.
it.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: Aspetta un attimo, ero io che ti stavo facendo quelle cazzo di richieste?
it.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: Quindi forse potresti farmi uscire da Tarkov con quello?
it.69dd287459515e0488e06641: Va bene. Tuttavia, un veicolo da combattimento non è una semplice scatola di munizioni. Non si nasconde una cosa del genere in un angolo. Come ci è riuscito?
it.69dd28745a3c6ffca3b28064: Ti sei dimenticato con chi stai parlando, eh?
it.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: Non mi porterà dove sto andando.
it.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: Non ho mai detto che fosse un uccello da combattimento. E non ti dirò come l'ho ottenuto.
it.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: Ci penseranno i miei ragazzi. Ma dovranno fare un salto alla base militare della Riserva.
it.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: No. Assicurati solo che nessuno spari ai miei tecnici quando arriveranno.
it.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: Ti credi proprio un granché, eh, novellino? Ti abbatterebbero al cordone di sicurezza, idiota!
it.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: C'è una nave al largo, vicino a Tarkov. Quindi ho bisogno di qualcosa che possa effettivamente raggiungerla.
it.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: Per casi particolari, ho un uccellino nascosto nella mia base.
it.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: Quindi non lo porteranno all'interno della zona di Tarkov?
it.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: Se lo porti nei punti giusti, nessuno lo toccherà.
it.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: Questa bellezza vi sopravviverà! Tuttavia, non sarebbe male lubrificare alcune parti prima del decollo.
it.69dd2874f013e0279cd98c7b: Pensare non è il suo compito adesso, vero?
it.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: Sta dicendo che è riuscito a convincere i suoi superiori a tenere un elicottero da combattimento a Tarkov?
it.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: Si è sistemato piuttosto bene! Hai dovuto ungere parecchie mani per mantenerlo?
it.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: Perché non me ne frega niente! Lei è a Tarkov, non in un campo di addestramento.
it.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: Non sa nulla del mio passato né del mio grado.
it.69e0a8f2306e1e0a9376383e: Dove diavolo stai cercando di andare?
it.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: Il problema è che io sono più un tipo da forze di terra. Non ho nemmeno nessuno a cui chiedere. Anche se...
it.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: Ma è meglio che te lo tenga per te, capito?
it.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: Basta solo essere abili con le persone giuste.
it.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: Non ha il grado necessario per preoccuparsi di come vanno le cose ai piani alti.
it.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: E forse non si tratta nemmeno di un uccello da combattimento…
it.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: Quindi fai attenzione a quello che dici se vuoi aiuto.
it.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: Questo potrebbe essere l'unico uccello rimasto in città e lei sta storcendo il naso!
it.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: Una volta finito, lancia un razzo di segnalazione nel punto in cui il sentiero incontra la foresta di Priozersk. È lì che arriveranno.

kr.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: 아, 그러셔? 그 BTR로도 갈 수 없는 곳이라고?
kr.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: 타르코프에 이제 더 이상 그런 건 안 날아다닐 거라고 생각했는데.
kr.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: 잠깐, 내가 지금 씨발 너한테 부탁이나 하러 온 거 같나?
kr.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: 그러면 이걸로 날 타르코프 밖으로 빼줄 수도 있겠네?
kr.69dd287459515e0488e06641: 알았어, 알았다고. 아무튼, 전투용 중장비가 무슨 그냥 탄통같이 무식한 물건이 아니잖아. 그런 걸 영영 감추고 있을 순 없을 거 같은데. 어떻게 한거지?
kr.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: 그 친구는 내가 가려고 하는 곳에 못 가.
kr.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: 누가 전투용이라고 했는가? 그리고 자네한테 알려줄 이유야 없네.
kr.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: 우리 애들이 해결할 문제일세. 근데 그 애들이 리저브 군사 기지에 가야 하거든.
kr.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: 아니. 그냥 우리 공병들이 갔을 때 아무도 없게 해주면 되네.
kr.69dd2874ab50480c7b5b6155: 그럴 수도 있고, 아닐 수도 있지!
kr.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: 자네는 자기 객관화가 안 되는 문제라도 있나, 응? 차단선에 가기도 전에 격추당할 거다, 이 새끼야!
kr.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: 저 타르코프 너머에 있는 해협에 정박한 배야. 그래서 저기에 직접 갈 수 있는 운송 수단이 필요하다 한거고.
kr.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: 아주 특별한 경우를 위해서 내 기지에 비밀리에 주기중인 헬리콥터 한 대가 있어.
kr.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: 그러면 타르코프 내에서는 격추시킬 일은 없다고?
kr.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: 정해진 구역 내에서만 비행한다면 문제는 없겠지.
kr.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: 이 이쁜이는 자네보다도 명줄이 길거든! 물론 이륙하기 전에 기름칠 좀 해둬서 나쁠 건 없네.
kr.69dd2874f013e0279cd98c7b: 머리를 쓰는 건 자네 일은 아니지 않나, 안 그래?
kr.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: 그러니까 윗사람들을 설득해서 타르코프 안에 공격 헬기를 배치시켜놨다 이거야?
kr.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: 이 곳에 제대로 터 잡았나 보네! 그거 숨긴답시고 꽤 많이 찔러주기라도 했나봐?
kr.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: 왜냐하면 난 관심 없으니까! 자네는 지금 타르코프에 있다고, 신병 훈련소가 아니란 말일세.
kr.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: 당신은 내가 어떤 사람인지도, 무슨 계급이었는지도 모르잖아.
kr.69dd2874fe3f14687c44ca1f: 그래. 그럼 뭘 하면 되는 건데?
kr.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: 문제는 말이야, 난 땅깨 출신이야. 내 주변에 물어볼 사람은 없어. 아마도…
kr.69e0a94c6046b68442abee41: 다른 방법이 있을 것 같기도 한데.
kr.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: 하지만 이거에 대해선 함구하는 게 좋을 거다, 알았나?
kr.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: 난 그냥 담당자들한테 비위 맞춰가면 될 뿐이야.
kr.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: 자네가 여기서 돌아가는 일에 대해 걱정할 만큼 짬밥을 먹은 거 같진 않은데.
kr.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: 그리고 이건 엄밀히 말해서 공격 헬기라 부르기도 뭐한 물건이네…
kr.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: 그러니까 내 도움이 필요하다면 입조심을 하는 게 좋을 걸세.
kr.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: 여기 있는 헬기가 이 도시에 있는 헬기들 중 유일하게 날아다닐 수 있는 물건인데, 아주 배가 불렀나?
kr.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: 반드시 그 길에 아무도 없어야 하네.
kr.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: 확인이 끝나면 프리오제르스크 숲으로 향하는 길 에서 조명탄을 쏘면 되네.

po.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: Ah é? Aquele BTR maldito não consegue chegar lá?
po.69dd28741580354be1032098: Então você precisa de um barco.
po.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: Não achei que ainda tivesse algo assim funcionando em Tarkov.
po.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: Espera um segundo, fui eu que vim até você com esses pedidos de merda?
po.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: Então talvez você pudesse me tirar de Tarkov nele também?
po.69dd287459515e0488e06641: Justo. Mesmo assim, um veículo de combate não é uma caixa de munição. Você não esconde algo assim num canto. Como você conseguiu?
po.69dd28745a3c6ffca3b28064: Você esqueceu com quem está falando, hein?
po.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: Não vai me levar onde estou indo.
po.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: Nunca disse que era de combate. E não vou te contar como consegui.
po.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: Meus caras vão cuidar. Mas vão precisar visitar a base militar Reserve.
po.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: Não. Só garanta que ninguém vai atirar nos meus técnicos quando chegarem lá.
po.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: Você se acha muito, hein, novato? Eles abateriam no cordão, seu idiota!
po.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: Tem um navio ancorado perto de Tarkov. Então preciso de algo que consiga chegar até lá.
po.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: Para casos especiais, tenho uma aeronave guardada na minha base.
po.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: Então não vão atirar nela dentro da zona de Tarkov?
po.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: Se você voar pelos lugares certos, ninguém mexe.
po.69dd2874d36468b44f099980: Então eu tenho que consertar também?
po.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: Essa beleza vai durar mais do que você! Mesmo assim, não faz mal dar uma ajeitada em algumas coisas antes de decolar.
po.69dd2874f013e0279cd98c7b: Pensar não é o seu trabalho agora, não é?
po.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: Você está dizendo que conseguiu convencer seus superiores a manter um helicóptero de combate em Tarkov?
po.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: Você se deu bem! Teve que untar muita mão para mantê-lo?
po.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: Porque não me importa! Você está em Tarkov, não num campo de treinamento.
po.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: Você não sabe nada sobre minha origem ou minha patente.
po.69dd2874fe3f14687c44ca1f: Tudo bem. O que precisa ser feito?
po.69e0a8f2306e1e0a9376383e: Onde diabos você está tentando chegar?
po.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: O problema é que sou mais do tipo forças terrestres. Nem tenho ninguém para perguntar. Embora...
po.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: Mas é melhor você guardar isso para si, entendeu?
po.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: É só saber lidar com as pessoas certas.
po.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: Você não tem a patente para se preocupar com como as coisas são feitas lá em cima.
po.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: E talvez nem seja de combate…
po.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: Então tome cuidado com o que diz se quiser ajuda.
po.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: Isso pode ser a única aeronave em funcionamento que resta na cidade e você está torcendo o nariz!
po.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: Você garante que está seguro lá.
po.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: Quando terminar, lance um sinalizador onde o caminho encontra a floresta de Priozersk. É de lá que eles virão.

es.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: ¿Ah, sí? ¿Ese maldito BTR no puede llevarte?
es.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: Pensaba que cosas como esas ya no funcionaban en Tarkov.
es.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: A ver, perdona, pero ¿he sido yo el que ha venido pidiendo un puñetero favor?
es.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: ¿Entonces tal vez podrías sacarme de Tarkov en él también?
es.69dd287459515e0488e06641: Está bien. Pero aun así, un vehículo de combate no es como una caja de municiones. No es algo que puedas esconder fácilmente en un rincón. ¿Cómo lo has conseguido?
es.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: No me llevará a donde quiero ir.
es.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: Nunca he dicho que fuera un helicóptero de combate. Y no pienso decirte cómo lo he conseguido.
es.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: Mis chicos se encargarán. Pero tendrán que visitar la base militar de Reserve.
es.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: Nah. Solo asegúrate de que nadie dispare a mis técnicos cuando lleguen allí.
es.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: Te crees muy importante, ¿eh, novato? ¡Es obvio que lo derribarían en el bloqueo, imbécil!
es.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: Hay un barco varado cerca de la costa de Tarkov. Así que necesito algo que realmente pueda llevarme hasta allí.
es.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: Para casos especiales, tengo un pájaro guardado en mi base.
es.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: Entonces, ¿no lo derribarán dentro de la zona de Tarkov?
es.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: Si lo vuelas por los sitios adecuados, nadie lo tocará.
es.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: ¡Esta belleza te sobrevivirá! Aunque aun así, no estaría mal engrasar algunas piezas antes del vuelo.
es.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: ¿Me estás contando que conseguiste convencer a tus jefes de que dejaran un helicóptero de combate en Tarkov?
es.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: ¡Te la has apañado muy bien! ¿Sobornaste a mucha peña para quedártelo?
es.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: ¡Porque me importa una mierda! Estás en Tarkov, no en un campo de adiestramiento.
es.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: Tú no sabes nada de mi pasado ni de mi rango.
es.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: El problema es que me especializo principalmente en fuerzas terrestres. Ni siquiera tengo a alguien a quien preguntarle. Aunque…
es.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: Pero será mejor que no se lo cuentes a nadie, ¿vale?
es.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: Solo debes llevarte bien con las personas adecuadas.
es.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: No tienes el rango necesario para preocuparte de cómo se hacen las cosas en las altas esferas.
es.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: Y tal vez ni siquiera es un helicóptero de combate…
es.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: Así que cuida lo que dices si quieres ayuda.
es.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: ¡Esta podría ser la única aeronave funcional de la ciudad y tú estás haciéndole ascos!
es.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: Asegúrate de que el sitio esté seguro.
es.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: Cuando hayas terminado, dispara una bengala donde el camino se conecta con el bosque de Priozersk. Ahí es por donde entrarán.

es-mx.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: ¿Ah, sí? ¿Ese maldito BTR no puede llevarte?
es-mx.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: Pensaba que cosas como esas ya no funcionaban en Tarkov.
es-mx.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: A ver, perdóname, pero ¿yo fui el que vino a ti pidiendo un puto favor?
es-mx.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: ¿Entonces tal vez podrías sacarme de Tarkov en él también?
es-mx.69dd287459515e0488e06641: Está bien. Pero aun así, un vehículo de combate no es como una caja de municiones. No es algo que puedas esconder fácilmente en un rincón. ¿Cómo lo lograste?
es-mx.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: Eso no me llevará a donde quiero ir.
es-mx.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: Nunca dije que fuera un helicóptero de combate. Y no voy a decirte cómo lo conseguí.
es-mx.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: Mis muchachos se encargarán. Pero tendrán que visitar la base militar de la Reserva.
es-mx.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: Nah. Solo asegúrate de que nadie le dispare a mis técnicos cuando lleguen ahí.
es-mx.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: Te crees muy importante, ¿eh, novato? ¡Obviamente lo derribarían en el bloqueo, idiota!
es-mx.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: Hay un barco varado cerca de la costa de Tarkov. Así que necesito algo que realmente pueda llevarme hasta allá.
es-mx.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: Para casos especiales, tengo un pájaro guardado en mi base.
es-mx.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: Entonces, ¿no van a dispararle dentro de la zona de Tarkov?
es-mx.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: Si lo vuelas por los lugares adecuados, nadie lo tocará.
es-mx.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: ¡Esta belleza vivirá más que tú! Aunque aun así, no estaría mal engrasar algunas piezas antes del despegue.
es-mx.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: ¿Me estás diciendo que lograste convencer a tus jefes de que dejaran un helicóptero de combate en Tarkov?
es-mx.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: ¡Te la has apañado muy bien! ¿Tuviste que sobornar a mucha gente para quedártelo?
es-mx.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: ¡Porque me importa un carajo! Estás en Tarkov, no en un campo de adiestramiento.
es-mx.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: Tú no sabes nada de mi pasado ni de mi grado.
es-mx.69dd2874fe3f14687c44ca1f: Está bueno, pues. ¿Qué hay que hacer?
es-mx.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: El problema es que me especializo principalmente en fuerzas terrestres. Ni siquiera tengo a alguien a quien preguntarle. Aunque…
es-mx.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: Pero más te vale que no le digas a nadie, ¿entendido?
es-mx.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: Solo tienes que llevarte bien con las personas adecuadas.
es-mx.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: No tienes el grado necesario para preocuparte de cómo se hacen las cosas en los altos mandos.
es-mx.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: Y tal vez ni siquiera es un helicóptero de combate…
es-mx.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: Así que ten cuidado con lo que dices si quieres ayuda.
es-mx.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: ¡Esta podría ser la única aeronave funcional que queda en la ciudad y tú la estás mirando por encima del hombro!
es-mx.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: Asegúrate de que ese lugar esté seguro.
es-mx.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: Cuando termines, dispara una bengala donde el camino se conecta con el bosque de Priozersk. Ahí es por donde entrarán.

tu.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: Oh yeah? That damn BTR can’t make it?
tu.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: Didn’t think anything like that is still running in Tarkov.
tu.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: Hold on a second, was that me coming to you with fucking requests?
tu.69dd2874513cd2ae28a7f544: Hold on. Is it even operational?
tu.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: So maybe you could fly me out of Tarkov on it too?
tu.69dd2874530e529ef964cfa6: Hold on. Is it even operational?
tu.69dd287459515e0488e06641: Fair enough. Still, a combat vehicle isn’t some ammo box. You don’t just hide something like that in a corner. How’d you pull it off?
tu.69dd28745a3c6ffca3b28064: You forget who you’re talking to, huh?
tu.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: It won’t get me where I’m going.
tu.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: I never said it was a combat bird. And I’m not telling you how I got it.
tu.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: My guys will handle it. But they’ll need to pay a visit to the Reserve military base.
tu.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: Nah. Just make sure nobody’s shooting at my techs when they get there.
tu.69dd2874ab50480c7b5b6155: Maybe I did, maybe I didn’t!
tu.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: You think pretty highly of yourself, huh, rookie? They’d shoot it down at the cordon, dumbass!
tu.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: There’s a ship sitting offshore near Tarkov. So I need something that can actually reach it.
tu.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: For special cases, I’ve got a bird tucked away at my base.
tu.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: So they’re not gonna shoot it inside the Tarkov zone?
tu.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: If you fly it to proper spots, no one touches it.
tu.69dd2874d36468b44f099980: So I’ve gotta fix it too?
tu.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: This beauty will outlive you! Still, it wouldn't hurt to grease a few things before takeoff.
tu.69dd2874f013e0279cd98c7b: Thinking’s not your job now, is it?
tu.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: You’re saying you managed to talk your bosses into keeping a combat helicopter in Tarkov?
tu.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: You’ve got yourself set up pretty well! Had to grease a lot of palms to keep it?
tu.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: Because I don’t give a damn! You’re in Tarkov, not on a training ground.
tu.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: You don’t know anything about my background or my rank.
tu.69dd2874fe3f14687c44ca1f: Fine. What needs to be done?
tu.69e0a8f2306e1e0a9376383e: Where the hell are you trying to get to?
tu.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: Problem is, I’m more of a ground forces type. Don’t even have anyone to ask. Although...
tu.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: But you better keep that to yourself, got it?
tu.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: Just have to be slick with the right people.
tu.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: You don’t have the rank to worry about how things get done up top.
tu.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: And maybe it’s not even a combat bird…
tu.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: So watch what you say if you want help.
tu.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: This might be the only working bird left in the city and you’re turning your nose up!
tu.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: You make sure it’s safe there.
tu.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: Once you’re done, fire a signal flare where the path meets the Priozersk forest. That’s where they’ll come in.

ru.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: Не думал, что в Таркове осталась настолько серьёзная техника.
ru.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: Я чёт не понял, это я к тебе за ремонтом обратился или чё?
ru.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: Так может ты меня на нём сможешь отсюда вывезти?
ru.69dd287459515e0488e06641: Я тебя понял. Но всё-таки, боевой борт не ящик патронов, такое незаметно у себя оставить не получится. Как ты это сделал?
ru.69dd28745a3c6ffca3b28064: А ты не забыл, с кем разговор имеешь, а?
ru.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: Он не проедет туда, куда мне надо.
ru.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: Я не говорил, что этот борт боевой. И не буду говорить тебе, как он у меня оказался.
ru.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: Мои парни сами всё сделают. Но им придётся сходить в гости на базу РосРезерва.
ru.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: Не. Просто сделай так, чтобы никто не палил по моим техникам, когда они придут на место.
ru.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: А не много ты о себе думаешь, салага? Её ж на кордоне собьют, олень!
ru.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: Недалеко от Таркова на стоянке остался один корабль. Так что и транспорт нужен подходящий.
ru.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: Для особо важных случаев у меня на базе есть вертушка.
ru.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: Если летать, куда надо, то всё норм будет.
ru.69dd2874d36468b44f099980: То есть мне ещё и починить его надо?
ru.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: Да эта ласточка и тебя переживёт! Но подмазать кой-чего перед взлётом не помешает.
ru.69dd2874f013e0279cd98c7b: А думать это и не твоя работа вроде, а?
ru.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: Хочешь сказать, что ты договорился с начальством о хранении в Таркове боевого вертолёта?
ru.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: А ты хорошо устроился! Многих подмазать пришлось, чтобы его у себя оставить?
ru.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: А мне и нахер оно не надо! Ты в Таркове, а не на учебном полигоне.
ru.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: Ты не знаешь ничего о моём боевом опыте и звании.
ru.69e0a8f2306e1e0a9376383e: И в какую такую глушь тебе попасть надо?
ru.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: Но я сам это, из сухопутных. Даже спрашивать не у кого. Хотя…
ru.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: Вертеться надо уметь, вот и всё.
ru.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: Не вижу на тебе погонов, с которыми разрешается думать, как наверху дела делаются.
ru.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: А может и не боевой это вертолёт…
ru.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: Так что думай, кому и что говоришь, если хочешь своё получить.
ru.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: Может быть, это единственная вертушка в городе, а ты морду воротишь!
ru.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: А ты сделаешь так, чтобы там было безопасно.
ru.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: Когда всё сделаешь, запусти сигнальный огонь, где тропинка к лесу идёт. Оттуда мои парни и придут.

th.69dd287406b0799f9431afff: Oh yeah? That damn BTR can’t make it?
th.69dd28742b8feca41e715018: Didn’t think anything like that is still running in Tarkov.
th.69dd28744ba06ba8ee128c7b: Hold on a second, was that me coming to you with fucking requests?
th.69dd2874513cd2ae28a7f544: Hold on. Is it even operational?
th.69dd28745246a3acda9b3914: So maybe you could fly me out of Tarkov on it too?
th.69dd2874530e529ef964cfa6: Hold on. Is it even operational?
th.69dd287459515e0488e06641: Fair enough. Still, a combat vehicle isn’t some ammo box. You don’t just hide something like that in a corner. How’d you pull it off?
th.69dd28745a3c6ffca3b28064: You forget who you’re talking to, huh?
th.69dd28745e6418d16c397f6e: It won’t get me where I’m going.
th.69dd2874612f26d5125106fa: I never said it was a combat bird. And I’m not telling you how I got it.
th.69dd287468005b08280cf7ec: My guys will handle it. But they’ll need to pay a visit to the Reserve military base.
th.69dd28747e7c8ba372133756: Nah. Just make sure nobody’s shooting at my techs when they get there.
th.69dd2874ab50480c7b5b6155: Maybe I did, maybe I didn’t!
th.69dd2874c1083645b7a821e9: You think pretty highly of yourself, huh, rookie? They’d shoot it down at the cordon, dumbass!
th.69dd2874c49458837db5e29c: There’s a ship sitting offshore near Tarkov. So I need something that can actually reach it.
th.69dd2874c5410b5e316927d8: For special cases, I’ve got a bird tucked away at my base.
th.69dd2874cdb1599ce2043a9a: So they’re not gonna shoot it inside the Tarkov zone?
th.69dd2874ce2a24553da54692: If you fly it to proper spots, no one touches it.
th.69dd2874d36468b44f099980: So I’ve gotta fix it too?
th.69dd2874ed41b6fed2825aab: This beauty will outlive you! Still, it wouldn't hurt to grease a few things before takeoff.
th.69dd2874f013e0279cd98c7b: Thinking’s not your job now, is it?
th.69dd2874f46f6a6b2905adba: You’re saying you managed to talk your bosses into keeping a combat helicopter in Tarkov?
th.69dd2874f687c2666fd0bded: You’ve got yourself set up pretty well! Had to grease a lot of palms to keep it?
th.69dd2874fa68878c74590109: Because I don’t give a damn! You’re in Tarkov, not on a training ground.
th.69dd2874fcffbf667281849c: You don’t know anything about my background or my rank.
th.69dd2874fe3f14687c44ca1f: Fine. What needs to be done?
th.69e0a8f2306e1e0a9376383e: Where the hell are you trying to get to?
th.69e0a92f274bee6d548dec3a: Problem is, I’m more of a ground forces type. Don’t even have anyone to ask. Although...
th.69e0a96fe9f293375f8ef468: But you better keep that to yourself, got it?
th.69e0a991897050fbe0454661: Just have to be slick with the right people.
th.69e0a9b87943b1ebb920bbd5: You don’t have the rank to worry about how things get done up top.
th.69e0a9f5a5121dd15e905b23: And maybe it’s not even a combat bird…
th.69e0aa24cefa2da93b8475ec: So watch what you say if you want help.
th.69e0aa63cee0f44df33aed81: This might be the only working bird left in the city and you’re turning your nose up!
th.69e0aa80106f488f69919405: You make sure it’s safe there.
th.69e0aab473aa653f6012d388: Once you’re done, fire a signal flare where the path meets the Priozersk forest. That’s where they’ll come in.

ch.69dd2a870163563b15477cf5: 没错。给我找几个军用滤波器来，我会想办法安排交通工具的，送你上西天都可以。
ch.69dd2a8708fb3ef7f58fc2c4: 你爱去哪去哪！我的直升机能把你带到任何地方，只要不是塔科夫以外的地方都行。
ch.69dd2a871f352a6149573dd1: 我不建议你想太多，因为你的脑瓜实在是不太灵光。你觉得光用钱就能弥补之前的那场闹剧？太荒唐了。不过我有其他需求，而且是立刻马上。
ch.69dd2a8735a4cd1ac672ec50: 我还以为能和你正常做生意呢。
ch.69dd2a873e41387d8eceedde: 我没让你免费帮忙，我会给钱的。
ch.69dd2a8748ca289a06075599: 所以我们可以做笔交易咯？
ch.69dd2a876b3ebd50ef548266: 但你甚至都没问我要的是什么交通工具…
ch.69dd2a876c0544152f685d6c: 我这的好东西多得是。但在你带着我要的滤波器回来见我之前，你的那些请求在我这就是个屁。
ch.69dd2a877f0333cf8c931f55: 你搞到了一架直升飞机？！
ch.69dd2a87807cd396b2a96c7b: 没错，给我找几个军用滤波器来。然后我们就可以商量，怎么把你弄到你要去的地方。
ch.69dd2a87905a0c37dea7bdca: 但你甚至都不知道我要的是什么交通工具…
ch.69dd2a87f201f262a875fd27: 哼……你这家伙运气不错，非常不错。我确实需要点东西，立刻、马上。
ch.69dd2a87f4a5a3614e4394ca: 我不是来求你施舍的，我愿意接任务。
ch.69dd2a87fcb7666966aa8470: 哦，是啊，当然了。我的价格是一百万……不，一万万卢布！

cz.69dd2a870163563b15477cf5: Jo. Přines mi pár vojenských napájecích filtrů a já ti ten odvoz vyřeším.
cz.69dd2a8708fb3ef7f58fc2c4: Je mi to u prdele. Můj vrtulník tě dostane kamkoliv, pokud to nebude mimo Tarkov.
cz.69dd2a871f352a6149573dd1: Nedoporučoval bych ti moc přemýšlet. Peníze takovej průser nevyžehlí. Ale zrovna něco nutně potřebuju.
cz.69dd2a876b3ebd50ef548266: Ale ani ses nezeptal, jakej odvoz potřebuju…
cz.69dd2a876c0544152f685d6c: Mám spoustu věcí. Ale dokud mi nepřineseš ty filtry, nebudu o tvý žádosti ani přemýšlet.
cz.69dd2a87807cd396b2a96c7b: Jo. Přines mi pár vojenských napájecích filtrů. Pak tě dostanu, kam potřebuješ.
cz.69dd2a87905a0c37dea7bdca: Ani nevíš, jakej odvoz vlastně hledám…
cz.69dd2a87f201f262a875fd27: Hm… Máš štěstí. Opravdu velké štěstí. Něco potřebuju, a to hned.
cz.69dd2a87f4a5a3614e4394ca: Nechci žádný milodary. Klidně vezmu nějakou těžkou práci.
cz.69dd2a87fcb7666966aa8470: Jo, jasně. Moje cena je milion… ne, milion milionů rublů!

en.69dd2a870163563b15477cf5: Yeah. Bring me a few military power filters, and I’ll sort out transport for you.
en.69dd2a8708fb3ef7f58fc2c4: I don’t give a damn. My helicopter can get you anywhere, as long as it’s not out of Tarkov.

en.69dd2a876b3ebd50ef548266: But you didn’t even ask what kind of transport I need…

en.69dd2a87807cd396b2a96c7b: Yeah. Bring me a few military-grade power filters. Then I’ll get you where you need to go.
en.69dd2a87905a0c37dea7bdca: You don’t even know what kind of transport I’m looking for…
en.69dd2a879cfd743d209d8124: So, a favor for a favor?

en.69dd2a87f4a5a3614e4394ca: Not asking for a handout. I can take on a difficult job.
en.69dd2a87fcb7666966aa8470: Oh yeah, sure. My price is a million… no, a million millions roubles!

it.69dd2a870163563b15477cf5: Sì. Portami qualche filtro elettrico militare e io le sistemerò il trasporto.
it.69dd2a8708fb3ef7f58fc2c4: Non me ne frega niente. Il mio elicottero può portarla ovunque, purché non sia fuori da Tarkov.
it.69dd2a871f352a6149573dd1: Non ti consiglierei di pensarci troppo. I soldi non basteranno a coprire un pasticcio del genere. Ma ho bisogno di una cosa, e subito.
it.69dd2a8735a4cd1ac672ec50: Pensavo che lei fosse un uomo d'affari.
it.69dd2a873e41387d8eceedde: Non è gratuito. Sono disposto a pagare.
it.69dd2a876b3ebd50ef548266: Ma non mi ha nemmeno chiesto di che tipo di mezzo di trasporto ho bisogno…
it.69dd2a876c0544152f685d6c: Ho un sacco di cose. Ma finché non mi porterai quei filtri, non prenderò nemmeno in considerazione la tua richiesta.
it.69dd2a87807cd396b2a96c7b: Sì. Portami alcuni filtri elettrici di tipo militare. Poi ti porterò dove devi andare.
it.69dd2a87905a0c37dea7bdca: Non sa nemmeno che tipo di mezzo di trasporto sto cercando…
it.69dd2a879cfd743d209d8124: Allora, un favore in cambio di un favore?
it.69dd2a87f201f262a875fd27: Hm… Che fortuna. Una fortuna incredibile. Ho davvero bisogno di qualcosa, subito.
it.69dd2a87f4a5a3614e4394ca: Non sto chiedendo l'elemosina. Sono in grado di affrontare un lavoro difficile.
it.69dd2a87fcb7666966aa8470: Oh sì, certo. Il mio prezzo è un milione... no, un milione di milioni di rubli!

jp.69dd2a870163563b15477cf5: ああ。軍用パワーフィルターをいくつか持ってこい。輸送の手配は俺がする。
jp.69dd2a8708fb3ef7f58fc2c4: どうだっていい。俺のヘリなら、タルコフの外にさえでなければ、どこへでも連れてってやれる。
jp.69dd2a871f352a6149573dd1: あまり深く考えるな。あんな失敗は金ではどうにもならん。だが、俺には今すぐ必要なものがある。
jp.69dd2a8735a4cd1ac672ec50: あんたはビジネスマンだと思ってたんだがな。
jp.69dd2a8748ca289a06075599: それじゃあ決まりだな？
jp.69dd2a876b3ebd50ef548266: だが、あんたはどんな乗り物が必要なのか、聞いてもいないじゃないか...
jp.69dd2a876c0544152f685d6c: 色々と持ってはいる。だがお前がフィルターを持ってくるまでは、お前の頼みなんて考えもしないぞ。
jp.69dd2a87807cd396b2a96c7b: ああ、軍用のパワーフィルターをいくつか持ってこい。そうすれば、お前を目的地まで連れてってやる。
jp.69dd2a87905a0c37dea7bdca: 俺がどんな乗り物を探しているのか、あんたはまだ知らないだろう...
jp.69dd2a879cfd743d209d8124: つまり、代わりに頼みごとがあるってことか？
jp.69dd2a87f201f262a875fd27: ふむ... 幸運な奴だ。本当に幸運だ。今すぐ必要なものがある。
jp.69dd2a87f4a5a3614e4394ca: 施しを求めてるわけじゃない。困難な仕事でも引き受ける。
jp.69dd2a87fcb7666966aa8470: ああ、そうか。値段は 100万... いや、 10億ルーブルだ！

es.69dd2a870163563b15477cf5: Sí. Tráeme unos cuantos filtros militares de energía y yo te conseguiré el transporte.
es.69dd2a8708fb3ef7f58fc2c4: No me importa una mierda. Mi helicóptero puede llevarte a cualquier sitio, siempre y cuando no sea fuera de Tarkov.
es.69dd2a871f352a6149573dd1: No te recomiendo que pienses demasiado en esto. El dinero no arreglará una cagada como esa. Pero hay algo que necesito, de inmediato.
es.69dd2a8735a4cd1ac672ec50: Creía que eras un hombre de negocios.
es.69dd2a876b3ebd50ef548266: Pero ni siquiera me has preguntado qué tipo de transporte necesito…
es.69dd2a876c0544152f685d6c: Tengo un buen montón de cosas. Pero hasta que no me traigas esos filtros, ni siquiera pensaré en tu petición.
es.69dd2a87807cd396b2a96c7b: Sí. Tráeme unos cuantos filtros militares de energía. Entonces te llevaré a donde necesites ir.
es.69dd2a87905a0c37dea7bdca: Ni siquiera sabes qué tipo de transporte estoy buscando…
es.69dd2a87f201f262a875fd27: Hm… Qué suerte tienes. Mucha suerte. Yo sí que necesito algo, y rápido.
es.69dd2a87f4a5a3614e4394ca: No estoy pidiendo caridad. Puedo encargarme de un trabajo difícil.
es.69dd2a87fcb7666966aa8470: Ah, sí, claro. ¡Mi precio es un millón… no, mil millones de rublos!

ru.69dd2a870163563b15477cf5: Ага. Притащи мне несколько военных фильтров питания, а я достану транспорт.
ru.69dd2a8708fb3ef7f58fc2c4: Да мне насрать. Моя вертушка тебя куда угодно доставит, разве что из Таркова не вывезет.
ru.69dd2a871f352a6149573dd1: Я бы не советовал тебе особо много думать. Деньгами такое кидалово не замажешь. Но, сука, мне очень нужно кое-что, и нужно вчера.
ru.69dd2a8735a4cd1ac672ec50: Я думал, что ты деловой человек.
ru.69dd2a873e41387d8eceedde: Не задаром же. Я могу заплатить.
ru.69dd2a876b3ebd50ef548266: Но ты даже не спросил, что за транспорт я ищу…
ru.69dd2a876c0544152f685d6c: У меня много чего есть. И пока ты не притащишь мне эти фильтры, я даже думать о твоей просьбе не буду.
ru.69dd2a87807cd396b2a96c7b: Ага. Притащи мне несколько военных фильтров питания. Потом я доставлю тебя, куда надо.
ru.69dd2a87905a0c37dea7bdca: Но ты даже не знаешь, что за транспорт я ищу…
ru.69dd2a87f201f262a875fd27: Хм… Везёт тебе, сильно везёт. Мне кое-что нужно, и нужно ещё вчера.
ru.69dd2a87f4a5a3614e4394ca: Но ведь не за просто так. Могу выполнить сложный заказ.
ru.69dd2a87fcb7666966aa8470: Ага, давай. Моя цена: миллион, нет, миллион миллионов рублей!

ch.69dd31aa005a416e826da4f3: 塔科夫外海停着一艘船，我需要想办法到船上去。
ch.69dd31aa03970c4b256a1ee9: 去军营广场上那架米里直升机周围看看吧，如果那里没有的话，到火车站平台那边的仓库找找。哦，对了，搞不好军事学院的地下室里有，你应该知道的，标着黑主教棋子的那栋楼。
ch.69dd31aa1a55e25e586bb9bc: 那时候城里的情况一团糟，根本管不过来，无论是就地维修还是疏散出去的风险都太高了，不如留在原地……实际上，大部分重装备就是这样被遗弃在塔科夫的。
ch.69dd31aa249774e6b7c56723: 好吧，我会告诉你的。但要是有其他人问起来，可别到处说 Prapor 有一架直升机什么的，明白了吗？
ch.69dd31aa3f4e234fc888580e: 我要去的地方 BTR 去不了。
ch.69dd31aa4fa0d32cee9fd2b6: 嗯，怎么说呢……如果能适当润滑一些部件的话，应该还是可以飞的。
ch.69dd31aa5338d93f4eeed29d: 难道这种程度的损失就没人过问吗？
ch.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: 嗯……我觉得还是有法子能安排的。你恐高吗？
ch.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: 那到底是什么直升机？你是从哪搞来的？
ch.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: 我在 EMERCOM 有个朋友，你知道的，紧急情况部，当初我们刚入伍那会就经常偷偷一起溜出去…
ch.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: 没错，我是有一架。留着给特殊情况下用的，但如果你真的需要的话，我确实能帮上忙。
ch.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: 储备站应该还留着一些特种油料，航空级别的，型号叫 AMG-10。
ch.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: 你这是什么意思？EMERCOM 的人一直忙得团团转，直到封锁之前都在三班倒地干活，甚至冒着你们这些 PMC 的火力疏散平民。
ch.69dd31aa901c86ca99d66b51: 等等……你弄到了一架直升机？！
ch.69dd31aa99bf9d72bd027bcd: 呃，其实它不算是武装直升机…
ch.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: 哈哈，所以事情真的是这样的吗？一架武装直升机在疏散中就这么“凑巧”留在了某个准尉的基地里？
ch.69dd31aac6e5d3c52b51c897: 哦？这倒是新鲜，所以你到底要上哪儿去？
ch.69dd31aad83d096b4859ae6e: 所以你把它完全修好了？
ch.69dd31aae157dc1870ed0b4b: 等等，这架飞机还能飞吗？
ch.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: 别这么大惊小怪的，战士。我手下的机修师知道该怎么干活，他们之前已经让直升机顺利运转起来了。
ch.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: 那你这个部里的朋友在“契约战争”期间都在干什么呢？
ch.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: 之后他就在当地参加工作，负责搜救和灭火之类的——当然，前提是地方消防部门应付不过来的情况下。
ch.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: 反正最终是，他们有一架直升机严重受损，然后我私底下做了点安排，悄悄把它给“报废”掉了——总之，这架飞机名义上已经不再是政府财产了。
ch.69e1ee3b88817ecfc059fc31: 但现在需要你自愿付出点劳动，好让飞机的工况恢复如新了。
ch.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: 如果你能找来我需要的润滑油的话，我的人应该很快就能把直升机整备好。

cz.69dd31aa005a416e826da4f3: Nedaleko od Tarkova je loď. Potřebuju se na ni dostat.
cz.69dd31aa03970c4b256a1ee9: Zkontroluj to u toho vrtulníku Mi na buzeráku u kasáren. Pokud tam nebude, prohledej náklad u nástupišť nebo sklep pod budovou akademie, Černý střelec.
cz.69dd31aa1a55e25e586bb9bc: V té chvíli se v Tarkově dělo tolik věcí, že jeho oprava nebo evakuace by mohly být nebezpečnější než nechat ho tam, jak je.
cz.69dd31aa249774e6b7c56723: Dobře, řeknu ti to. Ale jestli se někdo zeptá, Prapor žádný vrtulník nemá, jasný?
cz.69dd31aa3f4e234fc888580e: BTR mě nedostane tam, kam potřebuju.
cz.69dd31aa4fa0d32cee9fd2b6: No, jak to říct… Když to na pár místech namazáme, mělo by to fungovat.
cz.69dd31aa5338d93f4eeed29d: A to nikdo takovou ztrátu neřešil?
cz.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: Hm… Myslím, že se nějak domluvíme. Bojíš se výšek?
cz.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: Tak co to teda je? A kde jsi to vzal?
cz.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: Mám kamaráda z EMERCOMu, ještě za vojny jsme se spolu tajně plížili ven...
cz.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: Jeden mám, to jo. Schovávám si ho pro speciální případy, ale jestli ho vážně potřebuješ, můžu pomoct.
cz.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: Na základně Reserve by mělo zbýt nějaké speciální mazivo, říká se mu AMG-10.
cz.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: Jak jako co? Makalo se nonstop. Na tři směny až do blokády. Někdy i pod palbou.
cz.69dd31aa99bf9d72bd027bcd: No, není to zrovna bojový stroj...
cz.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: Jen tak? Bojový vrtulník, který prostě „náhodou“ zůstal na základně nějakého praporčíka během evakuace?
cz.69dd31aac6e5d3c52b51c897: Aha? A co je to za místo?
cz.69dd31aad83d096b4859ae6e: Takže jsi ho dal kompletně dohromady?
cz.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: Klid, bojovníku, moji technici vědí, co dělají. Tenhle vrtulník už v minulosti rozchodili.
cz.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: A co dělali během Válek kontraktorů?
cz.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: Pracoval v tomhle regionu, pátrací a záchranné akce, hasil požáry, když na to požární hlídky nestačily.
cz.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: Ke konci byl jeden z jejich vrtulníků těžce poškozen a já zařídil, aby ho potichu „odepsali“.
cz.69e1ee3b88817ecfc059fc31: Ale teď to vyžaduje tvou dobrovolnou účast.
cz.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: Když to přineseš, moji lidi všechno rychle připraví.

en.69dd31aa005a416e826da4f3: There’s a ship not far from Tarkov. I need to get on it.
en.69dd31aa03970c4b256a1ee9: Check near the MI bird at the barracks square. If it’s not there, search the cargo by the platforms or the basement under the academy building, Black Bishop.
en.69dd31aa1a55e25e586bb9bc: By that point, there was so much going on in Tarkov that repairing or evacuating it could’ve been more dangerous than leaving it there.
en.69dd31aa249774e6b7c56723: Alright, I’ll tell you. But if anyone asks, Prapor doesn’t have any helicopter, understood?
en.69dd31aa3652f504c8a6154e: Where should I look for it?
en.69dd31aa3f4e234fc888580e: The BTR won’t get me where I need to go.
en.69dd31aa4fa0d32cee9fd2b6: Well, how do I put it… If we grease a few spots, it should fly.
en.69dd31aa5338d93f4eeed29d: And no one questioned such a loss?
en.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: Hm… I think we can work something out. You afraid of heights?
en.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: Then what is it? And where did you get it?
en.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: I’ve got a friend from EMERCOM, back during conscription we used to sneak out together…
en.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: I’ve got one, yes. I keep it for special situations, but if you really need it, I can help.
en.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: There should be some special oil left at the Reserve base, called AMG-10.
en.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: What do you mean? Working non-stop. Three shifts until the blockade. Sometimes even under fire.
en.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: Just like that? A combat helicopter that just “happened” to stay on a warrant officer’s base during the evacuation?
en.69dd31aac6e5d3c52b51c897: Oh? And what kind of place is that?
en.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: Relax warrior, my technicians know what they’re doing. They’ve already had this helicopter running before.
en.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: And what were they doing during the Contract Wars?
en.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: He worked in the region, search and rescue, putting out fires when fire watchers couldn’t handle it.
en.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: Toward the end, one of their helicopters was badly damaged, and I arranged for it to be quietly “written off”.
en.69e1ee3b88817ecfc059fc31: But now it needs your voluntary participation.
en.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: If you bring it, my guys will get everything ready quickly.

fr.69dd31aa249774e6b7c56723: Alright, I’ll tell you. But if anyone asks, Prapor doesn’t have any helicopter, understood?
fr.69dd31aa3652f504c8a6154e: Where should I look for it?
fr.69dd31aa3f4e234fc888580e: The BTR won’t get me where I need to go.
fr.69dd31aa4fa0d32cee9fd2b6: Well, how do I put it… If we grease a few spots, it should fly.
fr.69dd31aa5338d93f4eeed29d: And no one questioned such a loss?
fr.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: Hm… I think we can work something out. You afraid of heights?
fr.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: Then what is it? And where did you get it?
fr.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: I’ve got a friend from EMERCOM, back during conscription we used to sneak out together…
fr.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: I’ve got one, yes. I keep it for special situations, but if you really need it, I can help.
fr.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: There should be some special oil left at the Reserve base, called AMG-10.
fr.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: What do you mean? Working non-stop. Three shifts until the blockade. Sometimes even under fire.
fr.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: Just like that? A combat helicopter that just “happened” to stay on a warrant officer’s base during the evacuation?
fr.69dd31aac6e5d3c52b51c897: Oh? And what kind of place is that?
fr.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: Relax warrior, my technicians know what they’re doing. They’ve already had this helicopter running before.
fr.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: And what were they doing during the Contract Wars?
fr.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: He worked in the region, search and rescue, putting out fires when fire watchers couldn’t handle it.
fr.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: Toward the end, one of their helicopters was badly damaged, and I arranged for it to be quietly “written off”.
fr.69e1ee3b88817ecfc059fc31: But now it needs your voluntary participation.
fr.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: If you bring it, my guys will get everything ready quickly.

it.69dd31aa005a416e826da4f3: C'è una nave non lontano da Tarkov. Devo salire a bordo.
it.69dd31aa03970c4b256a1ee9: Controlla nei pressi dell'uccello MI nella piazza della caserma. Se non è lì, cerca nel carico vicino alle piattaforme o nel seminterrato sotto l'edificio dell'accademia, Black Bishop.
it.69dd31aa1a55e25e586bb9bc: A quel punto, a Tarkov stavano succedendo così tante cose che ripararlo o evacuarlo avrebbe potuto essere più pericoloso che lasciarlo lì.
it.69dd31aa249774e6b7c56723: Va bene, glielo dirò. Ma se qualcuno lo chiede, Prapor non ha nessun elicottero, inteso?
it.69dd31aa3f4e234fc888580e: Il BTR non mi porterà dove devo andare.
it.69dd31aa4fa0d32cee9fd2b6: Beh, come dire… Se lubrificiamo qualche punto, dovrebbe funzionare.
it.69dd31aa5338d93f4eeed29d: E nessuno ha messo in discussione una tale perdita?
it.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: Mmm... Credo che potremo trovare una soluzione. Hai paura dell'altezza?
it.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: Allora, di cosa si tratta? E dove l'ha preso?
it.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: Ho un amico dell'EMERCOM; ai tempi del servizio militare ce la svignavamo insieme...
it.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: Ne ho uno, sì. Lo tengo da parte per situazioni speciali, ma se ne hai davvero bisogno, posso aiutarti.
it.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: Alla base della Riserva dovrebbe esserci ancora un po' di un olio speciale, chiamato AMG-10.
it.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: Cosa intendi dire? Lavorando senza sosta. Tre turni fino al blocco. A volte persino sotto il fuoco nemico.
it.69dd31aa99bf9d72bd027bcd: Beh, non si tratta proprio di un combattimento...
it.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: Proprio così? Un elicottero da combattimento che si è “casualmente” fermato alla base di un sottufficiale durante l’evacuazione?
it.69dd31aac6e5d3c52b51c897: Oh? E che tipo di posto è quello?
it.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: Rilassati, guerriero, i miei tecnici sanno quello che fanno. Hanno già fatto funzionare questo elicottero in passato.
it.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: E cosa stavano facendo durante le Guerre dei Contratti?
it.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: Lavorava nella regione, occupandosi di ricerca e soccorso, spegnendo gli incendi quando i vigili del fuoco non riuscivano a gestirli.
it.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: Verso la fine, uno dei loro elicotteri è stato gravemente danneggiato e ho fatto in modo che venisse silenziosamente “messo fuori servizio”.
it.69e1ee3b88817ecfc059fc31: Ma ora è necessaria la tua partecipazione volontaria.
it.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: Se glielo porti, i miei ragazzi prepareranno tutto in fretta.
