kr.69dd31aa005a416e826da4f3: 타르코프에서 멀지 않은 곳에 배 한 척이 있는데, 거기로 가야 해.
kr.69dd31aa03970c4b256a1ee9: 주 막사들 근처에 주기된 Mi-26 헬리콥터의 근처를 뒤져보게. 만약 없으면, 기차역 플랫폼 근처의 화물 상자들이나 집체교육장으로 쓰는 막사의 지하에도 가보고. 블랙 비숍 건물 말일세.
kr.69dd31aa1a55e25e586bb9bc: 그 당시의 타르코프는 너무 난장판이라서 수리하거나 회수하는게 폐기 처분하는 것보다 더 위험하다고 판단했지.
kr.69dd31aa249774e6b7c56723: 그래, 그래. 얘기해 주지. 하지만 누가 묻거든, 프라퍼는 헬기 같은 건 없다고 말해야 하네, 알겠나?
kr.69dd31aa4fa0d32cee9fd2b6: 이걸 뭐라고 해야 하지… 구리스칠만 좀 해주면 다시 날 수 있을 걸세.
kr.69dd31aa5338d93f4eeed29d: 헬기 한 대가 손망실됐는데 아무도 신경을 안 썼다고?
kr.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: 흠… 나한테 방법이 하나 있는데, 자네 혹시 고소공포증 있나?
kr.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: 그럼 뭔데? 아니, 그건 어디서 구한 건데?
kr.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: 내 친구 한 명이 비상사태부에 있는데, 내가 입대했을 떄부터 알고 지내던 친구였네…
kr.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: 한 대 있네. 특별한 경우에만 꺼내 쓰는데, 자네가 원한다면 꺼내다 주지.
kr.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: 리저브 기지에 AMG-10이라고 하는 특수 윤활유가 좀 남아 있을 걸세.
kr.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: 그게 무슨 소리인가? 쉴 틈도 없이 계속 일했다네. 봉쇄령이 내려지기 전까진 3교대로 근무했네. 때로는 교전 중에도 근무해야 했고.
kr.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: 진짜 그냥 도와준다고? 저 공격헬기가 대피령이 내려진 동안부터 왠 준위가 있는 기지에 계속 "남겨진" 공격헬기란 소리야?
kr.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: 진정하게, 우리 공병들이 자기 할 일은 똑 부러지게 잘 한다고. 전에도 이 헬기로 비행 나가본 적도 있다네.
kr.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: 그래서 그 사람들은 계약 전쟁 시기에는 뭘 했는데?
kr.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: 그 녀석은 이 지역에서 수색 구조 작업이나, 소방관들 조차도 통제하기 어려운 현장에도 일하러 다녔지.
kr.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: 그러다가 그 친구의 헬기 중 한 대가 심하게 파손됐는데, 내가 그걸 "물자 이동"을 시켰지.
kr.69e1ee3b88817ecfc059fc31: 하지만, 자네의 자발적인 도움이 필요해 보이네.
kr.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: 만야 그걸 가져다 준다면 우리 애들이 더 빨리 준비할 수 있을걸세.

po.69dd31aa005a416e826da4f3: Há um navio não muito longe de Tarkov. Preciso embarcar nele.
po.69dd31aa03970c4b256a1ee9: Procure perto do helicóptero MI na praça do quartel. Se não estiver lá, procure na carga próxima às plataformas ou no porão sob o prédio da academia, Bispo Preto.
po.69dd31aa1a55e25e586bb9bc: Naquela época, havia tanto acontecendo em Tarkov que reparar ou evacuar seria mais perigoso do que deixar lá.
po.69dd31aa249774e6b7c56723: Certo, vou te contar. Mas se alguém perguntar, Prapor não tem nenhum helicóptero, entendido?
po.69dd31aa3f4e234fc888580e: O BTR não vai me levar onde preciso ir.
po.69dd31aa4fa0d32cee9fd2b6: Bom, como eu diria… Se a gente der uma ajeitada em alguns pontos, deve voar.
po.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: Hm… Acho que podemos chegar a um acordo. Você tem medo de altura?
po.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: Então o que é isso? E onde você conseguiu?
po.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: Tenho um amigo do EMERCOM, lá no tempo do serviço militar a gente escapulia junto…
po.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: Tenho um sim. Guardo para situações especiais, mas se você realmente precisar, posso ajudar.
po.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: Deve ter algum óleo especial na base Reserve, chamado AMG-10.
po.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: O que você quer dizer? Trabalhando sem parar. Três turnos até o bloqueio. Às vezes até sob fogo.
po.69dd31aa99bf9d72bd027bcd: Bom, não é exatamente de combate…
po.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: Assim do nada? Um helicóptero de combate que simplesmente "ficou" na base de um suboficial durante a evacuação?
po.69dd31aac6e5d3c52b51c897: Oh? E que tipo de lugar é esse?
po.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: Relaxa, guerreiro, meus técnicos sabem o que estão fazendo. Eles já colocaram esse helicóptero para funcionar antes.
po.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: E o que eles faziam durante as Contract Wars?
po.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: Ele trabalhava na região, busca e resgate, apagando incêndios quando os bombeiros não conseguiam lidar.
po.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: Perto do fim, um dos helicópteros deles foi gravemente danificado, e eu providenciei para que fosse discretamente "baixado".
po.69e1ee3b88817ecfc059fc31: Mas agora precisa da sua participação voluntária.
po.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: Se você trouxer, meus caras deixam tudo pronto rapidinho.

sk.69dd31aa5338d93f4eeed29d: And no one questioned such a loss?
sk.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: Hm… I think we can work something out. You afraid of heights?
sk.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: Then what is it? And where did you get it?
sk.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: I’ve got a friend from EMERCOM, back during conscription we used to sneak out together…
sk.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: I’ve got one, yes. I keep it for special situations, but if you really need it, I can help.
sk.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: There should be some special oil left at the Reserve base, called AMG-10.
sk.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: What do you mean? Working non-stop. Three shifts until the blockade. Sometimes even under fire.
sk.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: Just like that? A combat helicopter that just “happened” to stay on a warrant officer’s base during the evacuation?
sk.69dd31aac6e5d3c52b51c897: Oh? And what kind of place is that?
sk.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: Relax warrior, my technicians know what they’re doing. They’ve already had this helicopter running before.
sk.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: And what were they doing during the Contract Wars?
sk.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: He worked in the region, search and rescue, putting out fires when fire watchers couldn’t handle it.
sk.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: Toward the end, one of their helicopters was badly damaged, and I arranged for it to be quietly “written off”.
sk.69e1ee3b88817ecfc059fc31: But now it needs your voluntary participation.
sk.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: If you bring it, my guys will get everything ready quickly.

es.69dd31aa005a416e826da4f3: Hay un barco no muy lejos de Tarkov. Necesito abordarlo.
es.69dd31aa03970c4b256a1ee9: Revisa cerca del helicóptero MI en la plaza frente a las barracas. Si no está ahí, busca en la carga junto a las plataformas o el sótano de la academia, en Alfil Negro.
es.69dd31aa1a55e25e586bb9bc: Para ese entonces, pasaban tantas cosas en Tarkov que repararlo o evacuarlo podría haber sido más peligroso que dejarlo allí.
es.69dd31aa249774e6b7c56723: Vale, te lo diré. Pero si alguien pregunta, Prapor no tiene ningún helicóptero, ¿entendido?
es.69dd31aa3f4e234fc888580e: El BTR no puede llevarme a donde necesito ir.
es.69dd31aa4fa0d32cee9fd2b6: Bueno, cómo decirlo… Con un poco de aceite en algunas piezas, debería volar sin problemas.
es.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: Mmm… Creo que podemos solucionar eso. ¿Te dan miedo las alturas?
es.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: Entonces, ¿qué es? ¿Y de dónde lo has sacado?
es.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: Tengo un amigo de EMERCOM; cuando estábamos en el servicio militar obligatorio, solíamos escaparnos juntos…
es.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: Sí, tengo uno. Lo guardo para situaciones especiales, pero si realmente lo necesitas, puedo ayudarte.
es.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: Debería quedar un poco de aceite especial en la base de Reserve, llamado AMG-10.
es.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: ¿Qué quieres decir? Trabajaban sin parar. Tres turnos hasta que se impuso el bloqueo. A veces, incluso bajo fuego enemigo.
es.69dd31aa99bf9d72bd027bcd: Bueno, no es exactamente de combate…
es.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: ¿Así nada más? ¿Un helicóptero de combate que “casualmente” se quedó en la base de un suboficial durante la evacuación?
es.69dd31aac6e5d3c52b51c897: ¿Ah, sí? ¿Y qué tipo de lugar es ese?
es.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: Tranquilo, guerrero, mis técnicos saben lo que hacen. Ya han conseguido que este helicóptero funcione antes.
es.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: ¿Y qué hacían durante las Contract Wars?
es.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: Él trabajaba en la región, en búsqueda y rescate, apagando incendios cuando los bomberos no podían con ellos.
es.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: Hacia el final, uno de sus helicópteros sufrió graves daños, y me encargué de que lo “dieran de baja” discretamente.
es.69e1ee3b88817ecfc059fc31: Pero ahora necesitamos de tu colaboración.
es.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: Si lo traes, mis chicos lo tendrán listo al instante.

ru.69dd31aa005a416e826da4f3: Недалеко от Таркова остался на стоянке один корабль. Мне нужно туда попасть.
ru.69dd31aa03970c4b256a1ee9: Посмотри рядом с «Мишкой» на плацу. А если там не будет, то есть смысл обыскать грузы на перроне и подвал под учебным корпусом. Ну, чёрный слон.
ru.69dd31aa1a55e25e586bb9bc: В Таркове уже столько всего творилось, что ремонтировать и вывозить вертолёт могло быть опаснее, чем бросить в городе.
ru.69dd31aa249774e6b7c56723: Ладно, тебе я расскажу, только если кто спросит – никакой вертушки у Прапора нет, лады?
ru.69dd31aa4fa0d32cee9fd2b6: Ну как тебе сказать… Если в паре мест подмазать, должен полететь.
ru.69dd31aa5338d93f4eeed29d: И никто не спросил с твоего товарища за такую большую потерю?
ru.69dd31aa575e574be4698d9b: Хм… Думаю, сможем кое-что придумать. Высоты не боишься?
ru.69dd31aa634a27925e67ce92: А какой тогда? И откуда он у тебя?
ru.69dd31aa6d4369e505fb4a04: В общем, есть у меня один товарищ из МЧС, ещё на срочке вместе в самоволку бегали…
ru.69dd31aa6fc67a76561ff699: Есть один, да. Держу для особых случаев, но если тебе сильно надо, то могу помочь.
ru.69dd31aa8a7c71b592f02e58: На базе РосРезерва должно было остаться особое масло, АМГ-10 называется.
ru.69dd31aa8ca3b86f9dd5aa9c: Как что? Работали в три смены вплоть до введения блокады, иногда и под огонь попадали.
ru.69dd31aac23ea013cbd82eba: Вот так просто? Боевой вертолёт, который «случайно» остался на базе прапорщика во время эвакуации?
ru.69dd31aac6e5d3c52b51c897: Ого! И что это за места такие?
ru.69dd31aaf99ef31330098066: Да не ссы ты, мои техники своё дело знают, да и раньше уже этот вертолёт запускали.
ru.69dd31aafd4f57589badec51: А что они делали во время Контрактных войн?
ru.69e1ee0e1cb313e3c0ceb096: Он в области работал. Искали потеряшек и помогали пожары тушить, когда лесоохрана не справлялась.
ru.69e1ee28c3436f418c9fb552: Ближе к концу Контрактных войн одну вертушку повредили серьёзно, а я подсуетился и договорился о тихом «списании».
ru.69e1ee498d6af0879a50b9ae: Вот если его притащишь, то ребята всё быстро сделают.

ch.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: 明白了，我什么时候能收到你的消息？
ch.69dd3afb0fd45597a2d0c0e2: 不是，就只准备“打听打听”吗？
ch.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: 海岸线不是有条路通往海关方向么？从疗养院东楼出发，往海关方向下坡，有一大片空地。过了那片地之后，你会看到几个棚屋和一些集装箱围起来的地方，那里就是了。
ch.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: 别这样，我本来也要到他们那儿跑一趟的。不过你可以做点事，提高点成功率。
ch.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: 他们有几个藏匿点，最近老有外人过去晃悠。你把那些不请自来的“客人”清理掉，我会告诉那些走私者们是你在帮忙。
ch.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: 等你把事情搞定，我这边也差不多有消息了。
ch.69dd3afb7c6807b24a89784f: 你能帮我跟他们牵个线吗？
ch.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: 从 Ultra 正门出来，过马路，再过一条铁轨就看到了。整个营地是用集装箱搭起来的，有大铁棚子、帐篷，还有一些临时搭的破屋子。那边有个红星标记，很显眼。
ch.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: 他们一般不跟你这种雇佣兵打交道。不过我可以帮你打听打听。
ch.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: 之前我从走私犯那儿弄过点零件，他们那边啥破烂都有，说不定也有能在水上漂的玩意儿。
ch.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: 一个在立交桥 Ultra 商场附近，另一个在海岸线码头北边，靠近疗养院那一带，用围栏围起来的那个。
ch.69dd3afbd5cca9c073ed4f0d: 行，那这些营地都在哪呢？
ch.69dd3afbfd27122752ac35bc: Ultra 商场附近的那个具体在哪？
ch.69eb561d4eb5f3a1b121c4ec: 那你认识的人里有谁能帮上忙吗？

cz.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: Chápu. Kdy můžu čekat, že se mi ozveš?
cz.69dd3afb0fd45597a2d0c0e2: A to bys udělal jen tak?
cz.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: Sejdi dolů od resortu směrem ke Customs, je tam velké otevřené pole. Za ním uvidíš pár hangárů s přepravními kontejnery.
cz.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: Klídek, chlape, stejně mám tím směrem cestu. Ale mohl bys udělat něco, abys zvýšil svoje šance.
cz.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: Mají pár skrýší, kde se v poslední době ukazuje až moc cizáků. Když tyhle „hosty“ vyčistíš, dám pašerákům vědět, že jsi jim pomohl ty.
cz.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: Než budeš hotový a vrátíš se, budu mít pro tebe info.
cz.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: Vyjdi z Ultra, přejdi silnici a koleje a narazíš přímo na to. Kontejnerový kemp, velký přístřešek, stany, provizorní chatrče. Je tam červená hvězda, nemůžeš to minout.
cz.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: S lidmi jako ty se obvykle nebaví. Ale můžu se poptat.
cz.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: Už dřív jsem od pašeráků bral nějaké díly, válí se jim tam všemožný harampádí. Možná budou mít i něco, co plave.
cz.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: Jeden je blízko Ultra na Interchange. Druhý je severně od přístavního terminálu, někde tam, kde je resort.
cz.69dd3afbd5cca9c073ed4f0d: Tak jo. Kde tyhle kempy jsou?
cz.69dd3afbe9d790667d78df7b: A co ten kemp u resortu?
cz.69eb561d4eb5f3a1b121c4ec: Znáš někoho, kdo by mohl pomoct?

en.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: Got it. When should I expect to hear back from you?
en.69dd3afb0fd45597a2d0c0e2: And you’d do that just like that?
en.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: Go down from the resort toward customs, there’s a big open field. Past that you’ll see a few hangars with shipping containers.
en.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: Relax man, I’ll be heading that way anyway. But you could do something to improve your chances.
en.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: They’ve got a couple of stashes where too many outsiders have been showing up lately. You clear out those “guests”, I’ll let the smugglers know it was you who helped.
en.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: By the time you’re done and back, I’ll have info for you.
en.69dd3afb7c6807b24a89784f: Can you put me in touch with them?
en.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: Head out from Ultra, cross the road and the railway, you’ll run straight into it. Container camp, big canopy, tents, makeshift shacks. There’s a red star marking it, you won’t miss it.
en.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: They don’t usually deal with your kind. But I can ask around.
en.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: Picked up some parts from smugglers before, they’ve got all kinds of junk lying around. Might have something that floats too.
en.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: One’s near Ultra at the interchange. The other’s north of the port terminal, around where the health resort is.
en.69dd3afbe9d790667d78df7b: What about the camp by the resort?
en.69dd3afbfd27122752ac35bc: How do I find the one near Ultra?
en.69eb561d4eb5f3a1b121c4ec: You know anyone who could help?

it.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: Ricevuto. Quando posso aspettarmi una tua risposta?
it.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: Scendi dal resort verso la dogana, c'è un grande campo aperto. Superato quello, vedrai alcuni hangar con dei container.
it.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: Rilassati, amico, ci andrò comunque. Ma potresti fare qualcosa per aumentare le tue possibilità.
it.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: Hanno un paio di nascondigli dove ultimamente si sono presentati troppi estranei. Tu occupati di cacciare quegli “ospiti”, io farò sapere ai contrabbandieri che sei stato tu ad aiutarli.
it.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: Quando avrà finito e sarà tornato, avrò delle informazioni per te.
it.69dd3afb7c6807b24a89784f: Puoi mettermi in contatto con loro?
it.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: Esci da Ultra, attraversa la strada e i binari, e lo troverai subito. Un accampamento di container, un grande tendone, tende, baracche di fortuna. C'è una stella rossa che lo indica, non potrai non vederlo.
it.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: Di solito non hanno a che fare con quelli come te. Ma posso chiedere in giro.
it.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: Ho già preso qualche pezzo dai contrabbandieri in passato, hanno ogni genere di cianfrusaglie in giro. Potrebbero avere anche qualcosa che galleggia.
it.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: Uno è vicino a Ultra, all'incrocio. L'altro si trova a nord del terminal portuale, nei pressi della località termale.
it.69dd3afbd5cca9c073ed4f0d: Va bene. Dove si trovano questi accampamenti?
it.69dd3afbe9d790667d78df7b: E il campo vicino al resort?
it.69dd3afbfd27122752ac35bc: Come faccio a trovare quello vicino a Ultra?

kr.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: 알았어. 그 사람들이 언제쯤 나한테 연락해 올까?
kr.69dd3afb0fd45597a2d0c0e2: 너가 그냥 바로 연락을 해 주겠다고?
kr.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: 리조트에서 내려와서 세관 쪽으로 가다 보면 넓은 공터가 있는데, 그 쪽으로 가면 화물 컨테이너로 된 격납고들이 보일 거야.
kr.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: 좀 진정해 봐. 어차피 나도 볼 일이 있어서 그 쪽으로 가야 한다고. 아마 그 쪽이 뭐라도 좀 해주면 그 사람들이 연락해 줄 확률이 높아지겠지.
kr.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: 요 최근 들어서 그 양반들이 물건을 적재해두는 곳들에 자꾸 쥐새끼들이 들락거린다 하더라고. 그래서 선생이 그 “손님들”을 좀 손 봐주면 그 양반들한테 선생이 좀 도와줬다고 언질은 해줄 수 있지.
kr.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: 선생이 다 처리하고 오면 나한테 와. 그러면 그 양반들에 대해 알려줄 테니까.
kr.69dd3afb7c6807b24a89784f: 그 사람들하고 좀 연결해 줄 수 있어?
kr.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: 울트라 몰 밖으로 나가서 도로랑 열차 선로들을 건너면 바로 있을 거야. 컨테이너 캠프인데, 거기에 커다란 천막이랑 텐트들, 그리고 가건물들이 좀 있는 곳인데, 빨간 별표를 쳐 놔서 쉽게 찾을 수 있을 거야.
kr.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: 그 양반들은 선생 같은 사람들은 고객으로 치진 않는데, 물어봐 줄순 있지.
kr.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: 요 근처에서 밀수꾼 놈들이 흘린 걸 주운 적이 있는데, 별의 별 물건들을 싸들고 다녔더라고. 물에 뜨는 배 같은 것도 있을 거 같은데.
kr.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: 하나는 인터체인지에 있는 울트라 몰 근처에, 다른 하나는 터미널 항구 북쪽에 있어, 헬스 리조트 근처야.
kr.69dd3afbd5cca9c073ed4f0d: 그래, 그러면 그 캠프들은 어디 있는데?
kr.69dd3afbe9d790667d78df7b: 헬스 리조트 근처에 있는 캠프는 어디에 있지?
kr.69dd3afbfd27122752ac35bc: 울트라 몰 근처에 있는 건 어디에 있지?

po.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: Entendido. Quando devo esperar notícias suas?
po.69dd3afb0fd45597a2d0c0e2: E você faria isso assim do nada?
po.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: Desça do resort em direção à Customs, tem um grande campo aberto. Depois disso você vai ver alguns hangares com contêineres de carga.
po.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: Relaxa cara, vou para lá de qualquer jeito. Mas você poderia fazer algo para melhorar as suas chances.
po.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: Eles têm alguns esconderijos onde têm aparecido muita gente de fora ultimamente. Você limpa esses "convidados", eu aviso os contrabandistas que foi você quem ajudou.
po.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: Quando você terminar e voltar, terei informações para você.
po.69dd3afb7c6807b24a89784f: Você pode me colocar em contato com eles?
po.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: Saindo de Ultra, cruze a estrada e a ferrovia, você vai dar direto nele. Acampamento de contêineres, toldo grande, tendas, barracos improvisados. Tem uma estrela vermelha marcando a posição, não tem como errar.
po.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: Eles geralmente não lidam com o seu tipo. Mas posso perguntar por aí.
po.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: Já peguei algumas peças dos contrabandistas antes, eles têm todo tipo de sucata por aí. Pode ter alguma coisa que flutua também.
po.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: Um fica perto de Ultra no Interchange. O outro fica ao norte do terminal portuário, perto de onde fica o resort de saúde.
po.69dd3afbe9d790667d78df7b: E o acampamento perto do resort?
po.69dd3afbfd27122752ac35bc: Como encontro o que fica perto de Ultra?
po.69eb561d4eb5f3a1b121c4ec: Você conhece alguém que poderia ajudar?

sk.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: One’s near Ultra at the interchange. The other’s north of the port terminal, around where the health resort is.
sk.69dd3afbe9d790667d78df7b: What about the camp by the resort?
sk.69dd3afbfd27122752ac35bc: How do I find the one near Ultra?
sk.69eb561d4eb5f3a1b121c4ec: You know anyone who could help?

es.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: Lo entiendo. ¿Cuándo puedo esperar tener una respuesta?
es.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: Bajas desde el Balneario hacia Customs y hay un enorme campo abierto. Pasando ese campo, verás unos hangares con contenedores de transporte.
es.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: Relaja, tío, de todos modos voy en esa dirección. Pero hay algo que podrías hacer para mejorar tus posibilidades.
es.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: Tienen un par de alijos donde últimamente han aparecido demasiados intrusos. Si te deshaces de esos “visitantes”, les diré a los contrabandistas que tú has sido quien les ayudó.
es.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: Para cuando hayas terminado y hayas regresado, tendré la información para ti.
es.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: Sales por la entrada principal del ULTRA, cruzas la carretera y las vías del tren, y te lo encontrarás justo delante. Un campamento de contenedores, con una carpa grande, tiendas de campaña y chozas improvisadas. Tiene una estrella roja pintada; lo verás enseguida.
es.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: No suelen tratar con gente como tú. Pero puedo preguntar por ahí.
es.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: Compré algunas piezas a unos contrabandistas hace un tiempo; tienen todo tipo de chatarra por ahí. Quizá tengan algo que pueda flotar.
es.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: Uno está cerca del ULTRA, en Interchange. El otro está al norte de la terminal portuaria, por donde está el Balneario.
es.69dd3afbe9d790667d78df7b: ¿Y qué hay del campamento que está junto al Balneario?
es.69dd3afbfd27122752ac35bc: ¿Cómo encuentro el que está cerca del ULTRA?

es-mx.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: Entendido. ¿Cuándo recibiré noticias de tu parte?
es-mx.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: Bajas desde el Sanatorio hacia Aduanas y hay un campo abierto enorme. Pasando ese campo, verás unos hangares con contenedores de transporte.
es-mx.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: Relájate, hombre, de todos modos voy para esos rumbos. Pero hay algo que podrías hacer para mejorar tus posibilidades.
es-mx.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: Tienen un par de alijos donde han aparecido demasiados forasteros últimamente. Si te deshaces de esos "visitantes", le diré a los contrabandistas que tú fuiste el que les ayudó.
es-mx.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: Para cuando termines y regreses, ya tendré la información para ti.
es-mx.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: Desde la entrada del ULTRA, cruzas la carretera y las vías del tren, y te lo toparás justo enfrente. Un campamento de contenedores, con una carpa grande, tiendas de campaña y chozas improvisadas. Tiene una estrella roja pintada; no tiene pierde.
es-mx.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: Normalmente, no tratan con gente como tú. Pero puedo preguntar por ahí.
es-mx.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: Hace tiempo compré algunas piezas a unos contrabandistas; tienen todo tipo de chatarra por ahí. Tal vez ellos tengan algo que pueda flotar.
es-mx.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: Uno está cerca del ULTRA, en Intercambio. El otro está al norte de la terminal portuaria, por donde está el Sanatorio.
es-mx.69dd3afbe9d790667d78df7b: ¿Y qué hay del campamento que está junto al Sanatorio?
es-mx.69dd3afbfd27122752ac35bc: ¿Cómo encuentro el que está cerca del ULTRA?

tu.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: Got it. When should I expect to hear back from you?
tu.69dd3afb0fd45597a2d0c0e2: And you’d do that just like that?
tu.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: Go down from the resort toward customs, there’s a big open field. Past that you’ll see a few hangars with shipping containers.
tu.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: Relax man, I’ll be heading that way anyway. But you could do something to improve your chances.
tu.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: They’ve got a couple of stashes where too many outsiders have been showing up lately. You clear out those “guests”, I’ll let the smugglers know it was you who helped.
tu.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: By the time you’re done and back, I’ll have info for you.
tu.69dd3afb7c6807b24a89784f: Can you put me in touch with them?
tu.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: Head out from Ultra, cross the road and the railway, you’ll run straight into it. Container camp, big canopy, tents, makeshift shacks. There’s a red star marking it, you won’t miss it.
tu.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: They don’t usually deal with your kind. But I can ask around.
tu.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: Picked up some parts from smugglers before, they’ve got all kinds of junk lying around. Might have something that floats too.
tu.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: One’s near Ultra at the interchange. The other’s north of the port terminal, around where the health resort is.
tu.69dd3afbe9d790667d78df7b: What about the camp by the resort?
tu.69dd3afbfd27122752ac35bc: How do I find the one near Ultra?
tu.69eb561d4eb5f3a1b121c4ec: You know anyone who could help?

ru.69dd3afb0b1194a960158d3b: Понятно. А когда ждать новостей от тебя?
ru.69dd3afb0fd45597a2d0c0e2: И ты сделаешь это просто так?
ru.69dd3afb461f4f2b593076fb: Если прям от санатория спускаться в сторону таможки, там будет поле здоровое, и за ним как раз несколько ангаров с морскими контейнерами.
ru.69dd3afb4a72ba3274d3c8c1: Да не парься, мне всё равно по пути будет. Но ты можешь кой-чё сделать, чтобы поднять шансы на успех.
ru.69dd3afb54ef32876fbfa4bd: У них есть 2 схрона, где сейчас много народу залётного появилось. Если постреляешь гостей, я контрабандистам передам, что это именно ты помог.
ru.69dd3afb769a2f17d748eca1: К моменту, когда ты сделаешь работу и вернёшься, инфа уже точно будет.
ru.69dd3afb7c6807b24a89784f: Ты можешь связать меня с ними?
ru.69dd3afb85d7492e8d1eedd5: Если пойдёшь от «Ультры» через дорогу и ж/дшку, уткнёшься в лагерь из контейнеров с крупным навесом, палатками и времянками. Он ещё красной звездой помечен, не потеряешься.
ru.69dd3afb938087a38e93b8bc: Обычно с вашими они дела не ведут. Но я могу поспрашивать.
ru.69dd3afba47d90d466b13cc9: Некоторые детали я брал у контрабандистов, у них же до жопы разного хлама. Может и техника есть.
ru.69dd3afbbf97b79222def82c: Один рядом с «Ультрой» на развязке, второй к северу от портового терминала, ну где санаторий стоит.
ru.69eb561d4eb5f3a1b121c4ec: Знаешь кого-то, кто смог бы с этим помочь?

ch.69ddf4af14b1ad12b7e0525c: 那你那艘船就别想了。想让我考虑帮你，先把你给我惹的麻烦解决了。
ch.69ddf4af2223103397b8c3fd: 别什么都往我身上甩，我没时间听你扯淡。
ch.69ddf4af368f47aad3f33c52: 那我想办法给你弄点弹药来。
ch.69ddf4af42b7242868a9ce02: 别他妈装傻了，你个狗操的……当初我让你帮我摆脱 Skier，你倒好，全程站他那边！现在还有脸来找我帮忙？
ch.69ddf4af4fb346d10d9128d1: 因为你，我现在出门跑车的时候连同轴机枪的备弹都找不齐了。给我带点子弹来。还有，别指望我马上就能信你。
ch.69ddf4af654b0cd95d7f9aab: 呵，现在说这种话就是放屁。因为你，我现在是麻烦缠身，几乎要撑不下去了。
ch.69ddf4af7fb5a2156137ba56: 我可以帮你弄到缺的东西，很快。
ch.69ddf4afac2b709ca20d1203: 我现在缺的是“信任”……你懂吗？Skier 那个混蛋连弹药都不肯给我补满，你知道这对我的安全有多大威胁吗？
ch.69ddf4afc9f7c31b513bb0bb: 怎么补？你还能把时间倒回去重新选一次？
ch.69ddf4afd2e9b4c095feca59: 不然怪谁？我信过你，你却坑了我。
ch.69ddf4aff6175a697e6b6cd8: 这本来就是你该做的。别以为这样我们之间的恩怨就一笔勾销了。

cz.69ddf4af14b1ad12b7e0525c: Tak na tu svoji loď zapomeň. Jestli chceš, abych o nějaké pomoci vůbec uvažoval, nejdřív vyřeš ty sračky, do kterých jsi mě dostal.
cz.69ddf4af2223103397b8c3fd: Neházej všechno na mě. Na tohle nemám čas.
cz.69ddf4af42b7242868a9ce02: Nedělej blbýho, ty sráči… Místo abys mi pomohl dostat se ze Skierova vlivu, tak jsi ho celou dobu podporoval! A teď mě jdeš prosit o pomoc?
cz.69ddf4af4fb346d10d9128d1: Kvůli tobě nemám ani dost munice na každou akci. Přines mi náboje. A pak ode mě žádnou důvěru nečekej.
cz.69ddf4af654b0cd95d7f9aab: No jasně, to je pěkná píčovina. Kvůli tobě jsem v takových sračkách, že se sotva držím nad vodou.
cz.69ddf4af7fb5a2156137ba56: Seženu ti cokoli, co ti chybí, a to rychle.
cz.69ddf4afac2b709ca20d1203: To, co mi teď chybí, je důvěra… Už ani nenosím plnou zásobu munice, chápeš to?
cz.69ddf4afbd370d6e74a279f9: Chceš říct, že je to všechno moje vina?
cz.69ddf4afc9f7c31b513bb0bb: Jak? Vrátíš čas a uděláš to pořádně?
cz.69ddf4afd2e9b4c095feca59: Kdo jinej? Věřil jsem ti a ty jsi mě podrazil.
cz.69ddf4aff6175a697e6b6cd8: To je to nejmenší, co můžeš udělat. A nemysli si, že se tím mezi náma všechno vyřeší.

en.69ddf4af14b1ad12b7e0525c: Then forget about your ship. If you want me to even think about helping, you fix the mess you got me into first.
en.69ddf4af2223103397b8c3fd: Don’t pin everything on me. I don’t have time for this.
en.69ddf4af42b7242868a9ce02: Don’t play dumb, fucko… Instead of helping me get out from under Skier, you backed him the whole way! And now you come asking me for help?
en.69ddf4af4fb346d10d9128d1: Because of you I don’t even have enough ammo for every run. Bring me rounds. And don’t expect trust after that.
en.69ddf4af654b0cd95d7f9aab: Oh yeah now that’s bullshit. Because of you I’m in such deep shit that I’m barely holding things together right now.
en.69ddf4af7fb5a2156137ba56: I can get you whatever you’re missing, fast.
en.69ddf4afac2b709ca20d1203: What I’m missing right now is trust… I don’t even carry a full ammo load anymore, you get that?
en.69ddf4afbd370d6e74a279f9: You’re saying this is all on me?
en.69ddf4afc9f7c31b513bb0bb: How? You gonna roll back time and do things right?
en.69ddf4afd2e9b4c095feca59: Who else? I trusted you, and you burned me.
en.69ddf4aff6175a697e6b6cd8: That’s the least you can do. And don’t think that fixes everything between us.

it.69ddf4af1223959680c0bfe4: Va bene… Di cosa hai bisogno?

it.69ddf4af2223103397b8c3fd: Non scaricare tutto su di me. Non ho tempo per queste cose.
it.69ddf4af42b7242868a9ce02: Non fare finta di niente, idiota… Invece di aiutarmi a liberarmi da Skier, tu l'hai sostenuto fino in fondo! E ora vieni a chiedermi aiuto?

it.69ddf4af654b0cd95d7f9aab: Oh sì, questa sì che è una stronzata. Per colpa sua mi trovo in un guaio così grande che riesco a malapena a tenere tutto insieme in questo momento.
it.69ddf4af7fb5a2156137ba56: Posso procurarti rapidamente tutto ciò che ti manca.
it.69ddf4afac2b709ca20d1203: Quello che mi manca in questo momento è la fiducia… Non porto nemmeno più con me un carico completo di munizioni, capisci?
it.69ddf4afbd370d6e74a279f9: Sta dicendo che è tutta colpa mia?
it.69ddf4afc11cd30eea5383c4: Va bene, me ne occupo io.
it.69ddf4afc9f7c31b513bb0bb: Come? Ha intenzione di tornare indietro nel tempo e sistemare le cose?
it.69ddf4afd2e9b4c095feca59: Chi altro? Mi fidavo, e mi ha tradito.
it.69ddf4aff6175a697e6b6cd8: È il minimo che possa fare. E non pensi che questo risolva tutto tra noi.

kr.69ddf4afc9f7c31b513bb0bb: 어떻게? 뭐 타임머신이라도 타고 가서 되돌려 놓게?

po.69ddf4af14b1ad12b7e0525c: Então esqueça o seu navio. Se você quer que eu sequer pense em ajudar, primeiro resolve a bagunça que me meteu.

po.69ddf4afbd370d6e74a279f9: Você está dizendo que tudo isso é culpa minha?
po.69ddf4afc9f7c31b513bb0bb: Como? Vai voltar no tempo e fazer as coisas direito?
po.69ddf4afd2e9b4c095feca59: Quem mais? Eu confiei em você, e você me traiu.
po.69ddf4aff6175a697e6b6cd8: É o mínimo que você pode fazer. E não pense que isso resolve tudo entre nós.

es.69ddf4af14b1ad12b7e0525c: Entonces, olvídate de tu barco. Si quieres que me plantee siquiera ayudarte, primero arregla el lío en el que me has metido.

es.69ddf4aff6175a697e6b6cd8: Es lo menos que puedes hacer. Y no creas que eso arreglará todo entre nosotros.

ch.69ddf6b6d174ade00cae4962: 嗨呀，咱俩谁和谁啊！你帮我摆脱 Skier 那事我还能忘了？要不是你，我现在还在给他卖命呢！
ch.69ddf6b6d2592d93ad255d6c: 你自己去的话，他们连话都不会跟你说。不过我可以帮你问。
ch.69ddf6b6dad403de95b3e481: 行吧……那我什么时候能有消息？
ch.69ddf6b7f7d1c98354acd84a: 我本来就打算一会去见一趟这些走私的。下次见面的时候，我就能给你答复。怎么样？

cz.69ddf6b61aba60e37aa78d60: Ale stejně, v Tarkově nikdo nic nedělá zadarmo.
cz.69ddf6b62131d47fc4a73abb: No, možná víš, kdo by mohl pomoct?
cz.69ddf6b638cc542ca5940bdc: Perfektní. Co ode mě potřebuješ? Zaplatit? Udělat pro ně nějakou práci?
cz.69ddf6b66c753876b104e98c: Vlastně... jo. Pašeráci. Válí se jim tam stará výbava, mohli by mít loď.
cz.69ddf6b671d09a0079fb1979: Tohle není zadarmo. Tenkrát jsi mi hodně pomohl, tak teď pomáhám já tobě.
cz.69ddf6b6d174ade00cae4962: Ale prosím tě, příteli! Myslíš, že jsem zapomněl, jak jsi mě vysekal od Skiera? Bez tebe bych pro něj doteď otročil!
cz.69ddf6b6d2592d93ad255d6c: Kdybys tam šel na vlastní pěst, vůbec by se s tebou nebavili, to je jistý. Ale můžu se za tebe poptat.
cz.69ddf6b6dad403de95b3e481: Tak jo... Kdy od tebe můžu čekat zprávy?
cz.69ddf6b7f7d1c98354acd84a: Vlastně jsem tam měl v plánu zrovna vyrazit, takže až se příště uvidíme, budu mít odpověď. Platí?

en.69ddf6b6d174ade00cae4962: Oh come on, friend! You think I forgot how you got me out from under Skier? I’d still be slaving for him without you!
en.69ddf6b6d2592d93ad255d6c: If you go on your own, they won’t even talk to you, that’s for sure. But I can ask for you.
en.69ddf6b6dad403de95b3e481: Alright… When can I expect news from you?
en.69ddf6b7f7d1c98354acd84a: I was planning on heading over there right now actually, so next time we meet, I’ll have an answer. Sound good?

it.69ddf6b62131d47fc4a73abb: Beh, forse conosci qualcuno che potrebbe aiutarla?

cz.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira o tom ví, má prej nějakýho informátora. Zajdi za ní, třeba tě nasměruje.
cz.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Jako by ty parchanti věděli všechno dopředu!
cz.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: Našel jsem tu flashku. (Předat flashku z SUV)
cz.68de966fabf01da331905c63: Ty a já, zelenáči, jsme si v jednom podobní: já se to taky rozhodl zjistit. Můžeme si navzájem pomoct.
cz.68de96c038d4f28ecbb213a3: Ber to jako gesto dobré vůle. Naše zájmy se překrývají, takže tě do toho beru. Ne abys zpychnul, nebo si to rozmyslím.
cz.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: Kde jsem to skončil…? Jo, jasně. Toho šéfa s flashkou sejmuli.
cz.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: Aha, tys na něj narazil, jo? Už je to tam nějakej čas, ale nikdo toho moc neví!
cz.68f3e261059b6b44a50fc091: Ty a já, zelenáči, jsme si v jednom podobní: já se to taky rozhodl zjistit.
cz.68f3e28d379920eb69fc0563: Mohli bychom si navzájem pomoct, ale sotva tě znám. Tahle práce je trochu moc důležitá, než abych ji jen tak dal náhodnýmu žoldákovi.
cz.68f3e29ec08673d7d0a022b0: Dokaž mi, že za něco stojíš, a pak se můžeme bavit o tom letadle.
cz.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: Už spolu nějakej čas pracujeme. Takže si pojďme promluvit o tom zříceným letadle.
cz.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: Aha, ty si vzpomínáš! No, ukazál jsi, co umíš. Teď můžeme začít na týhle věci pracovat.

en.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
en.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: I found out that the first ones to leave the city were big shots from TerraGroup.
en.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: One or two people leaving could be a coincidence, but this was a massive crowd all at once.
en.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: The TerraGroup people always rode around in black G-Wagons, and that’s how they were trying to leave the city.
en.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: So I’ve got a tip that one of them was carrying a very important thumb drive with him.
en.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: And what does that have to do with the plane?
en.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: Rumor has it, the thumb drive has info about that plane. Something very important.
en.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: I smell one hell of a secret here! Where there’s secrets, there’s big money.
en.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Think about it — how much would journalists pay for a scoop like that? Or TerraGroup, just to protect their little secrets…
en.682f27b65490346ee00379d3: Which car? I’ll go take it.
en.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: I like your eagerness, soldier, but I can’t say exactly where the car is.
en.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira knows about this, she’s got some informant, apparently. Go to her, maybe she can point you in the right direction.
en.682f27b65490346ee00379d8: Alright. Tell me what you know.
en.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Like those bastards knew everything beforehand!
en.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: I found the flash drive. (Hand over the SUV flash drive)
en.68de966fabf01da331905c63: You and I, rookie, we’re alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too. We can help each other.
en.68de96b72afa88ca16b424d3: Just like that? Why so generous?
en.68de96c038d4f28ecbb213a3: Consider it a gesture of goodwill. Our interests overlap, so I’m taking you in on this. Don’t get cocky, or I’ll change my mind.
en.68de96d9f0596c272c70bb1e: Alright, so! I’ve got a lead.
en.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: Where was I…? Oh, right. That big shot with the flash drive got taken out.
en.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: Ah, you ran into it, huh? It’s been there a while, but nobody really knows much!
en.68f3e261059b6b44a50fc091: You and I, rookie, we’re alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too.
en.68f3e28d379920eb69fc0563: We could help each other, but I barely know you. This job's a bit too important to just give it to random mercs.
en.68f3e29ec08673d7d0a022b0: Prove yourself to me, and then we can talk about the plane.
en.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: We've worked together for a while now. So let's talk about the crashed plane.
en.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: Oh, you remember! Well, you've proven yourself. Now we can start working on this thing.
en.68f3f3834639551159543d74: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
en.68f3f4d8bdb3df68c0467dd3: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
en.68f3f4dbd8c7f6f8de1a877a: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
en.68f3f4dca8f896b6c8bfcf87: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
en.68f3f4dd3a1fb4b52095f40b: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
en.68fd692b19e31c7b99779556: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
en.6900adb6c574434b05594306: I don’t know if the Scavs shot him, or the military intercepted him, or someone else… In any case, looks like the guy left the flash drive in his car.

fr.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: Savez-vous quelque chose à propos de l’avion qui s’est écrasé dans la forêt ?
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: J’ai découvert que les premiers à quitter la ville étaient des gros bonnets de TerraGroup.
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: Une ou deux personnes qui partent, ça pourrait être une coïncidence, mais là, c’était une évacuation massive et simultanée.
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: Les gens de TerraGroup roulaient toujours en G-Wagon noirs, et c’est comme ça qu’ils ont tenté de quitter la ville.
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: J’ai donc reçu un tuyau selon lequel l’un d’eux transportait avec lui une clé USB très importante.
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: Et quel est le rapport avec l’avion ?
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: La rumeur dit que cette clé USB contient des informations sur cet avion. Quelque chose de vraiment important.
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: Je sens qu’il y a un sacré secret là-dessous. Et là où il y a des secrets, il y a beaucoup d’argent.
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Réfléchis : combien les journalistes paieraient pour un scoop pareil ? Ou TerraGroup, juste pour protéger leurs petits secrets…
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379d3: Quelle voiture ? Je vais aller la chercher.
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: J’aime ton ambition, soldat, mais je ne peux pas dire exactement où se trouve le véhicule.
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira est au courant. Apparemment, elle a un informateur. Va la voir, peut-être qu’elle pourra t’orienter.
fr.682f27b65490346ee00379d8: D’accord. Dites-moi ce que vous savez.
fr.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Comme si ces bâtards savaient tout à l’avance…
fr.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: J’ai trouvé la clé USB. (Donner la clé USB du SUV)
fr.68de966fabf01da331905c63: Toi et moi, le bleu, on a un point commun : moi aussi, je veux comprendre ce qui se passe. On peut s’entraider.
fr.68de96b72afa88ca16b424d3: Comme ça, gratuitement ? Pourquoi tant de générosité ?
fr.68de96c038d4f28ecbb213a3: Considère ça comme un geste de bonne volonté. Nos intérêts se recoupent, alors je t’inclus dans l’affaire. Ne prends pas la grosse tête, ou je changerai d’avis.
fr.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: Où en étais-je… Ah oui. Le gros bonnet avec la clé USB s’est fait descendre.
fr.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: Ah, tu es tombé dessus ? Ça fait un moment qu’elle est là, mais personne ne sait vraiment ce qui s’est passé.
fr.68f3e261059b6b44a50fc091: Toi et moi, la bleusaille, on se ressemble sur un point : moi aussi, j’ai décidé d’éclaircir cette histoire.
fr.68f3e28d379920eb69fc0563: On pourrait s’entraider, mais je te connais à peine. Ce boulot est un peu trop important pour le confier à n’importe quel mercenaire.
fr.68f3e29ec08673d7d0a022b0: Prouve-moi ce que tu vaux, et ensuite on parlera de l’avion.
fr.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: On bosse ensemble depuis un moment maintenant. Alors parlons de l’avion écrasé.
fr.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: Ah, tu t’en souviens ! Très bien, tu as fait tes preuves. On peut commencer à travailler sérieusement là-dessus.
fr.68f3f3834639551159543d74: Savez-vous quelque chose à propos de l’avion qui s’est écrasé dans la forêt ?
fr.68f3f4d8bdb3df68c0467dd3: Savez-vous quelque chose à propos de l’avion qui s’est écrasé dans la forêt ?
fr.68f3f4dbd8c7f6f8de1a877a: Savez-vous quelque chose à propos de l’avion qui s’est écrasé dans la forêt ?
fr.68f3f4dca8f896b6c8bfcf87: Savez-vous quelque chose à propos de l’avion qui s’est écrasé dans la forêt ?
fr.68f3f4dd3a1fb4b52095f40b: Savez-vous quelque chose à propos de l’avion qui s’est écrasé dans la forêt ?
fr.68fd692b19e31c7b99779556: Savez-vous quelque chose à propos de l’avion qui s’est écrasé dans la forêt ?
fr.6900adb6c574434b05594306: Je ne sais pas si ce sont les scavs qui l’ont abattu, si l’armée l’a intercepté, ou quelqu’un d’autre… Quoi qu’il en soit, on dirait bien que le type a laissé la clé USB dans sa voiture.

it.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: Sai qualcosa dell'aereo che è precipitato nella foresta?
it.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: Ho scoperto che i primi a lasciare la città sono stati i pezzi grossi della TerraGroup.
it.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: Una o due persone che se ne vanno potrebbero essere una coincidenza, ma questa era una folla enorme tutta insieme.
it.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: I membri della TerraGroup viaggiavano sempre su G-Wagon nere, ed era proprio così che stavano cercando di lasciare la città.
it.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: Ho saputo che uno di loro aveva con sé una chiavetta USB molto importante.
it.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: E questo cosa c'entra con l'aereo?
it.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: Si dice che la chiavetta USB contenga informazioni su quell'aereo. Qualcosa di molto importante.
it.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: Sento che qui c'è un segreto incredibile! Dove ci sono segreti, ci sono anche un sacco di soldi.
it.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Pensaci: quanto pagherebbero i giornalisti per uno scoop del genere? O TerraGroup, solo per proteggere i loro piccoli segreti...
it.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: Mi piace il tuo entusiasmo, soldato, ma non posso dirti esattamente dove si trova l'auto.
it.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira ne è a conoscenza, a quanto pare ha qualche informatore. Vai da lei, forse potrà indicarti la direzione giusta.
it.682f27b65490346ee00379d8: Va bene. Dimmi quello che sai.
it.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Come se quei bastardi sapessero già tutto in anticipo!
it.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: Ho trovato la chiavetta USB. (Consegna la chiavetta USB del SUV)
it.68de966fabf01da331905c63: Tu ed io, novellino, abbiamo una cosa in comune: anch'io ho deciso di capirci qualcosa. Possiamo aiutarci a vicenda.
it.68de96c038d4f28ecbb213a3: Consideralo un gesto di buona volontà. I nostri interessi coincidono, quindi ti coinvolgerò in questa faccenda. Non montarti la testa, o cambierò idea.
it.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: Dove ero rimasto...? Ah, sì. Quel pezzo grosso con la chiavetta USB è stato eliminato.
it.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: Ah, l'hai trovato, eh? È lì da un po', ma nessuno sa molto al riguardo!
it.68f3e261059b6b44a50fc091: Tu ed io, novellino, abbiamo una cosa in comune: anch'io ho deciso di capirlo.
it.68f3e28d379920eb69fc0563: Potremmo aiutarci a vicenda, ma ti conosco appena. Questo lavoro è troppo importante per affidarlo a mercenari a caso.
it.68f3e29ec08673d7d0a022b0: Dimostrami chi sei, poi potremo parlare dell'aereo.
it.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: Lavoriamo insieme già da un po'. Parliamo dell'aereo precipitato.
it.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: Oh, te lo ricordi! Beh, hai dato prova di te stesso. Ora possiamo iniziare a lavorare su questa cosa.
it.68f3f3834639551159543d74: Sai qualcosa dell'aereo che è precipitato nella foresta?

jp.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: その飛行機が森の中で墜落した件について、なにか知ってるか？
jp.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: 最初に街から逃げたのは TerraGroup の重役って話だ。
jp.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: 一人二人ってなら偶然かもしれないが、一斉にだ。怪しすぎるだろ。
jp.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: 連中はいつも黒いGワゴンで移動してた。その車で街を抜けようとしてたらしい。
jp.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: 奴らの一人が重要な USBメモリを持ってたという情報を掴んだ。
jp.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: それと飛行機がどう関係するんだ？

jp.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: 俺たちはもう十分長く組んでる。飛行機の話をしてやろう。
jp.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: おお、覚えてたのかお前は信頼に値する。早速取り掛かろうじゃないか。

pl.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: I found out that the first ones to leave the city were big shots from TerraGroup.
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: One or two people leaving could be a coincidence, but this was a massive crowd all at once.
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: The TerraGroup people always rode around in black G-Wagons, and that’s how they were trying to leave the city.
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: So I’ve got a tip that one of them was carrying a very important thumb drive with him.
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: And what does that have to do with the plane?
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: Rumor has it, the thumb drive has info about that plane. Something very important.
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: I smell one hell of a secret here! Where there’s secrets, there’s big money.
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Think about it — how much would journalists pay for a scoop like that? Or TerraGroup, just to protect their little secrets…
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379d3: Which car? I’ll go take it.
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: I like your eagerness, soldier, but I can’t say exactly where the car is.
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira knows about this, she’s got some informant, apparently. Go to her, maybe she can point you in the right direction.
pl.682f27b65490346ee00379d8: Alright. Tell me what you know.
pl.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Like those bastards knew everything beforehand!
pl.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: I found the flash drive. (Hand over the SUV flash drive)
pl.68de966fabf01da331905c63: You and I, rookie, we’re alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too. We can help each other.
pl.68de96b72afa88ca16b424d3: Just like that? Why so generous?
pl.68de96c038d4f28ecbb213a3: Consider it a gesture of goodwill. Our interests overlap, so I’m taking you in on this. Don’t get cocky, or I’ll change my mind.
pl.68de96d9f0596c272c70bb1e: Alright, so! I’ve got a lead.
pl.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: Where was I…? Oh, right. That big shot with the flash drive got taken out.
pl.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: Ah, you ran into it, huh? It’s been there a while, but nobody really knows much!
pl.68f3e261059b6b44a50fc091: You and I, rookie, we’re alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too.
pl.68f3e28d379920eb69fc0563: We could help each other, but I barely know you. This job's a bit too important to just give it to random mercs.
pl.68f3e29ec08673d7d0a022b0: Prove yourself to me, and then we can talk about the plane.
pl.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: We've worked together for a while now. So let's talk about the crashed plane.
pl.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: Oh, you remember! Well, you've proven yourself. Now we can start working on this thing.

po.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: Eu descobri que os primeiros a abandonar a cidade foram os figurões da TerraGroup.

po.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: Diz a lenda que o pen drive tem informações sobre aquele avião. Algo muito importante.
po.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: Eu sinto cheiro de um baita segredo aqui! E onde tem segredo, tem muita grana.
po.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Pensa comigo: Quanto os jornalistas pagariam por uma reportagem dessas? Ou a TerraGroup, só para proteger seus segredinhos…

po.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: Eu gosto da sua disposição, soldado, mas eu não consigo dizer exatamente aonde o carro está.

po.682f27b65490346ee00379d8: Muito bem. Diga-me o que você sabe.
po.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Como se aqueles desgraçados soubessem tudo de antemão!

po.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: Onde eu estava...? Ah, certo. Aquele figurão com o pen drive foi eliminado.
po.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: Há, você esbarrou nisso, hã? Está aí já faz um tempo, mas ninguém sabe muita coisa sobre isso!

es.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: ¿Sabes algo sobre el avión que se ha estrellado en el bosque?
es.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: Descubrí que los primeros en abandonar la ciudad fueron los directivos de TerraGroup.
es.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: Que se marcharan uno o dos podría ser una coincidencia, pero esto era una enorme multitud de golpe.
es.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: La gente de TerraGroup siempre se desplazaba en todoterrenos G-Wagons de color negro, y así era como intentaban salir de la ciudad.
es.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: Tengo información de que uno de ellos traía encima una memoria USB muy importante.
es.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: ¿Y eso qué tiene que ver con el avión?
es.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: Corren rumores de que la memoria USB contiene información sobre ese avión. Algo muy importante.
es.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: ¡Me huele a que hay un secreto del copón! Y donde hay secretos, hay mucho dinero.
es.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Piénsalo. ¿Cuánto pagarían los periodistas por una exclusiva como esa? O TerraGroup, solo para proteger sus pequeños secretos…
es.682f27b65490346ee00379d3: ¿Qué coche era? Iré a por ella.
es.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: Me gusta tu entusiasmo, soldado, pero no sabría decirte exactamente dónde está ese coche.
es.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira sabe algo al respecto; parece que tiene un informante. Ve con ella, tal vez pueda indicarte el camino correcto.
es.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: ¡Es como si esos bastardos lo supieran todo de antemano!
es.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: He encontrado la memoria USB. (Entrega la memoria USB del SUV todoterreno)
es.68de966fabf01da331905c63: Novato, tú y yo nos parecemos en una cosa: también me he decidido a llegar al fondo de todo esto. Podemos ayudarnos mutuamente.
es.68de96b72afa88ca16b424d3: ¿Así nada más? ¿A qué se debe tanta generosidad?
es.68de96c038d4f28ecbb213a3: Considéralo un gesto de buena voluntad. Nuestros intereses coinciden, así que te incluiré en este asunto. No te pases de listo, o cambiaré de opinión.
es.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: ¿por dónde iba…? Ah, sí. Ese pez gordo de la memoria USB fue eliminado.
es.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: Ah, ¿te has topado con eso, eh? ¡Lleva ahí ya un tiempo, pero la verdad es que nadie sabe mucho al respecto!
es.68f3e261059b6b44a50fc091: Novato, tú y yo nos parecemos en una cosa: también me he decidido a llegar al fondo de todo esto.
es.68f3e28d379920eb69fc0563: Podemos ayudarnos mutuamente, pero apenas te conozco. Este trabajo es demasiado importante como para dárselo a un mercenario cualquiera.
es.68f3e29ec08673d7d0a022b0: Demuéstrame lo que vales y luego hablaremos del avión.
es.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: Ya llevamos un tiempo trabajando juntos. Así que hablemos del avión estrellado.
es.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: ¡Ah, lo recuerdas! Bueno, ya has demostrado lo que vales. Ahora podemos empezar a trabajar en este asunto.

es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: ¿Sabes algo sobre ese avión que se estrelló en el bosque?
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: Descubrí que los primeros en abandonar la ciudad fueron los altos directivos de TerraGroup.
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: Que se fueran uno o dos podría ser una coincidencia, pero esto era toda una multitud de golpe.
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: La gente de TerraGroup siempre se desplazaba en camionetas G-Wagons de color negro, y así era como intentaban salir de la ciudad.
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: Tengo información de que uno de ellos llevaba una memoria USB muy importante.
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: ¿Y eso qué tiene que ver con el avión?
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: Se rumorea que la memoria USB contiene información sobre ese avión. Algo muy importante.
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: ¡Me huele a que hay un secreto tremendo! Y donde hay secretos, hay mucho dinero.
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Piénsalo. ¿Cuánto pagarían los periodistas por una exclusiva como esa? O TerraGroup, solo para proteger sus pequeños secretos…
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: Me gusta tu entusiasmo, soldado, pero no sabría decirte exactamente dónde está el auto.
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira sabe algo al respecto; al parecer tiene un informante. Ve con ella, tal vez pueda indicarte el camino correcto.
es-mx.682f27b65490346ee00379d8: Muy bien. Cuéntame lo que sabes.
es-mx.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: ¡Es como si esos bastardos lo supieran todo antes de tiempo!

tu.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: Ormanda düşen o uçak hakkında bir şey biliyor musun?
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: Şunu öğrendim: Şehirden ilk kaçanlar TerraGroup’un üst düzey adamlarıymış.
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: Bir iki kişi ayrılır, tesadüf dersin; ama bu sefer büyük bir kalabalık aynı anda çıkmış.
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: TerraGroup’un adamları hep siyah G-Serisi araçlarla gezerdi, şehirden kaçmaya çalışırken de öyleymişler.
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: Ve bana gelen bilgiye göre onlardan biri çok önemli bir USB belleği yanında taşıyormuş.
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: Peki bunun uçakla ne ilgisi var?
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: Söylentiye göre USB bellekte o uçakla ilgili bilgiler varmış. Hem de çok önemli şeyler.
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: Burada büyük bir sır kokusu alıyorum! Sır varsa büyük para da vardır.
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Düşünsene — gazeteciler böyle bir habere ne kadar para verir? Ya da TerraGroup… küçük sırlarını korumak için kaç para öder?
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: Hevesini seviyorum asker, ama arabanın tam olarak nerede olduğunu söyleyemem.
tu.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira bu işi biliyor, görünüşe göre bir muhbiri var. Ona git, belki seni doğru yöne yönlendirebilir.
tu.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Sanki o piçler her şeyi önceden biliyordu!
tu.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: USB belleği buldum. (SUV USB belleğini teslim et)
tu.68de966fabf01da331905c63: Seninle benim, acemi, benzer olduğumuz bir şey var: Ben de bu işi çözmeye karar verdim. Birbirimize yardım edebiliriz.
tu.68de96b72afa88ca16b424d3: Bu kadar mı? Neden bu kadar cömertsin?
tu.68de96c038d4f28ecbb213a3: Bunu bir iyi niyet göstergesi olarak düşün. Çıkarlarımız örtüşüyor, o yüzden seni bu işe dahil ediyorum. Ama şımarma, fikrimi değiştiririm.
tu.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: Neredeydim…? Ha evet. USB belleği taşıyan o üst düzey adam öldürülmüş.
tu.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: Ha, sen de mi denk geldin? Bir süredir orada duruyor, ama kimse pek bir şey bilmiyor!
tu.68f3e261059b6b44a50fc091: Seninle benim, acemi, benzer olduğumuz bir şey var: Ben de bu işi çözmeye karar verdim.
tu.68f3e28d379920eb69fc0563: Birbirimize yardım edebiliriz ama seni pek tanımıyorum. Bu iş rastgele paralı askerlere verilecek kadar önemsiz değil.
tu.68f3e29ec08673d7d0a022b0: Kendini kanıtla, sonra uçak hakkında konuşuruz.
tu.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: Bir süredir birlikte çalışıyoruz. O zaman düşen uçak hakkında konuşalım.
tu.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: Aaa, hatırlıyorsun demek! Kendini kanıtladın. Şimdi bu işe başlayabiliriz.

ru.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: Ты что-то знаешь об упавшем в лесу самолёте?
ru.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: Я узнал, что самыми первыми из города начали валить шишки из TerraGroup.
ru.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: И ладно один там свинтил или два, можно было бы списать на совпадение, но это было массово.
ru.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: Террагруповцы всегда гоняли на черных геликах, на них же и сваливали из города.
ru.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: По наводке один из них вез с собой особо важную флешку.
ru.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: А там, по слухам, инфа по самолётику этому. Что-то очень важное.
ru.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: Нюхом чую здесь охереть какую тайну! А там, где тайны – большие деньги.
ru.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Прикинь сколько бабла заплатят журналюги за какую-нибудь сенсацию? Или TerraGroup, лишь бы свои секретики сохранить…
ru.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: Мне нравится твоё рвение, боец, но точно сказать, где стоит тачка, я не могу.
ru.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Эльвира в курсе этого дельца, у неё какой-то информатор есть. Сходи к ней, может подскажет направление.
ru.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Будто эти черти всё заранее знали, ёлки-палки!
ru.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: Я нашёл флешку. (Передать флешку из внедорожника)
ru.68de966fabf01da331905c63: Мы с тобой, салага, похожи в чём-то: я тоже решил в этом деле разобраться. Мы можем помочь друг другу.
ru.68de96b72afa88ca16b424d3: Просто так? С чего такая щедрость?
ru.68de96c038d4f28ecbb213a3: Считай, по доброте душевной решил взять тебя в долю, раз уж интересы пересекаются. Сильно не выёбывайся, а то передумаю.
ru.68de96d9f0596c272c70bb1e: Так вот! Есть у меня одна ниточка.
ru.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: Так, на чём я остановился?.. А, точно. Шишку этого с флешкой приняли.
ru.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: А-а, наткнулся на него, да? Столько уже лежит, но никто ничего толком и не знает!
ru.68f3e261059b6b44a50fc091: Мы с тобой, салага, похожи в чём-то: я тоже решил в этом деле разобраться.
ru.68f3e28d379920eb69fc0563: Мы и могли бы помочь друг другу, но я тебя едва знаю. А дело кажется слишком серьёзным, чтобы с кем попало работать.
ru.68f3e29ec08673d7d0a022b0: Вот проявишь себя, тогда и приходи, поболтаем про самолёт.
ru.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: Мы с тобой уже поработали достаточно. Так что там про самолёт?
ru.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: А, помнишь! Ну да, ты показал себя. Теперь и над таким дельцем можем поработать.

ro.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: I found out that the first ones to leave the city were big shots from TerraGroup.
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: One or two people leaving could be a coincidence, but this was a massive crowd all at once.
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: The TerraGroup people always rode around in black G-Wagons, and that’s how they were trying to leave the city.
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: So I’ve got a tip that one of them was carrying a very important thumb drive with him.
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: And what does that have to do with the plane?
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: Rumor has it, the thumb drive has info about that plane. Something very important.
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: I smell one hell of a secret here! Where there’s secrets, there’s big money.
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Think about it — how much would journalists pay for a scoop like that? Or TerraGroup, just to protect their little secrets…
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379d3: Which car? I’ll go take it.
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: I like your eagerness, soldier, but I can’t say exactly where the car is.
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira knows about this, she’s got some informant, apparently. Go to her, maybe she can point you in the right direction.
ro.682f27b65490346ee00379d8: Alright. Tell me what you know.
ro.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Like those bastards knew everything beforehand!
ro.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: I found the flash drive. (Hand over the SUV flash drive)
ro.68de966fabf01da331905c63: You and I, rookie, we’re alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too. We can help each other.
ro.68de96b72afa88ca16b424d3: Just like that? Why so generous?
ro.68de96c038d4f28ecbb213a3: Consider it a gesture of goodwill. Our interests overlap, so I’m taking you in on this. Don’t get cocky, or I’ll change my mind.
ro.68de96d9f0596c272c70bb1e: Alright, so! I’ve got a lead.
ro.68de97cec7dd2f8f0e7e94b4: Where was I…? Oh, right. That big shot with the flash drive got taken out.
ro.68f3e106c769c151d5d2b8d3: Ah, you ran into it, huh? It’s been there a while, but nobody really knows much!
ro.68f3e261059b6b44a50fc091: You and I, rookie, we’re alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too.
ro.68f3e28d379920eb69fc0563: We could help each other, but I barely know you. This job's a bit too important to just give it to random mercs.
ro.68f3e29ec08673d7d0a022b0: Prove yourself to me, and then we can talk about the plane.
ro.68f3e3978ad598fddccd1d92: We've worked together for a while now. So let's talk about the crashed plane.
ro.68f3e3b743d3826c741fd66c: Oh, you remember! Well, you've proven yourself. Now we can start working on this thing.
ro.68f3f3834639551159543d74: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?

ro.68f3f4dbd8c7f6f8de1a877a: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?

ro.6900adb6c574434b05594306: I don’t know if the Scavs shot him, or the military intercepted him, or someone else… In any case, looks like the guy left the flash drive in his car.

in.682f27b65490346ee00379c4: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?
in.682f27b65490346ee00379c8: I found out that the first ones to leave the city were big shots from TerraGroup.
in.682f27b65490346ee00379c9: One or two people leaving could be a coincidence, but this was a massive crowd all at once.
in.682f27b65490346ee00379ca: The TerraGroup people always rode around in black G-Wagons, and that’s how they were trying to leave the city.
in.682f27b65490346ee00379cb: So I’ve got a tip that one of them was carrying a very important thumb drive with him.
in.682f27b65490346ee00379cc: And what does that have to do with the plane?
in.682f27b65490346ee00379cd: Rumor has it, the thumb drive has info about that plane. Something very important.
in.682f27b65490346ee00379ce: I smell one hell of a secret here! Where there’s secrets, there’s big money.
in.682f27b65490346ee00379d2: Think about it — how much would journalists pay for a scoop like that? Or TerraGroup, just to protect their little secrets…
in.682f27b65490346ee00379d3: Which car? I’ll go take it.
in.682f27b65490346ee00379d4: I like your eagerness, soldier, but I can’t say exactly where the car is.
in.682f27b65490346ee00379d5: Elvira knows about this, she’s got some informant, apparently. Go to her, maybe she can point you in the right direction.
in.682f27b65490346ee00379d8: Alright. Tell me what you know.
in.68ae291bd0f98c1807bb7766: Like those bastards knew everything beforehand!
in.68b567b0a57cb8cfed6bebfa: I found the flash drive. (Hand over the SUV flash drive)
in.68de966fabf01da331905c63: You and I, rookie, we’re alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too. We can help each other.
in.68de96b72afa88ca16b424d3: Just like that? Why so generous?

ch.68b6e8f935046a9ef0925124: 我会把钱转给他。一有消息，我就联系你。
ch.68b83abb105bf77b617bb209: 那个人一向用美元交换情报。你把钱给我，我来转交。
ch.68b83abb7a883e465b3ae058: 我想问一下关于那辆越野车的事情。
ch.68b83abb95b542cc5cf1067a: 那凑够钱再回来找我。如果你真的想知道车的位置的话。
ch.68b83abb9a1247525e09fce8: 我身上没有钱。（去筹集 2000 美元）
ch.68b83abb9afeb71430883f9a: 你想得没错。这世界上的一切都要付出代价。
ch.68b83abbb6aba85818bf7399: 没错——没错，我知道情况了。你在找一辆黑色越野车。这种车通常是 TerraGroup 的高层在用。
ch.68b83abbd595477c12e2b089: 和你做生意很愉快，年轻人。我会把钱转给线人。过一阵子再来。
ch.68b83abbfa537e5341a46d71: 只能通过我。在这种时候，线人可不是随便能接触到的。
ch.68fd72c24a87c4f020f8d790: 我认识一个能帮你的家伙。他知道那个人和那辆车最后出现的位置。

cz.68b6e8da51a4e9297cd31641: Podařilo se ti sehnat ty prachy? Výborně.
cz.68b6e8f935046a9ef0925124: Předám mu to. Jakmile budu mít zprávy, ozvu se ti.
cz.68b83abb105bf77b617bb209: Ten člověk vždycky chce za informace dolary. Ty mi dáš prachy a já mu je předám.
cz.68b83abb2af3142e3f5287a2: Bylo mi řečeno, abych tě navštívil…
cz.68b83abb95b542cc5cf1067a: Tak ho najdi a vrať se ke mně. Pokud chceš opravdu znát polohu toho vozidla, samozřejmě.
cz.68b83abb9a1247525e09fce8: Nemám u sebe ty prachy. (Sehnat 2 000 USD)
cz.68b83abb9afeb71430883f9a: Uvažuješ správným směrem. Všechno v našem světě má svou cenu.
cz.68b83abb9ea053d7abb5ac6e: Pavel Jegorovič mi řekl, že přijdeš.
cz.68b83abbb6aba85818bf7399: Ano-ano, byl jsem informován. Hledáš černý SUV. Takový vozidla používal vysoce postavený personál TerraGroup.
cz.68b83abbd595477c12e2b089: Je mi potěšením s tebou obchodovat, mladý muži. Předám platbu informátorovi. Vrať se o něco později.
cz.68b83abbfa537e5341a46d71: Pouze přes mě. V týhle době se informátoři nerozdávaj na potkání.
cz.68fd72c24a87c4f020f8d790: Znám někoho, kdo ti může pomoct. Ví, kde byl ten člověk a jeho vozidlo naposledy viděn.

en.68b6e8da51a4e9297cd31641: Were you able to gather the funds? Excellent.
en.68b6e8f935046a9ef0925124: I will forward it to him. As soon as I have news, I will contact you.
en.68b83abb105bf77b617bb209: This person always asks for dollars in exchange for information. You give me the cash, and I will pass it to him.
en.68b83abb2af3142e3f5287a2: I’ve been told to visit you…
en.68b83abb95b542cc5cf1067a: Then find it and return to me. If you truly wish to know the location of the vehicle, of course.
en.68b83abb9a1247525e09fce8: I don’t have the cash on me. (Gather 2,000 USD)
en.68b83abb9afeb71430883f9a: You are thinking in the right direction. Everything in our world comes at a price.
en.68b83abb9ea053d7abb5ac6e: Pavel Yegorovich told me that you would come.
en.68b83abbb6aba85818bf7399: Yes-yes, I have been briefed. You are looking for a black SUV. Such vehicles were used by high-ranking TerraGroup personnel.
en.68b83abbd595477c12e2b089: It is a pleasure to do business with you, young man. I will forward the payment to the informant. Return a little later.
en.68b83abbfa537e5341a46d71: Only through me. In these times, informants are not handed out lightly.
en.68fd72c24a87c4f020f8d790: I know someone who can assist you. He knows where the person and his vehicle were last seen.

fr.68b83abb2af3142e3f5287a2: On m’a dit de vous rendre visite.
fr.68b83abb447800890cc54a7b: Je suis là à propos de la tâche.
fr.68b83abb7a883e465b3ae058: Je suis là à propos du SUV.
fr.68b83abb95b542cc5cf1067a: Alors trouve-le et reviens me voir. Si tu veux vraiment connaître l’emplacement du véhicule, bien sûr.
fr.68b83abb96d0c718592f8871: Comment est-ce que je rentre en contact avec lui ?
fr.68b83abb9a1247525e09fce8: Je n’ai pas l’argent sur moi. (Récolter 2 000 Dollars)
fr.68b83abb9afeb71430883f9a: Tu réfléchis de la bonne manière. Tout, dans notre monde, a un prix.
fr.68b83abb9ea053d7abb5ac6e: Pavel Yegorovich m’a dit que tu viendrai.
fr.68b83abbb6aba85818bf7399: Oui oui, c’est ce qu’on m’a dit. Tu cherches un SUV noir. C’est le genre de véhicule qu’utilisaient les gens bien placés de TerraGroup.
fr.68b83abbd595477c12e2b089: C’est un plaisir de faire affaire avec toi, jeune homme. Je transmettrai le paiement à l’informateur. Reviens un peu plus tard.
fr.68b83abbfa537e5341a46d71: Uniquement par mon intermédiaire. De nos jours, on ne livre pas des informateurs comme ça.
fr.68fd72c24a87c4f020f8d790: Je connais quelqu’un qui peut t’aider. Il sait où cette personne et son véhicule ont été vus pour la dernière fois.

it.68b6e8da51a4e9297cd31641: Sei riuscito a raccogliere i fondi? Ottimo.
it.68b6e8f935046a9ef0925124: Glielo inoltrerò. Non appena avrò notizie, ti contatterò.
it.68b83abb105bf77b617bb209: Questa persona chiede sempre dollari in cambio di informazioni. Tu mi dai i soldi e io glieli passerò.
it.68b83abb2af3142e3f5287a2: Mi è stato detto di venire a trovarti...
it.68b83abb95b542cc5cf1067a: Poi trovalo e riportamelo. Se davvero desideri conoscere la posizione del veicolo, ovviamente.
it.68b83abb9a1247525e09fce8: Non ho contanti con me. (Raccogli 2.000 USD)
it.68b83abb9afeb71430883f9a: Stai ragionando nella direzione giusta. Tutto nel nostro mondo ha un prezzo.
it.68b83abb9ea053d7abb5ac6e: Pavel Yegorovich mi ha detto che saresti venuto.
it.68b83abbb6aba85818bf7399: Sì, sì, sono stato informato. Stai cercando un SUV nero. Veicoli di questo tipo erano utilizzati dal personale di alto rango della TerraGroup.
it.68b83abbd595477c12e2b089: È un piacere fare affari con te, giovanotto. Inoltrerò il pagamento all'informatore. Torna un po' più tardi.
it.68b83abbfa537e5341a46d71: Solo attraverso me. In questi tempi, gli informatori non vengono distribuiti con leggerezza.
it.68fd72c24a87c4f020f8d790: Conosco qualcuno che può aiutarti. Sa dove sono stati visti l'ultima volta quella persona e il suo veicolo.

jp.68b6e8da51a4e9297cd31641: 資金は集められたのかしら？素晴らしいわ。
jp.68b6e8f1524c8e22435181dc: これだ。(2,000 ドルを渡す)
jp.68b6e8f935046a9ef0925124: 彼に送るわ。情報が入ったら、また連絡させてもらうわ。
jp.68b83abb105bf77b617bb209: この人物は常に、情報と引き換えにドルでの支払いを要求するの。現金を渡してくれれば、私が彼に渡しておくわ。
jp.68b83abb2af3142e3f5287a2: あんたに会いに行くよう言われたんだ...
jp.68b83abb378351390b2be0c1: これだ。(2,000ドル を渡す)
jp.68b83abb447800890cc54a7b: タスクの件で来たんだ。
jp.68b83abb95b542cc5cf1067a: 見つけて私のところに帰ってきてちょうだい。もちろん、本当に車両の場所を知りたいのならね。
jp.68b83abb96d0c718592f8871: 彼にどうやって連絡すれば良いんだ？
jp.68b83abb9a1247525e09fce8: 手持ちがない。(2000ドル を集める)
jp.68b83abb9afeb71430883f9a: あなたは正しい方向で考えているわ。この世のあらゆるものには代償が伴うのよ。
jp.68b83abb9ea053d7abb5ac6e: パヴェル・イェゴロヴィッチがあなたが来るって言ってたわ。
jp.68b83abbb6aba85818bf7399: ええ、ええ、話は聞いているわ。黒い SUV を探しているのね。そのような車両は TerraGroup の上位職員が使っていたわ。
jp.68b83abbd595477c12e2b089: お兄さん、貴方と取引できて嬉しいわ。情報を提供してくれる人へ支払っておくわね。また後で来なさい。
jp.68b83abbfa537e5341a46d71: 私を通してのみよ。今の時代、情報屋は簡単には渡せないわ。
jp.68fd72c24a87c4f020f8d790: あなたを助けられる人を知ってるわ。その人物と車両が最後にどこで目撃されたか、彼は知っているの。

kr.68b6e8da51a4e9297cd31641: 그만한 돈을 구해오신 건가요? 아주 좋습니다.
kr.68b6e8f935046a9ef0925124: 그 정보원에게 바로 전달할게요. 소식이 들어오는 대로 바로 연락드리죠.
kr.68b83abb105bf77b617bb209: 이 사람은 정보를 거래하는 대가로 항상 달러화만 받고 있어요. 저에게 돈을 주신다면, 제가 그 정보원에게 전달하도록 하죠.
kr.68b83abb95b542cc5cf1067a: 돈이 준비되시는 대로 저한테 돌아오시면 됩니다. 혹시 차가 어디에 있는지 정말로 알고 싶으시다면요.
kr.68b83abb9a1247525e09fce8: 지금 당장 나한텐 그만한 돈이 없는데. (2,000 달러 모아오기)
kr.68b83abb9afeb71430883f9a: 올바른 방향으로 생각하고 계시군요. 이 세상의 모든 것에는 다 그만 한 값어치가 매겨져 있는 법이죠.
kr.68b83abb9ea053d7abb5ac6e: 파벨 예고로비치가 젊은이께서 오실 거라고 알려줬네요.

ch.68c156959c1b6745036ad7e8: 你好。我们的人都知道，如果在补给方面出了问题，你能帮得上忙。
ch.68c156aa5341d57d897d31fa: 你太抬举我了，兄弟！来 Ragman 这儿，你想要啥都有，护甲、衣服，全给你安排！不过你不是来购物的，对吧？
ch.68c156c9e873cfad883ab739: 我需要去港口，但我不熟这个区域。
ch.68c156d766d0e03a4f134384: 想撤离？很多人试过……但你来对地方了！我会帮你联系对的人，给你指路。但先帮我办件小事。
ch.68c1570deb5e95842268e27c: Ultra 商场附近的森林最近有动静，可能还有车辆。我需要你去调查一下。我的人都忙着，这会儿你来得正好。
ch.68c1578da853537996d38577: 对，在立交桥那边绕着 Ultra 侦查一圈，多留意有没有发动着的车辆。发现什么都跟我说一声。
ch.68c157a36d03eccaa2cfe7cf: 有更有挑战性的任务吗？我可不是为了干这种活儿才接受的训练。
ch.68c157b4ea48b528488b4b14: 别急嘛，兄弟！你要是能挖到那边的动静，我们会给你更酷的任务。所以去调查一下，回来再说！
ch.68c1583617cb1e13c333eefe: 我查过立交桥周边了。在 Ultra 北边听到了有车队的声音。一切如你说的那样。
ch.68c1584ee7c737ae462c80ad: 哎，兄弟……别装傻行不行？Ultra 北边就是铁轨，那片林子小得跟没有一样！你再这样敷衍任务，就别再回来见我！
ch.68c158681165d22a52b7965f: 呃，我……可能方向搞错了……我等会儿再来。
ch.68c158d5b421b896f0866d82: 我把 Ultra 周围都侦查过了，没有发动着的车辆，也没有可疑声音。很安静。
ch.68c158fb77d18d095a7ae95c: 啥都没有？那营地也空着的话，肯定不是车队。那就没什么可担心的了。
ch.68c15911c90e6f3abbe703dc: 我的部分完成了。你答应过要告诉我下一步该怎么走。
ch.68c1591ff030ae1b564f810d: 我记得呢，兄弟！去海关那边，那是工厂旁边的工业区。那里有个本地商人负责那片区域，叫 Skier。记得去找他，但别在海关里瞎找——他八成已经回到北边港口的老窝了。去那儿和他谈。
ch.68c1592d17cd1804daee0976: 这个 Skier 对陌生人怎么样？
ch.68c15940145e7033a2ccbec0: 你得做好心理准备。他自己经历过不少事儿！不过我会先替你打声招呼，他肯定会见你。之后就看你自己了，兄弟。
ch.68c1596009346c7023091649: 嘿，要是撤离不成，记得来 Ragman 这边混！像你这种人，在我这永远有活儿干！

cz.68c156959c1b6745036ad7e8: Ahoj. Naši lidi říkali, že bys nám mohl pomoct, když máme problémy se zásobováním.
cz.68c156aa5341d57d897d31fa: Lichotíš mi, ahpere! U Ragmana seženeš všechno, co potřebuješ. Balistiky, parádní hadry, my tě vybavíme! Ale nepřišel jsi sem jenom nakupovat, co?
cz.68c156c9e873cfad883ab739: Potřebuju se dostat do přístavu, ale neznám tu oblast.
cz.68c156d766d0e03a4f134384: Evakuace, jo? Spousta lidí to zkoušela... Ale přišel jsi správně! Spojím tě se správnými lidmi a ukážu ti cestu. Jen pro mě nejdřív udělej jednu malou laskavost.
cz.68c1570deb5e95842268e27c: V lese u nákupního centra Ultra byl nějakej poprask, možná tam byly i nějaký vozidla. Chci, abys to tam prozkoumal. Moji lidi jsou zrovna zaneprázdněný jinejma kšeftama, takže seš tu ve správnou chvíli.
cz.68c1578da853537996d38577: Jo, pošmejdi kolem Ultra na Interchange a poslouchej, jestli neuslyšíš nějaký vozidla. Dej mi vědět o všem, co najdeš.
cz.68c157a36d03eccaa2cfe7cf: Nemáš něco serióznějšího? Na takovouhle práci jsem se necvičil.
cz.68c157b4ea48b528488b4b14: Klid, brácho! Jestli vyhrabeš nějaký informace o tom poprasku, seženem ti lepší prácičku. Tak to tam omrkni a vrať se!
cz.68c1583617cb1e13c333eefe: Prolezl jsem Interchange. Slyšel jsem motorizovanou skupinu severně od Ultra. Všechno, jak jsi říkal.
cz.68c1584ee7c737ae462c80ad: Hele, brácho... nehraj si se mnou na blbýho, jo? Severně od Ultra jsou jenom koleje, ten les je fakt malej, skoro žádnej! Jestli neděláš svou práci pořádně, tak se nevracej!
cz.68c158681165d22a52b7965f: Já, ehm, špatně jsem se zorientoval... Vrátím se později.
cz.68c158d5b421b896f0866d82: Prošmejdil jsem celý okolí Ultra. Žádný funkční vozidla, žádný podezřelý zvuky. Všude klid.
cz.68c158fb77d18d095a7ae95c: Vůbec nic, jo? No, jestli je i ten tábor prázdnej, tak to určitě není konvoj. Takže se není čeho bát.
cz.68c15911c90e6f3abbe703dc: Udělal jsem, co jsem měl. Slíbil jsi mi, že mi ukážeš cestu dál.
cz.68c1591ff030ae1b564f810d: Pamatuju si, ahpere! Běž do Customs, je to průmyslová zóna poblíž továrny. Vede to tam místní obchodník, říká si Skier. Určitě ho vyhledej, ale nehledej ho na Customs. Pravděpodobně se přesunul zpátky na základnu v severním přístavu. Promluv si s ním tam.
cz.68c1592d17cd1804daee0976: Jak se ten Skier chová k cizincům?
cz.68c15940145e7033a2ccbec0: Čekej cokoliv. Sám si toho hodně prožil! Ale já mu to za tebe vysvětlím, takže si s tebou promluví. Pak už je to na tobě, brácho.
cz.68c1596009346c7023091649: A hele, jestli ti ta evakuace nevyjde, stav se u Ragmana! Vždycky mám práci pro chlapy jako ty!

en.68c156959c1b6745036ad7e8: Hello. Our guys were told you could help if there are supply issues.
en.68c156aa5341d57d897d31fa: You flatter me, ahper! At Ragman’s, you can find anything you need. Armor, fancy clothes, we’ll hook you up! But you didn’t just come here for shopping, huh?
en.68c156c9e873cfad883ab739: I need to get to the port, but I don’t know the area.
en.68c156d766d0e03a4f134384: Evacuating, huh? Plenty have tried… But you came the right way! I’ll link you with the right people and show you the path. Just do one little favor for me first.
en.68c1570deb5e95842268e27c: There’s been commotion in the forest near the Ultra mall, maybe even some vehicles involved. I want that place checked out. My crew’s all tied up with other gigs, so you showed up at a good time.
en.68c1578da853537996d38577: Yup, scout around Ultra at the Interchange and keep an ear out for running vehicles. Lemme know about everything you find.
en.68c157a36d03eccaa2cfe7cf: Got anything more serious? I didn’t train for this kind of work.
en.68c157b4ea48b528488b4b14: Calm your horses, brother! If you dig up any info on that commotion, we’ll get you a cooler job. So check the place up and come back!
en.68c1583617cb1e13c333eefe: I checked the Interchange. Heard a motorized group north of Ultra. Everything as you said.
en.68c1584ee7c737ae462c80ad: Eh, bro… don’t play dumb with me, alright? North of Ultra is just the railway tracks, the forest is really tiny, like non-existent! If you don’t do your job properly, don’t bother coming back!
en.68c158681165d22a52b7965f: I, um, got my bearings wrong… I’ll come back later.
en.68c158d5b421b896f0866d82: I scouted all around Ultra. No working vehicles, no suspicious sounds. All quiet.
en.68c158fb77d18d095a7ae95c: Nothing at all, huh? Well, if the camp’s empty too, then it’s definitely not a convoy. Nothing to worry about then.
en.68c15911c90e6f3abbe703dc: I did my part. You promised to show me the way forward.
en.68c1591ff030ae1b564f810d: I remember, ahper! Head to Customs, it's an industrial zone near the factory. Local trader runs it, goes by Skier. Make sure you see him, but don’t bother looking for him on Customs. He’s likely moved back to his base in the north port. Talk to him there.
en.68c15940145e7033a2ccbec0: Expect anything. He’s been through a lot himself! But I’ll explain things to him for you, so he’ll let you talk. After that, it’s all on you, brother.
en.68c1596009346c7023091649: And hey, if the evacuation doesn’t pan out, swing by Ragman’s! I always have work for guys like you!

fr.68c156959c1b6745036ad7e8: Bonjour. Nos gars m’ont dit que vous pouviez aider en cas de problèmes d’approvisionnement.
fr.68c156aa5341d57d897d31fa: Tu me flattes, ahper ! Chez Ragman, tu peux trouver tout ce qu’il te faut. Armures, fringues stylées, on s’occupe de tout ! Mais tu n’es pas venu juste pour faire du shopping, hein ?
fr.68c156c9e873cfad883ab739: Je dois me rendre au port, mais je ne connais pas la zone.
fr.68c156d766d0e03a4f134384: Évacuer, hein ? Beaucoup ont essayé… Mais tu es au bon endroit ! Je vais te mettre en relation avec les bonnes personnes et t’indiquer le chemin. Mais rends-moi d’abord un petit service.
fr.68c1570deb5e95842268e27c: Il y a eu de l’agitation dans la forêt près d’Ultra, peut-être même des véhicules impliqués. Je veux que tu ailles voir ça. Mon équipe est déjà occupée ailleurs, alors tu tombes bien.
fr.68c157341bb0a5fcc6498302: Donc une mission de reconnaissance classique ?
fr.68c1578da853537996d38577: Ouais. Fais le tour de l'Ultra dans l'échangeur et tends l’oreille pour repérer des véhicules en marche. Dis-moi tout ce que tu trouves.
fr.68c157a36d03eccaa2cfe7cf: Tu n’as rien de plus sérieux ? Je ne me suis pas entraîné pour ce genre de boulot.
fr.68c157b4ea48b528488b4b14: Du calme, frère ! Si tu déniches la moindre info sur cette agitation, on te filera un boulot plus intéressant. Alors va vérifier et reviens me voir !
fr.68c1583617cb1e13c333eefe: J’ai inspecté l'échangeur. J’ai entendu un groupe motorisé au nord d’Ultra. Comme vous l’aviez dit.
fr.68c1584ee7c737ae462c80ad: Eh, frère… ne me prends pas pour un idiot, d’accord ? Au nord d’Ultra, il n’y a que les voies ferrées, la forêt est minuscule, voire inexistante ! Si tu ne fais pas ton boulot correctement, ne reviens même pas !
fr.68c158681165d22a52b7965f: Euh… je me suis trompé d'endroit… Je repasserai plus tard.
fr.68c158d5b421b896f0866d82: J’ai fouillé tout le secteur d’Ultra. Aucun véhicule en état de marche, aucun bruit suspect. Tout est calme.
fr.68c158fb77d18d095a7ae95c: Rien du tout, hein ? Bon, si le camp est vide aussi, alors ce n’est clairement pas un convoi. Rien d’inquiétant.
fr.68c15911c90e6f3abbe703dc: J’ai fait ma part. Vous aviez promis de me montrer la suite du chemin.
fr.68c1591ff030ae1b564f810d: Je m’en souviens, ahper ! Va dans les douanes, c’est une zone industrielle près de l’usine. Un marchand local y opère, on l’appelle Skier. Assure-toi de le voir, mais ne le cherche pas dans les douanes. Il est probablement retourné à sa base au port nord. Parle-lui là-bas.
fr.68c1592d17cd1804daee0976: Comment est ce Skier avec les étrangers ?
fr.68c15940145e7033a2ccbec0: Attends-toi à tout. Il en a bavé lui aussi ! Mais je vais lui expliquer la situation, il te laissera lui parler. Après ça, ce sera à toi de jouer, frère.
fr.68c1596009346c7023091649: Et hé, si l’évacuation ne se fait pas, passe chez Ragman ! J’ai toujours du boulot pour des types comme toi.
